text: Pag-abot sa Barangay Capuling, Dueñas, Iloilo, nagpundo ang grupo sang biktima agud magpangihi sang gulpi na lamang nakabati ang grupo sang paglinagapok.
english: Upon arrival at Barangay Capuling, Dueñas, Iloilo, the victim's group stopped to urinate when the group suddenly heard gunshots.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagdinalagan ang mga kaupdanan sang biktima kag ang 15 anyos nga biktima ang nagdiretso sa talamnan, samtang naglubong ang iya tiil, gani naabtan siya sang mga suspek kag ginbuno patay.
english: The victim's companions immediately ran away and the 15-year-old victim went straight to the field, while his leg was buried, so the suspects caught him and stabbed him to death.

text: Ginapatihan nga may daan na nga hiligut-anon ang duha ka grupo rason nga tuman ang kaakig sini sa biktima.
english: It is believed that the two groups had an old quarrel that caused him to be very angry with the victim.

text: Ginhingagaw pa kuntani nga dal-on sang mga residente ang biktima padulong sa ospital, apang gindeklara ini nga dead on arrival.
english: Residents tried to rush the victim to the hospital, but he was declared dead on arrival.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagpatigayon sang hot pursuit operation ang kapulisan nga nagresulta sa pagkilala kag pag-aresto sa isa ka suspek nga ginkilala kay alyas “Tam-tam,”samtang ang duha pa gid ka suspek ang padayon nga ginapangita sang otoridad.
english: Police immediately conducted a hot pursuit operation that resulted in the identification and arrest of one suspect identified as “Tam-tam,” while two other suspects are still being sought by the authorities.

text: Samtang sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo sa suspek nga si ”Alyas Tam-tam”, iya ginpahayag nga madugay na sini nga ginadumtan ang grupo sang biktima bangud nakaagi ini gintampuyong sang grupo sang biktima nga ginhalin sang iya kaugot sa mga ini.
english: Meanwhile, in an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the suspect, alias Tam-tam, said he had long hated the victim's group because he had been attacked by the victim's group.

text: Suno sa suspek indi man ini kuntani mangbuno apang gin-garit garit sang grupo sang biktima rason nga naimpito gid ini.
english: According to the suspect, he did not intend to stab but was stabbed by the victim's group, causing him to be injured.

text: Dugang pa sang suspek nga naghinulsol man ini kuntani apang wala na ini sang mahimo bangud napatay na sini ang biktima.
english: The suspect said he would have regretted it but he had no choice but to kill the victim.

text: Nabutang sa record sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) nga gin-imbitar sini kuntani bilang resource person si former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Catalina Cabral sa hearing sang Lunes, apang wala ini nagkadto.
english: The Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) records that it was supposed to invite former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Catalina Cabral as a resource person to Monday's hearing, but she did not attend.

text: Nagpadayon ang hearing sang amo nga adlaw, kun sa diin ang nag-atubang amo si AGAP Party-list Representative Nicanor Briones, apang naghingyo ini sang executive session, ukon wala gin-livestream.
english: The hearing continued that day, where AGAP Party-list Representative Nicanor Briones appeared, but he requested an executive session, or it was not livestreamed.

text: Matandaan nga isa si Cabral sa ginhingadlan sang ICI nga dapat pasakaan sang kaso sa Office of the Ombudsman kaangot sa alleged ghost project sa Bulacan nga nagabalor sang P95 million.
english: Cabral is one of those named by the ICI to file a case with the Office of the Ombudsman in connection with the alleged ghost project in Bulacan worth P95 million.

text: Ang amo nga proyekto ang gin-implementar sang DPWH Bulacan 1st District Engineering Office paagi sa contractor nga Topnotch Catalyst Builders Inc.
english: The project was implemented by the DPWH Bulacan 1st District Engineering Office through contractor Topnotch Catalyst Builders Inc.

text: Matandaan man nga ginlawag anay ni former DPWH undersecretary Roberto Bernardo si Cabral nga nagabaton sang cuts and control insertions para sa infrastructure projects sa National Expenditure Program (NEP).
english: Former DPWH undersecretary Roberto Bernardo also accused Cabral of receiving cuts and control insertions for infrastructure projects in the National Expenditure Program (NEP).

text: Pasado alas 12:00 kaina sang kaagahon, gindeklarar si Cabral nga patay matapos ginaalegar nga nahulog sa pil-as kag nasapwan ang lawas sini sa malapit sa Bued River sa Kennon Road sa Tuba, Benguet.
english: Around 12:00 this morning, Cabral was declared dead after he allegedly fell into a cliff and his body was found near the Bued River on Kennon Road in Tuba, Benguet.

text: Base sa pagpangusisa sang pulis, alas tres kahapon sang hapon, nagabyahe si Cabral kag ang iya driver sa Kennon Road padulong sa La Union, apang nag-request si Cabral nga magdulog sa Maramal, Camp 5, Camp 4, kag naghingyo nga magpabilin ini anay didto.
english: According to police investigation, Cabral and his driver were traveling on Kennon Road to La Union at 3 pm yesterday, but Cabral requested to stop at Maramal, Camp 5, Camp 4, and asked to stay there.

text: Nagbalik ang driver sa area sang alas singko sang hapon, apang wala na si Cabral.
english: The driver returned to the area at 5 pm, but Cabral was gone.

text: Sang alas syete na sang gab-i, nagpangayo na sang bulig ang driver sa pulis bangud wala gihapon nakit-an ang anay undersecretary.
english: At 7 pm, the driver asked the police for help because the former undersecretary was still missing.

text: Sang nag-responde na ang mga pulis, nakit-an ang biktima sa kilid sang Bued River.
english: When police responded, the victim was found on the banks of the Bued River.

text: Ginabanta nga 20 tubtub 30 ang kataason sang pil-as kun sa diin siya ginaalegar nga nahulog.
english: The cliff where he allegedly fell was estimated to be 20 to 30 feet high.

text: Wala pa sang kumpirmasyon kun may foul play sa insidente.#
english: There is no confirmation of foul play in the incident.

text: Kada easter pamilyar kita sa tradisyon sang iban nga pungsod nga egg hunting.
english: Every easter we are familiar with the foreign tradition of egg hunting.

text: Apang pamilyar ka man bala sang feather hunting sa Iceland?
english: But are you also familiar with feather hunting in Iceland?

text: Kada summer sa nasambit nga pungsod, kapin 400 ka hunters ang nagabantay sa isa ka remote island agud nga makapangita sang pinasahi nga treasure — ini amo ang pinakamahal nga balahibo sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Every summer in the country, more than 400 hunters patrol a remote island in search of a special treasure — the most expensive fur in the world.

text: Ini nga balahibo ukon feather ang iya ka Eider polar duck, sa diin makuha ang pinaka-natural fibers.
english: This feather is the Eider polar duck, where the most natural fibers are obtained.

text: Ang isa ka kilogram sang Eiderdown feathers nga gina-produce bilang luxury products, ang may baylo nga linibo ka mga dolyar.
english: One kilogram of Eiderdown feathers, which are produced as luxury products, can cost thousands of dollars.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang eider duck, naga-shed sang ila kaugalingon nga balahibo halin sa ila dughan agud makahimo sang nest.
english: It is known that the eider duck, shed their own feathers from their chest to build a nest.

text: Ini nga mga nest ang gina-ayam sang hunters kada-tuig sa ila Eiderdown hunt.
english: These nests are hunted by hunters each year in their Eiderdown hunt.

text: Nagpahanumdom liwat ang Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) sa online sellers nga magtuman sa registration kag tax remittance rules sang ahensya, bangud kun indi, igasuspinde gid ang ila operasyon sa idalom sang Online Kandado program.
english: The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) once again reminded online sellers to comply with the agency's registration and tax remittance rules, otherwise their operations under the Online Kandado program will be suspended.

text: Ginpaguwa ni BIR Commissioner Romeo Lumagui Jr.
english: BIR Commissioner Romeo Lumagui Jr.

text: ini nga statement antes ang ginapanan-aw na nga pagsaka sang sales sa online stores sa Christmas holidays.
english: this statement ahead of the expected increase in sales in online stores during the Christmas holidays.

text: Suno sa commissioner, pareho sa physical stores, obligado ang online stores nga magpa-rehistro sa BIR bisan daku ukon gamay man ang ila nga operasyon.
english: According to the commissioner, like physical stores, online stores are obliged to register with the BIR whether their operations are large or small.

text: “Pag dating sa pagrerehistro wala tayong minimum.
english: “When it comes to registration, we don't have a minimum.

text: Lahat ng nagnenegosyo, lahat ng naglalayon na magbenta online ay kinakailangang magrehistro sa aming ahensyo.
english: All businesses, all those who intend to sell online are required to register with our agency.

text: Ibang usapin yung kung may babayaran ba, o may ikakaltas na buwis.
english: It's another matter of whether to pay, or to deduct taxes.

text: Pero kinakailangan na magrehistro tayo sa BIR,” suno kay Lumagui.
english: But we need to register with the BIR,” Lumagui said.

text:
“Kung maliit naman ang negosyo ay wala namang babayarang buwis syempre hindi natin masabi paano kung biglang lumaki yan at hindi ka rehistrado, dapat sakop ka na agad at may babayaran ka na para madali na lang ang benta.”

Suno sa natungdan, may yara sang online registration portal ang BIR para mas mahapos sa business owners nga makaparehistro sa ahensya.
english:
"If the business is small and does not pay taxes, of course we cannot say how if it suddenly grows and you are not registered, you should be covered immediately and pay something so that the sale is easy.

He said the BIR has an online registration portal to make it easier for business owners to register with the agency.

text: Nagapakig-angot man sila sa dalagku nga online selling platforms para nga mapahanumdom sa ila ang ila katungdanan nga i-monitor kun naga-comply ang ila sellers sa pagsulundan.
english: They are also in contact with major online selling platforms to remind them of their duty to monitor whether their sellers comply with the rules.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Section 115 sang National Internal Revenue Code (as amended by Republic Act No.
english: Section 115 of the National Internal Revenue Code (as amended by Republic Act No.

text: 12023) amo ang nagahatag sang otoridad sa Commissioner of Internal Revenue nga magsuspinde sang business operations.
english: 12023) is what authorizes the Commissioner of Internal Revenue to suspend business operations.

text: “If retail/physical stores are registered and paying their taxes, online stores should do the same,” dugang ni Lumagui.
english: “If retail/physical stores are registered and paying their taxes, online stores should do the same,” Lumagui added.

text: Pahanumdom naman sini sa consumers sa holidays, “To all consumers, ask online sellers/businesses for an official receipt.
english: He reminded consumers during the holidays, “To all consumers, ask online sellers/businesses for an official receipt.

text: If you are spending your hard-earned income after paying taxes on their products, then online sellers/businesses should also pay their taxes.”
english: If you are spending your hard-earned income after paying taxes on their products, then online sellers/businesses should also pay their taxes.”

text: PARIS, FRANCE-Wala na nakaabante para sa gold medal match ang Filipino boxer nga si Aira Villegas matapos ginpierde sang kasumpong sini nga si Buse Naz Çakıroğlu sang Turkey sa ila medal round sa women’s 50 kg boxing event sa 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: PARIS, FRANCE-Filipino boxer Aira Villegas did not advance to the gold medal match after being defeated by her opponent Buse Naz Çakıroğlu of Turkey in their medal round in the women's 50 kg boxing event at the 2024 Paris Olympics.

text: Unanimous ang desisyon sang mga judges nga nagpabor tanan sa pambato sang Turkey.
english: The judges unanimously decided in favor of the Turkish fighter.

text: Sa pihak sini, may medalya gihapon si Villegas bangud assured na nga daan ini sang bronze medal.
english: Meanwhile, Villegas still has a medal because he is already assured of a bronze medal.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga medalya sang Pilipinas kasunod sang double gold medal ni Carlos Yulo sa men’s gymnastics.
english: This is the Philippines' third medal following Carlos Yulo's double gold medal in men's gymnastics.

text: Liwat nga gin-apinan ni U.S. President Donald Trump si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu kag gintawag nga “political witch hunt” ang ginapatigayon nga hearing batuk diri.
english: U.S. President Donald Trump has once again defended Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and called the hearing against him a “political witch hunt”.

text: Suno kay Trump, “terible” kag indi makatarungan para kay Netanyahu, nga ginakabig niya nga isa ka “War Hero” kag lider nga may dako nga kontribusyon sa relasyon sang Israel kag Estados Unidos, subong man sa pagpugong sa pamahog sang Iran.
english: According to Trump, it is “terrible” and unfair for Netanyahu, whom he considers a “War Hero” and leader who has made a significant contribution to Israel-US relations, as well as to containing the Iranian threat.

text: Sa isa ka post sa Truth Social, ginsiling pa ni Trump nga ang hearing mahimo nga makaapekto sa negosasyon ni Netanyahu sa Hamas, nga ginakaulamiran sang pagpabalik sang mga hostages.
english: In a post on Truth Social, Trump further said the hearing could affect Netanyahu’s negotiations with Hamas, which is concerned about the return of the hostages.

text: Ginpakamalaut man sini sang padayon nga hearing sa Prime Minister sa pihak sang mga seryoso nga isyu kasubong sang seguridad sang pungsod.
english: He also condemned the continued hearing of the Prime Minister despite serious issues such as national security.

text: Ginsaway man sang Presidente sang Amerika ang mga pag-akusar kay Netanyahu, kasubong sang pagbaton sang malahalon nga pagkabutang gikan sa mga negosyante kabaylo sang mga pabor sa politika.
english: The US President also criticized accusations against Netanyahu, such as accepting valuables from businessmen in exchange for political favors.

text: Samtang, padayon nga ginapakig-bato ni Netanyahu ang iya sini nga paging inosente kag hugot nga ginpanginwala sang mga pagpanimangod batuk sa iya.
english: Meanwhile, Netanyahu continues to maintain his innocence and has strongly denied the allegations against him.

text: Madumduman nga nag-umpisa ang hearing para sa Prime Minister sang 2020 para sa mga kaso nga bribery, fraud, kag breach of trust.
english: The hearing for the Prime Minister began in 2020 for bribery, fraud, and breach of trust cases.

text: Gintawag sang sexy actress nga si Barbie Imperial nga “fake news” ang impormasyon nga nagabusong siya sang ila mangin anak sang hunk actor nga si Richard Gutierrez.
english: Sexy actress Barbie Imperial has called reports that she is pregnant with her future son with hunk actor Richard Gutierrez “fake news”.

text: Ginhimo ini sang aktres paagi sa pagpanawagan sa iya fans nga i-“mass report” ang isa ka Facebook page nga Showbizfinds nga nag-alegar nga nag-ako siya nga makaangkon na sila sang aktor sang ila kaugalingon nga baby.
english: The actress did this by calling on her fans to “mass report” a Facebook page Showbizfinds which alleged that she confessed that they are about to have an actor of their own baby.

text: Lunsay kabutigan lang ang gin-post sang amo nga page suno kay Barbie kag ginklaro sini nga wala siya naghambal nga nagadala siya.
english: Barbie said the page posted all lies and clarified that she did not say she was carrying.

text: Wala naman gin-ako apang wala man gin-deny sang aktres kun matuod nga nobyo na sini si Richard.
english: The actress did not admit but did not deny if Richard is her boyfriend.

text: Antes sini, nakita sang netizens ang pila ka clue nga may relasyon ang duha bangud pareho ang ila background sa pila ka Instagram photos kag nakit-an pa sa South Korea nga magka-upod.
english: Earlier, netizens saw some clues that the two are in a relationship because they have the same background in some Instagram photos and were seen in South Korea together.

text: Matandaan nga antes sini nga espekulasyon, una na nga ginkumpirma sang asawa ni Richard nga si Sarah Lahbati nga bulagay na sila apang wala sang ginhatag nga rason.
english: Before this speculation, Richard's wife Sarah Lahbati had previously confirmed that they were separated but did not give a reason.

text: Ginkasal sanday Sarah kag Richard sang 2020 kag may duha ka mga anak nga sanday Zion kag Kai.
english: Sarah and Richard married in 2020 and have two children Zion and Kai.

text: Bantog na sa aton ang istorya angot sa red sea ukon dagat nga nag-ala dugo sa kapula.
english: We are familiar with the story of the red sea that turned red.

text: Apang sa New Zealand, bantog man ang tubig nga indi pula kundi neon green!
english: But in New Zealand, the water is also famous for being not red but neon green!

text: Nakakita ka na bala sang daw nagasiga nga tubig sa isa ka pond?
english: Have you ever seen what appears to be sparkling water in a pond?

text: Ang amo nga pond ang ginpangalanan nga ‘Devil’s Bath’ isa sa mga popular attraction sa Wai-O-Tapu volcanic area sa New Zealand.
english: The pond is named 'Devil's Bath' one of the popular attractions in the Wai-O-Tapu volcanic area in New Zealand.

text: 11 square miles ang kalapadon sang Devil’s Bath sa diin may yara sang viewing platform malapit diri nga mahimo tindugan sang mga turista agud makita sang maayo ang pinasahi nga view.
english: 11 square miles is the area of ​​Devil's Bath where there is a viewing platform nearby where tourists can stand to get a better view of the unique view.

text: Ang tubig sa amo nga pond ang may yara sang concentrated iron, rason nga may intense green color ini, kag may yara man sang sulfur concentration, nga nagatuga sang light green kag yellowish nga color sa tubig.
english: The water in the pond contains concentrated iron, giving it an intense green color, and a sulfur concentration, which causes the water to have a light green and yellowish color.

text: Curious ka bala kun mahimo makalangoy kag makapaligo sa ‘Devil’s Bath’?
english: Are you curious if you can swim and bathe in the Devil's Bath?

text: Ang sabat, INDI bangud tuman ka acidic ang lime-colored water sa amo nga pond kag posible nga ma peel off ang panit sang isa ka indibidwal nga magatusmaw diri.
english: The answer is NO because the lime-colored water in the pond is very acidic and is likely to peel off the skin of an individual who dips in it.

text: Isa ka lalaki sa Colombia nga masami ginaigo sang kilat ang nagdesisyon nga ilubong ang iya kaugalingon sa duta agud indi na siya maigo liwat.
english: A man in Colombia who is frequently struck by lightning decided to bury himself in the ground to prevent himself from being struck again.

text: Nagkutkot si Alexander Mandon sang buho tubtob sa iya liog ang kataason, gintabunan niya ang iya kaugalingon kag ang iya lang ulo ang nagguwa.
english: Alexander Mandon dug a hole up to his neck in height, he covered himself and only his head came out.

text: Ang iya lawas yara sa idalom sang duta sa sulod sang pila ka oras.
english: His body was underground for several hours.

text: Si Alexander isa ka soldado kag ginasuspetsahan nga may yara sang makatilingala nga kondisyon sa lawas nga nagahimo sa iya nga madali siya nga maigo sang kilat.
english: Alexander is a soldier and is suspected of having a strange physical condition that makes him vulnerable to lightning strikes.

text: Ang iya pinakaulihi nga inagihan amo ang pinakamabaskog bangud sa isa ka adlaw, makaduha siya nga naigo sang kilat.
english: His most recent experience was the most intense because in one day, he was struck by lightning twice.

text: Ang una nga pag-igo sa iya sang kilat ang yara siya sa sulod sang isa ka kampo kag sa maayo nga palad, wala man sang may natabo sa iya.
english: The first time he was struck by lightning he was inside a camp and fortunately, nothing happened to him.

text: Apang ang iya mga opisyales sa militar nahadlok nga basi mahalitan ang mga kaupod gani nagdesisyon sila nga siya ang pabakasyunon anay.
english: But his military officers were afraid that the comrades might be harmed so they decided to put him on leave.

text: Sang pagpauli niya, naigo siya liwat sang kilat.
english: On his way home, he was struck by lightning again.

text: Paralisado siya kag indi na makalakat bangud sang pag-igo sang kilat sa iya.
english: He was paralyzed and unable to walk due to lightning striking him.

text: Pila ka adlaw, nagpakonsulta siya sa doktor sa ila lugar kag ginlaygayan siya sang doktor nga ilubong ang iya kaugalingon sa duta apang kinahanglan nga tubtob ini sa iya liog bangud suno sa iya doctor, ang higko sa duta amo ang magasuyop sang mga electrical charges sa lawas ni Alexander.
english: A few days later, he consulted a local doctor and the doctor advised him to bury himself in the ground but it had to be up to his neck because according to his doctor, the dirt on the ground would absorb the electrical charges in Alexander’s body.

text: Matapos malubong ang iya kaugalingon, ginpahayag nga nakabatyag siya sang kaumpawan kag wala na sang report pa nga ginaigo siya liwat sang kilat.
english: After burying himself, he reportedly felt relieved and there were no reports of him being struck by lightning again.

text: Yara lamang sa P725 million ang ginpain nga pondo para sa Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) sa idalom sang ginaduso nga 2025 national budget — mas manubo sang P431-million sa 1.156 billion nga budget subong nga tuig.
english: Only P725 million has been allocated for the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) under the proposed 2025 national budget — P431-million less than this year's 1.156 billion budget.

text:
Kun basehan ang information nga accessible sa Department of Budget and Management website, nakapahat-pahat kun sa diin makadto ang pondo:

*P312.5 million para sa general administration and support*P158.2 million para sa Amateur Sports Development Program*P255 million para sa locally funded projects.
english:
Based on the information accessible on the Department of Budget and Management website, the funds will be divided into:

*P312.5 million for general administration and support*P158.2 million for Amateur Sports Development Program*P255 million for locally funded projects.

text: Sa P255 million nga locally funded projects, P175 million ang para sa preparation, training and participation para sa 2025 Southeast Asian Games sa Thailand; P56.7 million para sa 2025 Asian Winter Games sa Harbin, China; P11.27 million para sa 2025 Brunei-Indonesia-Malaysia-Philippines-Northern Territory-East Association of Southeast Asian Nations Growth Area (BIMPNT-EAGA) Games kag P11.97 million para sa Asian Youth Para Games.
english: Of the P255 million locally funded projects, P175 million is for preparation, training and participation for the 2025 Southeast Asian Games in Thailand; P56.7 million for the 2025 Asian Winter Games in Harbin, China; P11.27 million for the 2025 Brunei-Indonesia-Malaysia-Philippines-Northern Territory-East Association of Southeast Asian Nations Growth Area (BIMPNT-EAGA) Games and P11.97 million for the Asian Youth Para Games.

text: Nahibaluan nga daku ang gin-nubo sini ipaanggid sa P752 million sa 2024 national budget bangud ang 2025 ang indi man tuig sang Olympics, Youth Olympics kag Paralympics.
english: It is known that this is a significant reduction compared to the P752 million in the 2024 national budget because 2025 is not the year of the Olympics, Youth Olympics and Paralympics.

text:
Ang iban pa nga locally-funded projects sa idalom sang 2024 national budget nga wala nahatag sa idalom sang proposed 2025 budget amo ang:

Rehabilitation sang Rizal Memorial Sports Complex – P200 million

Rehabilitation kag upgrading sang Philsports Complex – P75 million

Philippine National Para Games – P10 million

Financial assistance sa athletes lakip na sa Community Sports Development, and Sports Activities – P174.2 million

Philippine National Anti-Doping Organization – P10 million

Preparation, training and participation in the Brunei-Indonesia-Malaysia-Philippines-Northern Territory-East Association of Southeast Asian Nations Growth Area (BIMPNT-EAGA) Games – P30 million

Indigenous Peoples Games – P10 million

Support sa Volleyball Nations League 2024 hosted by the Philippines – P80 million

Support sa Volleyball World Beach Pro Tour Challenge hosted by the Philippines – P10 million

Reserved Officers Training Corps Games – P65.91 million

Support sa Samahang Kickboxing ng Pilipinas – P5 million

Nahibaluan nga luwas sa P725 million allocation sa idalom sang proposed 2025 budget, mahimo magamit sang PSC ang National Sports Development Fund sandig sa nakasaad sa PSC law.
english:
Other locally-funded projects under the 2024 national budget that were not provided under the proposed 2025 budget are:

Rehabilitation of Rizal Memorial Sports Complex – P200 million

Rehabilitation and upgrading of Philsports Complex – P75 million

Philippine National Para Games – P10 million

Financial assistance to athletes including Community Sports Development, and Sports Activities – P174.2 million

Philippine National Anti-Doping Organization – P10 million

Preparation, training and participation in the Brunei-Indonesia-Malaysia-Philippines-Northern Territory-East Association of Southeast Asian Nations Growth Area (BIMPNT-EAGA) Games – P30 million

Indigenous Peoples Games – P10 million

Support for Volleyball Nations League 2024 hosted by the Philippines – P80 million

Support for the Volleyball World Beach Pro Tour Challenge hosted by the Philippines – P10 million

Reserved Officers Training Corps Games – P65.91 million

Support to the Philippine Kickboxing Association – P5 million

It is known that besides the P725 million allocation under the proposed 2025 budget, the PSC can use the National Sports Development Fund as stipulated in the PSC law.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakaagaw-atensyon man ini nga budget samtang nagapadayon subong ang Olympics kun sa diin naka-back-to-back gold medal si Carlos Yulo sa duha ka magkasunod nga adlaw sa artistic gymnastics.
english: It is known that this budget also attracted attention as the Olympics continue where Carlos Yulo won back-to-back gold medals in two consecutive days in artistic gymnastics.

text: Sigurado naman sang bronze medals ang female boxers nga sanday Nesthy Petecio kag Aira Villegas kag madamo sang iban pa na atleta ang natalana pa na mag-compete sa masunod nga mga inadlaw.
english: Female boxers Nesthy Petecio and Aira Villegas are sure of bronze medals and many other athletes are scheduled to compete in the coming days.

text: Ginkabos ang world no.2 kag tiglawas sang Pilipinas nga si Ernest John “EJ” Obiena nga makabulsa sang medalya sa Paris Olympics 2024.
english: World no.2 and Philippine representative Ernest John “EJ” Obiena is poor to pocket a medal at the Paris 2024 Olympics.

text: Sa 12 ka pole vaulters nga nag-qualify sa finals sang men’s pole vault, nagpang-apat lamang ang 28-anyos nga Pinoy pride matapos napaslawan ini nga ma-clear ang 5.95 meters sa iya tatlo gid ka attempts.
english: Of the 12 pole vaulters who qualified for the finals of the men's pole vault, the 28-year-old Pinoy pride finished fourth after failing to clear 5.95 meters in his three attempts.

text: Apisar sang resulta sang hampang, daku ang nangin improvement sa performance ni Obiena ipaanggid sa ika-11 sini nga pwesto sang una ini nga nagpasakop sa Olympics sa Japan sang 2021.
english: Despite the result of the game, Obiena's performance was a big improvement compared to his 11th place when he first competed in the Olympics in Japan in 2021.

text: Sa imbukada sang hampang sa Stade de France nga nagsugod 1:00 kaina sang kaagahon kag nagtakop pasado ‘las tres, nangin mahapos para kay Obiena nga ma-clear sang tag-isa lamang ka attempt ang kataason nga 5.50 meters kag 5.70-meters.
english: In the opening match at the Stade de France which started at 1:00 am yesterday and ended past 3:00, it was easy for Obiena to clear the heights of 5.50 meters and 5.70-meters with just one attempt each.

text: Sa ikatatlo na nga height nga amo ang 5.80-meters, natandog sini ang bar rason nga nagdesisyon ini kag si Coach Vitaly Petrov nga laktawan na lang amo nga kataason kag mag-diretso na sa 5.85m.
english: At the third height of 5.80-meters, he touched the bar so he and Coach Vitaly Petrov decided to skip that height and go straight to 5.85m.

text: Na-clear sini ang amo nga height kag nakakuha man sang 5.90m clearances nga amo ang nagbutang sa iya sa maayo nga posisyon nga makakuha sang medalya.
english: She cleared that height and also got 5.90m clearances which put her in a good position to win a medal.

text: Apat na lang kuntani sila nga nabilin sa kumpetisyon sang wala gid ini nagmadinalag-on nga ma-clear ang 5.95-meters sang tatlo ka beses.
english: They would have been four down from the competition when it never managed to clear 5.95-meters three times.

text: Si Emmanouil Karalis sang Greeze ang nakakuha sang bronze (via countback) apisar pa nga pareho sila ni Obiena nga may 5.90 nga final clearances.
english: Emmanouil Karalis of Greeze took bronze (via countback) despite both he and Obiena having 5.90 final clearances.

text: Una nga na-eliminate ang Pinoy bangud wala ini nakalapaw sang tatlo ka beses sa 5.95 meters.
english: The Filipino was first eliminated because he did not exceed 5.95 meters three times.

text: Ini bangud man na-perfect ni Karalis ang iya una nga mga lukso sa tag-isa lang ka attempt (magluwas sa 5.90 mark) samtang si Obiena naman ang naka-miss sa nauna sini nga attempt sa 5.80.
english: This is because Karalis perfected his first jumps in only one attempt each (except for the 5.90 mark) while Obiena missed his previous attempt in 5.80.

text: Wala naman sang nakibot sang nadepensahan sang world number one nga si Armand “Mondo” Duplantis ang iya gold medal ilabi na bangud makit-an nga chill lang ini halin sa pamuno sang kumpetisyon.
english: No one was surprised when world number one Armand “Mondo” Duplantis defended his gold medal especially since he was seen as chill from the beginning of the competition.

text: Gin-reset man sini ang world kag Olympic records paagi sa pag-clear sang 6.25 meters.
english: She also reset world and Olympic records by clearing 6.25 metres.

text: Nagpangaduha naman sa kumpetisyon ang world no.
english: The world no.

text: 3 nga si Sam Kendricks sang USA (5.95 meters).#
english: 3 Sam Kendricks of the USA (5.95 meters).#

text: Ginsaylo na ang model nga si Deniece Cornejo sa Maximum Security Camp sang Correctional Institution for Women (CIW) sa Mandaluyong.
english: Model Deniece Cornejo has been transferred to the Maximum Security Camp of the Correctional Institution for Women (CIW) in Mandaluyong.

text: Ini nga kampo amo ang ginahamtangan sang high profile nga persons deprived of liberty (PDLs).
english: This camp is home to high profile persons deprived of liberty (PDLs).

text: Base sa operating manual sang Bureau of Corrections, ang maximum security PDLs amo ang highly dangerous ukon high security risk nga mga preso nga nagalakip sang mga may minimum sentence nga 20 ka tuig pasaka.
english: Based on the operating manual of the Bureau of Corrections, maximum security PDLs are highly dangerous or high security risk inmates that include those with a minimum sentence of 20 years and above.

text: Matandaan nga gin-convict sang Taguig Regional Trial Court Branch 153 si Deniece sa krimen nga serious illegal detention for ransom sa TV host kag comedian nga si Ferdinand “Vhong” Navarro.
english: It can be recalled that the Taguig Regional Trial Court Branch 153 convicted Deniece of the crime of serious illegal detention for ransom of TV host and comedian Ferdinand “Vhong” Navarro.

text: Base sa pagsulundan, sa pagsulod sini sa Correctional Institution for Women, ginpatinir ini anay sa Reception and Diagnostic Center (RDC) kun sa diin ginadiretso ang bag-o nga mga preso sa sulod sang duha ka bulan lakip na ang lima ka adlaw nga quarantine.
english: According to the rules, upon entering the Correctional Institution for Women, she was first kept at the Reception and Diagnostic Center (RDC) where new inmates are directed for two months including five days of quarantine.

text: Matandaan nga magluwas kay Deniece, napamatbatan man nga guilty beyond reasonable doubt for serious illegal detention for ransom sanday Cedric Lee, Simeon Palma Raz Jr.
english: Besides Deniece, Cedric Lee, Simeon Palma Raz Jr. and others were also found guilty beyond reasonable doubt of serious illegal detention for ransom.

text: kag Ferdinand Guerrero kag ginsentensyahan sang reclusion perpetua kun sa diin paga-presuhon sila sa sulod sang 20 ka tuig tubtub sa kuwarenta ka tuig.
english: and Ferdinand Guerrero and were sentenced to reclusion perpetua where they will be imprisoned for 20 years to 40 years.

text: Kun basehan ang ila nga sentensya, sanday Raz, Lee kag Guerrero ang mahimo nga sayluhon man sa Maximum Security Camp sang New Bilibid Prison sa Muntinlupa halin sa NBP RDC.
english: Based on their sentence, Raz, Lee and Guerrero could also be transferred to the Maximum Security Camp of the New Bilibid Prison in Muntinlupa from the NBP RDC.

text: Hugot nga ginatutukan sang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) ang sitwasyon sang mga Pilipino nga naapektuhan sang nagapadayon nga tension sa border sang Thailand kag Cambodia.
english: The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) is closely monitoring the situation of Filipinos affected by the ongoing tension on the border between Thailand and Cambodia.

text: Suno kay DMW Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac, yara sa 56 ka mga Pilipino sa Cambodia kag 259 naman sa Thailand ang direkta nga apektado sang tensyon.
english: According to DMW Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac, 56 Filipinos in Cambodia and 259 in Thailand are directly affected by the tension.

text: Kadam-an sa mga ini ang mga manunudlo kag non-teaching personnel nga nagatrabaho sa mga eskwelahan malapit sa border sang Thailand nga temporarypo nga ginpa-evacuate bangud sa nagalala nga sitwasyon.
english: Most of them are teachers and non-teaching personnel working in schools near the Thai border who were temporarily evacuated due to the deteriorating situation.

text: Gin-report man sang tiglikom nga 22 sa 56 ka mga Pilipino nga yara sa Cambodia ang nakatalana nga i-repatriate sa pungsod sa masunod nga semana.
english: The secretary also reported that 22 of the 56 Filipinos in Cambodia are scheduled to be repatriated to the country next week.

text: Samtang, naghatag naman ang nasambit nga ahensya sang financial assistance para sa nagapanguna nga kinahanglanon sang mga manunudlo nga temporaryo nga nadulaan sang trabaho bangud sa kinagamo.
english: Meanwhile, the agency provided financial assistance for the basic needs of teachers who temporarily lost their jobs due to the unrest.

text: Posible nga i-withdraw ni Iloilo 1st District Representative Janette Garin ang House Bill No.
english: Iloilo 1st District Representative Janette Garin is likely to withdraw House Bill No.

text: 6292 – Expansion of MORE Power Franchise sa pito ka mga kabanwahan sa first district.
english: 6292 – Expansion of MORE Power Franchise to seven towns in the first district.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Garin, iya ginpahayag nga mahimo niya ini bawion inkaso nga magpasugot ang Iloilo Electric Cooperative (ILECO) nga panubuan ang presyo sang kuryente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Garin said he can withdraw it if the Iloilo Electric Cooperative (ILECO) agrees to reduce the price of electricity.

text: Suno sa iya makapila na ini gindala sa ila nga mga pagsinapol kaupod ang General Manager sang ILECO 1 Mike Paguntalan apang daw kaangay nga ginapabungolan lang nila ini.
english: He said it has been brought up several times in their meetings with ILECO 1 General Manager Mike Paguntalan but it seems that they are just ignoring it.

text: Dugang ni Garin, ang importante subong sa iya amo nga mapasar ang house bill agud mapanubo ang presyo sang kuryente, masulod man ukon indi ang MORE power.
english: Garin added that the important thing for him now is to pass the house bill to lower the price of electricity, whether or not MORE power is included.

text: Wala sang himuon nga sugar importation ang Pilipinas tubtub sa tunga-tunga sang 2025 bangud estable pa gihapon ang domestic supply kag bastante pa agud mahatag ang kinahanglanon sa pungsod.
english: The Philippines will not import sugar until mid-2025 as domestic supply is still stable and sufficient to meet the country's needs.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu-Laurel Jr., nalab-ot ini nga desisyon kasunod sang meeting kay Sugar Regulatory Authority (SRA) Administrator Pablo Luis Azcona.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu-Laurel Jr., the decision was reached following a meeting with Sugar Regulatory Authority (SRA) Administrator Pablo Luis Azcona.

text: “Administrator Azcona and I agreed that a decision on sugar importation could be delayed until after May, when the current harvest season ends,” suno kay Tiu Laurel.
english: “Administrator Azcona and I agreed that a decision on sugar importation could be delayed until after May, when the current harvest season ends,” said Tiu Laurel.

text: “Our supply for both raw and refined sugar are stable and we are just beginning our harvest season so Secretary Tiu Laurel and I agreed that there will be no sugar imports until after harvest sometime in May or June,” pahayag naman ni Azcona.
english: “Our supply for both raw and refined sugar are stable and we are just beginning our harvest season so Secretary Tiu Laurel and I agreed that there will be no sugar imports until after harvest sometime in May or June,” Azcona said.

text: Nag-umpisa ang current crop year sang Sept.
english: The current crop year began on Sept.

text: 15 kag matapos sa Agusto sa masunod nga tuig.
english: 15 and ends in August next year.

text: Gin-report man sang SRA nga naghinay ang pagsugod sang latest harvest season.
english: The SRA also reported a slow start to the latest harvest season.

text: Gina-angot ang total cane volume sa lower sugar content per ton of cane bangud sa El Niño nga rason kun ngaa gin-atrasar anay ang pag-harvest sang tubo para nga mag-gulang pa kag magsaka ang sugar content.
english: The total cane volume is linked to lower sugar content per ton of cane due to El Niño which is the reason why the harvest of sugarcane was delayed to allow it to ripen and increase the sugar content.

text: Ginalantaw nga ang sugar production sa crop year 2024-2025 ang magalab-ot sa 1.782 million metric tons nga mas manubo sang 7.2 percent ipaanggid sa figures sang nagligad nga tuig base sa nakasaad sa Sugar Order No.
english: Sugar production in the crop year 2024-2025 is expected to reach 1.782 million metric tons, down 7.2 percent compared to last year's figures based on Sugar Order No.

text: Patay sa isa lang ka mabaskog nga sumbag ang isa ka 50-anyos nga tiyo matapos nga ginsumbag sang iya hinablos sa sulod sang ila balay sa Purok-2, Brgy.
english: A 50-year-old uncle was stabbed to death by his nephew inside their house in Purok-2, Brgy.

text: San Roque, Mercedes, Camarines Norte.
english: San Roque, Mercedes, Camarines Norte.

text: Ang biktima amo si Vince, soltero samtang ang suspek naman amo si Hiro,26- anyos.
english: The victim was identified as Vince, single while the suspect was identified as Hiro, 26 years old.

text: Base sa impormasyon, nakit-an sang suspek nga ginasakit sang biktima ang iya adopted nga bata nga babaye.
english: According to reports, the suspect saw the victim hurting his adopted daughter.

text: Nangakig ang suspek rason nga ginsumbag niya ang tiyo kag nalipong.
english: The suspect became angry and punched the uncle and he fainted.

text: Gindala ini sa ospital apang wala na natabangan.
english: He was taken to the hospital but was not helped.

text: Naaresto naman ang suspek.
english: The suspect was arrested.

text: Ginaduso ni Commission on Elections (Comelec) Commissioner George Garcia nga tukuron ang task force batok sa fake news.
english: Commission on Elections (Comelec) Commissioner George Garcia has proposed the establishment of a task force against fake news.

text: Suno kay Garcia, iga-propose niya ini sa Comelec en Banc subong nga semana.
english: Garcia said he will propose it to the Comelec en Banc this week.

text: Ini bangud sa iya, nagaduging ang sala nga impormasyon sa social media.
english: This is because, according to him, false information is spreading on social media.

text: Pila diri ang nagasiling nga tapos na ang eleksyon, na-shade na ang balota, kag may mga nakaboto na nga daan antes pa man ang May 2022 elections.
english: Several of them say that the election is over, the ballot has been shaded, and some have already voted before the May 2022 elections.

text: Importante suno sa komisyoner nga maaktuhan ini agud indi madagtaan ang integridad sang eleksyon.
english: The commissioner said it is important to address this so that the integrity of the election is not tarnished.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, nagtukod man ang COMELEC sang Task Force Kontra Bigay nga nagatuyo naman nga tapnaon ang vote-buying.
english: Last week, the COMELEC also established a Task Force Against Bigay which aims to curb vote-buying.

text: Nagtaas ang presyo sang pagkaon sa bug-os nga kalibutan sang Oktubre — ini pinakamataas nga lebel sa sulod sang 18 ka bulan, nga may daku nga pagtaas sa bili sang vegetable oil.
english: Global food prices rose in October — they were the highest levels in 18 months, with a sharp rise in the cost of vegetable oil.

text: Suno sa Food and Agriculture Organization, ang FAO Food Price Index, nga nagabantay sang bulanan nga mga pagbag-o sa international price sang basket of food commodities, naglab-ot sa 127.4 points sang nagligad nga bulan, duha ka porsyento nga pagtaas gikan sa Septyembre.
english: According to the Food and Agriculture Organization, the FAO Food Price Index, which monitors monthly changes in the international price of a basket of food commodities, reached 127.4 points last month, a two percent increase from September.

text: Ini ang pinakamataas halin sang Abril 2023 apang 20.5 percent gihapon nga mas manubo sangsa pinakamataas nga nalab-ot sang Marso 2022 kasunod sang pagsalakay sang Russia sa agricultural powerhouse nga Ukraine.
english: This is the highest since April 2023 but still 20.5 percent below the peak reached in March 2022 following Russia’s invasion of agricultural powerhouse Ukraine.

text:
ILOILO CITY – Exciting suno sa Commission on Elections (COMELEC) ang modifications sa patigayunon nga ikaduha nga hugnat sang PiliPinas Debate 2022 karon sa gab-i.

Mangin sentro sang debate ang isyu sa government accountability, foreign relations at safety and security.
english:
ILOILO CITY – The modifications in the second round of the PiliPinas Debate 2022 tonight are exciting, according to the Commission on Elections (COMELEC).

The debate will focus on issues of government accountability, foreign relations and safety and security.

text: Agud nga mas exciting ang pagbayluhanay sang pahayag sang mga kandidato, gin-islan sang COMELEC ang sistema.
english: To make the exchange of statements between the candidates more exciting, the COMELEC changed the system.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni COMELEC Spokesperson James Jimenez nga mas ginpalawig pa sa duha ka minutos ang tyempo nga ihatag para sa mga kandidato kung ikumpara sa 90 segundos sang nagligad nga Marso 19.
english: Earlier, COMELEC Spokesperson James Jimenez said the time given for candidates has been extended by two minutes compared to 90 seconds last March 19.

text: May yara man sang 30 ka segundos ang mga kandidato para sa rebuttal.
english: Candidates also have 30 seconds for a rebuttal.

text: Ang siyam ka mga kandidato ang hatagan sang 60 seconds para sa ila nga closing statement.
english: The nine candidates will be given 60 seconds for their closing statements.

text: Sa amo nga format, tunga-on ini sa apat ka mga segment.
english: In such a format, it will be divided into four segments.

text: Ang una nga segment sang debate, sabton sang tanan nga kandidato ang general question.
english: The first segment of the debate, all candidates will answer the general question.

text: Ang dugang pa nga modification amo nga sa iban pa nga segment, tunga-on ang mga kandidato sa tatlo ka grupo kag hatagan sang tag-isa ka pamangkot nga amo ang mangin sentro sang ila nga debate.
english: Another modification is that in other segments, the candidates will be divided into three groups and each will be given a question that will be the focus of their debate.

text: Ang groupings ang mahibaluan pinaagi sa draw lots, las-singko sa karon sa hapon.
english: The groupings will be determined through draw lots, 5 pm today.

text: Sa pinakaulihi nga impormasyon, si former Sen.
english: According to the latest information, former Sen.

text: Bongbong Marcos ang indi na naman magtambong sa amo nga debate.
english: Bongbong Marcos will not attend the debate.

text: Ginhangkat ni Atty. Ferdinand Topacio si Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Atty. Ferdinand Topacio is President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga pangalanan na ang tanan nga may kahilabtanan sa anomalya sa flood control scandal.
english: to name all those involved in the anomaly in the flood control scandal.

text: Ginhimo ini ni Topacio sa isa ka forum nga gin-organisar sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino (PDP) ang political party sa diin siya mismo ang nagaserbe bilang deputy spokesperson.
english: Topacio did this at a forum organized by the Philippine Democratic Party (PDP) the political party where he himself serves as deputy spokesperson.

text: Suno kay Topacio, kun permi nalang nga ginapadayaw ni Marcos nga siya nag-umpisa sa imbestigasyon kag siya ang nagpagguwa sang pangalan sang mga dalagkuan nga contractor, dapat siya man ang magbuyagyag sang pangalan sang mga nagserbe nga mastermind.
english: According to Topacio, if Marcos always boasts that he initiated the investigation and he released the names of the big contractors, he should also reveal the names of those who served as masterminds.

text: Pahayag pa niya, Setyembre pa sang ginporma ni Marcos ang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI), apang nagapadayon nga mahinay ang lakat sang imbestigasyon kaupod na ang pagpa-priso sa mga may kahilabtanan.
english: He said Marcos formed the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) in September, but the investigation continues to be slow including the imprisonment of those involved.

text: Nagapati ang abogado nga nahibaluan sang presidente kun sin-o ang yara sa likod sang lapnagon nga korapsyon.
english: The lawyer believes the president knows who is behind the widespread corruption.

text: Ginakwestyon man ni Topacio ang Presidente, kun ano ang nagapugong sa iya agud ibuyagyag ang iya mga nahibaluan.
english: Topacio also questioned the President, what is preventing him from revealing his knowledge.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga lip-service lamang ang Nakita sang publiko halin kay President Marcos, kag nagapadayon nga nagahipos sa pihak sang nabuyagyag nga lapnagon nga korapsyon.
english: He also said that the public has only seen lip-service from President Marcos, and continues to remain silent despite the exposure of widespread corruption.

text: Nagpahayag si US President Donald Trump nga handa siya magbulig sa pagsolbar sang tensyon sa tunga sang Estados Unidos kag North Korea.
english: US President Donald Trump has said he is ready to help resolve tensions between the United States and North Korea.

text: Sa isa ka Oval Office event kun sa diin gin-highlight niya ang mga tikang agud nga maresolbar ang global conflicts, ginpamangkot si Trump kun nakasulat siya kay North Korean leader Kim Jong Un nga una nga gin-report sini nga bulan.
english: At an Oval Office event where he highlighted steps to resolve global conflicts, Trump was asked if he had written to North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, which was first reported this month.

text: Wala direkta nga ginsabat ni Trump ang amo nga pamangkot, apang ginsiling niya nga manami ang relasyon sini kay Kim Jong Un.
english: Trump did not directly address that question, but said he had good relations with Kim Jong Un.

text: Base sa website nga NK News nga nakabase sa Seoul kag naga-monitor sa North Korea, makapila ka beses nga ginbalibaran sang delegasyon sang North Korea sa United Nations sa New York ang sulat ni Trump para kay Kim.
english: According to the Seoul-based website NK News, which monitors North Korea, North Korea’s delegation to the United Nations in New York has repeatedly rejected Trump’s letter for Kim.

text: Matandaan nga sa una nga termino ni Trump sang tuig 2017 tubtob 2021, tatlo ka beses sila nagtipon ni Kim sa summit kag nagbinayluhanay sang mga sulat nga ginpahayag ni Trump nga “matahum” antes ang wala ginlauman nga diplomatic effort nga nagguba sang US demands nga buy-an ni Kim ang iya nuclear weapons.
english: During Trump's first term from 2017 to 2021, he and Kim met three times at the summit and exchanged letters that Trump described as "beautiful" before an unexpected diplomatic effort that broke US demands that Kim give up his nuclear weapons.

text: Sa iya ikaduha nga termino, gin-ako ni Trump nga isa na ka “nuclear power” ang North Korea.
english: In his second term, Trump acknowledged that North Korea was already a “nuclear power.”

text: Ginpahayag sang White House sang Hunyo 11 nga handa si Trump nga liwat mag-communicate kay Kim, samtang wala ginakumpirmar ang anuman nga sulat nga ginpadala.
english: The White House said on June 11 that Trump was willing to communicate with Kim again, while not confirming any correspondence had been sent.

text: Samtang ang North Korea wala pa sang interes nga magbalik sa negosasyon halin sang pag-untat sang diplomasya sang 2019.
english: Meanwhile North Korea has shown no interest in returning to negotiations since a diplomatic breakdown in 2019.

text: Sa subong, padayon nga ginpasanyog sang North Korea ang ila nuclear kag ballistic missile program, kag nagahugpong pa sa Russia pinaagi sa pagsuporta sa giyera sang Moscow sa Ukraine.
english: Meanwhile, North Korea continues to boost its nuclear and ballistic missile program, and is even aligning itself with Russia by supporting Moscow's war in Ukraine.

text: Magasugata sa masunod nga semana sa mga motorista ang big-time oil price hike.
english: Motorists will be greeted next week by a big-time oil price hike.

text: Suno kay Rodela Romero, Assistant director sang Oil Industry Management Bureau sang Department of Energy, ang pagtaas sa presyo sang gatong ang bangud sa paghina sang balor sang peso kag serye sang hurricanes sa Gulf of Mexico sa diin nahamtang ang oil rigs sang Estados Unidos.
english: According to Rodela Romero, assistant director of the Oil Industry Management Bureau of the Department of Energy, the increase in fuel prices is due to the weakening of the peso and a series of hurricanes in the Gulf of Mexico where the US oil rigs are located.

text:
Yari ang ginalauman nga pagtaas sa presyo sang gatong:

Gasoline – 1.10-1.40
Diesel – 1.70-1.90
Kerosene 1.10-1.20

Ipagwa ang pinal nga presyo sang gatong sa Lunes kag ipatuman naman ini sa Martes.
english:
Here are the expected increases in fuel prices:

Petrol – 1.10-1.40
Diesel – 1.70-1.90
Kerosene 1.10-1.20

The final fuel price will be released on Monday and will be implemented on Tuesday.

text: Ginahulat pa ang duha ka District Engineering Offices sa probinsya sang Iloilo nga magsumiter sang ginapangayo nga mga detalye kag dokumento sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan agud makapatigayon na sang imbestigasyon sa mga flood control projects sa probinsya.
english: The two District Engineering Offices in Iloilo province are still waiting to submit the required details and documents to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan to conduct an investigation into the flood control projects in the province.

text: Ini angot sa privilege speech ni 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar, nga nagpanawagan nga imbestigaran ang mga proyekto halin sang tuig 2022 tubtob subong nga tuig 2025 nga nalista sa “Sumbong sa Pangulo” website.
english: This is in connection with the privilege speech of 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar, who called for an investigation into the projects from 2022 to 2025 listed on the “Complaint to the President” website.

text: Ang imbestigasyon nagatuyo man nga magpalab-ot sa opisina sang Presidente kun may ara guid nga mga proyekto ukon laban lang diri mga ghost projects.
english: The investigation also aims to convey to the President's office whether there are any projects or mostly ghost projects.

text: Sa subong, ang mga nakapasa sang dokumento amo ang First District, 2nd District, kag 4th District, samtang ginahulat pa nga magpasa ang 3rd kag 5th District.
english: So far, those who have submitted documents are the First District, 2nd District, and 4th District, while the 3rd and 5th Districts are still waiting to submit.

text: Suno kay Iloilo Provincial Vice Governor Lee Ann Debuque, ginpahayag sini nga icheck anay ang kabug-usan nga mga dokumento agud kun may kulang, makahimo sang dugang nga follow-up communication.
english: Iloilo Provincial Vice Governor Lee Ann Debuque said they will check all the documents so that if there is anything missing, they can make additional follow-up communication.

text: Ginadumilian man nila nga matapos ang tuig nga wala pa na-assess ang mga dokumento.
english: They also prohibit the end of the year without having assessed the documents.

text: Dugang pa sang Bise Gobernador nga ginatagaan gid nila sang importansya ang insakto nga proseso agud nga mangin fair sa tagsa ka distrito ang ila mga tikang nga ginabuhat kag para mangin transparent ini sa publiko.
english: The Vice Governor added that they attach great importance to the proper process so that their steps are fair to each district and transparent to the public.

text: Nakahiligan mo man bala ang pag-kolekta sang imo paborito nga mga gamit?
english: Do you also enjoy collecting your favorite items?

text: Sa South Korea, may mag-asawa nga nangin bantog bangud puno ang ila nga two-storey house sang ila ginpang-kolekta nga basura sa sulod sang 10 ka-tuig.
english: In South Korea, a couple became famous for filling their two-storey house with garbage they collected for 10 years.

text: Nagapati ang mag-asawa nga manggad nila ang basura nga ila napangtipon ilabi na nga wala man sang trabaho ang 40 anyos nila nga anak.
english: The couple believes that the garbage they have collected is their wealth especially since their 40-year-old son is unemployed.

text: Sang nag-angkon sang balatian sa tagipusuon ang misis kag ginpanugyanan sang iya doktor nga magpuyo sa matinlo nga palibot, didto na kag nagpasugot ang iya nga bana nga hawanan kag kuhaon ang tanan nga basura sa sulod sang ila nga balay.
english: When the wife suffered from heart disease and her doctor advised her to live in a clean environment, her husband agreed to clean up and remove all the garbage inside their house.

text: Kapin 150 ka tonelada sang basura ang nakuha sa balay sang mag-asawa.
english: More than 150 tons of trash were recovered from the couple’s home.

text: Suno sa bana, handa siya nga mag-untat na sa pagkolekta sang basura para sa ikaayong lawas sang iya misis.
english: The husband said he is ready to stop collecting garbage for the sake of his wife's health.

text: Mangin international na ang reunion concert sang banda nga Rivermaya kag magasugod na ini sa Septyembre!

text: Sa pinakaulihi nga data nga ginpagwa sang Municipal Tourism Office sang Malay, Aklan, nagdangat sa kabug-usan nga 145,021 ang mga naglagaw sa nasambit nga white beach nga napalibutan sang mga palm tree, bar kag restaurants.
english: According to the latest data released by the Municipal Tourism Office of Malay, Aklan, a total of 145,021 visitors visited the white beach surrounded by palm trees, bars and restaurants.

text: Nagapanguna sa mga turista ang mga domestic tourist nga nagadangat sa 118,008.

text: Samtang 1,295 naman ang mga Overseas Filipino Workers kag Overseas.
english: Meanwhile, 1,295 are Overseas Filipino Workers and Overseas.

text: Nagdangat naman sa 25,718 ang numero sang mga foreign tourist nga nagbakasyon sa isla.
english: The number of foreign tourists who vacationed on the island reached 25,718.

text: Nakarekord naman sang pagtaas sang masobra 23,000 ang numero subong nga Oktubre kun ipaanggid sang Setyembre 2024.
english: The number recorded an increase of more than 23,000 this October compared to September 2024.

text: Imposible para kay presidential candidate Senator Manny Pacquiao nga maga-isol siya sa 2022 presidential race, apang ginbuyagyag man sini ang pangalan sang kandidato nga iya suportahan kun hinali nga ‘may sign halin sa Diyos’ nga magatulod sa iya nga mag-withdraw siya sa eleksyon.
english: It is impossible for presidential candidate Senator Manny Pacquiao to withdraw from the 2022 presidential race, but he also revealed the name of the candidate he would support if suddenly 'there is a sign from God' that will lead him to withdraw from the election.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Pacquiao, ginpahayag sini nga ang iya kaupod sa Senado nga si Senador Panfilo ‘Ping’ Lacson sng iya nga suportahan kun matabo gid man nga maisol siya sa iya nga presidential bid.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Pacquiao said his Senate colleague Senator Panfilo 'Ping' Lacson will support him if he is withdrawn from his presidential bid.

text: “Malabong mangyari yan (na mag-withdraw sa presidential race), pero kung sakali na magbigay ng sign sa akin ang Panginoon, then si Lacson, mas okay pa.
english: “It's unlikely to happen (to withdraw from the presidential race), but if the Lord gives me a sign, then Lacson, it's better.

text: Istrikto, matigas na lider, at mabusisi din pagdating sa budget ng Pilipinas,” suno kay Pacquiao.
english: He is a strict, tough leader, and he is also responsible when it comes to the Philippine budget,” Pacquiao said.

text: Pag-abot sa iya pilion nga bise-presidente, kun mag-isol man ang iya runningmate nga si Buhay Representative Lito Atienza, ginpahayag ni Pacquiao nga si Senate President Vicente Sotto III ang iya nga suportahan.
english: When it comes to his choice of vice-president, if his runningmate Buhay Representative Lito Atienza withdraws, Pacquiao said he will support Senate President Vicente Sotto III.

text: Si Sotto amo man ang runningmate ni Lacson.
english: Sotto is also Lacson’s runningmate.

text: Mismo si Atienza ang una nga nagpahayag nga si Sotto ang iya nga luyag nga magbulos bilang runningmate ni Pacquiao kun mag-withdraw siya sa vice-presidential bid.
english: Atienza himself was the first to say that Sotto is his preferred replacement as Pacquiao's runningmate if he withdraws from the vice-presidential bid.

text: Ginkumpirma man ni Pacquiao sa Bombo Radyo nga maga-istoryahanay sila ni Sotto tuhoy diri.
english: Pacquiao also confirmed to Bombo Radyo that he will discuss the matter with Sotto.

text: Ginapadasig na sang Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) ang pagtinguha para sa ambisyoso nga National Fiber Backbone (NFB) program agud makompleto ang proyekto sang isa ka tuig nga mas temprano sa orihinal nga target.
english: The Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) is now accelerating the effort for the ambitious National Fiber Backbone (NFB) program to complete the project a year ahead of the original target.

text: Suno kay DICT Secretary Ivan Uy, target sang ahensya nga makompleto ang National Fiber Backbone sa 2027, isa ka tuig nga mas temprano sa 2028 original target, matapos naka-secure sang $288-million loan halin sa World Bank.
english: According to DICT Secretary Ivan Uy, the agency targets to complete the National Fiber Backbone by 2027, one year earlier than the 2028 original target, after securing a $288-million loan from the World Bank.

text: Sang Abril, nakompleto sang gobyerno ang first phase sang National Fiber Backbone paagi sa deployment sang 1,245-kilometer cable network nga nagakonekta sang 28 nodes halin sa Laoag City, Ilocos Norte, pakadto sa Quezon City,nga nagasakop sang Northern kag Central Luzon, Metro Manila, kag apat ka Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA) ecozones.
english: In April, the government completed the first phase of the National Fiber Backbone with the deployment of a 1,245-kilometer cable network connecting 28 nodes from Laoag City, Ilocos Norte, to Quezon City,covering Northern and Central Luzon, Metro Manila, and four Bases Conversion and Development Authorities (BCDA).

text: Ini naka-deliver sang inisyal nga 600 GigaBytes per Second nga optical capacity.
english: It delivered an initial 600 GigaBytes per Second optical capacity.

text: Ang deployment naman sang phases 2 kag 3 ang ginahimo na kag makompleto sa tunga-tunga sang 2025.
english: The deployment of phases 2 and 3 is underway and will be completed by mid-2025.

text: Katuyuan sang ahensya nga maghatag sang government-owned high-speed fiber network, nga maka-provide sang public internet access para sa mga government agencies, public institutions, kag mga komunidad.
english: The agency aims to provide a government-owned high-speed fiber network, which can provide public internet access for government agencies, public institutions, and communities.

text: Ipasaka na subong nga adlaw ni DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian sa Office of the Ombudsman ang kaso batok sa 14 ka barangay officials sa Iloilo City nga ginaalegar nga nagbuhin sang ayuda para sa mga benepisyaryo sang Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS).
english: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian will file today with the Office of the Ombudsman the case against 14 barangay officials in Iloilo City who allegedly reduced the aid for the beneficiaries of the Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS).

text: Nag-ugat ang kaso sa reklamo sang mga benepisyaryo nga may mga opisyal nga nagbuhin sang P8,000 tubtob P9,000 gikan sa P10,000 nga ayuda rason nga yara na lang sa P1,000-P2,000 ang ila madala pauli.
english: The case stemmed from the complaint of the beneficiaries that some officials deducted P8,000 to P9,000 from the P10,000 aid, leaving them with only P1,000-P2,000 to take home.

text: Matandaan nga kadam-an sa mga nagreklamo ang halin sa distrito sang Jaro kag Arevalo.
english: Most of the complainants are from Jaro and Arevalo districts.

text: Suno kay Gatchalian, ang mga indibidwal nga involved sa kaso ang nagalakip sang punong barangay, kagawad, treasurer, kag iban nga appointed officials.
english: According to Gatchalian, the individuals involved in the case include the barangay captain, kagawad, treasurer, and other appointed officials.

text: Pamilyar ka man bala sa babaye nga nagtulog sa sulod sang madugay nga panahon kag nangin bantog sa pangalan nga sleeping beauty?
english: Are you also familiar with the woman who slept for a long time and became famous as sleeping beauty?

text: Sa India, lalaki naman ang nag-ala sleeping beauty bangud sa pinasahi sini nga balatian nga ginatunaan sang pagtulog niya sa sulod 300 ka-adlaw.
english: In India, a man became a sleeping beauty because of a special disease that causes him to sleep for 300 days.

text: Siya amo si Purkharam, isa ka middle aged nga lalaki, residente sang Bhadwa Village, Rajasthan, India, kag nagasuprir sa balatian nga “HPA axis hypersomnia”.
english: He is Purkharam, a middle aged man, resident of Bhadwa Village, Rajasthan, India, and suffering from the disease “HPA axis hypersomnia”.

text: 23 ka-tuig na ang nakaligad sang una nga nadiagnose sa amo nga rare disorder ang lalaki sa diin humalin sa masobra 15 ka-oras nga pagtulog, naglala pa ini sa 25 ka-adlaw, kag sa subong, nagadangat na sa halos 300 ka-adlaw ang pagtulog ni Purkahanam tuga sang iya balatian.
english: 23 years ago, the man was first diagnosed with the rare disorder where from more than 15 hours of sleep, it worsened to 25 days, and now, Purkahanam has been sleeping for nearly 300 days due to his illness.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang bulong para sa balatian sang lalaki sa diin ang iya gintestingan nga mga treatment ang may yara sang side-effects kaangay sang fatigue kag pagsakit sang ulo.
english: Currently, there is no cure for the man's disease where the treatments he tried have side-effects such as fatigue and headaches.

text: Apang sa pihak sini, kumbinisido man ang pamilya sang lalaki nga maabot ang adlaw, nga mabalik pa sa normal ang kabuhi sini.
english: But despite this, the man's family is also convinced that the day will come, that his life will return to normal.

text: Indi lang potensyal nga world title fight ang balantayan kay former eight-division world boxing champion Manny Pacquiao kundi isa ka pelikula!
english: Former eight-division world boxing champion Manny Pacquiao is not only watching a potential world title fight but also a movie!

text: Ini bangud maga-upod sa isa ka upcoming action movie ang Pinoy boxing legend kag ang American-Korean actor nga si Ma Dong-seok ukon kilala nga si Don Lee kag ang parte sini nga pelikula ang iga-shoot mismo diri sa Pilipinas.
english: This is because the Pinoy boxing legend and American-Korean actor Ma Dong-seok or known as Don Lee will be together in an upcoming action movie and part of this film will be shot here in the Philippines.

english: and movie producer Chavit Singson, the “Pambansang Kamao” and the “Train to Busan” actor have already met for this project which is scheduled to include Manny’s boxing expertise.

text: Wala pa sang kumpleto nga detalye nga ginpaguwa apang kabahin ang Pilipinas sang lokasyon sang action movie bangud plano man ni Lee nga magtukod sang studio diri sa pungsod particular sa Vigan.
english: No complete details have been released but the Philippines is part of the location of the action movie as Lee also plans to set up a studio here in the country particularly in Vigan.

text: Sang Abril, nagkit-anay man sanday Pacquiao kag Lee sa South Korea kun sa diin ginsiling sang South Korean actor nga fan siya ni Pacquiao kag nakapangayo pa anay ini sang autograph para sa Big Punch Boxing Club.
english: In April, Pacquiao and Lee also met in South Korea where the South Korean actor said he was a fan of Pacquiao and even asked for an autograph for the Big Punch Boxing Club.

text: Magluwas nga kilala sa iya performance sa “Train to Busan,” kilala man si Lee sa iya papel sa “Eternals” sang Marvel.
english: In addition to being known for his performance in “Train to Busan,” Lee is also known for his role in Marvel’s “Eternals.”

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, magluwas sa boksing kag pulitika, nakalusot man ang show biz commitments sa karera ni Pacquiao lakip ang katapusan sini nga pelikula nga WAPAKMAN nga nangin Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) entry sang 2009.
english: On the other hand, besides boxing and politics, Pacquiao's show biz commitments have also escaped his career including his last film WAPAKMAN which became a Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) entry in 2009.

text: May yara man ini sang documentary film nga “Manny” nga napaguwa sang 2015.
english: It also has a documentary film “Manny” released in 2015.

text: Indi pagpasugtan sang Senate ang pagbalik sang P45 billion nga ginkakas sa proposed 2026 budget sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: The Senate will not allow the return of the P45 billion removed from the proposed 2026 budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: Ini suno kay Senate Majority Floor Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri.
english: This is according to Senate Majority Floor Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri.

text: Ang amo nga amount ang pagagamiton kuntani para sa 10,000 projects sang DPWH, apang nagakontrahanay ang panindugan sang kamara kag senado sa diin ginainsister sang higher chamber ang amo nga budget cut.
english: The amount was supposed to be used for 10,000 projects of the DPWH, but the positions of the House and Senate are contradictory where the higher chamber insists on the budget cut.

text: Suno kay Zubiri nga suportado sini ang mga miyembro sang bicameral contingent sang senado, apang suno sa iya basi mahimo ini nga “pabaskuganay” kon ibalik ang bug-os nga pondo.
english: Zubiri said he supports the members of the bicameral contingent of the senate, but he said it might be “strengthened” if the entire fund is returned.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga mas maayo nga klaro kun diin nga proyekto ang mabuhinan ukon ibalik ang kwarta.
english: He said it is better to be clear which projects will be reduced or refunded.

text: Ginpunto man sini nga ang DPWH kag si Presidente Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: He also pointed out that the DPWH and President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: mismo nagsiling nga may overpricing sa construction materials, gani indi nagakaigo nga ibalik ang bug-os nga pondo.
english: itself said there was overpricing in construction materials, so it was not appropriate to return the entire fund.

text: Ginkumpirmar man sini nga mahimo nga ma-delay ang budget process.
english: He also confirmed that the budget process could be delayed.

text: Apang gin-athag niya nga wala man sang malain kun may yara sang reenacted budget para sa 2026.
english: But he clarified that there is nothing wrong with having a reenacted budget for 2026.

text: Ginbalik sang anay Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) director nga si Engineer Gerard Opulencia ang P40 milyon nga restitution sini sa gobyerno.
english: Former DPWH director Engineer Gerard Opulencia returned his P40 million restitution to the government.

text: Ini nga kwarta gintugyan sang anay opisyal sa Department of Justice sa pagpanguna ni Acting Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida bilang kabahin sang ginalauman nga P150 million nga kickbacks nga nakuha sa nagkalain-lain nga proyekto.
english: The money was handed over by the former official to the Department of Justice led by Acting Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida as part of the expected P150 million kickbacks obtained from various projects.

text: Ginpunto man ni Opulencia nga wala siya nakabaton sang kickbacks sa flood control projects sa Bulacan.
english: Opulencia also pointed out that he did not receive kickbacks for flood control projects in Bulacan.

text: Sa karon ginatugyan man siya sang DOJ sa Witness Protection Program bangod importante ang iya testimonya bilang kabahin sang imbestigasyon.
english: The DOJ is also now handing him over to the Witness Protection Program because his testimony is important as part of the investigation.

text: Kaupod man sang anay opisyal bilang provisional members sanday Roberto Bernardo kag Henry Alcantara, nga nagbalik man sang P110 milyon kag ginapaabot nga magabalik pa sang dugang nga P200 milyon sa gobyerno.
english: Also accompanying the former official as provisional members are Roberto Bernardo and Henry Alcantara, who also returned P110 million and are expected to return another P200 million to the government.

text: Kun kaadlawan sang imo pinalangga sa kabuhi, ano ang handa mo nga himuon para sa iya?
english: When it's your loved one's birthday, what are you willing to do for them?

text: Paghatag sang regalo, sorpresa, ukon pagpatigayon sang espesyal nga party?
english: Giving a gift, surprise, or hosting a special party?

text: Para kay Sharaine Domingo sang Cabatuan, Isabela, handa siya nga magpropose sang kasal sa iya nga kahagugma agud nga mangin mas espesyal ang sorpresa niya para sa kaadlawan sang iya nobyo.
english: For Sharaine Domingo of Cabatuan, Isabela, she is ready to propose marriage to her boyfriend so that her surprise for her boyfriend's birthday will be more special.

text: Suno kay Domingo, wala pa man nag-umpisa ang pandemya, plano na niya ini nga himuon rason nga kadungan sang kaadlawan sang iya kahagugma nga si Richard Angeles, wala siya nagduh-duha nga dayunon ang wedding proposal.
english: According to Domingo, even before the pandemic started, he planned to do it so coinciding with the birthday of his boyfriend Richard Angeles, he did not hesitate to continue the wedding proposal.

text: Tuman na lamang ang kalipay sang babaye sang nagsabat man nga ‘YES’ ang iya nga nobyo matapos siya nga nagluhod kag nagpropose.
english: The woman was overjoyed when her boyfriend replied 'YES' after she knelt down and proposed.

text: Nagtrending naman ang video nga gin-upload ni Domingo sa diin makit-an ang birthday suprise niya sa nobyo kag may paaman pa nga wedding proposal.
english: A video uploaded by Domingo showing her birthday surprise to her boyfriend and a wedding proposal is trending.

text: Walo ka tuig na nga magkarelasyon ang couple sa diin plano na sang mga ini nga magpakasal sa palaabuton nga Disyembre.
english: The couple have been in a relationship for eight years and plan to get married in December.

text: Mensahe ni Domingo sa iban nga mga babaye kaangay niya, wala sang dapat kahadlukan ukon ikahuya sa pagpakita sang pagpalangga para sa kahagugma.
english: Domingo's message to other women like her, there is nothing to be afraid of or ashamed to show love for love.

text: Masobra isa ka bulan na lang ang nabilin antes ang eleksyon apang nagapanindugan si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga neutral siya gihapon kag wala sang gina-endorso nga kandidato sa pagka-presidente.
english: With more than a month left before the election, President Rodrigo Duterte insists he is still neutral and does not endorse any presidential candidate.

text:
Ginpahayag ini ni Duterte sa iya pagsapol sa national kag regional task forces to end the local armed conflict sa Lapu-lapu City subong nga gab-i.
