text: Nagdasig ang inflation ukon ang pagsaka sang mga balaklon kag serbisyo sa pungsod sang nagligad nga bulan sa 2.3% ipaanggid sa 1.9% nga narekord sang Setyembre.
english: Inflation or the increase in goods and services in the country accelerated last month to 2.3% compared to 1.9% recorded in September.

text: Suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), ang mayor nga rason sang pagsaka sang inflation subong nga Oktubre amo ang mas mataas nga inflation sa pagkaon kag non-alcoholic beverages sa lebel nga 2.9% gikan sa 1.4% sang Setyembre.
english: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), the main reason for the rise in inflation this October was higher inflation in food and non-alcoholic beverages at a level of 2.9% from 1.4% in September.

text: Ang inflation sang bugas nagdasig man sa 9.6% gikan sa 5.7%.
english: Rice inflation also accelerated to 9.6% from 5.7%.

text: Sa subong, ang average nga inflation halin Enero tubtob Oktubre yara sa 3.3%.
english: Currently, average inflation from January to October is at 3.3%.

text: Nagboluntaryo nga magpakalbo ang aktres nga si Ryza Cenon para sa iya palaabuton nga pelikula nga “Lihim” sa idalom sang direksyon ni Mikhail Red.
english: Actress Ryza Cenon volunteered to shave her head for her upcoming film “Secret” under the direction of Mikhail Red.

text: Suno sa aktres, personal niya ini nga desisyon agud nga mangin epektibo gid ang iya pagdala sa iya papel sa amo nga proyekto.
english: According to the actress, it was her personal decision so that she could carry her role in the project very effectively.

text: “Pinaglaban ko talaga ito para maging effective ang portrayal ng role ko…For me, mas okay siya sa karakter ko at nag-look test po kami, hindi ko trip yung prostethics, hindi ko gusto yung hitsura.
english: “I really fought for it to make the portrayal of my role effective...For me, he was more okay with my character and we did a look test, I don't like prosthetics, I don't like the look.

text: Parang sabi ko, mas okay kung kalbo talaga.
english: I'm like, I'd rather be bald.

text: Mas makakatulong siya sa karakter ko,” pahayag sini.
english: He will be more helpful to my character,” he said.

text: Gindokumento man sini ang iya pagpakalbo sa iya nga latest vlog — istilo nga naapresyar pati sang iya anak.
english: She also documented her haircut in her latest vlog — a style that even her son appreciates.

text: “Natuwa naman po siya.
english: “He was happy.

text: Ayaw niya sa buhok, actually.
english: He doesn't like hair, actually.

text: Ayaw po niya ng buhok so nandidiri po siya sa buhok.
english: He doesn't like hair so he hates hair.

text: Kaya nung nakita niya po na kalbo ako, tuwang-tuwa siya.
english: So when he saw that I was bald, he was very happy.

text: Every time na hinahawakan niya ang ulo ko, para siyang kinikiliti, tawa siya nang tawa,” dugang sini nga nagatumod sa iya tatlo ka tuig nga anak nga si Night.
english: Every time he touches my head, it's like tickling him, he's laughing,” she added, referring to her three-year-old son Night.

text: Ginpabutyag man sang 36-anyos nga aktres ang excitement para sa iya bag-o nga movie kag nagalaum siya nga mapilian ini bilang official entry sa 2024 Metro Manila Film Festival sa Disyembre.
english: The 36-year-old actress also expressed excitement for her new movie and hopes it will be selected as an official entry in the 2024 Metro Manila Film Festival in December.

text: Kaupod sini sa proyekto sanday Heaven Peralejo, Eula Valdez, Nicole Omillo, Phoebe Walker, Mon Confiado, Rafa Siguion-Reyna, Gold Aceron, kag Skywalker David.
english: With her on the project are Heaven Peralejo, Eula Valdez, Nicole Omillo, Phoebe Walker, Mon Confiado, Rafa Siguion-Reyna, Gold Aceron, and Skywalker David.

text: Gin-disqualify ang French pole vaulter nga si Anthony Ammirati matapos nag-igo ang iya kinatawo sa crossbar sa iya pagtinguha nga malumpat ang 5.70m sa Paris 2024 Olympics.
english: French pole vaulter Anthony Ammirati has been disqualified after his penis hit the crossbar in his attempt to jump 5.70m at the Paris 2024 Olympics.

text:
“I was disqualified from the Olympics because my junk is too big.”

Nakuhaan naman ang slow-motion video sang 21 anyos nga atleta sang nagbunggo ang iya kinatawo sa crossbar.
english:
“I was disqualified from the Olympics because my junk is too big.”

A slow-motion video of the 21-year-old athlete was captured when his penis hit the crossbar.

text: Apisar nga nagtapos lang sa 12th place sa qualifying group, nangin instant social media sensation naman si Ammirati bangud sa insidente.
english: Despite finishing in 12th place in the qualifying group, Ammirati became an instant social media sensation because of the incident.

text: Madamo naman ang nagdayaw kay Ammirati bangud sa iya positibo nga reaksyon sa natabo nga mishap.
english: Many praised Ammirati for her positive reaction to the mishap.

text: Magahatag ang Kamara sang P3-million kay Carlos Yulo matapos ini nagdaog sang gold medal sa floor exercise sa gymnastics nga amo ang una nga medalya sang Pilipinas sa Paris Olympics 2024.
english: The House of Representatives will award P3-million to Carlos Yulo after he won the gold medal in the floor exercise in gymnastics, which is the Philippines' first medal at the Paris 2024 Olympics.

text: Suno kay House Committee on Appropriations Chairman Representative Elizaldy Co, ini nga award amo ang salamin sang suporta sa kadalag-an sang Pinoy kag kabahin man sang commitment sang lower chamber nga pasangkaron pa gid ang abilidad sang mga atleta nga Pilipino sa international sports scene.
english: According to House Committee on Appropriations Chairman Representative Elizaldy Co, the award is a reflection of the support for the Filipino victory and part of the lower chamber's commitment to further enhance the abilities of Filipino athletes in the international sports scene.

text: Mangin si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: It will be President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: ang nagpalab-ot man sang mensahe sang pagpanginbulahan para sa 24-anyos nga gymnast.
english: also conveyed a message of congratulations for the 24-year-old gymnast.

text: Wala pa sang pinal nga lista kun ano ang mga premyo nga batunon ni Yulo apang yari ang incentives nga na-anunsyo na nga daan para sa mga Pinoy nga makabulsa sang sini nga kadalag-an.
english: There is no final list of prizes that Yulo will receive but here are the incentives that have already been announced for Filipinos who can pocket this victory.

text: Posible pa ini madugangan kaangay sa nabaton sang weightlifting star nga si Hidilyn Diaz nga may total cash incentive nga masobra P50 million magluwas pa sa house and lots, condominiums, kag lifetime free flights kasunod sang iya pagdaog sang gold medal sa Tokyo Olympics 2020.
english: This is likely to be increased like the one received by weightlifting star Hidilyn Diaz who received a total cash incentive of more than P50 million in addition to house and lots, condominiums, and lifetime free flights following her gold medal win at the Tokyo Olympics 2020.

text: Kon may magtaliwan nga miyembro sang pamilya, ginahatagan gid naton sang importansya ang mga handumanan nga ila ginbilin sa aton.
english: When a family member passes away, we really value the memories they left us.

text: Halin sa baul, bayo, picture, alahas kag ano pa nga butang nga rason agud sila ang aton dumdomon.
english: From trunks, clothes, pictures, jewelry and anything else that makes us remember them.

text: Apang suksukon mo ayhan ang isa ka alahas kon ang pendant kag gin-gamit nga materyal diri amo ang iya ngipon.
english: But you would probably wear a piece of jewelry if the pendant and used material here were his teeth.

text: Didto sa Australia, may isa ka alahera ukon jeweller nga kilala bangud sa iya pinasahi nga pamaagi sang paghimo sang mga commemorative nga mga alahas nga may nakabutang nga ngipon sang nagtaliwan nga himata.
english: In Australia, there is a jeweler who is known for his unique way of making commemorative jewelry with the tooth of a deceased relative.

text: Siya amo si Jacqui Williams, 29, tag-iya sang Grave Metallum Jewellery.
english: She is Jacqui Williams, 29, owner of Grave Metallum Jewellery.

text: Sadto isa siya ka hardinero sa isa ka patyo apang sang ulihi, nangin isa ka full time nga alahera apang indi ordinaryo ang iya mga ginahimo.
english: He used to be a gardener in a courtyard but later, he became a full time jeweler but his works were not ordinary.

text: Gina-offer niya sa iya mga kliyente kon interesado sila nga magpahimo sang alahas nga may buhok ukon ngipon sang ila nagtaliwan nga himata bilang remembrance kag madamo man ang nagkainteres diri.
english: She offers her clients if they are interested to have jewelry made with the hair or teeth of their deceased relative as a remembrance and many have also shown interest in it.

text: Suno kay Jacqui, ini ang iya pamaagi agud makabulig sa nabatyagan nga kalisod sang mga tawo nga napatyan sang miyembro sang pamilya.
english: According to Jacqui, this is her way to help the people who have lost a family member.

text: Ang tagsa ka alahas nagalawig sang tubtob 2 ka bulan antes matapos kag nagabalor sang ($10,000 AUD) ukon 374,461.94 pesos.
english: Each piece of jewelry takes up to 2 months to complete and costs ($10,000 AUD) or 374,461.94 pesos.

text: Mas nagtunog ang espekulasyon nga natapos na ang relasyon nanday Paolo Contis kag Yen Santos.
english: The speculation that the relationship between Paolo Contis and Yen Santos is over has become louder.

text: Ini matapos nanotisyaran nga ginhimo ni Paolo nga private ang iya nga Instagram page kag ginpang-unfollow na sini ang tanan sa amo nga social media platform lakip na si Yen.
english: This was after it was noticed that Paolo had made his Instagram page private and had unfollowed everyone on the social media platform including Yen.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, nadiparahan man sang Internet users nga wala na ang birthday post ni Yen para kay Paolo kag wala naman ini sang gina-follow sa Instagram.
english: Last month, Internet users also noticed that Yen's birthday post for Paolo was gone and that he was not following anyone on Instagram.

text:
Katapusan nga naka-post si Paolo kaangot kay Yen sang Nobyembre 2022 kadungan sang iya birthday kun sa diin iya ini gintawag nga “My Best Actress.”

Sang Mayo subong nga tuig, nagsabat si Paolo nga gusto sini nga “personal” lang anay ang mga bagay-bagay sang gindabukan ang isyu sang break-up.
english:
Paolo last posted about Yen in November 2022 on her birthday where he called her “My Best Actress.”

In May this year, Paolo replied that he wanted things to be “personal” when the issue of break-up was raised.

text: 2021 sang naglupok ang kontrobersiya nga naga-date ang duha nga kadungan man sang kontrobersyal nga breakup nanday LJ kag Paolo bisan pa may anak sila nga si Summer.
english: 2021 when controversy erupted that the two were dating which also coincided with LJ and Paolo’s controversial breakup despite having a daughter named Summer.

text: Enero 2023 sang ginkumpirma ang relasyon nanday Yen kag Paolo apang gina-insister nga indi third party si Yen sa una nga relasyon sang aktor.
english: It was January 2023 when Yen and Paolo’s relationship was confirmed but it is insisted that Yen was not a third party to the actor’s previous relationship.

text: Gin-nominate si US President Donald Trump para sa Nobel Peace Prize.
english: US President Donald Trump has been nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize.

text: Si Rep.
english: Rep.

text: Earl “Buddy” Carter sang Georgia amo ang naghimo sang nominasyon sa diin gintumod sini ang “extraordinary kag historic nga papel ni Trump sa pagpatunga agud tapuson ang away sa tunga sang Israel kag Iran” kag pagpugong sa Tehran nga maangkon ang pinakamakamamatay nga mga armas sa planeta.
english: Earl “Buddy” Carter of Georgia made the nomination in which he referred to Trump’s “extraordinary and historic role in mediating to end the fight between Israel and Iran” and preventing Tehran from acquiring the deadliest weapons on the planet.

text: Sa sulat nga ginpadala ni Carter sa head sang Norwegian Nobel Commission sa Oslo matapos gin-anunsyo ni Trump ang ceasefire, ginpahayag sang senador nga ini nga maisog nga lihok ni Trump ang nagapakita sang ideals nga amo ang ginapangita sang peace prize nga kilalahon: ang pursuit of peace, prevention of war, kag advancement of international harmony.
english: In a letter Carter sent to the head of the Norwegian Nobel Commission in Oslo after Trump announced the ceasefire, the senator said this bold move by Trump reflects the ideals that the peace prize seeks to recognize: the pursuit of peace, prevention of war, and advancement of international harmony.

text: Suno kay Cater, ang mensahe ni Trump tuhoy sa pagrespeto kag kalinong ang magaresulta sa pag-untat sang military activity kag pagslbar sa minilyon nga kabuhi sa Middle East kag iban nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: According to Cater, Trump's message of respect and peace will result in a halt to military activity and save millions of lives in the Middle East and other parts of the world.

text: Ginmanduan ni Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz ang Israel Defense Forces nga atakehon ang Tehran matapos ginpaulanan sang missiles sang Iran ang Israel.
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz ordered the Israel Defense Forces to attack Tehran after Iran rained missiles on Israel.

text: Suno kay Katz, ang nangin tikang sang Iran ang ginakabig nga paglapas sa gindeklara nga ceasefire.
english: According to Katz, Iran's move is considered a violation of the declared ceasefire.

text: “In light of Iran’s blatant violation of the ceasefire declared by the President of the United States… I have instructed the IDF (Israel Defense Forces)… to continue high-intensity operations targeting regime assets and terror infrastructure in Tehran,” pahayag ni Katz.
english: “In light of Iran’s blatant violation of the ceasefire declared by the President of the United States… I have instructed the IDF (Israel Defense Forces)… to continue high-intensity operations targeting regime assets and terror infrastructure in Tehran,” Katz said.

text: Gin-aresto ang 43-anyos nga American singer-songwriter nga si Justin Timberlake bangud sa pagmaneho apisar hubog sa New York sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: 43-year-old American singer-songwriter Justin Timberlake was arrested for drunk driving in New York in the United States of America.

text: Base sa pahayag sang local district attorney’s office sang Sag Harbor, nadakpan ang singer sa Long Island matapos nga wala sini ginsunod ang “stop” sign kag duha ka beses nga nagsaylo sang lane.
english: According to the local district attorney's office of Sag Harbor, the singer was arrested on Long Island after he failed to obey a stop sign and changed lanes twice.

text: Tatlo ka beses man sini nga ginpangindian ang chemical test apang maathag suno sa pulis nga nagapanimaho na ini sang ilimnon sang ginparahan sang pulis pasado 12:00 sa kagab-ihon.
english: He also refused the chemical test three times but it was clear that he was smelling of alcohol when he was stopped by the police around 12:00 pm.

text: Sunod nga nagguluwa ang mga impormasyon nga hubog na si Timberlake antes ini nagguwa sa party malapit sa area kun sa diin siya nadakpan.
english: Reports subsequently surfaced that Timberlake was drunk before he left the party near the area where he was arrested.

text: Ginpabilin ini sa kustodiya sang pulis sa amo nga gab-i apang ginpaguwa man pagkasunod nga adlaw.
english: He was kept in police custody that night but was also released the next day.

text: Natalana ang iya pag-atubang sa korte sa Hulyo 26.
english: He is scheduled to appear in court on July 26.

text: Nahibaluan nga on tour subong ang pop singer sa iya album nga “Everything I Thought It Was.” Sa weekend, natalana ang concert sini sa Chicago kag may duha ka shows sa New York City sa masunod nga semana.
english: The pop singer is currently on tour with her album “Everything I Thought It Was.” On the weekend, it has a concert in Chicago and two shows in New York City next week.

text: ILOILO CITY- Hello sa mga plantito kag plantita!
english: ILOILO CITY- Hello to the plants and plants!

text: Indi bala nanamian gid kamo nga magtandog sang mga tanom kag simhutan ang mga ini ilabi na kon matahum ini sa imo panulukan?
english: Don't you enjoy touching plants and smelling them especially when they are beautiful to your eyes?

text: Apang maapresyar mo ayhan ang isa ka hardin nga imo kadtuan nga indi mo mahikap, indi mo man masimhutan kag kon indi ka gid makapugong basi amo pa ini ang magdul-ong sa imo sa ulihi nga palahuwayan?
english: But can you appreciate a garden you go to that you can't touch, you can't smell and if you can't help it, it might be the one that leads you to your final resting place?

text: Sa Northumberland, England, may yara sang ginatawag nga The Alnwick Garden.
english: In Northumberland, England, there is something called The Alnwick Garden.

text: Kag ini ginbansagan nga pinakamakamamatay nga hardin.
english: And it was nicknamed the deadliest garden.

text: May yara na gani sang mga nagbisita diri nga nagkalalipong.
english: There are even those who have visited here who have fainted.

text: Ang rason amo nga ang makit-an sa hardin ang kapin 100 ‘toxic, intoxicating, kag narcotic’ plants.
english: The reason is that the garden contains more than 100 toxic, intoxicating, and narcotic plants.

text: Ginalakipan ini sang monkshood nga bulak nga wala lamang nagapamunga sang makamamatay nga berries kundi mangin ang dahon kag puno sini ang makapatay sa tawo.
english: It includes the monkshood flower that not only produces deadly berries but also its leaves and stems can kill humans.

text: Yara man ang giant hogweed nga phototoxic, nga mahimo magsunog sa imo panit kag magresulta sang pagtubo sang bitog-bitog nga magatinir sa imo panit sang pito ka tuig.
english: There is also the giant hogweed which is phototoxic, which can burn your skin and result in the growth of moles that will stay on your skin for seven years.

text: Sa subong, ang mga luyag magkadto sa hardin nga napalibutan sang salsalon nga gate kag kudal ang kinahanglan nga magsuksok sang safety suits kag kinahanglan nga magsunod gid sa tour guide agud indi mabutang sa peligro ang ila kabuhi.
english: Currently, those who wish to visit the garden surrounded by an iron gate and fence are required to wear safety suits and must strictly follow the tour guide so as not to put their lives in danger.

text: Matapos ang inadlaw nga pagpangulihot sang Pilipinas sa medal tally sa Paris Olympics 2024, nakaangkon na gid man sang gold medal ang nasyon kag nakanta pa ang “Lupang Hinirang” sa atubang sang linibo ka mga tawo sa France sang nagkampyon si Carlos Edriel Yulo sa finals sang floor exercise sa men’s artistic gymnastics.
english: After the Philippines' day-long struggle in the medal tally at the Paris 2024 Olympics, the country finally won a gold medal and sang “Lupang Hinirang” in front of thousands of people in France when Carlos Edriel Yulo won the finals of the floor exercise in men's artistic gymnastics.

text: Ginhimo ni Yulo ang maragtason nga kadalag-an sa Bercy Arena kun sa diin naka-skor ini sang 15.000 points kag nangin ikaduha nga Olympic champion sa maragtas sang Pilipinas kasunod sang nahimo ni Hidilyn Diaz sa weightlifting sa Tokyo Olympics 2020.
english: Yulo made a historic victory at the Bercy Arena where she scored 15,000 points and became the second Olympic champion in Philippine history after Hidilyn Diaz in weightlifting at the Tokyo Olympics 2020.

text: Ginlutos ni Yulo ang defending gold medalist nga si Artem Dolgopyat sang Israel nga naka-skor lamang sang 14.966 points kag nagpangaduha lamang sa ranking, samtang ang top qualifier naman nga Filipino-British gymnast nga si Jake Jarman sang Great Britain amo ang nakakuha sang bronze medal matapos nakapagkit sang 14.933 points.
english: Yulo beat defending gold medalist Artem Dolgopyat of Israel who scored only 14.966 points and finished second in the ranking, while top qualifier Filipino-British gymnast Jake Jarman of Great Britain won the bronze medal after scoring 14.93 points.

text: Walo ang mga nag-perform sa finale sang floor exercise kag si Yulo ang ikatatlo nga nagpakita sang routine sunod sa Israel kag sa Tokyo Olympics silver medalist nga si Rayderley Zapata (14.333).
english: Eight performed in the finale of the floor exercise and Yulo was the third to show the routine behind Israel and Tokyo Olympics silver medalist Rayderley Zapata (14.333).

text: Pagkatapos kay Yulo, nagsunod ang lima ka iban pa nga gymnasts sa pag-perform sang ila routine kun sa diin ginabasehan ang difficulty kag ang katinlo kag kaayuhon sang execution apang ang 24-anyos lamang nga tumandok sang Malate, Manila amo ang isahanon nga nakalab-ot sa 15-point mark sa amo nga apparatus.
english: After Yulo, five other gymnasts followed in performing their routine based on difficulty and cleanliness and good execution but only the 24-year-old native of Malate, Manila was the only one who reached the 15-point mark on the apparatus.

text: Magluwas nga una ini nga medalya sang Pilipinas sa Paris Games, ini man ang una nga podium finish sang Pilipinas sa gymnastics sa Olympics.
english: Besides being the Philippines' first medal at the Paris Games, it was also the Philippines' first podium finish in gymnastics at the Olympics.

text: Ginbawi gid ni Yulo ang iya anay kapaslawan sa Tokyo Games kun sa diin wala ini nakasulod sa floor exercise final kag nagpang-apat naman sa vault.
english: Yulo made up for her previous failure at the Tokyo Games where she did not make it to the floor exercise final and finished fourth in the vault.

text: Bangud sa iya gold medal, kumpleto na ang floor exercise collection ni Yulo nga nagalakip man sang mga titulo sa World Artistic Gymnastics Championships, Asian Artistic Gymnastics Championships, kag Southeast Asian Games.
english: Thanks to her gold medal, Yulo’s floor exercise collection is complete which also includes titles in the World Artistic Gymnastics Championships, Asian Artistic Gymnastics Championships, and Southeast Asian Games.

text: Posible pa nga madugangan ang medalya sang Filipino gymnast bangud subong nga adlaw, Agusto 4, naka-schedule man ang medal round sa isa pa sa iya pet events nga amo ang vault kun sa diin isa man siya sa finalists.
english: The Filipino gymnast is likely to win more medals because today, August 4, the medal round is also scheduled in another of her pet events, the vault where she is also one of the finalists.

text:
Kun matandaan, sang nagligad nga gab-i, sulod man si Yulo sa finals sang all-around gymnastics apang nagpang-12 lamang siya sa 24 ka gymnasts bangud naglagbong ini sa una nga apparatus nga pommel horse matapos nga nadulaan sang balanse kag nahulog sa mat.#

(Screenshot from OneSports)
english:
Last night, Yulo also entered the finals of all-around gymnastics but he was only 12th out of 24 gymnasts because he fell on the first apparatus, the pommel horse, after losing his balance and falling to the mat.

(Screenshot from OneSports)

text: Magalunsar ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) sang isa ka imbestigasyon agod mahibaluan kon bala ang pagdugang sang importasyon sang semento nagatuga ukon nagapamahog nga magtuga sang daku nga halit sa domestic industry.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) will launch an inquiry to determine whether increased cement imports are causing or threatening to cause significant damage to the domestic industry.

text: Suno kay Trade Secretary Ma.
english: According to Trade Secretary Ma.

text: Cristina Roque, santo sa Section 6 sang Republic Act No.8800 ukon Safeguard Measures Act nga nagasaad nga ang DTI Secretary mahimo nga mag-umpisa sang preliminary safeguard investigation kon may yara sang ebidensya nga ang dugang nga pag-import sang ginakonsiderar nga produkto ang mangin pamahog sa isa ka partikular nga lokal nga sektor sang produkto.
english: Cristina Roque, pursuant to Section 6 of Republic Act No.8800 or Safeguard Measures Act which provides that the DTI Secretary may initiate a preliminary safeguard investigation if there is evidence that further importation of the product under consideration will pose a threat to a particular local product sector.

text: Ang una nga imbestigasyon magasakop sang pag-import sang semento halin sa mga tuig 2019 tubtob 2024.
english: The first investigation will cover cement import from the years 2019 to 2024.

text: Ang pag-usisa gin-trigger sang ebidensya nga ginhatag sa DTI samtang ang mga importasyon sang semento naglab-ot sa 51% sang Hunyo 2024.
english: The probe was triggered by evidence provided to the DTI as cement imports reached 51% by June 2024.

text: Ginhatagan man pagtamod sang Trade Department nga ang pagbaligya sang domestic cement industry nagnubo halin sa P79 billion sang 2019 pakadto sa P64 billion sang 2023.
english: The Trade Department also noted that sales of the domestic cement industry have declined from P79 billion in 2019 to P64 billion in 2023.

text: Pilason ang lima ka madre kag isa ka monghe sang mabungguan sang trailer truck ang ila nga ginasakyan sa Barangay Sampagar, Damulog, Bukidnon.
english: Five nuns and a monk were injured when a trailer truck hit them in Barangay Sampagar, Damulog, Bukidnon.

text: Sa malain nga palad, napatay ang ila nga driver nga si Alfredo Lagrimas, 65-anyos.
english: Unfortunately, their driver, Alfredo Lagrimas, 65, was killed.

text: Suno sa impormasyon halin sa Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) Damulog, halin ang mga biktima sa Malaybalay City, Bukidnon kag padulong sa South Cotabato.
english: According to information from the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) Damulog, the victims were from Malaybalay City, Bukidnon and were heading to South Cotabato.

text: Ginpahayag nga madasig ang dalagan sang trailer truck sa kurbada nga porsyon sang dalan kag gin-agaw ang linya sang van.
english: The trailer truck was reportedly speeding on the curved portion of the road and usurped the lane of the van.

text: Madasig naman nga gindala ang mga biktima sa Bukidnon Provincial Hospital-Kibawe.
english: The victims were rushed to the Bukidnon Provincial Hospital-Kibawe.

text: Padayon ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad.
english: Authorities are still investigating.

text: Pamilyar kaman bala sa nangin bantog nga ambahanon sa bilog nga Pilipinas nga ‘Manok na Pula’?
english: Are you familiar with the famous song 'Manok na Pula'?

text: Apang sa India, indi manok nga pula ang bantog kundi itom.
english: But in India, it is not red chicken that is famous but black.

text: Ini ang gina-ayam sang health-conscious meat eaters, bangud may mataas ini nga quality protein kag manubo nga fat content ipaanggid sa broiler chicken.
english: It is hunted by health-conscious meat eaters, as it has high quality protein and low fat content compared to broiler chicken.

text: Kilala bilang Kali Masi, ang Kadaknath chickens ang naghalin sa Jhabua district sa Madhya Pradesh sa India.
english: Known as Kali Masi, Kadaknath chickens originate from Jhabua district in Madhya Pradesh in India.

text: Ini nga Indian chicken ang bantog indi lamang bangud sa kalidad sang unod sini kag mga itlog kundi bangud sa duag itom sini nga panit kag dark-colored meat.
english: This Indian chicken is famous not only for the quality of its meat and eggs but also for its black skin and dark-colored meat.

text: Ang unod sang manok ang ginakabig bilang form of protein sa diin minilyon sa bilog nga kalibutan ang nagaconsume sini kada tuig.
english: Chicken meat is considered as a form of protein with millions around the world consuming it every year.

text: Ini nga manok ang naturally-raised kag mabakal sa presyo nga ginabanta P800.
english: This chicken is naturally-raised and can be purchased at a price of approximately P800.

text: Ang pamangkot, makaon ka man bala kun daw kaangay nga batok ang imo ginluto nga manok bangud itom ang duag sang panit kag unod sini?
english: The question is, can you eat it if your cooked chicken looks like a stick because the skin and flesh are black?

text: Ginhatag sang Philippine National Police (PNP) ang kabug-usan nga P10.6 million sa 30 informants nga nagbulig sa pag-aresto sang 30 wanted criminals sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) has awarded a total of P10.6 million to 30 informants who helped arrest 30 wanted criminals nationwide.

text: Ginpatigayon ang amo nga event sa Camp Crame kun sa diin ginbaton sang mga informants ang ila premyo nga nakabutang sa plastic envelopes kag nakasuksok sang full-face masks ang mga ini agud maprotektahan ang ila identity.
english: The event was held at Camp Crame where the informants received their prizes in plastic envelopes and wore full-face masks to protect their identity.

text: Suno sa ahensya, halin sa PNP intelligence fund ang pondo para sa ginhatag nga cash rewards nga gin-aprubahan sang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG).
english: According to the agency, the funds for the cash rewards approved by the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) came from the PNP intelligence fund.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mga naaresto ang may kahilabtanan sa dalagkuan nga krimen kaangay sang murder, rape, kag homicide.
english: It was learned that those arrested were involved in serious crimes such as murder, rape, and homicide.

text: Ang pinakadako nga reward nga P5.3 million ang ginhatag sa informant nga nagbulig sa pag-aresto sang suspect sang Pebrero 2023 nga wanted sa 7 counts of murder kag 25 counts of frustrated murder.
english: The biggest reward of P5.3 million was given to the informant who helped arrest the suspect in February 2023 who is wanted for 7 counts of murder and 25 counts of frustrated murder.

text: Samtang, ang pinakamagamay nga reward nga P50,000 ang ginhatag naman sa informant nga nagbulig sa pag-aresto sang suspect sa Kalinga sang Enero 2024 nga may double murder charges.
english: Meanwhile, the smallest reward of P50,000 was given to the informant who helped arrest the suspect in Kalinga in January 2024 with double murder charges.

text: Ginpunto ni PNP acting chief Lt.
english: PNP acting chief Lt.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Jose Melencio Nartatez ang importansya sang pagpakig-ugyon sang publiko sa pagtapos sang krimen, kag gin-abisohan ang mga pumuluyo nga padayon nga mag-report sang importante nga mga impormasyon sa kapulisan.
english: Jose Melencio Nartatez stressed the importance of public cooperation in ending crime, and advised residents to continue to report important information to the police.

text: ILOILO CITY- ‘In fighting form’ na ang tiglawas sang Pilipinas nga si Alethea Ambrosio sa Miss Supranational 2024 sa Poland.
english: ILOILO CITY- Philippine representative Alethea Ambrosio is in fighting form at the Miss Supranational 2024 in Poland.

text: Sa pag-abot ni Alathea sa Poland, gilayon ini nga nangin masako sa photoshoot kaupod sang iban nga kandidata.
english: When Alathea arrived in Poland, she immediately became busy with the photoshoot with the other contestants.

text: Target sang Bulacan native nga mangin ikaduha nga Pinay nga makoronahan bilang Miss Supranational pagkatapos ni Mutya Johanna Datul sang 2013.
english: The Bulacan native targets to become the second Filipina to be crowned Miss Supranational after Mutya Johanna Datul in 2013.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, first runner-up ang tiglawas sang Pilipinas nga si Pauline Amelinxck samtang ang tiglawas sang Ecuador naman ang nagdaug kag amo ang reigning queen.
english: Last year, Philippine representative Pauline Amelinxck was first runner-up while Ecuador's representative won and is the reigning queen.

text: Nakuha ni Ambrosio ang ticket para sa Miss Supranational pageant paagi sa pag-appoint sa iya sang Miss Philippines Culture and Heritage Celebration nga sister search sang Miss Universe Philippines.
english: Ambrosio got the ticket for the Miss Supranational pageant by being appointed by the Miss Philippines Culture and Heritage Celebration which is the sister search of Miss Universe Philippines.

text: Patigayunon ang Ang Miss Supranational 2024 sa Hulyo 6 kag amo ang mangin 15th edition sang Miss Supranational pageant.
english: Miss Supranational 2024 will be held on July 6 and will be the 15th edition of the Miss Supranational pageant.

text:
(Warning: Sensitive content)

Nautod gid ang lawas sang isa ka konduktor sang bus matapos mabungguan sang duha ka salakyan sa General Trias, Cavite.
english:
(Warning: Sensitive content)

A bus conductor was seriously injured after being hit by two vehicles in General Trias, Cavite.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, nagpanaog sa bus ang biktima sang hinali lang nabungguan sang kotse.
english: According to reports, the victim was getting off the bus when he was suddenly hit by a car.

text: Bangud madasig lang ang natabo, wala na nakalikaw ang nagasunod nga truck kag ginlasak kag ginyudyod ang biktima.
english: Because of the speed of the incident, the following truck could not avoid and hit and dragged the victim.

text: Natunga gid ang lawas sini kun sa diin kapin apat ka metros ang kalayuon sa isa kag isa.
english: Their bodies were split in half, more than four meters apart.

text: Nadakpan naman ang driver sang kotse samtang ginapangita pa ang driver sang truck.
english: The driver of the car was arrested while the driver of the truck is still being sought.

text: Pabakuron pa gid sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) ang mga programa kaangay sang nagabulig sa mga tawo nga nagapuyo sa karsada.
english: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) will further strengthen programs such as those that help people living on the streets.

text: Ini bangud ginapaabot ang pagtaas sang pagpamalimos sa sini nga bulan sang Disyembre nga tion sang Paskwa.
english: This is because an increase in begging is expected in this month of December during Christmas.

text: Suno sa DSWD, ang ila Pag-abot Program nakabulig kag nakahatag sang assistance sa 10,570 ka pamilya kag indibidwal sa kalsada sa sini nga tuig 2025.
english: According to the DSWD, their Pag-abot Program has helped and provided assistance to 10,570 families and individuals on the streets by 2025.

text: Sa isa ka pahayag ni DSWD spokesperson kag Assistant Secretary Irene Dumlao nga ginapaabot nila ang pagtaas sang insidente sang pagmalimos sa kalsada sa Paskwa.
english: In a statement, DSWD spokesperson and Assistant Secretary Irene Dumlao said they expect an increase in incidents of street begging during Christmas.

text: Gindugangan niya nga importante ang mabuligan kag maprotektahan ang mga mahuyang nga sektor, labi na ang mga kabataan, batuk sa abuso kag iban pa nga peligro.
english: He added that it is important to help and protect vulnerable sectors, especially children, against abuse and other dangers.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga ang Pag-abot Program nagatuyo nga buligan kag giya-an ang mga pamilya kag indibidwal sa kalsada para makabaton sila sang mas safe kag mas maayo nga kabuhi.
english: He said the Pag-abot Program aims to help and guide families and individuals on the streets so that they can have a safer and better life.

text: Sa karon, nakabulig ang programa sa 1,296 ka kabataan nga ara sa kalsada (CISS), 1,894 ka indibidwal nga ara sa kalsada (IISS) kag 7,380 ka pamilya nga ara sa kalsada (FISS).
english: To date, the program has helped 1,296 street children (CISS), 1,894 street individuals (IISS) and 7,380 street families (FISS).

text: Naabot sila sang Pag-abot teams paagi sa padayon kag maayo nga koordinasyon sa field operations.
english: They were reached by Pagabo teams through continuous and good coordination with field operations.

text: Dugang pa ni Dumlao nga ang DSWD committed sa pagbalik sang mga benepisyaryo sa ila komunidad, paghatag sang husto nga social protection services, kag pagpangita sang long-term nga solusyon para indi na sila mabalik sa kalsada.
english: Dumlao added that the DSWD is committed to returning beneficiaries to their communities, providing proper social protection services, and finding long-term solutions so that they do not return to the streets.

text: Ginpanawagan man sang DSWD ang publiko nga buligan kag protektahan ang mga tawo kag pamilya nga ara sa gihapon sa mga kalsada.
english: The DSWD also called on the public to help and protect people and families who are still on the streets.

text: ILOILO CITY- Opisyal na nga gindeklarar bilang persona non- grata sang local government sang Palawan sanday Rosmar Tan kag Rendon Labador.
english: ILOILO CITY – Rosmar Tan and Rendon Labador have been officially declared persona non- grata by the local government of Palawan.

text: Ang resolusyon nga ginpasa sang tanan nga myembro sang Palawan Provincial Council nga nagadeklarar sa nasambit nga social media personalities kag ang Team Malakas bilang persona non-grata sa Palawan ang gilayon nga gin-aprubahan sa first kag final reading.
english: The resolution passed by all members of the Palawan Provincial Council declaring the said social media personalities and Team Malakas as persona non-grata in Palawan was immediately approved in the first and final reading.

text: Ginpahayag ni Palawan 1st District Board Member Juan Antonio Alvarez, gin-insult nanday Rosmar kag Rendon ang bug-os nga banwa sang Coron kag mga pumuluyo sini.
english: Palawan 1st District Board Member Juan Antonio Alvarez said Rosmar and Rendon insulted the entire town of Coron and its residents.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagbisita ang Team Malakas sa Coron para sa isa ka outreach activity apang gin-alegar sang staff sang opisina sang alkalde sa isa ka social media post nga ginagamit lang sang duha ang mgaa pumuluyo sang Coron para sa ila nga vlog.
english: It was learned that Team Malakas visited Coron for an outreach activity but the staff of the mayor's office alleged in a social media post that the two were only using the residents of Coron for their vlog.

text: Ginsundan ini sang mainit nga pagbaisay nanday Labador kag Tan batok sa staff sang mayor’s office.
english: This was followed by a heated argument between Labador and Tan against the staff of the mayor's office.

text: Ginpahayag ni Alvarez nga apisar indi husto ang post sang staff, sa gihapon isa ini ka personal nga post kag indi official statement sang banwa.
english: Alvarez said that although the staff's post is not correct, it is still a personal post and not an official statement of the town.

text: Suno sa iya, wala nagakaigo ang reaksyon sang grupo ni Tan kag Labador.
english: He said the reaction of Tan and Labador's group was inappropriate.

text: Dugang niya, apisar naghatag sila sang bulig sa mga pumuluyo, wala sila gihapon sang kinamatarung nga insultuhon ang mga residente sang Coron.
english: He added that although they provided assistance to the residents, they still have no right to insult the residents of Coron.

text: Kahapon, nag-isyu ang grupo sang ila apology matapos ginpakita ni Councilor John Patrick Reyes sang Coron ang resolusyon nga nagadeklarar sa ila bilang persona non-grata.
english: Yesterday, the group issued their apology after Councilor John Patrick Reyes of Coron showed them a resolution declaring them persona non-grata.

text: Nangin maayo ang imbukada sang Agusto 3 para sa mga Pilipino sa Paris Olympics matapos nga nagdaog si Nesthy Petecio batok kay Amina Zidani sang France sa round-of-16 sang women’s 57kg weight class sa boxing.
english: The opening of August 3 was a good one for the Filipinos at the Paris Olympics after Nesthy Petecio won against Amina Zidani of France in the round-of-16 of the women’s 57kg weight class in boxing.

text: Sulod na subong sa quarterfinals ang Pinoy pride nga Tokyo Olympics silver medalist kag pananglitan magpangibabaw pa gid sa masunod nga round, sigurado na ini nga makadala sang medalya para sa pungsod.
english: The Pinoy pride Tokyo Olympics silver medalist is now in the quarterfinals and if he wins the next round, he is sure to bring a medal for the country.

text: Apang antes sina, yari anay ang mga balantayan nga atleta subong nga Sabado.
english: But before that, here are the athletes to watch this Saturday.

text:
OBIENA

Sa athletics, magasabak na sa kumpetisyon si Ernest John “EJ” Obiena 4:10 karon sa hapon (oras sa Pilipinas).
english:
OBIENA

In athletics, Ernest John “EJ” Obiena will compete at 4:10 pm (Philippine time).

text: Para ini sa men’s pole vault qualification (Group A) kun sa diin kinahanglan sini nga malukso ang qualification standard nga 5.80 meters ukon dapat nga malakip sa 12 best performers halin sa 32 nga yara sa kumpetisyon.
english: This is for the men's pole vault qualification (Group A) where he must jump the qualification standard of 5.80 meters or must be among the 12 best performers out of 32 in the competition.

text: Nagapangaduha si Obiena sa bug-os nga kalibutan sa patag sang pole vault subong kag siya man ang naga-uyat sang Asian record nga 6m apang mabudlay man ang banas para sa gold medal mission sini bangud yara man sa kumpetisyon ang defending Olympic champion nga si Armand Duplantis sang Sweden nga amo man ang world number one.
english: Obiena is currently ranked second in the world in the pole vault and also holds the Asian record of 6m but the path for her gold medal mission is also difficult because defending Olympic champion Armand Duplantis of Sweden who is also world number one is also in the competition.

text: Magluwas kay Duplantis nga may world record nga 6.23m, yara man ang World Number 3 nga si Sam Kendricks sang USA.
english: In addition to Duplantis with a world record of 6.23m, there is also World Number 3 Sam Kendricks of the USA.

text:
YULO

Balantayan na 9:30 karon sa gab-i ang potensyal man nga medalist sang Pilipinas nga si Carlos Edriel Yulo.
english:
YULO

Potential Philippine medalist Carlos Edriel Yulo will be announced at 9:30 pm tonight.

text: Finals na ini sa Men’s Floor Exercise nga isa man sa pet exercise ukon forte sang Pinoy pride.
english: It's the finals of the Men's Floor Exercise which is also one of the pet exercises or forte of Pinoy pride.

text:
Tuyo ni Yulo nga makabawi matapos nga nagpang-12 lamang sa 24 ka gymnasts sa all-around finals sang nagligad nga gab-i.

PAALAM

9:46 karon sa gab-i, magasaka liwat sa ring ang Tokyo Olympics silver medalist nga si Carlo Paalam para sa quarterfinals sang men’s -57kg division.
english:
Yulo aims to recover after finishing 12th out of 24 gymnasts in the all-around finals last night.

GOODBYE

9:46 tonight, Tokyo Olympics silver medalist Carlo Paalam will return to the ring for the quarterfinals of the men’s -57kg division.

text: Pananglitan magdaog si Paalam karon sa gab-i, sigurado na ini nga makaangkon sang bronze medal kag buhi man ang paglaum nga mapatasan sini ang iya nalab-ot sa Olympics sa Japan sang 2021 ukon mabulsa ang maila nga gold medal para sa Pilipinas.
english: If Paalam wins tonight, he is sure to win a bronze medal and there is hope that he will equal his achievement at the Olympics in Japan in 2021 or pocket the famous gold medal for the Philippines.

text: Matandaan nga nag-abante si Paalam sa quarterfinals matapos ginlutos ang Irish fighter nga si Jude Gallagher sa Round of 16.
english: Paalam advanced to the quarterfinals after defeating Irish fighter Jude Gallagher in the Round of 16.

text: Ang kabug-usan nga rankings sang mga pungsod sa Paris Olympics ang mahimo malantaw sa official website sang Bombo Radyo Philippines nga amo ang www.bomboradyo.com kag sa official facebook page sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo.
english: The overall rankings of the countries in the Paris Olympics can be viewed on the official website of Bombo Radyo Philippines which is www.bomboradyo.com and on the official facebook page of Bombo Radyo Iloilo.

text: Ginmanduan ni Passi City Mayor Stephen Palmares ang Hepe sang Passi Police Station nga si PLt Col.
english: Passi City Mayor Stephen Palmares ordered Passi Police Station Chief PLt Col.

text: German Magbanua nga hibaluon kag imbestigaran ang natabo nga ginamo sa opening of lights sa banwa sang Passi.
english: German Magbanua to investigate the riots at the opening of lights in Passi town.

text: Ang kinagamo natabo sangkaaghon sang Disyembre 8, 2025.
english: The riot occurred on the morning of December 8, 2025.

text: Naaktohan man nga may nagvideo sa natuhoy nga kinagamo kun sa diin makit-an nga may ginakaptan nga kutsilyo ang isa ka lalaki.
english: It was also caught that someone videoed the incident where a man was seen holding a knife.

text: Gintambangan man sang mga tawo sa palibot ang mga lalaki nga nagaginamo apang makit-an man nga halos indi masarangan nga mapunggan ang mga ini.
english: People around also helped the men who were making trouble but it was also seen that it was almost impossible to stop them.

text: Kaangot sini, ginmanduan na ni Mayor Palmares ang mga awtoridad kag mga opisyales sang barangay nga kinahanglan matumod na subong nga adlaw ang rason sang kinagamo kag mahibal-an man kun tumandok sang Passi ang mga ini ukon pangayaw.
english: In this regard, Mayor Palmares has ordered the authorities and barangay officials to identify the cause of the riot today and also to know whether they are natives of Passi or foreigners.

text: Suno pa sa alkalde, possible nga pasakaan sang kaso ang mga ini.
english: The mayor said it is possible to file a case against them.

text: Indi na lang mangin limitado sa mga ospital nga yara sa idalom sang Department of Health (DOH) ang zero-balance billing.
english: Zero-balance billing will no longer be limited to hospitals under the Department of Health (DOH).

text: Ini ang kasunod sang pag-amyenda sang Senado sa gin-proponer nga General Appropriations Bill, nga naghatag sang dugang pondo para sa ahensya.
english: This follows a Senate amendment to the proposed General Appropriations Bill, which provided additional funding for the agency.

text: Suno kay Secretary Teodoro Herbosa, kun ma-aprobahan ang ini nga pondo, gamiton ini para suportahan ang mga ospital sang local government units (LGU).
english: According to Secretary Teodoro Herbosa, if this fund is approved, it will be used to support the hospitals of local government units (LGUs).

text: Sa pahayag naman ni DOH spokesperson Albert Domingo nga ang zero-balance billing, paagi sa dugang nga pondo, ipatuman sa mga level three nga ospital nga ginapanag-iyahan sang mga LGU.
english: DOH spokesperson Albert Domingo said zero-balance billing, through additional funds, will be implemented in level three hospitals owned by LGUs.

text: Sa isa ka sulat nga ginpirmahan ni Herbosa para kay Senate President Vicente Sotto III, ginproponer ini kun paano magahimo sang no-balance billing sa mga ospital sang LGU.
english: In a letter signed by Herbosa to Senate President Vicente Sotto III, he proposed how to do no-balance billing in LGU hospitals.

text: Dugang pa, ginproponer sang DOH nga ang pagpagwa sang pondo para sa mga ospital sang LGU nga himuon paagi sa level three nga DOH hospitals.
english: In addition, the DOH proposed that the release of funds for LGU hospitals be done through level three DOH hospitals.

text: Sa karon, suno sa DOH, masobra sa isa ka milyon ka mga Pilipino ang nakabenepisyo na sa programa.
english: To date, according to the DOH, more than one million Filipinos have benefited from the program.

text: Naghimo sang rekord ang girl group nga BINI bilang top artist sa Spotify kag ginlapawan pa si Taylor Swift bilang most-listened-to singer sa Pilipinas.
english: Girl group BINI set a record as the top artist on Spotify and even surpassed Taylor Swift as the most-listened-to singer in the Philippines.

text: Hunyo 14 sang nalab-ot ini sang BINI suno sa Spotify Charts.
english: It was June 14 when BINI surpassed it according to Spotify Charts.

text: Suno sa record label sini nga Star Music Philippines, ini man ang una nga tion nga may Filipino act nga nakatupa sa #1 spot sa Spotify Philippines Daily Top Artists Chart.
english: According to its record label Star Music Philippines, this is also the first time a Filipino act has landed at the #1 spot on the Spotify Philippines Daily Top Artists Chart.

text: Una nga nakasulod sa charts, partikular sa number 190, ang BINI sang Pebrero 9, 2024.
english: First to enter the charts, specifically at number 190, was BINI on February 9, 2024.

text: Sulod sila sa ranking sa sulod sang 128 ka adlaw antes nalab-ot ang pinakamataas nga spot.
english: They were in the rankings for 128 days before reaching the top spot.

text: Antes sini, si Taylor amo ang nagapangibabaw nga daily artist sa Spotify Philippines sa sulod sang 968 days.
english: Before that, Taylor was the top daily artist on Spotify Philippines for 968 days.

text: Sang 2022, ang Quezon City ang nalakip pa gani sa top listeners sang amo nga American superstar sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: In 2022, Quezon City was even among the top listeners of that American superstar worldwide.

text: Ang ikatatlo nga spot sa local chart ang gina-okupa ni Hev Abi kag ginasundan nanday Ariana Grande, Sabrina Carpenter, Maki, TJ Monterde, SZA, Al James, kag Billie Eilish.
english: The third spot on the local chart is occupied by Hev Abi and is followed by Ariana Grande, Sabrina Carpenter, Maki, TJ Monterde, SZA, Al James, and Billie Eilish.

text:
Ang BINI naman ang may masobra 6.5 million monthly listeners sa Spotify samtang ang ila hit song nga Pantropiko ang nakatipon sang masobra 80 million plays (as of writing.)

Ang grupo — nga ginabug-usan nanday Jhoanna, Maloi, Stacey, Aiah, Colet, Gwen, Mikha, kag Sheena — ang nagselebrar sang ila ikatatlo nga anibsersaryo sang nagligad lamang nga Hunyo 11.
english:
BINI has more than 6.5 million monthly listeners on Spotify while their hit song Pantropiko has amassed more than 80 million plays (as of writing.)

The group — made up of Jhoanna, Maloi, Stacey, Aiah, Colet, Gwen, Mikha, and Sheena — celebrated their third anniversary just this past June 11.

text: Kilala sila nga “Nation’s Girl Group” kag popular man sa mga kanta nga “Na Na Na,” “Lagi,” “Huwag Muna Tayong Umuwi,” kag “Salamin, Salamin”.
english: They are known as the “Nation’s Girl Group” and are also popular for the songs “Na Na Na,” “Lagi,” “Huwag Muna Tayong Umuwi,” and “Salamin, Mirror”.

text: Ginpasiguro ni Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Vice Dizon nga pasabton ang tanan nga korap nga opisyal sa Bulacan 1st district engineering office.
english: Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Vice Dizon assured that all corrupt officials in the Bulacan 1st district engineering office will be held accountable.

text: Ginhimo ni Sec.
english: Made by Sec.

text: Dizon ang pahayag kadungan sang iya pagpakigsapol sa mga bga-o nga gin-appoint nga mga opisyal sang Malolos, Bulacan subong nga adlaw.
english: Dizon made the statement during his meeting with the newly appointed officials of Malolos, Bulacan today.

text: Ginpatigayon ang sinapol sa conference room nga gintawag ni Dizon bilang “infamous room” sa diin yara ang lamesa nga ginalatagan sanhg yara sa P300 million nga ginapahayag nga gintunga-tunga sang anay DPWH district engineers nga sanday Henry Alcantara kag Brice Hernandez.
english: The meeting was held in the conference room that Dizon called the “infamous room” where the table was set for the P300 million allegedly split between former DPWH district engineers Henry Alcantara and Brice Hernandez.

text: Suno kay Dizon, simboliko ang amo nga lugar bangud diri nag-usbong ang lapnagon nga iskandalo sa flood control projects.
english: According to Dizon, the area is symbolic because it is where the widespread scandal over flood control projects emerged.

text: Nagpromisa man ang tiglikon sang pagplastar sang mga solusyon kaupod ang mga bag-o nga opisyal sang district engineering office ng DPWH sa Bulacan.
english: The speaker also promised to lay out solutions with the new officials of the district engineering office of the DPWH in Bulacan.

text: Samtang, nakatalana man nga inpeksyunon ni Sec.
english: Meanwhile, Sec.

text: Dizon ang mga maanomaliya nga proyekto nga uyat sang Bulacan 1st district engineering office.
english: Dizon the anomalous projects handled by the Bulacan 1st district engineering office.

text: Nabudlayan ka man bala nga magpaniwang ukon magbuhin sang imo kabug-aton sa diin halos makahambal ka nga kun pwede lamang indi ka nalang magtikab sang imo baba agud malikawan mo ang pagkaon sang madamo?
english: Have you ever had difficulty losing weight or losing weight where you could almost say that if you could just keep your mouth shut so you could avoid eating too much?

text: Sa New Zealand, kontrobersyal ang gindevelop nga weight loss device nga gindisenyo agud mabuksan lamang sa 2 millimeter ang baba sang isa ka indibidwal.
english: In New Zealand, a controversial weight loss device designed to open an individual's mouth to only 2 millimeters has been developed.

text: Katuyuan sini nga malimitahan ang pag-usang sang baba sa pagkaon.
english: Its purpose is to limit the mouth’s chewing on food.

text: Ang DentalSlim Diet Control ang gindevelop sang mga scientist sang University of Otago, sa New Zealand.
english: DentalSlim Diet Control was developed by scientists at the University of Otago, in New Zealand.

text: Ini nga intra-oral device ang mahimo i-tapik sang dental professional sa lower back teeth sang kliyente.
english: This intra-oral device can be attached by the dental professional to the lower back teeth of the client.

text: Ini ang nagafeature sang pinasahi nga custom-manufactured locking bolts nga kontrolado sang magnet sa diin kun i-activate ini, ginapahanugutan lamang ang baba nga magbukas sang gamay apang husto lamang makaginhawa kag makahambal man sang normal ang nagasuksok sini.
english: It features special custom-manufactured locking bolts controlled by a magnet where when activated, the mouth is only allowed to open slightly but the wearer can breathe and speak normally.

text: Nagapati ang developers sang DentalSlim Diet Control nga dako ang papel sang sini nga produkto agud matapna ang global obesity epidemic.
english: The developers of DentalSlim Diet Control believe that this product will play a major role in curbing the global obesity epidemic.

text: Ginapabugal nga ginpakigbahin sang Filipino Olympian nga si Hergie Bacyadan ang iya Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity and Expression (SOGIE) sa Instagram reel.
english: Filipino Olympian Hergie Bacyadan proudly shared his Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity and Expression (SOGIE) on Instagram reel.

text: Ginakabig ni Bacyadan ang iya kaugalingon nga proud transgender apisar nga nagpamalibad ini nga maggamit sang hormone replacement therapy.
english: Bacyadan considers herself a proud transgender despite her refusal to use hormone replacement therapy.

text: Si Bacyadan ang nagbiya na sa Paris 2024 Olympics matapos ang iya away sa top-seeded nga si Li Qian sang China sa16 sang women’s 75kg division.
english: Bacyadan has withdrawn from the Paris 2024 Olympics after her fight with top-seeded Li Qian of China in the 16 of the women’s 75kg division.

text: Gindagdagan liwat sang Sandiganbayan Special Third Division si Janet Lim Napoles sang reclusion perpetua ukon hasta 80 ka tuig nga pagkakurong matapos nga napamatud-an nga guilty sa duha ka counts sang malversation of public funds nga may kahilabtanan sa indi-legal nga paggamit sang PDAF sang anay napatay nga si Benguet Representative Samuel Dangwa nga naglab-ot sa P19 milyon.
english: The Sandiganbayan Special Third Division has again extended Janet Lim Napoles' reclusion perpetua or up to 80 years in prison after she was found guilty of two counts of malversation of public funds related to the illegal use of the PDAF by former Benguet Representative Dangwaot amounting to P19 million.

text: Suno sa layi, ang malversation nga nagalab-ot sa masobra P8.8 milyon mahimo silutan sang reclusion perpetua, nga may sentensya nga 20 ka tuig kag isa ka adlaw tubtob 40 ka tuig nga pagkapreso.
english: According to the law, malversation amounting to more than P8.8 million is punishable by reclusion perpetua, with a sentence of 20 years and one day to 40 years in prison.

text: Sa iban pa nga malversation cases, si Napoles kag pila ka akusado ginsilutan man sang Reclusion temporal hasta 20 ka tuig nga pagkapriso kag Prision mayor hasta 12 ka tuig nga pagkapriso.
english: In other malversation cases, Napoles and several defendants were also sentenced to Reclusion temporal up to 20 years in prison and Prision mayor up to 12 years in prison.

text: Samtang, may iban man nga gin-acquit bangud wala napamatud-an sang prosekusyon ang ila sala beyond reasonable doubt.
english: Meanwhile, others were acquitted because the prosecution failed to prove their guilt beyond reasonable doubt.

text: Sa madumduman nga sang 2018, ginsilutan man si Napoles sang reclusion perpetua matapos napamatud-an nga guilty sa plunder.
english: In 2018, Napoles was also sentenced to reclusion perpetua after being found guilty of plunder.

text: Gindungan ni Ria Atayde sa selebrasyon sang Father’s Day, Hunyo 16, ang iya pag-anunsyo nga nagabusong na siya sang mangin subang nga anak nila ni Zanjoe Marudo.
english: Ria Atayde coincided with the celebration of Father's Day, June 16, by announcing that she is pregnant with Zanjoe Marudo's youngest child.

text: Nakabutang man sa post sang aktres ang laragway sang isa ka beach getaway kun sa diin proud sini nga ginpakita ang iya baby bump.
english: The actress also posted a picture of a beach getaway where she proudly showed off her baby bump.

text:
Wala na sini gindetalye kun pila ka bulan na ang iya ginadala, apang gintamyaw sini ang iya bana sang ‘Happy Father’s Day.’

Caption sang 32-anyos nga aktres: “To the dad you already are and the dad I know you’ll be.
english:
She did not elaborate on how many months she had been carrying, but greeted her husband with a 'Happy Father's Day.'

Caption of the 32-year-old actress: “To the dad you already are and the dad I know you’ll be.

text: Love you @onlyzanjoemarudo, so excited for this new chapter with you [emoji] Happy first Father’s Day!
english: Love you @onlyzanjoemarudo, so excited for this new chapter with you [emoji] Happy first Father’s Day!

text:
[Emoji]”

Marso sang ginkasal sanday Ria kag Zanjoe sa isa ka civil ceremony sa Quezon City.
english:
[Emoji]”

Ria and Zanjoe were married in March in a civil ceremony in Quezon City.

text: Ginguba sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) ang malapit 9,900 ka electrical appliances nga nagabalor sang masobra P7.7 million matapos napamatud-an nga substandard.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) destroyed nearly 9,900 electrical appliances worth more than P7.7 million after they were found to be substandard.

text: Ginpangunahan sang Fair Trade Enforcement Bureau (FTEB) sang ahensya ang operasyon sa items nga nagalakip sang electric fans, rice cookers, blenders, kettles, kag washing machines.
english: The agency's Fair Trade Enforcement Bureau (FTEB) led the operation on items including electric fans, rice cookers, blenders, kettles, and washing machines.

text: Lunsay ini uncertified kag wala nakaagi sa proper testing gani indi safe nga gamiton suno sa ahensya.
english: They are both uncertified and have not undergone proper testing and are therefore not safe to use, the agency said.

text: Gin-abisuhan man sang DTI ang tanan nga mga consumer ilabi na ang naga-shop para sa regalo kag raffle giveaways subong nga Christmas season nga indi gid magbakal sang items nga wala sang Philippine Standard (PS) mark ukon Import Commodity Clearance (ICC) sticker.
english: The DTI also advised all consumers especially those shopping for gifts and raffle giveaways this Christmas season not to buy items without the Philippine Standard (PS) mark or Import Commodity Clearance (ICC) sticker.

text: Bisan makabarato pa suno kay Atty. Marimel Porciuncula, OIC director sang DTI-FREB, posible mabutang sa kapahamakan ang pamilya kun substandard ang kaangay nga items bangud basi kun maglupok ini.
english: Even if it is cheaper, according to Atty. Marimel Porciuncula, OIC director of DTI-FREB, said the family could be put in danger if such items are substandard because they might explode.

text: Ini nga mga produkto ang una na nga nakumpiskar sang Hunyo matapos nagreklamo ang customer sa iya item nga ginbakal.
english: These products were first confiscated in June after a customer complained about his item purchase.

text: Sunod nagguwa nga ang ini nga distributor nga naka-base sa Valenzuela ang may yara sang warehouse nga puno sang uncertified home appliances.
english: It was later revealed that this distributor based in Valenzuela had a warehouse full of uncertified home appliances.

text: Lakip sa penalidad nga ginadagdag sa mga establisemento nga nagakomiter sang kaangay nga sala amo ang cease and desist order kag minimum penalty nga P70,000 base sa nakasaad sa Consumer Act of the Philippines.
english: Among the penalties imposed on establishments that commit such offenses are a cease and desist order and a minimum penalty of P70,000 based on the Consumer Act of the Philippines.

text: Nagapakig-angot man ang DTI sa iban pa nga online shopping platforms kag merchants para masigurado nga naga-post sila sang pictures sang ila produkto nga may yara sang DTI markings.
english: The DTI is also working with other online shopping platforms and merchants to ensure that they post pictures of their products with DTI markings.

text: Kun wala sang markings suno sa ahensya, isa na ini ka paandam sa consumers kag dapat man sila nga mangin proactive.
english: If there are no markings, the agency said, it is a warning to consumers and they should be proactive.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang Abril subong nga tuig, nakadangat na sa P340 million nga balor sang substandard products ang nakumpiskar sang DTI.#
english: Since April this year, the DTI has seized P340 million worth of substandard products.

text: ALGERIA – Ginpakamalaot sang Algeria Olympic Committee ang wala basehan nga pag-atake sa ila female boxer nga si Imane Khelif matapos gin-akusaran nga isa ka transgender matapos naghampang sa Paris 2024 Olympics.
english: ALGERIA – The Algeria Olympic Committee has condemned the baseless attack on its female boxer Imane Khelif after she was accused of being a transgender after playing in the Paris 2024 Olympics.

text:
“COA strongly condemns the unethical targeting and maligning of our esteemed athlete, Imane Khelif, with baseless propaganda from certain foreign media outlets.”

Suno sa Olympic Committee, si Khelif ang ginbun-ag nga isa ka babaye, apang may yara sang Disorder with Sex Development (DSD) nga rason kun nga may yara ini sang XY chromosomes kag mataas nga testosterone.
english:
“COA strongly condemns the unethical targeting and maligning of our esteemed athlete, Imane Khelif, with baseless propaganda from certain foreign media outlets.”

According to the Olympic Committee, Khelif was born a female, but has a Disorder with Sex Development (DSD) reason why she has XY chromosomes and high testosterone.

text: Isa man ini ka United Nations International Children’s Emergency Fund (UNICEF) ambassador, sa diin ginpakigbahin sini ang iya eksperyensya sa iya pagdako sa isa ka rural village sa diin wala ini ginpasugtan sang iya amay nga maghampang sang boxing bangud sa rason nga indi ini para sa mga babaye.
english: She is also a United Nations International Children’s Emergency Fund (UNICEF) ambassador, where she shared her experience of growing up in a rural village where her father did not allow her to play boxing on the grounds that it was not for women.

text: Dugang pa, ginakabig man nga indi patas sang Algeria ang pagpang-atake sa personalidad kag dignidad ni Khelif.
english: Furthermore, Algeria also considers the attack on Khelif’s personality and dignity unfair.

text: Ginpanindugan sang Algeria nga himuon nila ang tanan nga tikang agud proteksyunan ang ginakabig nila nga champion nga atleta.
english: Algeria insisted it would take all measures to protect its champion athlete.

text: “Such attacks on her personality and dignity are deeply unfair, especially as she prepares for the pinnacle of her career at the Olympics.
english: “Such attacks on her personality and dignity are deeply unfair, especially as she prepares for the pinnacle of her career at the Olympics.

text:
The COA has taken all necessary measures to protect our champion.”

Samtang suno naman kay International Olympic Committee (IOC) spokesman Mark Adams, ang tanan nga mga atleta sa Olympics ang ginpaidalom sa eligibility kag entry regulations.
english:
The COA has taken all necessary measures to protect our champion.”

Meanwhile, according to International Olympic Committee (IOC) spokesman Mark Adams, all athletes in the Olympics are subject to eligibility and entry regulations.

text: Ginpahayag ni Adams nga si Khelif ang nakahampang na sa 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games kag wala lang naglusot sang gulpi.
english: Adams noted that Khelif had already played in the 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games and didn’t just sneak out of nowhere.

text: “These athletes have competed many times before for many years, they haven’t just suddenly arrived – they competed in Tokyo.”
english: “These athletes have competed many times before for many years, they haven’t just suddenly arrived – they competed in Tokyo.”

Isang 16-anyos na dalagita ang nasawi matapos umanong barilin ang sarili sa harap mismo ng kanyang ina sa kanilang tahanan sa Balamban, Cebu.

A 16-year-old girl died after allegedly shooting herself in front of her mother at their home in Balamban, Cebu.

text: Batay sa paunang imbestigasyon ng Balamban Police Station, naganap ang insidente matapos umanong mapagalitan ang dalagita dahil sa madalas niyang pag-uwi nang gabi.
english: According to preliminary investigation of the Balamban Police Station, the incident occurred after the girl allegedly got angry because she often came home late at night.

text: Ayon sa mga ulat, ipinaabot ng ama na nasa Maynila ang kanyang mga obserbasyon sa ina tungkol sa ginagawa ng kanilang anak.
english: According to reports, the father, who is in Manila, conveyed his observations to the mother about what their son was doing.

text: Nang makumpirma ng ina mula sa guro ng dalagita na lumiliban din ito sa klase, agad siyang umuwi sa Cebu upang kausapin ang anak.
english: When the mother confirmed from the girl's teacher that she was also absent from class, she immediately returned to Cebu to talk to her daughter.

text: Pagdating sa kanilang bahay, pumasok sa kwarto ang ina upang kausapin ang dalagita.
english: When they got home, the mother went into the room to talk to the girl.

text: Sa hindi inaasahang pangyayari, bigla umanong kumuha ng baril ang dalagita, itinutok ito sa kanyang ulo, at ipinutok.
english: In an unexpected turn of events, the girl suddenly grabbed a gun, pointed it at his head, and fired.

text: Agad siyang isinugod sa ospital ngunit idineklarang patay kalaunan.
english: He was rushed to the hospital but was pronounced dead on Monday.

text: Patuloy ang imbestigasyon ng mga awtoridad upang matukoy ang pinagmulan ng ginamit na baril at ang iba pang detalye sa insidente.
english: Authorities are conducting an investigation to determine the source of the firearm used and other details of the incident.

text: Paalala: Kung ikaw o may kilala kang nahaharap sa matinding emosyonal na suliranin, huwag mag-atubiling humingi ng tulong.
english: Reminder: If you or someone you know is facing a severe emotional crisis, do not hesitate to ask for help.

text: Maaaring tumawag sa anumang lokal na crisis hotline sa inyong lugar.
english: You can call any local crisis hotline in your area.

text: Halos tanan sa aton ang nakaeksperyensya nga ma-late na sa aton kaladtuan, trabaho kag eskwelahan sa diin daw makasiling ka nalang nga ‘baw kun pwede ko lang palupadon ang akon salakyan ukon kotse nga ginasakyan’.
english: Almost all of us have experienced being late for our destinations, work and school where you just say 'wow if only I could fly my car or car'

text: Ini man ang ginahandom sang iban ilabi na kun daw indi maagwantahan ang traffic sa dalanon.
english: This is also the dream of some especially when the traffic on the road seems unbearable.

text: Ang mga nagalupad nga salakyan ukon kotse ang masami makit-an lang naton sa mga science fiction nga pelikula ukon sa libro.
english: Flying cars are often seen only in science fiction movies or books.

text: Apang sa Slovakia, Europe, indi na ini nagapabilin nga handom lamang bangud may Slovakian company nga nag-imbento sang pinakauna nga prototype flying car kag ginpalupad ini sa duha ka mga syudad agud testingan.
english: But in Slovakia, Europe, it no longer remains a dream because a Slovakian company invented the first prototype flying car and flew it to two cities to test.

text: Nagdangat sa 35 ka minutos ang paglupad sa kahanginan sang AirCar Prototype 1 nga kotse sa diin yara sa 118 Miles per hour ang kadasigon sini.
english: The AirCar Prototype 1 car took 35 minutes to fly at a speed of 118 miles per hour.

text: Ang amo nga AirCar nga may 160 horsepower BMW engine, ang gindisenyo bilang sports car sa diin may yara ini sang button-operated process.
english: The AirCar, which has a 160 horsepower BMW engine, is designed as a sports car where it has a button-operated process.

text: Suno sa kompaniya, may yara man sila sang ginadevelop nga AirCar Prototype 2, nga maga-feature sang 300 horsepower engine sa diin ginalauman nga maglupad ini sa kadasigon nga 186 Miles per hour nga may range nga 621 miles.
english: According to the company, they also have an AirCar Prototype 2 in development, which will feature a 300 horsepower engine where it is expected to fly at a speed of 186 Miles per hour with a range of 621 miles.

text: Kun ikaw, handom kag luyag mo man bala nga makasakay sa nagalupad nga kotse sa diin wala sang trapiko kag aso?
english: If you are, do you dream and want to ride in a flying car where there is no traffic and smoke?

text: In-activate sang Iran ang air defense sini sa Tehran sa mga una nga oras subong nga adlaw sang Lunes, June 23, suno sa local media.
english: Iran activated its air defense in Tehran in the early hours of Monday, June 23, according to local media.

text: Ini ang sa tunga sang ginalauman nga retaliatory attack nga ginlunsar nga missile attack sa Isarel sini nga aga nga natapna naman sang air defense sang Isarel, suno sa opisya sa Tel Aviv.
english: This is in the midst of an expected retaliatory attack launched missile attack on Israel this morning that was intercepted by Israeli air defense, according to the office in Tel Aviv.

text: Gin-report naman sang state-affiliated media nga na-intercept sang air defense system sang Iran ang “hostile targets” sa kabisera sang Tehran.
english: State-affiliated media reported that Iran's air defense system intercepted "hostile targets" in the capital Tehran.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) nga naglunsar ang Iran sang panibag-o nga missile strikes sa Israel.
english: The Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) also confirmed that Iran has launched new missile strikes on Israel.

text: Nangin rason ini sang pagtunog sang mga sirens sa ila mga lugar sa pungsod.
english: This has caused sirens to sound in their areas of the country.

text: Kabahin sini, ginmanduan sang Israeli military ang publiko nga magsulod sa bomb shelter ukon mamad kag ginasiguro sini nga nagagana ang ila nga defense systems.
english: In this regard, the Israeli military has ordered the public to enter the bomb shelter or mamad and it is ensuring that their defense systems are working.

text: Nalakip sa nominees sa Best Actress sa 7th Entertainment Editors’ Choice Awards for Movies ukon The Eddys ang mag-abyan nga sanday Kathryn Bernardo kag Julia Montes kag ang bag-o lang ginkasal nga si Charlie Dizon.
english: Among the nominees for Best Actress in the 7th Entertainment Editors' Choice Awards for Movies or The Eddys are friends Kathryn Bernardo and Julia Montes and newlywed Charlie Dizon.

text: Kasunod ini sang performance ni Bernardo sa “A Very Good Girl”; “Five Breakups And A Romance” kay Montes, kag “Third World Romance” kay Dizon.
english: This follows Bernardo’s performance in “A Very Good Girl”; “Five Breakups And A Romance” by Montes, and “Third World Romance” by Dizon.

text: Nakalinya man sa sini nga kategorya ang mga beterana na nga aktres nga sanday Marian Rivera (Rewind); Vilma Santos (When I Met You In Tokyo); kag Maricel Soriano (In His Mother’s Eyes).
english: Also in this category are veteran actresses Marian Rivera (Rewind); Vilma Santos (When I Met You In Tokyo); and Maricel Soriano (In His Mother’s Eyes).

text: Para naman sa Best Actor, nominees sanday Elijah Canlas, Dingdong Dantes, Cedrick Juan, Piolo Pascual, Alden Richards, kag Romnick Sarmenta.
english: For Best Actor, nominees are Elijah Canlas, Dingdong Dantes, Cedrick Juan, Piolo Pascual, Alden Richards, and Romnick Sarmenta.

text:
Maga-compete naman sa Best Picture award ang mga pelikula nga “About Us But Not About Us,” “Firefly,” “GomBurZa,” “Iti Mapukpukaw,” kag “Mallari.”

Ang The Eddys ang gin-organisa sang Society of Philippine Entertainment Editors sa tuyo nga maengganyo ang local filmmakers, producers, writers, kag actors nga padayunon ang paghimo sang sini nga mga obra-maestra nga replika sang matuod nga nagakatabo sa sosyudad.
english:
The films “About Us But Not About Us,” “Firefly,” “GomBurZa,” “Iti Mapukpukaw,” and “Mallari” will compete for the Best Picture award.

The Eddys was organized by the Society of Philippine Entertainment Editors to encourage local filmmakers, producers, writers, and actors to continue creating these works of art that are replicas of what is really happening in society.

text: Una na nga gin-anunsyo nga sa seremonya sang The Eddys sa Hulyo 7 sa Pasay City, hatagan man sang pagpasindungog ang iban pa nga screen veterans kag movie icons nga sanday Eva Darren, Nova Villa, Leo Martinez, Lito Lapid, kag Gina Alajar.
english: It was earlier announced that at The Eddys ceremony on July 7 in Pasay City, other screen veterans and movie icons Eva Darren, Nova Villa, Leo Martinez, Lito Lapid, and Gina Alajar will also be honored.

text: May espesyal man nga tribute para sa anay comic strip creator nga si Carlo J. Caparas bangud sa indi-mabayaran nga kontribusyon sini sa Philippine movie industry.
english: There was also a special tribute for former comic strip creator Carlo J. Caparas for his invaluable contribution to the Philippine movie industry.

text: Aprubado na ang wage hike para sa mga private sector workers sa Western Visayas.
english: The wage hike for private sector workers in Western Visayas has been approved.

text: Suno sa Department of Labor and Employment, epektibo ini umpisa sa tunga-tunga sang Nobyembre.
english: According to the Department of Labor and Employment, this will be effective starting in mid-November.

text: Sa gin-aprubahan sang Western Visayas regional wage board, may yara sang P33-P40 daily wage increase para sa private sector workers.
english: In the approval of the Western Visayas regional wage board, there is a P33-P40 daily wage increase for private sector workers.

text: Buot silingon sini, ang daily minimum wage rates sa rehiyon ang maga-range halin sa P485 tubtob sa P513 sa non-agriculture sector kag P480 sa agriculture sector.
english: This means that the daily minimum wage rates in the region will range from P485 to P513 in the non-agriculture sector and P480 in the agriculture sector.

text: Para sa non-agriculture workers sa commercial ukon industrial businesses nga may yara sang masobra 10 ka workers, ang approved wage hike amo ang P33 nga buot silingon, ang minimum wage nga P480 ang mangin P513.
english: For non-agriculture workers in commercial or industrial businesses with more than 10 workers, the approved wage hike is P33 which means that the minimum wage of P480 will become P513.

text: Ang mga workers naman sa mga Negosyo nga may 10 ka empleyado ukon mas manubo pa ang may yara sang P35 hike, kun sa diin ang P450 mangin P485.
english: Workers in businesses with 10 employees or less will have a P35 hike, from P450 to P485.

text: Ang mga agricultural workers naman ang makabaton sang P40 hike, kun sa diin P440 ang mangin P480.
english: Agricultural workers will receive a P40 hike, from P440 to P480.

text: Aprubado man ang P1,000 monthly increase para sa mga kasambahay gani ang monthly minimum wage nga P5,000 ang mangin P6,000.
english: The P1,000 monthly increase for maids was also approved so that the monthly minimum wage of P5,000 will be P6,000.

text: Ang wage orders ang ibalhag sa Nobyembre 1 kag mangin epektibo sa Nobyembre 17.
english: The wage orders will be published on November 1 and will become effective on November 17.

text: Ginkalipay kag ginpasalamatan ni Department of Education (DepEd) Secretary Sonny Angara ang pag-apruba sang P961.3 billion nga budget sang departamento.
english: Department of Education (DepEd) Secretary Sonny Angara welcomed and thanked the approval of the department's P961.3 billion budget.
