text: Mikaela Suansing, bilang chairperson sang House appropriations, ang 2026 budget para sa edukasyon ang pinakamataas sa kasaysayan sang pungsod.
english: Mikaela Suansing, as chairperson of House appropriations, the 2026 budget for education is the highest in the nation’s history.

text: Base sa report sang bicameral conference committee, P57.3 billion ang gintagana para sa Basic Education Facilities Program nga magapondo sa konstruksyon sang 40,000 ka mga bag-o nga classroom sa masunod nga tuig 2026.
english: Based on the report of the bicameral conference committee, P57.3 billion has been allocated for the Basic Education Facilities Program which will fund the construction of 40,000 new classrooms by 2026.

text: Ginbitay sang Iran ang lalaki nga agent sang Mossad spy service sang Israel.
english: Iran hanged male agent of Israel's Mossad spy service.

text: Ang amo nga lalaki nga si Majid Mosayebi ang gin-convict sa pagpang-espiya.
english: That man, Majid Mosayebi, was convicted of espionage.

text:
Yari ang statement sang judiciary:“Majid Mosayebi… was hanged this morning after going through the full process of criminal procedure and after his sentence was confirmed by the Supreme Court.”

Wala naman gindetalye kun san-o gin-aresto si Mosayebi.
english:
Here is the statement of the judiciary: “Majid Mosayebi… was hanged this morning after going through the full process of criminal procedure and after his sentence was confirmed by the Supreme Court.”

It did not provide details on when Mosayebi was arrested.

text: Ang pagbitay sa lalaki ang natabo sa tunga sang nagalala pa gid nga inaway sa tunga sang Israel kag Iran.
english: The man’s execution came amid an escalating conflict between Israel and Iran.

text: Nagviral sa social media ang isa ka lalaki nga nagpatigayon sang community pantry, apang sa baylo nga pagkaon ang itanyag sang libre sa mga pumuluyo, siya mismo ang nakadisplay sa iya gintawag nga ‘Jowa Community Pantry’.
english: A man who set up a community pantry went viral on social media, but instead of offering food for free to the residents, he himself displayed it in what he called the 'Jowa Community Pantry'

text: Para kay Jesse James Joves sang Pasig, kinahanglan lamang sang creativity agud makit-an niya ang iya ‘The One’.
english: For Jesse James Joves of Pasig, it only takes creativity to find his 'The One'.

text: Suno sa iya, walo na siya ka tuig nga single sa diin nagapati siya nga ini na ang tion nga magpangita na siya sang iban pa nga pamaagi agud maangkon ang ginahandom niya nga romantic relationship.
english: She said she has been single for eight years and believes that this is the time for her to find other ways to have the romantic relationship she dreams of.

text: Nagplastar si Joves sang duha ka puti nga pulungkuan sa atubang sang iya balay sa diin nagpungko siya kag gintanyag ang iya kaugalingon.
english: Joves placed two white chairs in front of his house where he sat and offered himself.

text:
Sa isa ka pulungkuan, nakabutang naman ang sa isa ka whiteboard nga ginsulatan niya sang mga tinaga nga “tall, dark, pwede na, loves the Lord, no issues, slightly used.”

Nangin agaw-atensyon si Joves sa mga naglabay nga pumuluyo sa atubang sang iya ‘Jowa Community Pantry’ sa diin madamo ang nagkuha sa iya sang picture kag gin-upload ini sa social media.
english:
On one chair, there was a whiteboard on which he had written the words “tall, dark, can, loves the Lord, no issues, slightly used.”

Joves attracted the attention of passers-by in front of his 'Jowa Community Pantry' where many took pictures of him and uploaded them on social media.

text: Madamo naman sang ginbilin nga makahalam-ot nga komento ang netizens sa mga naglapta nga picture ni Joves sa diin ginapahayag pa sang iban nga basi indi na masunod ang physical distancing kun pilahan ang iya ‘Jowa Community Pantry’ sang mga babaye nga single man kag available.
english: Netizens left many funny comments on Joves' pictures, some of which said that physical distancing might not be followed if his 'Jowa Community Pantry' was filled with women who are single and available.

text: Abiso naman sang mga abyan ni Joves, maghulat lamang ini bangud mangin worth it man sa gihapon ang iya paghulat sa tion nga ihatag na sa iya sang Mahal nga Makaako ang babaye nga para gid sa iya.
english: Joves' friends advised him to wait because it will be worth it when the Almighty gives him the woman he deserves.

text: Ginabaligya na lang sa tuman ka barato nga presyo ang mga tilapia sa Lake Sebu, South Cotabato.
english: Tilapia are being sold at very low prices in Lake Sebu, South Cotabato.

text: Ini bangud nag-emergency harvest ang mga manugpangisda bangud nagakalamatay na ang mga tilapia.
english: This is because the fishermen did an emergency harvest because the tilapia were dying.

text: Sa baylo nga pabay-an na lang nga magkalamatay sa mga fishpens ang mga tilapia, ila na lang ini nga gin-harvest kag ginbaligya sa barato nga presyo.
english: Instead of letting the tilapia die in the fishpens, they harvested it and sold it at a cheap price.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagadangat na lang sa P30-P50 ang kada kilo sang tilapia sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: It is known that the price of tilapia is only P30-P50 per kilo in the said area.

text: Ginatumod nga rason sang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Unit ang wala pagsunod sang pila ka drivers sa ginpahamtang nga loading kag unloading markings sa mga dalanon rason nga nagapugok ang trapiko sa syudad.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Unit is citing the non-compliance of some drivers with the loading and unloading markings on the roads as the reason for the traffic congestion in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: Pcol Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office, iya ginpahayag nga masami nga nagapundo ang pila ka mga pampubliko nga salakyan kaangay sang jeep kag bus, sa indi insakto nga lugar sa pagkuha sang ila mga pasahero labi na kon oras sang rush hour.
english: Pcol Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office, iya ginpahayag nga masami nga nagapundo ang pila ka mga pampubliko nga salakyan kaangay sang jeep kag bus, sa indi insakto nga lugar sa pagkuha sang ila mga pasahero labi na kon oras sang rush hour.

text: Ginpangabay man sang ahensya sa publiko ilabi na sa mga drivers nga magkooperar sa pagsunod sa mga signage kag markings nga ginbutang bilang reference sang public utility vehicles agud mangin matalunsay ang dalagan sang trapiko.
english: The agency also urged the public especially drivers to cooperate in following the signage and markings placed as references by public utility vehicles to ensure smooth flow of traffic.

text: Panawagan man sang ahensya sa mga pasahero nga maghulat sa designated loading kag unloading areas para malikawan ang disgrasya kag indi na magdugang ang trapiko sa dalanon.
english: The agency also appealed to passengers to wait in designated loading and unloading areas to avoid accidents and not increase traffic on the road.

text: Sa madumduman nga ini nga isyu nangin kabahin man sang diskusyon sa Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) samtang ginahimo ang plano paano mas paathagon kag mapauswag ang traffic discipline sa syudad.
english: Sa madumduman nga ini nga isyu nangin kabahin man sang diskusyon sa Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) samtang ginahimo ang plano paano mas paathagon kag mapauswag ang traffic discipline sa syudad.

text: Gin-utod ang performance sang P-pop sensation nga BINI kadungan sang 126th Independence Day festivities sa Quirino Grandstand sa Manila kagab-i para pasulabihon ang safety sang fans.
english: P-pop sensation BINI's performance during the 126th Independence Day festivities at the Quirino Grandstand in Manila was cut short last night to prioritize the safety of fans.

text: Naka-schedule ang performance sang grupo kasunod sang speech ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The group's performance is scheduled to follow the speech of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Matapos nakanta ang “Lagi”, nagpangabay na ang girl group sa fans nga mag-behave.
english: After singing “Lagi”, the girl group asked the fans to behave.

text: Ini matapos nanotisyaran nga may fan na nga nalipong bangud sa paggilinutok sang iban nga nagalantaw.
english: This was after it was noticed that a fan had fainted due to the crowd of other spectators.

text: Naglala ang sitwasyon sang nakit-an nga nagsaka na ang iban nga fans sa poste kag barikada para malantaw sang maayo ang BINI.
english: The situation worsened when some fans were seen climbing poles and barricades to get a better view of BINI.

text: Nagpahanumdom pa ang grupo sa fans nga magkalma bangud nabudlayan na ang security kag naghingyo man nga mag-isol bangud mas nagapalapit na ang mga ini sa entablado.
english: The group reminded fans to remain calm as security was getting difficult and also asked them to move away as they were getting closer to the stage.

text: Bangud wala nagtawhay ang sitwasyon, gin-utod na lang ang performance.Nagpaathag man ang grupo sa isa ka post nga gina-una nila ang safety kag nagapangayo man sang paghangop sang tanan.
english: Because the situation did not calm down, the performance was cut short. The group also explained in a post that they put safety first and asked for everyone's understanding.

text: “Thank you to everyone who supported us tonight!
english: “Thank you to everyone who supported us tonight!

text: However safety should always come first and we hope for your understanding.
english: However safety should always come first and we hope for your understanding.

text: More chances to see each other real soon!
english: More chances to see each other real soon!

text: We hope everyone gets home safely tonight.
english: We hope everyone gets home safely tonight.

text: Thank you so much!
english: Thank you so much!

text: Happy Independence Day,” statement sang grupo.
english: Happy Independence Day,” the group said in a statement.

text: Mas barato gihapon sang P3 kada kilo ang presyo sang local rice ipaanggid sa imported apisar nga naglaslas si Bagyo Kristine kag apisar may 3.6 million metric tons sang imported rice subong sa pungsod.
english: The price of local rice is still P3 cheaper per kilo compared to imported rice despite the outbreak of Typhoon Kristine and despite the fact that there are 3.6 million metric tons of imported rice in the country.

text: Base ini sa latest report nga ginplastar sang Department of Agriculture (DA).
english: This is based on the latest report put forward by the Department of Agriculture (DA).

text: Sa Metro Manila markets suno sa ahensya, ang retail prices sang local regular milled rice ang nagatupa sa P42 kag P47 per kilo ipaanggid sa retail price sang imported regular milled rice nga P45 per kilo.
english: In Metro Manila markets, the agency said, the retail prices of local regular milled rice fell to P42 and P47 per kilo compared to the retail price of imported regular milled rice of P45 per kilo.

text: Sa local premium rice, ang presyo ang nagalab-ot sa P50 kag P58 per kilo ipaanggid sa imported premium rice nga P52 tubtub sa P60 per kilo.
english: For local premium rice, the price ranges between P50 and P58 per kilo compared to imported premium rice which is P52 to P60 per kilo.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang economic managers nga ang retail price sang imported rice ang maganubo sang P7 per kilo kun iimplementar na ang Executive Order 62 nga amo ang nagpahanugot sa 15-percent tariff sa imported rice halin sa anay 35 percent.
english: Earlier, economic managers said the retail price of imported rice will drop by P7 per kilo when Executive Order 62 is implemented, which allowed a 15-percent tariff on imported rice from the previous 35 percent.

text: Una man nga ginsiling ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Earlier, Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: nga ang expected full impact sang EO 62 ang mabatyagan pa sa January 2025 bangud ang demand sa pagkaon ang masami nagatimbuok sa Disyembre.
english: that the expected full impact of EO 62 will be felt in January 2025 as food demand usually peaks in December.

text: As of Oct.
english: As of Oct.

text: 17, may yara sang at least 3.6 million metric tons sang imported rice sa Pilipinas nga kadam-an naghalin sa Vietnam.
english: 17, there are at least 3.6 million metric tons of imported rice in the Philippines mostly from Vietnam.

text: Ang iban pa nga ginkuhaan amo ang Thailand, Pakistan, Myanmar, India, China, Japan, Cambodia, Italy, kag Spain.
english: Other sources include Thailand, Pakistan, Myanmar, India, China, Japan, Cambodia, Italy, and Spain.

text: Ang local rice harvest naman para sa wet season ang nagsugod sang Septyembre kag natalana ang peak subong nga Oktubre.
english: The local rice harvest for the wet season began in September and is scheduled to peak this October.

text:
”Wala sang forever”

Ini ang nangin sentyemento sang iban matapos nahibaluan ang istorya sang Ukrainian couple.
english:
”Nothing is forever”

This has been the sentiment of some after learning the story of the Ukrainian couple.

text: Sini nga tuig, gin-ulan nanday Alexander Kudlay, 33, kag Viktoria Pustovitova, 29 ang international news headlines sang nagdesisyon ang mga ini nga posasan ang ila mga kamot sa sulod sang tatlo ka bulan.
english: This year, Alexander Kudlay, 33, and Viktoria Pustovitova, 29, made international headlines when they decided to handcuff themselves for three months.

text: Katuyuan sang couple nga masalbar ang ila nagalas-ay nga relasyon kag masigurado nga wala sa ila ang may magpanunto.
english: The couple's goal is to save their crumbling relationship and make sure that neither of them gets hurt.

text: Sa sulod sang tatlo ka bulan, updanay ang couple sa tanan nila nga hulag kag hilikuton bangud iping nga nakaposas ang isa nila ka mga kamot.
english: For three months, the couple was together in all their movements and activities because one of their hands was handcuffed.

text: Sa 123 ka-adlaw nga nakaposas ang ila mga kamot, ginakabig na ini sang iban nga ‘impressive’ kag makahalam-ot sa diin madamo man ang nagapati nga dako ang posibilidad nga ‘road to forever’ na ang duha.
english: With 123 days in handcuffs, some consider it impressive and funny where many believe that there is a high possibility that the two are on the road to forever.

text: Apang baliskad ini sa realidad.
english: But this is the opposite of reality.

text: Matapos ang tatlo ka bulan nga nakaposas sanday Alexander kag Viktoria, gilayon nila nga gin-anunsyo ang ila nga break-up sa publiko.
english: After three months in handcuffs, Alexander and Viktoria immediately announced their break-up to the public.

text: Gin-ako sang couple nga ila nadiskubrehan ang tuman kalayo nila nga mga panan-awan sa madamo nga issues kag indi man magsanto ang ila nga personalidad.
english: The couple admitted that they discovered that they had very different views on many issues and that their personalities did not match.

text: Nangin bantog naman sa bug-os nga Ukrain ang couple sa diin madamo sang nakahambal nga ‘wala gid man sang forever’.
english: The couple became famous throughout Ukraine where many said that 'there is no forever'

text:
”Makawat ang akon nga kuring”

Ini ang dako nga homemade sign nga ginbutang sang isa ka nagapanag-iya sang hinuptanan nga kuring sa gwa sang iya balay.
english:
”My cat is stealing”

This is a large homemade sign that a pet cat owner put up outside his house.

text: Ang hinuptanan nga kuring amo si Esme kag ang nagapanag-iya naman sa iya amo si Kate Felmet sang Beaverton, Oregon sa Estados Unidos.
english: The pet cat is Esme and her owner is Kate Felmet of Beaverton, Oregon in the United States.

text: Nalakip sa mga nasambit nga tinaga sa sign ang drawing sang itsura ni Esme nga may bitbit nga glove nga amo ang ginkawat sini sa kaiping nga balay.
english: Among the words on the sign was a drawing of Esme's face carrying a glove that she had stolen from a neighboring house.

text: Sa kilid sang dako nga sign nakahalay ang pila ka mga gloves kag face mask nga ginkawat ni Esme halin sa mga kaiping nga balay sa diin, nasaad man sa sign ang abiso sa mga kasilingan nga kuhaon na lamang nila ang ila ginapanag-iyahan nga gamit.
english: Next to the large sign were some gloves and face masks that Esme stole from neighboring houses.

text: Ang nasambit nga senyales nga ginhimo ni Felmet may kaangtanan sa iya ginhingadlan kawatan nga kuring, ang nangin bantog sa bug-os niya nga kasilingan.
english: The said sign made by Felmet in connection with his named thief cat, became famous throughout his neighborhood.

text: Bangud sa amo nga senyales sa gwa sang balay ni Felmet, madamo sang naham-ot sa iya hinuptanan nga kuring.
english: Because of the sign outside Felmet's house, many people were afraid of his pet cat.

text: Madamo man sang nagpadulong sa gwa sang balay ni Felmet agud kuhaan sang picture ang mga nakahalay nga gloves nga ginkawat ni Esme lakip na ang makahalam-ot nga homemade sign.
english: Many people also went outside Felmet's house to take pictures of the gloves that Esme stole including the funny homemade sign.

text: Ang hinuptanan nga kuring ang nangin kaangay man sang isa ka minor celebrity matapos nangin agaw-atensyon sa online world apisar nga kawatan.
english: The pet cat has also become like a minor celebrity after becoming the center of attention in the online world despite being a thief.

text: Suno sa site nga ‘The Conscious Cat’, may yara sang ‘prey-retrieval’ instinct ang mga kuring sa diin ginadala sang mga ini sa ila ginakabig nga ‘safe place’ ang tanan nga inanimate object nga ila masapwan.
english: According to the site 'The Conscious Cat', cats have a 'prey-retrieval' instinct where they take to what they consider a 'safe place' all inanimate objects they find.

text: Indi na pagtugutan nga mag-file sang leave ang mga police personnel subong nga bulan sang Disyembre, ilabi na nga nagahilapit ang paskwa kun sa diin madamo sang mga aktibidad nga pagahiwaton.
english: Police personnel will not be allowed to file for leave this December, especially as Christmas approaches when many activities will be held.

text: Suno kay PRO6 Regional Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan, tugutan lamang sang makadali sang ‘holiday break’ ang mga kapulisan agud nga mahatagan sang mga aktibidad nga ginahiwat rason nga kinahanglan may yara sang mga pulis nga nakastandby bilog nga adlaw sa mga pampubliko nga mga lugar.
english: According to PRO6 Regional Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan, the police will only be allowed a brief holiday break to accommodate the activities that are being held, which is why there should be policemen on standby all day in public places.

text: Ini agud mapabilin ang katawhay, kalinong kag safety sang mga pumuluyo sa tunga sang holiday rush.
english: This is to maintain peace, tranquility and safety of the residents in the midst of the holiday rush.

text: Dugang pa ni PBGen.
english: PBGen added.

text: Ligan, magapabilin ang pagmintinar sang police visbility, mobility kag madasig nga pagresponde ilabi na sa mga lugar nga madamo sang tawo pareho sang simbahan, terminals, malls, kag iban pa nga mga lugar ng may aktibidad agud malikawan ang ano man nga insidente kag ginamo.
english: Ligan, will maintain police visibility, mobility and quick response especially in crowded places such as churches, terminals, malls, and other places of activity to avoid any incidents and riots.

text: Tatlo ka mga Filipino nga manugpangisda ang napilasan matapos gin-atake sang Chinese Coast Guard kag Chinese militia vessels ang mga barko sang Pilipinas sa Escoda Shoal.
english: Three Filipino fishermen were injured after Chinese Coast Guard and Chinese militia vessels attacked Philippine ships in Escoda Shoal.

text: Ginpahayag sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) nga yara sa 20 ka mga Filipino fishing boats ang yara sa sulod sang Escoda Shoal sang gin-target ini sang mga China Coast Guard (CCG) vessels pinaagi sa pagbomba sang water cannons.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) said about 20 Filipino fishing boats were inside the Escoda Shoal when they were targeted by Chinese Coast Guard (CCG) vessels by firing water cannons.

text: Ginreport nga duha ka CCG vessels, upod ang mga Chinese militia ships ang yara sa insidente.
english: It was reported that two CCG vessels, along with Chinese militia ships were involved in the incident.

text: Suno sa PCG, duha ka barko sang Pilipinas ang tuman nga naguba bangud sa kabaskugon sang buga sang tubig halin sa water cannons sang CCG.
english: According to the PCG, two Philippine ships were badly damaged due to the force of the water spray from the CCG's water cannons.

text: Dugang pa, tatlo pa gid ka CCG vessels ang nagbalabag sa mga barko sang pungsod sang nag-responde sila sa insidente.
english: In addition, three more CCG vessels blocked the country's ships when they responded to the incident.

text: Gilayon naman nga ginhatagan sang nagakaigo nga medikal nga bulig ang tatlo ka manugpangisda nga napilasan matapos ang insidente.
english: The three injured fishermen were immediately given proper medical attention after the incident.

text: Padayon nga gina-monitor sang PCG ang sitwasyon sa lugar samtang ginpanawagan nila ang pagrespeto sa soberanya kag katungdanan sang mga manugpangisda nga Pilipino.
english: The PCG continues to monitor the situation in the area as they called for respect for the sovereignty and duties of Filipino fishermen.

text: Nagaisanon na lang si former Senator Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.
english: Former Senator Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos, Jr.

text: nga wala nakakumpirma kun magatambong ini sa debate nga patigayunon sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) sa Marso kag Abril.
english: who did not confirm whether he will attend the debate to be held by the Commission on Elections (Comelec) in March and April.

text:
Sandig sa pinakaulihi nga anunsyo ni Comelec spokesperson James Jimenez, siyam na sa napulo ka presidential candidates ang nagpahayag nga magapakita sila sa live debates:

Ini amo sanday:

* Former Foreign Affairs undersecretary Ernesto Abella

* Labor leader Leody De Guzman

* Manila Mayor Isko Moreno Domagoso

* Senator Panfilo Lacson

* Former Defense secretary Norberto Gonzales

* Negosyante nga si Faisal Mangondato

* Physician nga si Dr. Jose Montemayor, Jr.
english:
According to the latest announcement by Comelec spokesperson James Jimenez, nine of the ten presidential candidates have already announced that they will appear in the live debates:

These are:

* Former Foreign Affairs undersecretary Ernesto Abella

* Labor leader Leody De Guzman

* Manila Mayor Isko Moreno Domagoso

* Senator Panfilo Lacson

* Former Defense secretary Norberto Gonzales

* Businessman Faisal Mangondato

* Physician Dr. Jose Montemayor, Jr.

text:
* Senator Manny Pacquiao

* kag Vice President Leni Robredo

Ligum-dulom pa ang poll body kun maka-attend si Marcos.
english:
* Senator Manny Pacquiao

* and Vice President Leni Robredo

The poll body is still in the dark about whether Marcos will attend.

text: Antes diri, wala man sang Marcos nga nakit-an sa pila ka presidential interviews lakip na sa forum nga gin-organisa sang Kapisanan ng mga Brodkaster ng Pilipinas; apang kun matandaan, present ini sa debate nga gin-conduct sang SMNI network nga iya ni Apollo Quiboloy.
english: Earlier, Marcos was not seen in several presidential interviews including the forum organized by the Association of Broadcasters of the Philippines; but if you remember, he was present in the debate conducted by the SMNI network belonging to Apollo Quiboloy.

text:
SA PAGKA-BISE PRESIDENTE

Kun wala sang kumpirmasyon ang team ni Marcos sa presidential debate, amo man sini ang dalagan sa vice-presidential debate.
english:
TO BE VICE PRESIDENT

If there is no confirmation from Marcos' team in the presidential debate, the same will happen in the vice-presidential debate.

text: Sa pinakaulihi nga anunsyo ni Jimenez, wala pa nakakumpirma si vice presidential bet Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte sang iya attendance.
english: In Jimenez's latest announcement, vice presidential bet Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte has not yet confirmed his attendance.

text: Una na ini nakapahayag nga indi siya magtambong sa anuman nga debate antes ang eleksyon.
english: He had earlier said he would not attend any debate before the election.

text:
Ang nakakumpirma sang attendance amo sanday:

* Professor Walden Bello

* Rizalito David

* Manny Lopez

*Dr. Willie Ong

* Senator Francis Pangilinan

* Carlos Serapio

* kag Senate President Vicente Sotto IIISi Buhay party-list Representative Lito Atienza nga runningmate ni Pacquiao ang una na naka-kumpirma nga indi ini magtambong bangud sa medical reasons.
english:
Those who confirmed attendance were:

* Professor Walden Bello

* Rizalito David

* Manny Lopez

*Dr. Willie Ong

* Senator Francis Pangilinan

* Carlos Serapio

* and Senate President Vicente Sotto IIIBuhay party-list Representative Lito Atienza, Pacquiao's runningmate, earlier confirmed that he will not attend due to medical reasons.

text: Abante na sa quarterfinals sang men’s basketball sa Paris Olympics 2024 ang Team USA matapos nga ginlutos ang South Sudan sa ikaduha sini nga hampang sa group stage, 103-86.
english: Team USA advances to the quarterfinals of men's basketball at the Paris 2024 Olympics after beating South Sudan in its second group stage match, 103-86.

text: Nanguna sa American team si Bam Adebayo nga may 18 points kag seven rebounds; may 14 points si Kevin Durant; kag may 12 points, seven rebounds and five assists si LeBron James.
english: Bam Adebayo led the American team with 18 points and seven rebounds; Kevin Durant had 14 points; and LeBron James had 12 points, seven rebounds and five assists.

text: Matapos ginbangko sa bilog nga hampang sang team batok sa Serbia sang nagligad nga gab-i, nangin kabahin na subong si Jayson Tatum sang starting lineup kaupod si Anthony Davis, Steph Curry, James, kag Devin Booker.
english: After being benched for the team’s entire game against Serbia the previous night, Jayson Tatum is now part of the starting lineup alongside Anthony Davis, Steph Curry, James, and Devin Booker.

text:
Nanguna naman sa African team si Nuni Omot nga may 24 points kag si Carlik Jones nga may 18 points kag 7 assists nga nagbutang sang ila pungsod sa 1-1 nga record sa Group C.

Sunod nga atubangon sang USA ang Puerto Rico sa group play nga nauna na nalutos sa kamot ni Nikola Jokić kag Serbia.
english:
Nuni Omot led the African team with 24 points and Carlik Jones with 18 points and seven assists to put their country on a 1-1 record in Group C.

The USA will next face Puerto Rico in group play, having previously lost at the hands of Nikola Jokić and Serbia.

text: Gin-sorpresa sang celebrity couple nga sanday Carlo Aquino kag Charlie Dizon ang fans matapos ginsapubliko ang pictures sang ila kasal.
english: Celebrity couple Carlo Aquino and Charlie Dizon surprised fans after their wedding pictures were made public.

text: Ginpatigayon ang wedding ceremony sa isa ka pribado nga resort sa Silang, Cavite kag gintambungan sang iban nga mga artista kaangay kanday Sue Ramirez, Belle Mariano, Alexa Ilacad, Elisse Joson, Loisa Andalio, Vilma Santos-Concio, Maricel Soriano, kag iban pa.
english: The wedding ceremony was held at a private resort in Silang, Cavite and was attended by other artists such as Sue Ramirez, Belle Mariano, Alexa Ilacad, Elisse Joson, Loisa Andalio, Vilma Santos-Concio, Maricel Soriano, and others.

text:
Natabo ang seremonya isa ka adlaw lang matapos nadag-an ni Dizon ang Best Actress honors sa 2024 Gawad Urian para sa iya papel sa pelikula nga “Third World Romance.”

Una nga nagguwa ang espekulasyon nga naga-date ang duha sang late 2022 sang nakit-an sila nga magkaupod sa La Union.
english:
The ceremony came just a day after Dizon won Best Actress honors at the 2024 Gawad Urian for her role in the film “Third World Romance.”

Speculation that the two were dating first surfaced in late 2022 when they were spotted together in La Union.

text: Sang Enero 2023 naman sang ginkumpirma nila nga yara sila sa “getting to know each other” stage.
english: It was in January 2023 when they confirmed that they are in the “getting to know each other” stage.

text: Una sila nag-updanay sa 2020 series nga A Soldier’s Heart, kag nangin star man sa 2023 film nga Third World Romance.
english: They first worked together in the 2020 series A Soldier’s Heart, and also star in the 2023 film Third World Romance.

text: Nahibaluan nga ka-relasyon anay ni Carlo si Trina Candaza kag may anak sila nga si Enola Mithi apang ginkumpirma ang ila pagbulagay sang Abril 2022.
english: Carlo was previously in a relationship with Trina Candaza and they share a daughter, Enola Mithi, but their split was confirmed in April 2022.

text: Nagahuray-ad kag naipit sa tunga sang kahoy kag kawayan ang isa ka 51-anyos nga construction worker matapos madisgrasya sa iya ginamaneho nga motorsiklo sa Brgy.
english: A 51-year-old construction worker was trapped between a tree and bamboo after he was involved in an accident on his motorcycle in Brgy.

text: Gemat-y, Passi City, Iloilo.
english: Gemat-y, Passi City, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fire Officer 1 Jeric John Casamayor, Chief of Emergency Medical Services sang Passi City Bureau of Fire Protection, iya ginpahayag nga naabtan nila ang biktima nga wala na sang pulso kag lipong ini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fire Officer 1 Jeric John Casamayor, Chief of Emergency Medical Services of the Passi City Bureau of Fire Protection, said they found the victim without a pulse and dizzy.

text: Suno kay FO1 Casamayor, naghalin ang biktima sa iya trabaho kag pauli na kuntani sa iya pamilya sang natabo ang insidente.
english: According to FO1 Casamayor, the victim was on his way home from work when the incident occurred.

text: Dugang pa niya nga posible nga madasig ang pagpadalagan sang biktima sang iya motorsiklo kag nadulaan ini sang kontrol sa manibela.
english: He added that it is possible that the victim was driving his motorcycle fast and lost control of the steering wheel.

text: Bangod sini, nagbunggo ang iya motorsiklo sa kahoy sa kilid sang karsada kag tungod sa impact, nagtabog kag naipit ang iya lawas sa tunga sang kahoy kag kawayan.
english: As a result, his motorcycle hit a tree on the side of the road and due to the impact, his body was thrown and trapped between the tree and bamboo.

text: Nag-agum ang biktima sang patal nga pilas sa ulo kag nakaangkon man ini sang samad sa mata.
english: The victim sustained fatal head injuries and an eye injury.

text: Gindala pa ang biktima sa ospital apang gindeklarar ini nga dead on arrival.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Nagsaka na sa P1.69 billion ang balor sang halit sa sektor sang agrikultura sa Pilipinas bangud sa paglaslas ni Bagyo Kristine.
english: The value of damage to the agricultural sector in the Philippines due to the onslaught of Typhoon Kristine has risen to P1.69 billion.

text: Suno sa data sang Department of Agriculture, ang apektado nga areas amo ang Cordillera Administrative Region, Ilocos Region, Central Luzon, Calabarzon, MIMAROPA, Bicol Region, Western kag Eastern Visayas, kag ang SOCCSKSARGEN.
english: According to the data of the Department of Agriculture, the affected areas are the Cordillera Administrative Region, Ilocos Region, Central Luzon, Calabarzon, MIMAROPA, Bicol Region, Western and Eastern Visayas, and the SOCCSKSARGEN.

text: Nagdangat na sa 42,346 farmers kag 37,590 hectares sang agricultural areas ang apektado kag naglab-ot ang volume sang production loss sa 108,266 metric tons (MT).
english: A total of 42,346 farmers and 37,590 hectares of agricultural areas have been affected and the volume of production loss has reached 108,266 metric tons (MT).

text: Sa sini nga halit, ang humayan amo gid ang natam-an nga may pierde nga 104,198 MT.
english: Of this damage, rice was the worst affected with a loss of 104,198 MT.

text: May halit man kag kapierdehan sa mais, balinghoy, high-value crops, livestock kag poultry, kag agricultural facilities.
english: There was also damage and loss to corn, balinghoy, high-value crops, livestock and poultry, and agricultural facilities.

text: Maga-conduct pa ang agriculture department sang field evaluation kun mag-ayo-ayo na ang panahon kag ang sitwasyon.
english: The agriculture department will conduct a field evaluation when the weather and situation improves.

text: Ginsiling man sang ahensya nga may yara ini sang P531.72 million nga balor sang agricultural inputs para ipanagtag sa apektado nga mga mangunguma.
english: The agency also said it has P531.72 million worth of agricultural inputs for distribution to affected farmers.

text: Buligan man sang ahensya ang mga mangunguma paagi sa Quick Response Fund, Survival and Recovery (SURE) Loan Program, kag Philippine Crop Insurance Corporation.
english: The agency will also assist farmers through the Quick Response Fund, Survival and Recovery (SURE) Loan Program, and the Philippine Crop Insurance Corporation.

text: Ipatawag sang Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO) ang lalaki nga nagkabit-kabit sa streetlight sang Iloilo Sunset Boulevard.
english: The Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO) will summon the man who hung from the streetlight of Iloilo Sunset Boulevard.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: PCOL.
english: PCOL.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos, ginpahayag sini nga ginatinguhaan na nila nga ma-identify ang identity sang amo nga persona.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos, he said they are trying to identify the identity of the person.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, indi pwede nga pabay-an ukon i-tolerate lang ang amo nga akto, bangud delikado ini para sa iya kag makaguba man ini sang gamit nga ginapanag-iyahan sang siudad.
english: According to Garbanzos, the act cannot be tolerated, because it is dangerous for him and it can also damage equipment owned by the city.

text: Na-comatose subong ang isa ka Grade 3 student nga ginpulihan kastigo sang mga high school students.
english: A Grade 3 student who was beaten by high school students is now in a coma.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa Iligan City kag ang hitabo nakuhaan pa sang video.
english: The incident occurred in Iligan City and the incident was caught on video.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, apat ka mga lalaki ang nagkastigo sa siyam ka tuig nga bata nga lalaki nga estudyante sang Maria Cristina Falls Elementary School.
english: According to reports, four men beat up a nine-year-old boy who was a student at Maria Cristina Falls Elementary School.

text: Sa video, makit-an ang pagkastigo sa biktima kag kun paano ini ginsipa kag gintapungol sang mga suspek.
english: The video shows the victim being beaten and how he was kicked and stabbed by the suspects.

text: Matapos ang insidente, naospital gid ang bata kag yara subong sa Intensive Care Unit (ICU).
english: After the incident, the child was hospitalized and is now in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU).

text: Kamusta ang aton mga abyan nga mangunguma?
english: What about our farmer friends?

text: Paano ninyo ginatumod kun healthy pa ang duta nga ginatamnan ninyo sang inyo mga ulutanon sa uma?
english: How do you determine if the soil you plant your vegetables in is still healthy?

text: Didto sa Scotland, nangin uso ang pinasahi kag barato lang nga paagi sa paghibalo kun healthy pa ang duta.
english: In Scotland, a unique and inexpensive way to determine whether the soil is healthy has become fashionable.

text: Ini bangud ginalubong sang mga mangunguma ang ila brief ukon underwear sa idalom sang duta sa sulod sang duha ka bulan.
english: This is because farmers bury their briefs or underwear underground for two months.

text: Ari ang kondisyon: Kun tuman ka malala ukon gision ang itsura sang 100% cotton nga brief kun kutkuton mo na pagkaligad sang duha ka bulan, buot silingon, super healthy pa ang duta!
english: Here's the condition: If the 100% cotton brief looks very bad or torn when you dig it up after two months, it means that the soil is still super healthy!

text: Paathag ni Evan Wiig, executive director sang California’s Farmers Guild, ang cotton isa ka organic material kag naga-break down naturally kun ibutang mo sa compost pile.
english: Explained Evan Wiig, executive director of California’s Farmers Guild, cotton is an organic material and breaks down naturally when you put it in a compost pile.

text: Ini bangud kun ibutang mo ang cotton mo nga underwear sa idalom sang duta nga ‘full of life’ ukon healthy, ang tanan nga creatures ang magapista sa sini nga underwear.
english: This is because if you put your cotton underwear underground that is 'full of life' or healthy, all the creatures will feast on this underwear.

text: Samtang, kun sterile naman ukon wala sang kabuhi ang duta, wala gid sang gisi ang imo ilubong nga underwear bisan pila ka bulan mo pa ina nga hulaton antes kutkuton.
english: Meanwhile, if the soil is sterile or lifeless, your buried underwear will not be torn even if you wait months before digging it.

text: Ina bangud wala man sang mga creatures ukon bisan mga lago lang nga magapalapit sa imo nga underwear.
english: That's because no creatures or even lakes will approach your underwear.

text: Naeksperyensyahan mo na bala ang mahambalan nga edited ang imo picture nga ginapost sa social media?
english: Have you ever experienced being told that your picture posted on social media is edited?

text: May isa ka 23 anyos sa Myanmar nga nangin bantog sa online world bangud halos indi makapati ang mga netizen nga wala niya makaagi edit ang iya ginapost nga mga picture.
english: There is a 23-year-old in Myanmar who became famous in the online world because netizens can hardly believe that he did not edit the pictures he posted.

text: Siya amo si Su ‘Moh Moh’ Naing nga may yara lamang sang waist shape nga 13.7 inches, isa sa may pinakagamay nga hawak sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: She is Su ‘Moh Moh’ Naing who only has a waist shape of 13.7 inches, one of the smallest waist in the world.

text: Suno kay Naing, may kaangtanan sa genetics ang kagamayon sang iya hawak.
english: According to Naing, her small waist is related to genetics.

text: Apang ginpamatukan ini sang netizens sa diin napun-an ang iya mga pictures sa Instagram sang mga komento nga edited lamang ang tuman ka gamay kag manipis niya nga hawak.
english: However, netizens opposed this where her pictures on Instagram were filled with comments that edited only her very small and thin waist.

text: May mga nagasiling man nga mahimo nagpakakas sang ribs si Naing ukon nagasuksok sang tight corset agud maangkon ang tuman ka niwang nga figure.
english: There are also those who say that Naing may have removed her ribs or worn a tight corset to achieve a very thin figure.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Naing nga natural tanan ang iya nga lawas kag wala man sang dapat kabalak-an ang mga tawo bangud may yara siya sang healthy diet kag disposisyon.
english: Naing said that his body is all natural and people should not worry because he has a healthy diet and disposition.

text: Narekober sang Israel Defense Forces (IDF) ang bangkay sang tatlo ka mga bihag sang mga Hamas sa Gaza.
english: The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) have recovered the bodies of three Hamas hostages in Gaza.

text: Ginalakipan sang isa ka suldado kag duha ka mga sibilyan nga gindakop sang mga Hamas sang Oktubre 7, 2023.
english: Includes a soldier and two civilians captured by the Hamas on October 7, 2023.

text: Ginkilala ang mga bankay nga sanday Ofra Keidar, Yonatan Samerano kag ang suldado nga si Shay Levinson.
english: The bodies were identified as Ofra Keidar, Yonatan Samerano and soldier Shay Levinson.

text: Si Keidar ang isa ka 71-anyos ang naga-estar sa kibbutz Be’eri community sang ini ang ginpatay sang mga Hamas kag gindala ang lawas sini sa Gaza mangin ang asawa man sini ang ginpatay man.
english: Keidar, a 71-year-old resident of the kibbutz Be'eri community, was killed by Hamas and his body was taken to Gaza, where his wife was also killed.

text: Samtang, ang 21-anyos nga si Samerano ang isa ka talented DJ nga halin sa Tel Aviv, ginpatay siya sang mga Hamas samtang nagapalagyo halin sa Nova music festival.
english: Meanwhile, 21-year-old Samerano, a talented DJ from Tel Aviv, was killed by Hamas while fleeing from the Nova music festival.

text: Isa naman ka tank commander ang 19-anyos nga si Levinson kag dual German-Israel national ang napatay sa pagpakigbato kun sa diin gindala ang lawas sini sa Gaza.
english: Another tank commander, 19-year-old Levinson and dual German-Israel national, was killed in the fighting and his body was taken to Gaza.

text: Ginalauman man sang Israel nga makapangita sagihapon sila sang mga bangkay nga mga gitago sang mga Hamas.
english: Israel also hopes to continue to find bodies hidden by Hamas.

text: Nakuha sang Pilipinas ang commitment sang World Bank nga buligan ang sector sang agrikultura sa pungsod amo man ang human capital development.
english: The Philippines has secured the World Bank's commitment to assist the country's agricultural sector as well as human capital development.

text: Suno kay Finance Secretary Ralph Recto, ginpasalig ini sang bangko sa natabo nga high-level dialogue sa top officials sang World Bank Group (WBG) sa Washington DC ang Oktubre 22.
english: According to Finance Secretary Ralph Recto, the bank assured this during a high-level dialogue with top officials of the World Bank Group (WBG) in Washington DC on October 22.

text: Natabo ang pagsinapol sa sidelines sang WB – International Monetary Fund Annual Meetings sa amo nga state sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika halin sang Oktubre 22-25.
english: The meeting took place on the sidelines of the WB – International Monetary Fund Annual Meetings in the state in the United States of America from October 22-25.

text: Ginpangunahan ini ni Regional Vice President for East Asia and the Pacific Manuela Ferro kag nagpasalig nga mangin tayuyon ang mga suporta sa proyekto nga mapasaka sang productivity kag income sang Filipino farmers.
english: It was led by Regional Vice President for East Asia and the Pacific Manuela Ferro and assured that there will be continuous support to the project that will increase the productivity and income of Filipino farmers.

text: Ginpromisa man sang World Bank nga buligan ang pag-modernize sang agriculture sector para nga mas mangin commercially-viable kag export-oriented.
english: The World Bank also pledged to help modernize the agriculture sector to make it more commercially-viable and export-oriented.

text: Sa bahin ni Recto, gin-abi-abi sini ang assistance kag ginplastar nga ang pagpasangkad ang sini nga sektor ang magapahagan-hagan sang inflation kag magatib-ong pa sang economic growth.
english: For his part, Recto welcomed the assistance and said that the expansion of this sector will ease inflation and boost economic growth.

text: Ginkilala man sang World Bank ang investor confidence sa Pilipinas nga mabaskog gihapon bangud sa business-friendly reforms.
english: The World Bank also acknowledged that investor confidence in the Philippines remains strong due to business-friendly reforms.

text: Ginpahayag ni Recto nga daku ang potensyal sang Pilipinas nga mag-integrate sa global supply chain sang high-value manufacturing ilabi na sa semiconductor industry.
english: Recto said the Philippines has great potential to integrate into the global supply chain of high-value manufacturing especially in the semiconductor industry.

text: Ginhingyo man sini sa World Bank nga maghatag sang dugang nga assistance sa pagpabakod pa sa cybersecurity sang Pilipinas.
english: He also urged the World Bank to provide additional assistance to further strengthen the Philippines' cybersecurity.

text: Nahibaluan nga as of June, ang International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) sang World Bank amo ang third-largest official development assistance (ODA) partner sang Pilipinas nga may assistance nga lab-ot sa $8.84 billion.
english: As of June, the World Bank's International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) is the Philippines' third-largest official development assistance (ODA) partner with assistance of $8.84 billion.

text: Sa amo nga meeting, kaupod ni Recto sanday Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.; Finance Undersecretary Domini Velasquez; National Treasurer Sharon Almanza; WBG Alternate Executive Director Erwin Sta.
english: At the meeting, Recto was accompanied by Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.; Finance Undersecretary Domini Velasquez; National Treasurer Sharon Almanza; WBG Alternate Executive Director Erwin Sta.

english:

text: Nagpasalig ang newly appointed commissioner sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) nga si Atty. George Erwin Garcia nga maga-inhibit ini sa tanan nga mga kaso kun involved ang iya anay kliyente nga si presidential candidate Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: The newly appointed commissioner of the Commission on Elections (Comelec), Atty. George Erwin Garcia said he will inhibit all cases involving his former client, presidential candidate Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: May yara pa subong sang lima ka mga petisyon batok kay Marcos nga nagahulat sang pinal nga resolution halin sa Comelec en banc matapos nga ginpangbasura sa division level.
english: There are still five petitions against Marcos awaiting final resolution from the Comelec en banc after being dismissed at the division level.

text: Suno naman kay Garcia, kun masumalang na sini ang kaso ni Marcos, magasulat siya sa Clerk of Court kag i-saad nga indi siya pagpatisipar sa sini nga mga kaso.
english: Garcia said that when he meets Marcos' case, he will write to the Clerk of Court and promise not to participate in these cases.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nag-withdraw siya bilang abogado sa tanan nga mga kaso sa Comelec kag sa iba pa nga electoral tribunals agud mapamatud-an nga wala siya sang personal nga interes diri.
english: He also said he withdrew as a lawyer in all cases in the Comelec and other electoral tribunals to prove that he has no personal interest in it.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakaagi si Garcia nga nangin abogado indi lamang para kay Marcos kundi sa iban pa nga presidential candidates nga sanday Manila Mayor Isko Moreno Domagoso, kag Senators Manny Pacquiao kag Panfilo Lacson.
english: Garcia has been a lawyer not only for Marcos but also for other presidential candidates such as Manila Mayor Isko Moreno Domagoso, and Senators Manny Pacquiao and Panfilo Lacson.

text: Nagapang-apat ang Filipino socialite-artist nga si Heart Evangelista sa top 20 global celebrities sa fashion and sportswear sandig sa latest report sang Launchmetrics Insights sa fashion marketing.
english: Filipino socialite-artist Heart Evangelista ranks fourth among the top 20 global celebrities in fashion and sportswear according to the latest report by Launchmetrics Insights on fashion marketing.

text: Ini isa ka cloud-based performance benchmarking software nga nagpaguwa kahapon sang “Reinventing Influence: The Gen Z Impact on Fashion Marketing” report nga ginalantaw ang evolution sang fashion kag sportswear sa nagliligad nga tinuig kag ang pag-ilis sang nawong sang koneksyon kag impluwensya sa kalibutan.
english: It’s a cloud-based performance benchmarking software that yesterday released its “Reinventing Influence: The Gen Z Impact on Fashion Marketing” report looking at the evolution of fashion and sportswear over the past year and the changing face of global connectivity and influence.

text: Sa “Top 20 Celebrities Globally for all Fashion & Sportswear Segments,” Rank 4 ang Pinay actress nga asawa ni Senate President Chiz Escudero nga may total nga $85 million ukon P4.98-billion sa Media Impact Value (MIV) sang 2023.
english: In the “Top 20 Celebrities Globally for all Fashion & Sportswear Segments,” the Pinay actress, wife of Senate President Chiz Escudero, ranked 4th with a total of $85 million or P4.98-billion in Media Impact Value (MIV) in 2023.

text: Ini nga value suno sa Launchmetrics amo ang nagatugot sa brands nga maka-kuha sang monetary value sa post, interaction, ukon article sang celebrity ukon influencer kag gina-measure ang impact sini kag gina-identify ang contributions sa brand performance.
english: This value according to Launchmetrics is what allows brands to derive monetary value from a celebrity or influencer’s post, interaction, or article and measure its impact and identify contributions to brand performance.

text: Nagapang-siyam naman ang Filipina-Australian host-actress nga si Anne Curtis nga may MIV nga $55 million ukon P3.2-billion.
english: Filipina-Australian host-actress Anne Curtis is ninth with an MIV of $55 million or P3.2-billion.

text: Nagapanguna sa lista ang Indian actress nga si Avneet Kaur; ginasundan sang Dominican rapper nga si Anuel; South Korean boy band nga Enhypen; ang ang nagasunod kay Heart amo ang South Korean boy band nga NCT.
english: Topping the list are Indian actress Avneet Kaur; followed by Dominican rapper Anuel; South Korean boy band Enhypen; the the following Heart is the South Korean boy band NCT.

text: Gindayaw ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ang desisyon ni United States President Donald Trump nga bombahan ang nuclear sites sang Iran sa Fordow, Netanz kag Esfahan.
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has praised United States President Donald Trump's decision to bomb Iran's nuclear sites at Fordow, Netanz and Esfahan.

text: Suno kay Netanyahu, ang desisyon ni Trump nagapakita lamang sang iya pag-isa sa pagtapos sang paghari sang iya gintawag nga ‘most dangerous regime’ kag ang pungsod nga may pinakadelikado nga armas.
english: Netanyahu said Trump’s decision only shows his solidarity with ending the reign of what he called the ‘most dangerous regime’ and the country with the most dangerous weapons.

text:
Suno sa iya, ang liderato ni Trump naghimo sang isa ka makasaysayan nga desisyon nga marekord sa maragtas sang kalibutan tubtob san-o.

Ini suno sa iya ang magadala sang kauswagan kag kalinong sa bug-os nga Middle East kag bisan sa iban pa nga pungsod.
english:
He said the Trump leadership made a historic decision that will be recorded in world history forever.

This, he said, will bring prosperity and peace to the entire Middle East and even to other countries.

text: Samtang, ginpasalamatan naman ni Netanyahu si Trump sa iya madinalag-on nga pagguba sang mga nuclear sites sang Iran paagi sa bug-os niya nga kaisog kag kusog.
english: Meanwhile, Netanyahu thanked Trump for his successful destruction of Iran's nuclear sites with all his courage and strength.

text: Samtang, si U.S. President Donald Trump nagpamahog nga magbalos kun maglunsar sang pag-atake ang Iran batuk sa Amerika.
english: Meanwhile, U.S. President Donald Trump has threatened to retaliate if Iran launches an attack against the United States.

text: Ini matapos nga madinalag-on nga ginbombahan sang US Military ang tatlo ka Iranian nuclear sites.
english: This comes after the US Military successfully bombed three Iranian nuclear sites.

text: Base sa pahayag ni Trump, makabig nga isa ka makahalawhaw nga kadalag-an militar ang nasambit nga operasyon.
english: Based on Trump's statement, the operation was considered a stunning military victory.

text: Ginpabugal ni Trump nga ang panguna nga mga pasilidad sang nuclear enrichment sang Iran ang bug-os nga naguba.
english: Trump boasted that Iran’s main nuclear enrichment facilities were completely destroyed.

text: Gintawag sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino (PDP) nga political stunt ang bag-o nga kaso nga ginpasaka batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The Philippine Democratic Party (PDP) has called the new case filed against Vice President Sara Duterte a political stunt.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagpasaka sang plunder case kahapon nga adlaw sang Biyernes, Disyembre 12,ang pila ka civil society kag church leaders batok sa Vice President tungod sa iya anomalya sa paggamit sang pondo sang Office of the Vice President kag Department of Education, nga una sini nga ginapamunuan.
english: It is known that some civil society and church leaders filed a plunder case yesterday, Friday, December 12, against the Vice President for his anomaly in the use of funds of the Office of the Vice President and the Department of Education, which he previously headed.

text: Suno kay PDP Deputy Spokesperson Atty. Ferdinand Topacio, ginakabig sang partido nga alarming kag karadlawan ang nasambit nga tikang.
english: According to PDP Deputy Spokesperson Atty. Ferdinand Topacio, the party considers the move alarming and ridiculous.

text: Ginpanugyan niya nga kon tuod nga handum sang nagpreparar sang kaso nga mapanabat ang mga nag-gastos sang pondo, suno sa iya nga dapat unahon nila ang sa House of the Representatives.
english: He suggested that if the preparers of the case really want to hold accountable those who spent the funds, he said they should give priority to the House of Representatives.

text: Sa matandaan nga una na nga nagsiling ang mga church kag civil society leaders nga wala sila sang iban nga tuyo kundi ang mapanabat ang Bise Presidente.
english: It can be recalled that church and civil society leaders have earlier said that they have no other intention but to hold the Vice President accountable.

text: Gin-withdraw ni former Barotac Nuevo Sangguniang Bayan Member Jess Dimafiles ang iya kandidatura sa pagka-SB member subong nga tuig bangud wala nagasanto ang iya ginasuportahan nga presidential candidate sa kandidato nga ginasuportahan sang iya nga partido.
english: Former Barotac Nuevo Sangguniang Bayan Member Jess Dimafiles withdrew his candidacy for SB member this year because his supported presidential candidate does not match the candidate supported by his party.

text: Si Dimafiles ang kabahin sang slate sang Nacionalista Party sa banwa sang Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo, apang kilala man siya kag ang iya pamilya nga supporters ni presidential candidate Vice President Leni Robredo.
english: Dimafiles is part of the slate of the Nacionalista Party in Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo, but he and his family are also known to be supporters of presidential candidate Vice President Leni Robredo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dimafiles, iya ginpahayag nga sa walo sila nga kandidato sang Nacionalista sa pagka-SB member, siya lang ang nagasuporta kay Robredo bangud lunsay si former Senator Bongbong Marcos ang kandidato sang iya mga kaupdanan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Dimafiles said that of the eight Nacionalista candidates for SB membership, he is the only one who supports Robredo because former Senator Bongbong Marcos is the candidate of his colleagues.

text: Sang damlag lang suno sa former SB Member, gin-require siya sang ila nga political leader nga mag-post sang suporta para kay Marcos.
english: Recently, the former SB Member said, he was required by their political leader to post support for Marcos.

text: Ang ginatumod nga political leader amo si former 4th District Rep.
english: The political leader in question is former 4th District Rep.

text: Dr. Ferjenel Biron nga kandidato man sa pagka-congressman subong nga tuig.
english: Dr. Ferjenel Biron who is also a candidate for congressman this year.

text: Suno kay Dimafiles, bisan nga nagalain ang iya nga buot kag mabudlay para sa iya nga prinsipyo, nagtuman siya sa requirement kag nag-post sa social media nga suportado niya si Marcos.
english: According to Dimafiles, although he was upset and difficult for his principles, he complied with the requirement and posted on social media that he supported Marcos.

text: Apisar sini, ginkakas gihapon si Dimafiles sa ila nga partido.
english: Despite this, Dimafiles was still expelled from their party.

text: Kahapon, Marso 4, ginapahayag nagtakod sang tarpaulin ang iya nga ka-partido, wala nalakip ang iya nga picture, kag nakumpirma nga wala na siya sa grupo.
english: Yesterday, March 4, his partymate allegedly put up a tarpaulin, his picture was not included, and it was confirmed that he is no longer in the group.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga bisan may option man ini nga magpadalagan bilang independent candidate, nag-desisyon na lang ini nga mag-isol sa eleksyon kag i-tutok ang iya nga tyempo agud nga magkampanya para kay Robredo.
english: He said that although he had the option to run as an independent candidate, he decided to withdraw from the election and focus his time on campaigning for Robredo.

text: Plano ni Dimafiles nga mag-upod na lang sa mga volunteer groups nga nagasuporta sa presidential bid ni Robredo.
english: Dimafiles plans to join volunteer groups that support Robredo's presidential bid.

text: Nakaagi ka na langoy sa kahawaan?
english: Have you ever swam in space?

text: Posible na ina subong sa Sky Pool didto sa London — bag-o bukas nga swimming pool nga nahimo na nga atraksyon kag viral subong sa social media.
english: That’s now possible at the Sky Pool in London — new open swimming pool that’s already become an attraction and is now viral on social media.

text: Ang bag-o nga Sky Pool isa ka transparent nga swimming pool nga gintukod sa tunga sang duha ka building nga nagataas sang kapin 100 ka tapak.
english: The new Sky Pool is a transparent swimming pool built between two buildings that rises over 100 feet.

text: Ini nga acrylic pool ang nagalaba sang 80 ka tapak, kag 45 ka tapak sini ang yara gid sa tunga sang duha ka high-rise building — buot silingon, kun sin-o man ang nagalangoy didto sa ibabaw, mahatagan siya sang illusion nga nagalutaw siya sa panganod.
english: This acrylic pool is 80 feet long, and 45 feet of it is actually between two high-rise buildings — meaning that whoever swims up there will be given the illusion that he or she is floating in the clouds.

text: Mayo 19 sang ginbuksan ang amo nga pool.
english: The pool was opened on May 19.

text: Summer sang 2020 ang orihinal nga plano sa pagbukas sini apang na-delay bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: It was originally planned to open in the summer of 2020 but was delayed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Limitado lamang ini sa mga residente sang Embassy Gardens apartments.
english: This is limited to residents of the Embassy Gardens apartments.

text: Sa kilid sang pool, sa may building, may yara sang spa, bar, private cinema, indoor pool, co-working spaces, kag greenhouse nga may yara sang orange trees.
english: Poolside, along the building, there is a spa, bar, private cinema, indoor pool, co-working spaces, and greenhouse with orange trees.

text: Apang indi man basta-basta nga makalangoy diri, ha.
english: But it's not easy to swim here, either.

text: Kinahanglan mo anay nga mangin residente sang apartment.
english: You need to be a resident of the apartment first.

text: Ini nga pool ang nagapangaga sa kalabanan — ilabi na sa mga tawo nga tuman ang kahadlok sa heights.
english: This pool is jaw-dropping for most — especially for people who are extremely afraid of heights.

text: Siling pa gani sang iban, ini nga pool, isa ka “disaster that’s already happened.”Te, masarangan mo ni?
english: Some even say that this pool is a “disaster that’s already happened.” Well, can you handle it?

english: According to the forecast track, the typhoon will landfall — or pass near — Eastern Visayas or the Dinagat Islands tonight or tomorrow morning.

english: It will continue to pass through the Visayas until Sunday, next emerge in the Sulu Sea, and may pass near northern Palawan on Monday morning.

english: The state weather bureau expects the typhoon to strengthen slightly before landfall but will remain a tropical depression throughout the forecast period.
