english: It will strengthen again when it is in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Si Wilma amo ang una nga bagyo sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) subong nga Disyembre.
english: Wilma is the first typhoon in the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) this December.

text: Napilian ang Tony Award-winning singer kag Broadway star nga si Lea Salonga nga latest celebrity nga iga-immortalize bilang Madame Tussauds wax figure.
english: Tony Award-winning singer and Broadway star Lea Salonga has been chosen as the latest celebrity to be immortalized as a Madame Tussauds wax figure.

text: Ginsapubliko ini sa social media pages sang Madame Tussauds Singapore, Hunyo 5.
english: It was made public on Madame Tussauds Singapore’s social media pages, June 5.

text: “Shining, Shimmering, Splendid!
english: “Shining, Shimmering, Splendid!

text: The legendary Lea Salonga will have her very own wax figure in #MadameTussaudsSH!
english: The legendary Lea Salonga will have her very own wax figure in #MadameTussaudsSH!

text: Are you as excited as we are?” kabahin sang caption.
english: Are you as excited as we are?” part of the caption.

text: Kasunod sang pagpakita sang behind-the-scenes sa paghimo sang wax figure, ginsiling naman sang Filipino icon nga isa ka “absolute honor”, “privilege”, kag “fantastic” nga eksperyensya nga madugang siya sa mga personalidad nga may wax figure.
english: Following the behind-the-scenes demonstration of the wax figure, the Filipino icon said it was an “absolute honor”, ​​“privilege”, and “fantastic” experience to be added to the list of personalities who have wax figures.

text: Magluwas sa local productions kag projects, kilala si Lea sa musicals sa Broadway sa New York kag sa West End sa London.
english: In addition to local productions and projects, Lea is known for musicals on Broadway in New York and the West End in London.

text: Nangin star siya sa Miss Saigon, Les Misérables, Once on This Island, kag ang pinakaulihi amo ang Here Lies Love nga may apat ka Tony Award nominations lakip ang Best Choreography, Best Sound, Best Original Score (Music and/or Lyrics) Written for the Theater, kag Best Scenic Design of a Musical.
english: He starred in Miss Saigon, Les Misérables, Once on This Island, and most recently Here Lies Love with four Tony Award nominations including Best Choreography, Best Sound, Best Original Score (Music and/or Lyrics) Written for the Theater, and Best Scenic Design of a Musical.

text: Ang 53-anyos man nga singer-actress amo ang singing voice sa likod sang Disney princesses nga sanday Jasmine kag Mulan.
english: The 53-year-old singer-actress is also the singing voice behind Disney princesses Jasmine and Mulan.

text: Ang iban pa nga mga Pinoy nga may Madame Tussauds wax figures amo ang boxing legend nga si Manny Pacquiao, Miss Universe titleholders nga sanday Pia Wurtzbach kag Catriona Gray, kag ang aktres nga si Anne Curtis.
english: Other Filipinos with Madame Tussauds wax figures include boxing legend Manny Pacquiao, Miss Universe titleholders Pia Wurtzbach and Catriona Gray, and actress Anne Curtis.

text: Ginkwestyon ni Sen.
english: Questioned by Sen.

text: Robin Padilla ang madugay nga pagpasar sang layi para dumilian ang political dynasties sa pungsond.
english: Robin Padilla the long-awaited passage of a law to ban political dynasties in the country.

text: Lakip si Padilla sa mga lawmakers nga nag-file sang hagna kontra political dynasties sa Kongreso.
english: Padilla is among the lawmakers who filed a bill against political dynasties in Congress.

text: “Hindi ito laban sa pamilya kundi laban sa sistemang humahadlang sa pantay na oportunidad, malinis na pamamahala, at tunay na serbisyo publiko… Ang pamahalaan ay dapat bukas sa lahat ng karapat-dapat at hindi minamana,” suno sa senador.
english: “This is not against the family but against a system that hinders equal opportunities, clean governance, and true public service... Government should be open to all who deserve it and not inherit it,” the senator said.

text: Matandaan nga ginaprayoridad ni Pres.
english: It can be recalled that Pres.

text: Bongbong Marcos ang pagpasar sa Anti-Political Dynasty Bill.
english: Bongbong Marcos the passage of the Anti-Political Dynasty Bill.

text: Ini ang mensahe ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This is the message of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: angot sa pagkay-o sa San Juan Juanico Bridge.
english: regarding the repair of the San Juan Juanico Bridge.

text: Suno kay Marcos, naglab-ot sa P1.1 billion ang nagasto sa pag-retrofit sa taytay.
english: According to Marcos, P1.1 billion was spent on the retrofit of the bridge.

text: “We would not have to do any of this kung ‘yung every three years iniinspeksyon, inaayos… Eh kung saan-saan napunta, kaya’t hindi na nag-inspeksyon, kaya tayo nagkaganito,” pahayag sang Presidente.
english: “We would not have to do any of this if every three years it was inspected, fixed... Eh wherever it went, so it didn't inspect, so we are like this,” the President said.

text: Sa subong, ginbuksan na ang taytay para sa mga salakyan nga indi maglapaw sa 15-ton load limit.
english: So far, the bridge has been opened to vehicles not exceeding the 15-ton load limit.

text: Target nga mangin fully functional ang San Juanico Bridge sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The San Juanico Bridge is targeted to be fully functional next year.

text: Duda ang isa ka political analyst kun magatambong na si presidential candidate former Senator Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos, Jr.
english: A political analyst doubts whether presidential candidate former Senator Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos, Jr. will attend.

text: sa debate nga iga-organisar sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) apisar nga ihatag sang abanse ang “general idea” sang debate topics.
english: in the debate to be organized by the Commission on Elections (Comelec) despite giving the “general idea” of the debate topics in advance.

text: Una diri, mismo si Marcos ang nagpahayag sa isa ka ambush interview nga indi pa siya sigurado kun yara ang iya nga presensya sa debate sa Marso 19 bangud ginalantaw pa niya kun ano ang mangin format.
english: Earlier, Marcos himself said in an ambush interview that he is not sure if he will be present in the debate on March 19 because he is still looking at what the format will be.

text: Ang Comelec naman ang nagpasugot na nga mag-release sang ‘general idea’ kun ano ang mga topiko sa amo nga adlaw agud nga mangin ‘fair’ man sa tagsa ka kandidato.
english: The Comelec has agreed to release a general idea of ​​the topics on the day so that it will be fair to each candidate.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Joenar Pueblo, iya ginpahayag nga mangin makakilibot ang desisyon ni Marcos kun magpasugot na ini nga magtambong sa debate.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Joenar Pueblo, he said that Marcos' decision would be surprising if he agreed to attend the debate.

text: Ini bangud ginalantaw ni Pueblo nga gina-maintain na lang sang kampo ni Marcos ang figures samtang nagahilapit ang eleksyon: buot silingon, indi sini luyag nga mabuhinan ang iya nga boto — kun halimbawa — indi mangin maayo ang iya nga performance sa tunga-tunga sang mga masumalang nga pamangkot.
english: This is because Pueblo sees that the Marcos camp is just maintaining the figures as the election approaches: that is, it does not want to reduce its vote — if, for example — it does not perform well in the midst of the questions.

text: Magluwas diri suno kay Pueblo, posible nga nakit-an sang kampo ni Marcos nga leading man gihapon ini sa presidential surveys apisar nga pila ka beses naman ini nag-snub sang presidential interviews kag forums.
english: Besides, Pueblo said, it is possible that Marcos' camp has seen that he is still leading in presidential surveys despite having snubbed presidential interviews and forums several times.

text: Kun madumduman, ang lamang gintambungan ni Marcos amo ang mga debate nga gina-host sang media kag grupo nga ginapahayag kilala nga ‘friendly’ sa iya.
english: Marcos only attended debates hosted by the media and groups that were allegedly known to be 'friendly' to him.

text: SIN-O NAMAN ANG MAKABENEPISYO KUN MAGPADAYON SA PAGTAMBONG SA PRESIDENTIAL DEBATE?
english: WHO WILL BENEFIT IF YOU CONTINUE TO ATTEND THE PRESIDENTIAL DEBATE?

text: Ang debate ang tion suno kay Pueblo agud nga ma-presentar sang kandidato ang iya nga political awareness kag kun paano sini madala ang iya nga kaugalingon sa tunga sang mga kabudlayan.
english: The debate, Pueblo said, is the time for the candidate to present his political awareness and how he can carry himself in the midst of difficulties.

text: Diri halimbawa makit-an kun paano mag-responde ang lider sa tion sang pressure— halimbawa sa krisis, sa isyu sa China, sa kalamidad sa pungsod, sa pamahog sang terorista, kag iban pa nga nagalakip sang national concern.
english: Here, for example, you can see how the leader responds in times of pressure—for example, in a crisis, in the issue of China, in a disaster in the country, in the threat of terrorism, and others that include national concern.

text: Sa assessment ni Pueblo, ang pinaka-benepisyo halin sang ginpatigayon ang nagliligad nga mga debate amo ang labor leader nga si Ka Leody De Guzman.
english: In Pueblo's assessment, the most beneficiary since the last debates was labor leader Ka Leody De Guzman.

text: Ginpahayag ni Pueblo nga kun halimbawa indi man magdaog si De Guzman subong nga tuig, sigurado nga magtatak na ang iya nga pangalan sa publiko kag pwede sini magamit sa masunod nga eleksyon bangud nangin maayo man ang iya mga sabat sa nagliligad nga forums kag debate.
english: Pueblo said that if De Guzman does not win this year, his name will surely be stamped in the public and can be used in the next election because his answers in previous forums and debates have been good.

text: ILOILO CITY- Temprano pa nga natapos ang kampanya sang Filipino boxer nga si Eumir Marcial sa Paris Olympics matapos napierde ini sa kamot sang boxer sang Uzbekistan nga si Turabek Khabibullaev sa Round of 16 sa men’s 80kg division.
english: ILOILO CITY- Filipino boxer Eumir Marcial's campaign at the Paris Olympics ended early after he lost to Uzbekistan boxer Turabek Khabibullaev in the Round of 16 in the men's 80kg division.

text: Ang judges naghatag sang score nga 29-28, 29-28, 29-28, 30-27, 29-28, tanan pabor kay Khabibullaev.
english: The judges scored it 29-28, 29-28, 29-28, 30-27, 29-28, all in favor of Khabibullaev.

text: Hulaton naman ni Khabibullaev ang winner sa tunga sang Cuba nga si Arlen López kag Turkish nga si Kaan Aykutsun sa masunod nga round.
english: Khabibullaev will wait for the winner between Cuba's Arlen López and Turkish Kaan Aykutsun in the next round.

text: Si Marcial nga tumandok sang Zamboanga ang nangin bronze medalist sa Tokyo Olympics 2020.
english: Marcial, a native of Zamboanga, became the bronze medalist at the Tokyo Olympics 2020.

text: Wala pa man nakaguwa sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) si Bagyo Kristine apang nagpalangkalaak na sa P9.75-million ang balor sang kahalitan nga nabilin sini sa sektor sang agrikultura.
english: Typhoon Kristine has not yet left the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) but has already caused P9.75-million worth of damage to the agricultural sector.

text: Suno sa latest bulletin sang Department of Agriculture (DA), masobra na sa 230 ka mga mangunguma kag masobra 200 ektarya sang duta nga pang-agrikultura ang nahalitan nga may volume sang production loss nga 598 metric tons.
english: According to the latest bulletin of the Department of Agriculture (DA), more than 230 farmers and more than 200 hectares of agricultural land have been damaged with a volume of production loss of 598 metric tons.

text: Nagsugod naman ang ahensya sa pagpatigayon sang price monitoring sa posible nga mga pagbag-o sa presyo sang agricultural commodities.
english: The agency has started conducting price monitoring on possible changes in the prices of agricultural commodities.

text:
Yari ang lista sang available interventions/aid ukon assistance packages:

Una na nga nagpahanumdom ang ahensya sa mga mangunguma nga anihon na nga daan ang gulang na nga mga tanum agud nga indi matam-an sa halit nga dal-on sang bagyo.
english:
Here is a list of available interventions/aid or assistance packages:

The agency earlier reminded farmers to harvest old plants in advance to avoid the damage caused by the typhoon.

text: Si Bagyo Kristine amo na ang ika-11 nga nagsulod sa Pilipinas subong nga tuig.
english: Typhoon Kristine is the 11th to hit the Philippines this year.

text: Kun binag-binagon mo, mahambal mo bala kun ano ang masarangan mo nga himuon para sa imo nga kahagugma kag sa ngalan sang imo pagtuo?
english: When you think about it, can you say what you can do for your loved one and in the name of your faith?

text: Sa Bindura, Zimbabwe, may isa ka lalaki nga Youth Leader sang ila simbahan kag luyag testingan ang kaalwan sang Diyos pinaagi sa pagfasting ukon indi pagkaon sa sulod sang 40 ka-adlaw.
english: In Bindura, Zimbabwe, there was a man who was a Youth Leader of his church and wanted to test God's goodness by fasting or not eating for 40 days.

text: Siya amo Mark Muradzira, 27 anyos kag unemployed ukon wala sang trabaho.
english: He is Mark Muradzira, 27 years old and unemployed.

text: Sang ginpangayuan si Muradzira sang iya girlfriend sang dream car sini nga Lamborghini, tuman ang iya kadismaya bangud indi niya masarangan ang balor sini ilabi pa nga wala man siya sang trabaho.
english: When Muradzira was asked by his girlfriend for his dream car, a Lamborghini, he was very disappointed because he could not afford the value of it especially since he did not have a job.

text: Bangud kumbinsido si Muradzira nga sabton sang Diyos ang iya pangamuyo nga hatagan siya sang sports car nga Lamborghini, nagdesisyon siya nga magfasting sa sulod sang 40 ka-adlaw.
english: Convinced that God would answer his prayer to give him a Lamborghini sports car, Muradzira decided to fast for 40 days.

text: Diri kag gin-isolate niya ang iya kaugalingon sa isa ka maligwin nga kagulangan agud makalikaw sa temptasyon sang pagkaon.
english: It was here that he isolated himself in a secluded forest to escape the temptation of food.

text: Sa masubo nga palad, napaslawan si Muradzira sa iya nga plano bangud sa iya ika-33 nga adlaw sang pagfasting, nasapwan na lamang siya sang iya mga abyan nga nagapanghina na kag halos mabawian sang kabuhi.
english: Unfortunately, Muradzira failed in his plan because on his 33rd day of fasting, he was found by his friends who was weakening and almost died.

text: Gilayon man nga gindala ang lalaki sa ospital agud madapatan sang pagbulong.
english: The man was rushed to the hospital for treatment.

text: Masubo naman nga ginpahayag ni Bishop Mawuru, church leader ni Muradzira, nga kuntani nagfasting nalang ini agud makaangkon sang trabaho kag indi para magpangayo sang Lamborghini.
english: Bishop Mawuru, Muradzira's church leader, said he should have fasted to get a job and not to ask for a Lamborghini.

text: Isa ka shooting incident ang natabo sa sulod mismo sang Sangguniang Bayan Office sa Ibajay, Aklan.
english: A shooting incident occurred inside the Sangguniang Bayan Office in Ibajay, Aklan.

text: Ang ginapahayag nga biktima amo si Ibajay Vice Mayor Julio Estolloso.
english: The alleged victim was identified as Ibajay Vice Mayor Julio Estolloso.

text: Ang ginatudlo nga suspek amo si SB Member Mihrel Senatin.
english: The suspect is identified as SB Member Mihrel Senatin.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: (This is a developing story.
english: (This is a developing story.

text: Standby for updates.)
english: Standby for updates.)

text: Hambal sang katigulangan, kun ikaw ang ginkuha bilang maninay ukon maninoy, nagakadapat nga indi mo ini pagbalibadan.
english: The old saying goes, if you are taken as a mother-in-law or a mother-in-law, you should not refuse it.

text: Apang masarangan mo bala ini tungdan kun madamo sang “demands” ang ginakanan sang imo nga ihado ukon ihada?
english: But can you handle it if your grandchildren have a lot of demands?

text: Isa ka lalaki sa United Kingdom ang gintawag nga “selfish” sang mga ginikanan sang iya kuntani ihado matapos nagpamalibad ini nga mangin maninoy.
english: A man in the United Kingdom was called “selfish” by the parents of his would-be son-in-law after he refused to become a son-in-law.

text: Ini bangud daw kaangay nga may yara sang kontrata sa tunga sang ginikanan kag sang lalaki kag may mga ginapangayo ini nga wala sa lugar.
english: This is because it sounds like there is a contract between the parent and the man and it has demands that are out of place.

text: Ginkakibot na lang sang lalaki nga may yara sang envelope nga nag-abot sa iya balay sa diin nalakip ang malaba nga listahan sang ginapangayo sang ginikanan sang bata lakip na ang pagsaylo sang lalaki sang relihiyon kag pagregalo sa bata sang kwarta nga nagabug-os sang 18,000 british pound ukon P1.2 million sa tanan nga okasyon.
english: The man was surprised when an envelope arrived at his house containing a long list of demands from the child's parents including the man's conversion of religion and gifting the child with money amounting to 18,000 British pounds or P1.2 million on all occasions.

text: Magluwas sa malaba nga listahan, may yara pa sang legal contract nga nalakip sa diin kinahanglan sang lalaki nga magpirma agud nga mangin maninoy.
english: In addition to the long list, there is also a legal contract attached which the man needs to sign in order to become the father-in-law.

text: Ti ikaw, luyag mo pa bala nga mangin maninoy ukon maninay kun may mga amo sini nga ginapangayo ang ginikanan sang bata?
english: Would you still want to be a mother-in-law or a mother-in-law if the child's parents have such demands?

text: PARIS, FRANCE-Buhi sa gihapon ang paglaum sang Pinay boxer nga si Nesthy Petecio nga makakuhan sang Olympic gold medal.
english: PARIS, FRANCE-Finay boxer Nesthy Petecio's hopes of winning an Olympic gold medal are still alive.

text: Ini matapos ginlutos sang Filipina star ang mas bataon nga kasumpong nga Indian boxer nga si Jaismine Lamboria paagi sa unanimous decision sa round-of-32 sa women’s 57kg division sa hampang nga ginpatigayon sa North Paris Arena.
english: This comes after the Filipina star defeated younger opponent Indian boxer Jaismine Lamboria by unanimous decision in the round-of-32 in the women’s 57kg division in the match held at the North Paris Arena.

text: Si Petecio ang ikaduha nga member sang Philippine boxing team nga nag- advance kasunod ni Aira Villegas.
english: Petecio is the second member of the Philippine boxing team to advance after Aira Villegas.

text: Si Petecio nga silver medalist sa Tokyo Games sang 2021, ang nagdaug sa lima ka judges’ scorecards batok sa 22-anyos nga kasumpong.
english: Petecio, a silver medalist at the Tokyo Games in 2021, won all five judges’ scorecards over a 22-year-old opponent.

text: Liwat nga magaaway si Petecio sa Agusto 2 batok sa home bet nga si Amina Zidani sa round-of-16.
english: Petecio will fight again on August 2 against home bet Amina Zidani in the round-of-16.

text: Nagpasaka ang civil society members kag church personalities sang kaso nga plunder batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte sa Office of the Ombudsman subong nga adlaw, Disyembre 12, bangud sang ginaalegar nga ma-anomaliya nga paggamit sang confidential funds.
english: Civil society members and church personalities filed a case of plunder against Vice President Sara Duterte with the Office of the Ombudsman today, December 12, for alleged anomalous use of confidential funds.

text:
Lakip man sa ginpasaka nga panumbungon pati na sa mga personnel sang Office of the Vice President (OVP) kag Department of Education (DepEd) kun sa diin tiglikom anay ang bise-presidente amo ang masunod:

Lakip sa mga nagpasaka sang reklamo amo ang activists-priests nga sanday Flavie Villanueva kag Roberto Reyes, anay Finance Undersecretary Cielo Magno, former peace adviser Teresita Deles, kag iban pa.
english:
Also among the charges filed against personnel of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) and Department of Education (DepEd) where the vice-president was a secretary are the following:

Among those who filed complaints were activists-priests Flavie Villanueva and Roberto Reyes, former Finance Undersecretary Cielo Magno, former peace adviser Teresita Deles, and others.

text: Kun balikan, nabalahuba sa legislative inquiry nga ang contingent funds sang 2022 national budget ang ginsaylo para sa P125-million confidential funds sang OVP.
english: In retrospect, the legislative inquiry revealed that the contingent funds of the 2022 national budget were transferred to the P125-million confidential funds of the OVP.

text: Ini nga kantidad ang gingasto sang opisina ni Duterte sa sulod lamang sang 11 ka adlaw.
english: This amount was spent by Duterte's office in just 11 days.

text: Sang Hunyo naman, gin-adoptar sang Kamara ang report sang Committee on Good Government nga naga-rekomendar sang pagpasaka sang criminal, civil, and administrative complaints batok sa Vice President.
english: In June, the House adopted the report of the Committee on Good Government recommending the filing of criminal, civil, and administrative complaints against the Vice President.

text: Natukiban sang panel nga ang P612.5 million confidential funds ang gin-disburse sa idalom sang liderato ni Duterte sa OVP kag DepEd.
english: The panel found that P612.5 million confidential funds were disbursed under Duterte's leadership to the OVP and DepEd.

text: Matandaan nga ang isyu sa confidential funds ang isa man sa nangin basehan sang gin-file sang Kamara ang impeachment complaint batok sa Vice President bangud sang ginapahayag pag-traidor sang bise presidente sa public trust kag pag-komiter sang graft and corruption sa iya nga misuse kag malversation sang iya nga confidential funds.
english: The issue of confidential funds was also one of the basis for the House of Representatives to file an impeachment complaint against the Vice President for allegedly betraying the public trust and committing graft and corruption in his misuse and malversation of his confidential funds.

text: Wala pa nakabaton ang opisina ni Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna-Chairman on Committee on Transportation sang memorandum halin sa Land Transportation Office (LTO) kaangot sa pagpanakop sang e-bikes kag e-trikes sa mga national road.
english: The office of Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna-Chairman on Committee on Transportation has not yet received a memorandum from the Land Transportation Office (LTO) regarding the seizure of e-bikes and e-trikes on national roads.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Cabaluna, ginpahayag sini nga inisyal na sila nga nakaistorya ni LTO 6 Regional Director Gaudioso Geduspan II kag nagsiling nga kinahanglan sang iya opisina sang pormalidad ukon nakasulat sa papel agud maimplentar sang insakto sa siyudad ang amo nga pagsulundan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Cabaluna said they have initially spoken with LTO 6 Regional Director Gaudioso Geduspan II and said that his office needs formalities or written on paper to implement the rule properly in the city.

text: Suno kay Cabaluna, pabor man ini sa mega e-bikes kag e-trikes nga mag-operate bangud sustainable kag environment friendly apang mas mayo kun yara lang sa ila mga barangay bangud sa kapasidad sang amo nga mga salakyan.
english: According to Cabaluna, he is also in favor of mega e-bikes and e-trikes to operate because they are sustainable and environment friendly but it is better if they are in their barangays because of the capacity of these vehicles.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-hold man sang LTO ang pag-impound sang mga e-bikes kag e-trikes agud makapatigayon pa sang information drive ang amo nga ahensya.
english: The LTO also suspended the impoundment of e-bikes and e-trikes so that the agency can conduct more information drives.

text: Suno man kay LTO Chief, Asec.
english: According to LTO Chief, Asec.

text: Markus Lacaniolao, magasugod sa Enero 2, 2026 anfg enforcfement kag impounding operations sang nasambit nga mga salakyan.
english: Markus Lacaniolao, the enforcfement and impounding operations of these vehicles will start on January 2, 2026.

text: Nag-atras ang Filipina beauty queen nga si Krishnah Gravidez sa Miss Charm International competition.
english: Filipina beauty queen Krishnah Gravidez withdrew from the Miss Charm International competition.

text: Wala sang gintumod nga rason si Gravidez sa iya pag-withdraw sa kumpetisyon apang ginsiling sini nga ginpadalman niya ang amo nga desisyon.
english: Gravidez did not specify a reason for his withdrawal from the competition but said he took the decision seriously.

text: “To the pageant fans, Team Strawberries, my Vietnamese supporters, and my core team, who watched my journey and waited, I thank you for holding on.
english: “To the pageant fans, Team Strawberries, my Vietnamese supporters, and my core team, who watched my journey and waited, I thank you for holding on.

text: After much consideration and reflection, I regret to inform you that I have decided to withdraw from the Miss Charm International competition,” kabahin sang statement.
english: After much consideration and reflection, I regret to inform you that I have decided to withdraw from the Miss Charm International competition,” the statement read.

text: Ginpasalamatan sini ang tanan nga nangin kabahin sang iya journey lakip na ang giya sang Miss Universe Philippines kag Miss Charm Philippines.
english: She thanked everyone who has been a part of her journey including the guidance of Miss Universe Philippines and Miss Charm Philippines.

text: “Thank you once again for the incredible journey with Miss Universe Philippines and Miss Charm Philippines.
english: “Thank you once again for the incredible journey with Miss Universe Philippines and Miss Charm Philippines.

text: I will always cherish the memories and lessons learned during my time of reign,” dugang ni Gravidez.
english: I will always cherish the memories and lessons learned during my time of reign,” Gravidez added.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala pa sang kasiguraduhan kun san-o hiwaton ang Miss Charm 2024 apisar nga masobra isa ka tuig na nga nakoronahan si Gravidez.
english: It is known that there is still no certainty when Miss Charm 2024 will be held despite the fact that Gravidez has been crowned for more than a year.

text: Ginrepresentar sini anay ang Baguio City sa Miss Universe Philippines 2023 kag nakuha ang titulo sang nagtapos sa Top 3 sang Mayo sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: She previously represented Baguio City at Miss Universe Philippines 2023 and won the title when finishing in the Top 3 in May last year.

text: Nagbulos siya kay Annabelle McDonnell nga amo ang first runner-up sa global tilt sang Pebrero 2023.
english: She succeeds Annabelle McDonnell who was the first runner-up in the February 2023 global tilt.

text: Apang ini nga titulo ang na-turn over na ni Gravidez sa Top 10 finisher nga si Cyrille Payumo sang nagligad lamang nga bulan sang ginpatigayon ang Miss Universe 2024.
english: But this title was already turned over by Gravidez to Top 10 finisher Cyrille Payumo just last month when Miss Universe 2024 was held.

text: Wala pa sang official statement ang Miss Universe Philippines Organization, Empire Philippines, The Miss Philippines, kag Miss Charm pageant kaangot sa desisyon sang Pinay nga mag-isol sa international pageant.
english: The Miss Universe Philippines Organization, Empire Philippines, The Miss Philippines, and Miss Charm pageant have yet to issue an official statement regarding the Filipina's decision to withdraw from the international pageant.

text: Gindakop ang isa ka PNP officer matapos nga ginreklamo bangud sa pagpangmolestiya sa isa ka babaye nga kadete.
english: A PNP officer was arrested after he was accused of molesting a female cadet.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginpahubog anay sang 35-anyos nga suspek nga isa ka Police Majro ang 23-anyos nga kadete sa sulod sang Philippine National Police Academy (PNPA) sa Silang, Cavite.
english: The 35-year-old suspect, a Police Major, allegedly got the 23-year-old cadet drunk inside the Philippine National Police Academy (PNPA) in Silang, Cavite.

text: Suno sa biktima, gnihagad siya sang suspek nga mag-inom kag sang nahubog na,didto na ginmolestiya sang suspek ang kadete.
english: According to the victim, the suspect invited her to drink and when she got drunk, the suspect molested the cadet.

text: Nakadalagan naman ang biktima kag nangayo sang bulig.
english: The victim ran away and called for help.

text: Gilayon nga naaresto ang suspect nga nagapangatubang sang kaso nga acts of lasciviousness.
english: The suspect was immediately arrested and faces charges of acts of lasciviousness.

text: May duha ka rason ang Italian high jumper nga si Gianmarco Tamberi agud nga indi sini malimtan ang iya papel bilang flag bearer sa opening ceremony sang Paris Olympics — una, isa ini ka daku nga dungog para sa iya; kag ikaduha, nadula niya ang iya wedding ring samtang bitbit ang hayahay.
english: Italian high jumper Gianmarco Tamberi has two reasons for not forgetting his role as flag bearer at the opening ceremony of the Paris Olympics — first, it is a great honor for him; and second, she lost her wedding ring while carrying the ring.

text: Sa isa ka Instagram post, ginsiling ni Tamberi nga ang bag-o nga puluy-an sang iya singsing amo na ang Seine River nga amo ang venue sang parada sang mga sakayan kadungan sang seremonya sang Byernes sang gab-i (Sabado sang kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas).
english: In an Instagram post, Tamberi said the new home of his ring will now be the Seine River which was the venue for the parade of boats in conjunction with the ceremony on Friday night (Saturday morning Philippine time).

text: Sa amo nga post, nagpangayo sang pasaylo ang high jumper sa iya asawa nga si Chiara Bontempi.
english: In the post, the high jumper apologized to his wife, Chiara Bontempi.

text: Duha ka tuig na sila nga kasal antes sini nadula ang iya singsing.
english: They had been married for two years before she lost her ring.

text: “I’m sorry my love, I’m so sorry,” kabahin sang sulat sini.
english: “I’m sorry my love, I’m so sorry,” she wrote in part.

text: “Too much water, too many kilograms lost over the last few months and maybe the uncontrollable enthusiasm of what we were doing.
english: “Too much water, too many kilograms lost over the last few months and maybe the uncontrollable enthusiasm of what we were doing.

text:
Probably all three things.”

Ginpahayag sini nga nakit-an pa niya ang iya singsing nga nadanlog sa iya tudlo tubtub nga nag-umpok ini sa sakayan kag dalayon nga nahulog sa suba.
english:
Probably all three things.”

He said he even saw his ring fall off his finger until it hit the boat and fell into the river.

text: “If it had to happen, if I really had to lose this ring, I couldn’t imagine a better place.
english: “If it had to happen, if I really had to lose this ring, I couldn’t imagine a better place.

text: It will remain forever on the riverbed in the City of Love,” pahayag sini sa iya asawa.
english: It will remain forever on the riverbed in the City of Love,” he told his wife.

text: Nag-suhestiyon pa ini sa iya asawa nga ihulog man ang iya singsing sa River Seine.
english: He even suggested to his wife that he also throw his ring into the River Seine.

text: “So that they will be together forever and we will have one more excuse to, as you have always asked me, renew our promises and get married again.
english: “So that they will be together forever and we will have one more excuse to, as you have always asked me, renew our promises and get married again.

text: I love you my love,” dugang sini.
english: I love you my love,” it added.

text:
“May it be a good omen for returning home with an even bigger gold!”

Sa baylo nga magpangakig ang asawa, positibo ang nangin reply sini sa iya bana.
english:
“May it be a good omen for returning home with an even bigger gold!”

Instead of becoming angry, the wife responded positively.

text: “Only you could turn this into something romantic,” sabat ni Ciara.
english: “Only you could turn this into something romantic,” Ciara replied.

text: Septyembre 2022 sang nagpakasal sanday Ciara kag Gianmarco.
english: It was September 2022 when Ciara and Gianmarco tied the knot.

text: Antes sini, ang nasambit nga three-time Olympian sang Italya ang nakabulsa man sang gold medal sa Tokyo Games sang 2021.
english: Previously, the three-time Olympian of Italy also pocketed a gold medal at the Tokyo Games in 2021.

text: Nangin popular man ini sang nakuha sini ang amo nga medalya bangud nagpasugot ini nga i-share ang high jump first-place medal kaupod kay Mutaz Barshim sang Qatar.#
english: He also became popular when he won the medal because he agreed to share the high jump first-place medal with Mutaz Barshim of Qatar.

text: Wala naglawig ang pagtinir sang isa ka Brazilian swimmer sa Paris, France matapos nga ginlapas sini ang pagsulundan paagi sa pagguwa sa Olympic village nga wala nakalisensya sa head sang ila delegasyon.
english: A Brazilian swimmer's stay in Paris, France did not last long after she broke the rules by leaving the Olympic village without a license from the head of her delegation.

text: Ini amo si Ana Carolina Vieira nga kabahin sang women’s 4×100 metre freestyle relay nga nagtapos bilang ika-12 sa heats.
english: This was Ana Carolina Vieira who was part of the women’s 4×100 meter freestyle relay who finished 12th in the heats.

text: Ginpahayag nga kasunod sang event sa La Defense Arena, siya kag ang iya nobyo nga si Gabriel Santos ang nagdesisyon nga magguwa sa ila ginatiniran nga village sang Hulyo 26 apisar nga wala gid nila napahibalo ang ila teammates ukon ang team leader.
english: It was reported that following the event at La Defense Arena, she and her boyfriend Gabriel Santos decided to leave their village on July 26 despite not informing their teammates or the team leader.

text: Nadiskubrehan ini sang nag-post sila sa ila nga social media accounts rason nga gin-report mismo sang swimming team sa Brazilian Olympic Committee (BOC).
english: This was discovered when they posted on their social media accounts and the swimming team reported it to the Brazilian Olympic Committee (BOC).

text:
Gilayon nga nag-desisyon ang BOC para disiplinahon ang duha: “In common agreement with the members of the sport’s Technical Committee, the Team Chief and the Brazilian Aquatic Sports Confederation (CBDA), the COB decided to punish the two athletes for having left the Olympic Village without authorization during the night last Friday.”

Nakabaton sang warning si Santos bangud sa iya ginhimo, apang mas malala ang disiplina kay Vierra bangud ginpa-diretso ini pauli sa Brazil bangud gin-challenge pa sini ang desisyon sang committee sa relay team formation.
english:
The BOC immediately decided to discipline the two: “In common agreement with the members of the sport’s Technical Committee, the Team Chief and the Brazilian Aquatic Sports Confederation (CBDA), the COB decided to punish the two athletes for having left the Olympic Village without authorization during last Friday night.”

Santos received a warning for his actions, but Vierra was disciplined worse because he was sent straight home to Brazil because he challenged the committee's decision on the relay team formation.

text: “The athlete Ana Carolina, in a disrespectful and aggressive manner, contested a technical decision made by the Brazilian National Swimming Team committee,” pahayag sang BOC.
english: “The athlete Ana Carolina, in a disrespectful and aggressive manner, contested a technical decision made by the Brazilian National Swimming Team committee,” the BOC said in a statement.

text: “Ana Carolina Vieira was punished with dismissal from the delegation.
english: “Ana Carolina Vieira was punished with dismissal from the delegation.

text:
She will return to Brazil immediately.”

Mangin ang swimming leader sang pungsod ang wala man nag-apin kay Viera; sa baylo, gintawag ini nga “completely inappropriate” nga paminatasan.
english:
She will return to Brazil immediately.”

Even the country's swimming leader did not defend Viera; instead, it was called “completely inappropriate” behavior.

text: “We’re not here playing or taking a vacation … we’re here working for Brazil, for the 200 million taxpayers who are working for us,” pahayag sini sa news agency nga Reuters.
english: “We’re not here playing or taking a vacation … we’re here working for Brazil, for the 200 million taxpayers who are working for us,” he told the Reuters news agency.

text: “We can’t play around here.
english: “We can’t play around here.

text:
She took a completely inappropriate position to make her point, her dismay, about the formation of the relay.”

Mangin ang pila sa Brazilian netizens ang nagkomento man sang ila pagkadismaya.
english:
She took a completely inappropriate position to make her point, her dismay, about the formation of the relay.”

Even some Brazilian netizens commented on their disappointment.

text: “They are there with public money, the minimum required is to respect the rules,” pahayag sang isa.
english: “They are there with public money, the minimum required is to respect the rules,” said one.

text: Sang yara pa lang kita sa lamharon nga edad, masami naton makit-an sa aton paborito nga cartoon character ang ila nagasaot nga ikog.
english: When we were young, we often saw our favorite cartoon characters with their dancing tails.

text: Masami naga-imagine kita kun ano ayhan ang pamatyagan kun may yara man kita sang matuod nga ikog kaangay sang iya ka kabayo kag ido.
english: We often imagine what it would be like to have a real tail like his horse and dog.

text: Kun ikaw tuman ka curious kag luyag mag-angkon sang ikog nga daw matuod-tuod, indi na magkabalaka bangud may kompaniya nga nagatanyag sang baligya nga animatronic tail ukon ikog para sa mga tawo sa diin nagahulag ini via smartphone commands.
english: If you are very curious and want to have a tail that looks real, don't worry because there is a company that offers for sale an animatronic tail or tail for people where it moves via smartphone commands.

text: Ang Tail Company ang 15 ka-tuig na nga nagahimo sang mga realistic nga human tails ukon ikog.
english: The Tail Company has been making realistic human tails for 15 years.

text: Ang ginabaligya nga ikog ang may yara man sang feature nga removable covers sa diin mahimo ikaw makacharge sang imo nga power bank nga nagagarantiya sang tubtob 10 ka-oras nga paggamit.
english: The tail also features removable covers where you can charge your power bank that guarantees up to 10 hours of use.

text: Kun kinahanglan mo sang animatronic tail para sa imo proyekto nga cosplay ukon luyag mo lamang mag-enjoy sang nagaikul-ikol nga ikog, maangkon mo na ini sa balor nga 150 dollars ukon kapin P7,300.
english: If you need an animatronic tail for your cosplay project or just want to enjoy the twisting tail, you can get it for 150 dollars or more than P7,300.

text: Walo ka tawo ang ginbawian sang kabuhi samtang 15 ang pilason matapos mahulog sa pil-as ang isa ka mini dump tuck sa Sitio Platacan, Brgy.
english: Eight people were killed and 15 injured after a mini dump tuck fell into a cliff in Sitio Platacan, Brgy.

text: Christianuevo, Lebak,Sultan Kudarat.
english: Christianuevo, Lebak, Sultan Kudarat.

text: Nakaangkon ang mga napatay nga biktima sang mga pilas kag mga bali sa lawas.
english: The deceased victims sustained injuries and fractures to their bodies.

text: Gindala naman sa ospital ang mga pilason.
english: The injured were taken to the hospital.

text: Ang mini dump truck ginamaneho ni Alvin Guiapar Adam, 38, sang Parang, Maguindanao nga may sakay nga 22 ka tawo nga lunsay taga- Maguindanao del Norte.
english: The mini dump truck was driven by Alvin Guiapar Adam, 38, of Parang, Maguindanao with 22 people on board, all from Maguindanao del Norte.

text: Ang salakyan naghalin sa Brgy.
english: The vehicle was coming from Brgy.

text: Poloy-Poloy pakadto sa Cotabato City sang hinali lang nadulaan sang preno ang salakyan sa dulhugon nga bahin sang dalan.
english: Poloy-Poloy to Cotabato City when the vehicle suddenly lost control of the brakes on the bumpy part of the road.

text: Wala nakontrol sang driver ang manibela gani nagbunggo ini sa barandilya sa kilid sang highway kag nahulog sa pil-as.
english: The driver lost control of the steering wheel and hit a railing on the side of the highway and fell into a ravine.

text: Pilason ang duha ka mga estudyante sa shooting incident  sa sulod sang isa ka eskwelahan sa Sta.
english: Two students were injured in a shooting incident inside a school in Sta.

text: Rosa, Nueva Ecija.
english: Rosa, Nueva Ecija.

text: Ang mga biktima lunsay high school students sang Sta.
english: The victims were all high school students of Sta.

text: Rosa Integrated School sa Nueva Ecija.
english: Rosa Integrated School in Nueva Ecija.

text: Ginpahayag nga sa sulod mismo sang classroom natabo ang pagpangluthang.
english: The shooting reportedly occurred inside the classroom.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, ginluthang sang lalaki ang isa ka babaye antes gintiro sang gunman ang iya kaugalingon.
english: According to initial reports, the man shot a woman before the gunman shot himself.

text: Ginaalegar nga may relasyon ang duha.
english: The two are alleged to be in a relationship.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon.
english: The investigation is still ongoing.

text: Nagpaandam ang Land Transportation Office (LTO) sa mga manugbaligya kag manugbakal sang salakyan nga magadagdag sila sang tubtob P40,000 nga penaliad kon sila ang mapaslawan sa pagreport sang benta kag pagsaylo sang mga rehistro sang salakyan sa sulod sang pila ka adlaw pagkatapos sang transaksyon, isa ka polisa nga mahimo makaapekto sa linibo nga nagagamit sang segunda mano nga mga salakyan kag motorsiklo.
english: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has warned vehicle sellers and buyers that it will add up to P40,000 in penalties if they fail to report the sale and transfer vehicle registrations within a few days of the transaction, a policy that could affect thousands of users of second-hand vehicles and motorcycles.

text: Suno sa mando sang LTO, dapat ireport sang manugbaligya ang pagbaligya sang salakyan sa sulod sang lima ka adlaw halin sang aktwal nga pagbaligya paagi sa online submission.
english: As per the LTO directive, the seller must report the sale of the vehicle within five days of the actual sale through online submission.

text: Lakip sa kinahanglanon para sa online nga pagsumiter nagalakip sang Orihinal nga Official Receipt kag Certificate of Registration (ORCR) sang salakyan, isa ka notaryado nga Deed of Sale ukon bisan ano nga Deed of Conveyance, kag duha ka valid nga mga ID sang gobyerno gikan sa duha ka partido.
english: Among the requirement for online submission include the Original Official Receipt and Certificate of Registration (ORCR) of the vehicle, a notarized Deed of Sale or any other Deed of Conveyance, and two valid government IDs from both parties.

text: Ang mapaslawan sa pagreport magaresulta sa P20,000 nga multa para sa manugbaligya.
english: Failure to report will result in a P20,000 fine for the seller.

text: Samtang, kinahanglan nga iproseso sang bag-o nga tag-iya ang registration kag transfer of ownership sang salakyan sa sulod sang 20 working days halin sa petsa sang pagbaligya.
english: Meanwhile, the new owner needs to process the registration and transfer of ownership of the vehicle within 20 working days from the date of sale.

text: Nagpaandam si Pope Leo XIV sa posible nga kunsekwensya sang artificial intelligence (AI) sa intellectual development sang mga kabataan.
english: Pope Leo XIV warned of the possible consequences of artificial intelligence (AI) on the intellectual development of children.

text: Sa iya mensahe sa ginpatigayon nga Rome Conference on AI, ginplastar sang Santo Papa nga daku ang mabulig sang AI sa pag-develop sang pila ka sektor kaangay sang healthcare kag scientific research.
english: In his message at the Rome Conference on AI, the Pope stressed that AI can greatly contribute to the development of several sectors such as healthcare and scientific research.

text: Apang nagpabutyag ini sang kahangawa sa malain nga epekto sini sa kabataan ilabi na sa kun paano nila hangpon ang reyalidad sa kabuhi.
english: But he expressed concern about the negative impact it has on children especially on how they understand the reality of life.

text: “AI, especially Generative AI, has opened new horizons on many different levels, including enhancing research in healthcare and scientific discovery, but also raises troubling questions on its possible repercussions on humanity’s openness to truth and beauty, on our distinctive ability to grasp and process reality,” pahayag sang Pope.
english: “AI, especially Generative AI, has opened new horizons on many different levels, including enhancing research in healthcare and scientific discovery, but also raises troubling questions on its possible repercussions on humanity’s openness to truth and beauty, on our distinctive ability to grasp and process reality,” the Pope said.

text: “No generation has ever had such quick access to the amount of information now available through AI,” kabahin pa sang mensahe sini sa business leaders, policymakers kag researchers sa tuigan nga conference.
english: “No generation has ever had such quick access to the amount of information now available through AI,” he said in a message to business leaders, policymakers and researchers at the annual conference.

text:
“But again, access to data — however extensive — must not be confused with intelligence.”

Nahibaluan nga si Pope Leo ang nangin target man sang deep fake videos kag audio messages nga ginpalapta sa social media sang naeeleher siya nga Santo Papa.
english:
“But again, access to data — however extensive — must not be confused with intelligence.”

Pope Leo was also the target of deep fake videos and audio messages spread on social media when he was elected Pope.

text: Naka-publish ini sa YouTube kag TikTok pages kag naga-broadcast sang AI-generated messages nga nagapapati sa publiko nga ini ang matuod nga mensahe sang Pope sa lenggwahe nga English ukon Spanish.
english: It is published on YouTube and TikTok pages and broadcasts AI-generated messages that make the public believe it is the Pope’s real message in English or Spanish.

text: Sang tion ni Pope Francis, ginpangunahan anay sang Vatican ang Rome Call for AI Ethics nga pirmado sang Microsoft, IBM, United Nations, Italy kag universities kun sa diin ginaduso ang transparency kag pagtahod sa privacy sang iban nga mga tawo.
english: During the time of Pope Francis, the Vatican led the Rome Call for AI Ethics signed by Microsoft, IBM, the United Nations, Italy and universities which promotes transparency and respect for the privacy of other people.

text: Gin-athag ni Executive Secretary Ralph Recto nga fake news ang Memorandum Circular 47 nga nagasiling nga wala sang opisina sa gobyerno sa bilog nga pungsod sa December 26 kag 29.
english: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto clarified that Memorandum Circular 47, which states that there will be no government offices nationwide on December 26 and 29, is fake news.

text: Nakabutang sa peke nga memo nga ang rason sang amo nga deklarasyon sa suspensiyon sang opisina sa gobyerno amo nga mahatagan sang tsansa ang kada pamilya subong nga holiday season.
english: The fake memo states that the reason for the declaration of suspension of government offices is to give every family a chance this holiday season.

text: Apang suno kay Recto, indi matuod ang nasambit nga dokumento kag wala sang ginapagwa ang Palasyo nga amo nga Memorandum Circular.
english: However, Recto said the document is not true and the Palace does not issue a Memorandum Circular.

text: Ginmanduan ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr.

text: ang Bureau of Animal Industry (BAI) nga tutukan ang refinement sang protocols agud nga mapadasig ang roll-out sang African swine fever (ASF) vaccines matapos nakit-an ang maayo nga resulta sini sa pilot sites.
english: the Bureau of Animal Industry (BAI) to focus on the refinement of protocols to accelerate the roll-out of African swine fever (ASF) vaccines after seeing good results in pilot sites.

text: “We’re hopeful that impending changes to the vaccination protocol will finally fast-track the vaccine rollout and finally address our problem with this stubborn virus,” pahayag sini sa isa ka statement.
english: “We’re hopeful that impending changes to the vaccination protocol will finally fast-track the vaccine rollout and finally address our problem with this stubborn virus,” it said in a statement.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, sa Lobo, Batangas nga amo ang ground zero sang latest nga outbreak, masobra tatlo ka dosena nga baboy nga natublukan sang ASF vaccine halin sa Vietnam ang naka-develop sang bastante nga antibodies batok sa virus.
english: Last month, in Lobo, Batangas, the ground zero of the latest outbreak, more than three dozen pigs injected with the ASF vaccine from Vietnam developed sufficient antibodies against the virus.

text: Una nga nakabakal ang ahensya sang 10,000 doses sang sini nga Vietnamese-developed AVAC live vaccines paagi sa emergency procurement sang Agusto bilang kabahin sang plano nga magpanagtag sang 600,000 nga vaccine doses.
english: The agency first purchased 10,000 doses of these Vietnamese-developed AVAC live vaccines through emergency procurement in August as part of a plan to distribute 600,000 vaccine doses.

text: Apang nakahibalo man si Tiu Laurel nga madamo gihapon nga backyard hog raisers ang naga-alang-alang nga mag-upod sa ASF vaccine rollout bangud sa negatibo nga impresyon kag bangud sa kahangawa nga basi kun ihawon ang ila sagod nga baboy kun makit-an sa tests nga infected ini sang balatian.
english: However, Tiu Laurel is also aware that many backyard hog raisers are still reluctant to join the ASF vaccine rollout due to negative impressions and fears that their pigs might be slaughtered if tests show that they are infected with the disease.

text: Base sa latest nga data sang BAI kaangot sa ASF infection, as of October 2, may 30 ka mga probinsya sa 14 ka mga rehiyon sa pungsod ang may yara sang aktibo nga ASF cases.
english: Based on the latest data of the BAI on ASF infection, as of October 2, there are 30 provinces in 14 regions in the country with active ASF cases.

text: Una nga natabo ang ASF outbreak sa Pilipinas sang 2019 kun sa diin suno sa DA, nabudlayan gid ang hog industry sa pagbangon sa tuman ka malala nga epekto sini sa industrya sang baboy.#
english: The first ASF outbreak in the Philippines occurred in 2019 where, according to the DA, the hog industry struggled to recover from its severe impact on the pig industry.

text: Nagdugang ang actor nga si Dominic Roque sa lista sang showbiz personalities nga nagpasaka sang cyber libel complaint batok sa columnist kag online show host nga si Cristy Fermin.
english: Actor Dominic Roque has joined the list of showbiz personalities who have filed a cyber libel complaint against columnist and online show host Cristy Fermin.

text:
Gin-file ang reklamo sa Office of the City Prosecutor sa Pasig City bangud sa ginpahayag nga “malicious statements and innuendos” ni Fermin sa iya nga show nga “Showbiz Now Na.”

The complaint was filed with the Office of the City Prosecutor in Pasig City over Fermin's alleged “malicious statements and innuendos” on his show “Showbiz Now Na.”

english: In February, in the midst of Dominic and Bea's breakup, the actor's legal team issued a statement condemning Fermin's "malicious and defamatory public statements" on the issue.

text: Mangin magahod ang probinsya sang Iloilo kadungan sang mangin komemorasyon sang ika-36 nga anibersaryo sang 1986 People Power Revolution nga amo ang nagsipa sa pwesto sa anay diktador nga si late President Ferdinand Marcos, Sr.
english: Iloilo province will be bustling with the commemoration of the 36th anniversary of the 1986 People Power Revolution that ousted former dictator late President Ferdinand Marcos, Sr.

text: Sandig sa gin-isyu ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr.
english: According to a statement issued by Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr.

text: nga Executive Order No.
english: Executive Order No.

text:
136, yari ang mga balantayan nga aktibidad sa probinsya:

Sa Pebrero 25, patigayunon ang Freedom Rally sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol Grounds umpisa 8:00 sa gab-i.

May Freedom Countdown man nga himuon tubtub sa mismo oras kun san-o nagbiya si Marcos sa Pilipinas sang 1986.
english:
136, here are the activities to watch in the province:

On February 25, the Freedom Rally will be held at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol Grounds starting at 8:00 pm.

There will also be a Freedom Countdown until the very time when Marcos left the Philippines in 1986.

text: 9:25 p.m. ang exact time.
english: 9:25 p.m. is the exact time.

text:
Ang Freedom Countdown ang pagasundan naman sang People Power Noise Barrage nga himuon 9:25 sa gab-i.

Tanan nga ahensya sang gobyerno, establisyemento, sektor, kag households ang gina-engganyo nga magpartisipar sa amo nga noise barrage, kag tanan nga simbahan ang gina-hingyo man nga magbagting sang lingganay sa amo man nga oras.
english:
The Freedom Countdown will be followed by the People Power Noise Barrage at 9:25 pm.

All government agencies, establishments, sectors, and households are encouraged to participate in the noise barrage, and all churches are also requested to ring the bell at the same time.

text: Sa programa, imbitado ang mga alkalde sa probinsya.
english: In the program, the mayors of the province are invited.

text: Ang People Power Noise Barrage ang pagasundan sang People Power Caravan kun sa diin ang mga salakyan nga nagpartisipar sa Freedom Rally ang magapatigayon naman sang motorcade sa lain-lain nga bahin sang probinsya kag syudad sang Iloilo.
english: The People Power Noise Barrage will be followed by the People Power Caravan where the vehicles that participated in the Freedom Rally will conduct a motorcade in different parts of the province and Iloilo City.

text: Halin subong nga adlaw tubtub sa Pebrero 25, dapat man nga naka-display ang Philippine flags sa government offices, establishments, sectors, kag households.
english: From today until February 25, Philippine flags must also be on display in government offices, establishments, sectors, and households.

text: Gin-athag ni Defensor nga ini nga mga aktibidad ang ginbalay sandig sa Memorandum Circular No.
english: Defensor explained that these activities are outlined in Memorandum Circular No.

text: 2022-012 sang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG).
english: 2022-012 of the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG).

text: Ang amo nga circular ang naga-encourage sa local governments nga magdumdom sang 1986 revolt sa ila tagsa ka mga lugar.
english: The circular encourages local governments to commemorate the 1986 revolt in their respective areas.

text:
‘WE DON’T WANT TO FORGET IT’

“Ang gusto lang naton nga mensahe, ang People Power Revolution ari man di sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo, in the same manner that it was in EDSA,” suno kay Defensor.
english:
‘WE DON’T WANT TO FORGET IT’

“The message we want is that the People Power Revolution is here in Iloilo City and province, in the same manner that it was in EDSA,” Defensor said.

text: “We want to preserve our history.
english: “We want to preserve our history.

text: We don’t want to forget it, and we don’t want to change it,” dugang pa sang gobernador.
english: We don’t want to forget it, and we don’t want to change it,” the governor added.

text:
Subong nga tuig, ang commemoration sang EDSA ang may tema nga “Pagtutulungan Tungo sa Sama-Samang Pagbangon Mula sa Pandemya.”

‘WALA POLITICAL COLOR’

Gin-athag man ni Defensor nga paagi ini sa pag-preserbar sang legacy sang People Power, kag wala sang reference sa anuman nga political color.
english:
This year, the commemoration of EDSA has the theme “Working Together Towards a Common Recovery from the Pandemic.”

‘NO POLITICAL COLOR’

Defensor also explained that this is a way to preserve the legacy of People Power, and there is no reference to any political color.

text: Ginpanginwala man ni Defensor nga ang mga aktibidad ang may labot sa kampanya kag pag-abot ni 2022 presidential candidate kag former senator Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Defensor also denied that the activities were related to the campaign and the arrival of 2022 presidential candidate and former senator Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
