text: Sunod nga gin-engganyo ang fans nga magpasakop sa talent show para nga mabaton nila ang tumalagsahon nga premyo nga amo ang water bottle nga naggamit na sang mga myembro sang Oh My Girl.
english: Next, fans were encouraged to participate in the talent show to receive a special prize of a water bottle that has been used by the members of Oh My Girl.

text: Sang gin-ulan na sang pagpakamalaot, nag-sorry ang host bangud suno sa iya, ginpinsar niya nga isa ini ka memorable gesture apang baliskad gali ang natabo.
english: When the curse rained down, the host apologized because he said he thought it was a memorable gesture but the opposite happened.

text: Gin-ako man niya nga iya ini sala bangud sa iya poor judgement kag naghingyo nga indi na pagdalahigon ang mga estudyante.
english: He also admitted that it was his fault because of his poor judgment and asked not to involve the students.

text: Nag-sorry man ang student council nga amo ang nag-organisar sang festival apang madamo gihapon ang wala nahim-os ilabi na online.
english: The student council that organized the festival also apologized but there are still many things that are not done especially online.

text: Gintawag ini nga low-class kag bastos nga sahi sang mindset kag kun ngaa nabatas ini nga himuon sa ila mismo idols nga mga babaye man.
english: It was called a low-class and rude kind of mindset and why it was tolerated to do this to their own idols who are women too.

text: ILOILO – Kabug-usan nga 150 ka mga rice farmers ang nagtambong sa Farmers Field Day sa Barangay Badiangan, Mina.
english: ILOILO – A total of 150 rice farmers attended the Farmers Field Day in Barangay Badiangan, Mina.

text: Sa nasambit nga aktibidad, may ginpatigayon nga biofertilizers on-farm demonstration sa hybrid rice cluster area.
english: During the said activity, a biofertilizers on-farm demonstration was conducted in the hybrid rice cluster area.

text: Ang techno-demo ang nagpakita sa epekto sang biofertilizers agud mapasanyog ang produksyon, mapataas ang income kag malikawan ang peste kag mga balatian sa mga tanom.
english: The techno-demo demonstrated the impact of biofertilizers to boost production, increase income and prevent pests and diseases in crops.

text: Ang mga participants halin sa 15 farmer cooperatives kag associations ang nagtutok sa epekto sang biofertilizers sa pagdako sang humay.
english: Participants from 15 farmer cooperatives and associations focused on the impact of biofertilizers on rice growth.

text: Suno kay Engr.
english: According to Engr.

text: Jackson Demamay, Chief sang Western Visayas Integrated Agricultural Research Center (WESVIARC), pinaagi sa research, na-modernize ang sistema sang panguma.
english: Jackson Demamay, Chief of the Western Visayas Integrated Agricultural Research Center (WESVIARC), said through research, the farming system has been modernized.

text: “Adoption of mature technologies is one of the major challenges that the research has always faced and with this kind of technology-demonstration, we can extend what the research has been developed.”
english: “Adoption of mature technologies is one of the major challenges that the research has always faced and with this kind of technology-demonstration, we can extend what the research has been developed.”

text: Ginpahangop sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) nga ang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) ang may hurisdiksyon sa mga elected officials kag amo man nga ahensya ang dapat sundon pag-abot sa mga policies sa sini nga mga opisyal subong nga local and national elections.
english: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) explained that the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) has jurisdiction over elected officials and the same agency should be followed when it comes to policies on these officials during the local and national elections.

text: Kasunod ini sang nangin paandam ni DILG Undersecretary for Barangay Affairs Martin Diño sa mga barangay officials ilabi na sa mga punong barangay batok sa pagpang-endorso sa mga kandidato sa May 9 nga eleksyon.
english: This follows the warning of DILG Undersecretary for Barangay Affairs Martin Diño to barangay officials especially barangay captains against endorsing candidates in the May 9 elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Comelec Region VI Director Atty. Wilfred Jay Balisado, iya ginpahayag nga natapos na ang katungdanan sang Comelec sa mga barangay officials sang natapos na ang proclamation ukon na-eleher na sila sa posisyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Comelec Region VI Director Atty. Wilfred Jay Balisado, he said that the Comelec's duty to the barangay officials is over when the proclamation is over or they are elected to the position.

text: Sang barangay elections, ginpasiguro sang Comelec nga indi mangin affiliated sa political parties ang mga barangay officials.
english: During the barangay elections, the Comelec ensured that barangay officials will not be affiliated with political parties.

text: Subong nga nagahilapit na ang local kag national elections, ang DILG na suno kay Balisado ang may poder.
english: Now that the local and national elections are approaching, Balisado said the DILG has the power.

text: “If the DILG will tell us na bawal sila, then I think may proper basis ang DILG.
english: “If the DILG will tell us that they are prohibited, then I think the DILG has a proper basis.

text: Sa Comelec, we are only there until after the proclamation.
english: In Comelec, we are only there until after the proclamation.

text: After the proclamation, we have done our job.
english: After the proclamation, we have done our job.

text: The DILG will now take over sa kanilang policies,” paathag ni Balisado.
english: The DILG will now take over their policies,” Balisado explained.

text:
“Ang mag-govern talaga is the policy ng DILG.”

Una na nga ginpahayag ni Diño nga base sa pagsulundan, ang lamang ginatugutan nga maka-endorso sa kandidato sa eleksyon amo ang Presidente, bise-presidente, mga senador, congressmen, mayors, kag vice-mayors.
english:
“What really governs is the policy of the DILG.”

Earlier, Diño said that based on the rules, only the President, vice-president, senators, congressmen, mayors, and vice-mayors are allowed to endorse a candidate in the election.

text: Gin-remind man sini ang barangay officials nga magpabilin nga apolitical bangud wala sila sang prerogative nga mag-endorso sang political bets — nga mandated suno sa iya sa Omnibus Election Code.
english: He also reminded barangay officials to remain apolitical because they do not have the prerogative to endorse political bets — which he said is mandated in the Omnibus Election Code.

text: PARIS, FRANCE-Nakabaton sang indi manami nga reaksyon halin sa mga tumalan-aw ang Dutch volleyball player nga si Steven van de Velde sa hampang sini kaupod nga iya teammate nga si Matthew Immers sa beach volleyball nga ginpatigayon sa Eiffel Tower Stadium.
english: PARIS, FRANCE-Dutch volleyball player Steven van de Velde received a negative reaction from the spectators during his match with his teammate Matthew Immers in the beach volleyball match held at the Eiffel Tower Stadium.

text: Si Van de Velde, nga sang 2016 na- convict bangud sa pag- rape sa12-anyos nga babaye, ang gin-boo sang mga tawo.
english: Van de Velde, who in 2016 was convicted of raping a 12-year-old girl, was booed by the crowd.

text: Magluwas nga gin-boo, ginpierde man sila sang Italya.
english: In addition to being booed, Italy also defeated them.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Van de Velde ang nasentensiyahan sang apat ka tuig nga pagkapreso matapos gin-ako ang nakumiter nga three counts of rape, kag ginhilway sang 2017 matapos napreso sang masobra lang isa ka tuig.
english: Van de Velde was sentenced to four years in prison after pleading guilty to three counts of rape, and was released in 2017 after serving just over a year.

text: Ang iya pagkalakip sa Olympic team sang Netherland ang nagbaton sang seryoso nga pagpakamalot.
english: His inclusion in the Netherlands Olympic team has received serious condemnation.

text: Ginapangayuan sang paathag sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) ang babaye nga nagainom sang wine samtang nagamaneho sang salakyan.
english: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) is seeking an explanation from the woman who drank wine while driving.

text: Ginmando man ni LTO chief Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao ang 90 ka adlaw nga preventive suspension sa lisensya sang drayber.
english: LTO chief Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao also ordered a 90-day preventive suspension of the driver's license.

text: Gin-isyuhan na sang Show Cause Order ang lady driver kag amo man ang registered owner sang salakyan para magpaathag.
english: A Show Cause Order has been issued to the lady driver and the registered owner of the vehicle to explain.

text: Gintalana sang LTO ang hearing sa nasambit nga mga kaso sa Intelligence and Investigation Division (IID), LTO Central Office sa Quezon City sa Disyembre 12, 2025.
english: The LTO has scheduled a hearing on the said cases at the Intelligence and Investigation Division (IID), LTO Central Office in Quezon City on December 12, 2025.

text: Indi apektado ang surfer nga si Philmar Alipayo sa isyu nga ginakaulamiran sini matapos naglapta ang TikTok video nila sang isa ka influencer sa Siargao.
english: Surfer Philmar Alipayo is not affected by the issue he is aware of after a TikTok video of them with an influencer in Siargao went viral.

text: Sa iya pinakaulihi nga Instagram story, nag-share si Philmar sang ila couple pictures sang iya fiance nga si Andi Eigenmann.
english: In his latest Instagram story, Philmar shared couple pictures of his fiance Andi Eigenmann.

text: Caption sini sa ila nga selfie: “National Couple Day!
english: She captioned their selfie: “National Couple Day!

text: Post your other half [heart emoji]”.
english: Post your other half [heart emoji]”.

text: Sa ikaduha nga picture, updanay sila ni Andi kag anak nga si Lilo.
english: In the second picture, Andi and her daughter Lilo are together.

text: Nakabutang man ang lokasyon nga yara sa resort sa La Union; buot silingon, break anay sa ila puluy-an sa Siargao.
english: The location is also listed at the resort in La Union; that is, break first at their home in Siargao.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad lang nga adlaw sang naglapta ang video sang influencer/video creator nga si Crissa Liaging nga naga-istorya kay Philmar sa Siargao.
english: It can be recalled that just last day, a video of influencer/video creator Crissa Liaging went viral talking to Philmar in Siargao.

text: Naka-topless pa si Philmar kag halos wala na sang distansya sa isa kag isa.
english: Philmar was still topless and there was almost no distance between each other.

text: Million ang views sini pero gin-delete kag gin-reupload ni Crissa nga may amo gihapon nga video kag ginbutangan pa sang background music nga “Weak” sang American R&B vocal trio nga SWV.
english: It got a million views but Crissa deleted it and reuploaded it with the same video and the background music of “Weak” by American R&B vocal trio SWV.

text: Una naman nga nagdepensa ang influencer nga wala ini naga-flirt kay Philmar bangud nakahibalo siya nga pamilyado ini, apang wala ini ginpalampuwas sang netizens ilabi na ang nagaapin kay Andi.
english: The influencer initially defended that she was not flirting with Philmar because she knew he was married, but netizens, especially those who defended Andi, did not let him go.

text: Sa bahin ni Andi, nagpaguwa man ini sang statement nga naga-address sa hitabo: “What’s shameful is purposely posting and editing a video to cause a stir, disturbing the peace of people and dragging them into their negativity, just for some social media attention.”
english: For Andi’s part, she also released a statement addressing the incident: “What’s shameful is purposely posting and editing a video to cause a stir, disturbing the peace of people and dragging them into their negativity, just for some social media attention.”

text: Nagakalipay ang local nga mga mangunguma sa madinalag-on nga ani sang produkto nga mais nga bunga sang suporta sang Department of Agriculture (DA).
english: Local farmers are enjoying the successful harvest of corn products thanks to the support of the Department of Agriculture (DA).

text: Suno kay Maayon, Capiz Mayor Raymond Malapajo, importante ang pagbuligay sang mga kooperatiba kag ang wala untat nga suporta sang gobyerno sa mga mangunguma.
english: According to Maayon, Capiz Mayor Raymond Malapajo, the cooperation of the cooperatives and the continuous support of the government to the farmers is important.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga pinaagi sa nasambit nga inisyatibo sang ahensya, mas mapasanyog ang produkto nga mais.
english: He also said that through the agency's initiative, the corn product will be further promoted.

text: Nagpatigayon naman ang DA kaupod ang local government units kag private sector sang demonstration sang scientific-based farming technologies.
english: The DA together with local government units and the private sector conducted a demonstration of scientific-based farming technologies.

text: Nahatagan naman sang kahigayunan ang mga mangunguma nga mag-obserba sa epekto sang nagkalain-lain nga biofertilizers kag production performance sang nagkalain-lain nga hybrid corn varieties.
english: Farmers were given the opportunity to observe the effects of different biofertilizers and production performance of different hybrid corn varieties.

text: Passport kag rosarito lang gid ang nabitbit sang isa ka Ilongga overseas Filipino worker (OFW) sang nagdali-dali ini nga makapalagyo sa nasunog nga Wang Fuk Court housing complex sa Tai Po, Hong Kong sang Nobyembre 26.
english: An Ilongga overseas Filipino worker (OFW) was carrying only his passport and a rosary when he hurried to escape the burning Wang Fuk Court housing complex in Tai Po, Hong Kong on November 26.

text: Suno kay Jessica Sampiano, tumandok sang Siwalo, banwa sang Maasin, duha lang sila sang iya apat ka tuig nga alaga sang adlaw nga natabo ang sunog.
english: According to Jessica Sampiano, a native of Siwalo, Maasin town, she and her four-year-old dog were alone on the day the fire broke out.

text: Naga-istar sila sa ika-31 nga panalgan sang building.
english: They live on the 31st floor of the building.

text: Nagakatulog ang bata samtang nagapanglimpyo naman si Jessica sang napanimahuan sini ang aso.
english: The child was sleeping while Jessica was cleaning when she smelled the smoke.

text: Paathag sini, bisan nagasinggitan pa, naga-ginamo, ukon nagakalayo sa guwa sang high-rise apartment complex, wala gid siya sang makita bangud nakaputos sa bamboo scaffolding kag green net ang palibot sang ila ginatiniran nga building bangud nagapadayon ang renovation works.
english: He explained that even if they were shouting, making trouble, or burning outside the high-rise apartment complex, he could not see anything because the building was wrapped in bamboo scaffolding and green net because the renovation works were ongoing.

text: Indi naman makasaka ang iya employer bangud ginapunggan sang mga awtoridad nga may makasaka sa building agud indi na madugangan ang posible nga ma-trap.
english: His employer cannot climb because the authorities are preventing anyone from climbing the building to avoid increasing the possibility of being trapped.

text: Maayo lang suno kay Jessica bangud natalupangdan sini ang iya telepono kag didto napahibalo sang iya employer nga dapat magpanaog na bangud sa kadakuon sang kalayo.
english: Fortunately, Jessica said, she noticed her phone and was informed by her employer that she had to get off because of the size of the fire.

text: Dali-dali sini nga ginpukaw ang bata, gindal-an sang jacket, kag ginbulsa ang iya passport samtang nagatinguha nga makaguwa sa lugar.
english: He quickly woke the boy, brought him a jacket, and pocketed his passport while trying to leave the area.

text: Pahayag ni Jessica, tuman ang iya kakulba ilabi na sang naghuni na ang alarm kag tatlo ka beses pa sini kinahanglan nga itulod ang puertahan.
english: Jessica said she was very nervous especially when the alarm sounded and she had to push the door three times.

text: “Hambal ko, Lord, bahala ka na sa amon.
english: “I said, Lord, take care of us.

text: Kung mapatay man lang ang alaga ko, bahala na, pati man ako eh.
english: If my dog ​​dies, it's okay, so do I.

text: Unungan ko na lang gid sa,” suno kay Jessica.
english: I'll just stick with it,” Jessica said.

text: Magluwas sa passport, rosarito lang gid ang unod sang bulsa sang Ilongga sang amo nga tion nga amo ang nangin salandigan niya sa mabudlay nga tion.
english: Apart from the passport, the Ilongga had only a rosary in his pocket at that time which became his support in difficult times.

text: “Pagguwa ko sa pirtahan, maayo lang nagbukas ang lift, pero actually, kung mag-alarm na, ma-stop na ina [ang elevator],” paathag sini kun paano sila nakaguwa.
english: “When I got out the door, the elevator opened fine, but actually, when the alarm goes off, it [the elevator] stops,” he explained how they got out.

text: Sang amo nga tion suno sa iya, handa na siya nga manghagdan sila kuntani agud lang makaluwas.
english: At that time, he said, he was ready to climb the stairs just to escape.

text: “Ginhakos ako ni amo [sang nagkit-anay na kami] kag gapasalamat nga naluwas ko ang bata.
english: “My boss hugged me [when we met] and thanked me for saving the child.

text: Ang itsura ni amo, indi ma-drawing kun mahibi o makadlaw,” panugiron ni Jessica.
english: The face of the boss, can not be drawn whether crying or laughing,” Jessica said.

text: “Kadasig lang, wala lang isa ka minuto [sang pagguwa namon], nag-ibwal na ang building namon.
english: “It was so fast, in less than a minute [of our exit], our building was on fire.

text: Indi ko maintindihan ang nabatyagan ko.
english: I couldn't understand how I felt.

text: Daku ang pasalamat ko.
english: I am very grateful.

text: Bisan ano wala gid ko may nadala,” dugang sini.
english: I never brought anything,” it added.

text: Sa subong, temporaryo nga nagatinir sanday Jessica sa balay sang abyan sang iya employer.
english: Currently, Jessica is temporarily staying at her employer's friend's house.

text: “Amo na hambal sang alaga ko, pirme niya ginahambal sa akon.
english: “That’s what my dog ​​says, he always tells me.

text: Ginahakos ya ako, ‘Don’t worry, Auntie, we are safe’,” pahayag sini.
english: He hugs me, ‘Don’t worry, Auntie, we are safe’,” she said.

text: Nagapasalamat man siya sa tanan nga nagbulig sa iya kinahanglanon lakip na ang iya mga kaupdanan sa simbahan amo man sa Philippine Consulate, Overseas Workers Welfare Association (OWWA), asosasyon sa Maasin, kag iban pa.
english: He also thanked everyone who helped him in his needs including his church members as well as the Philippine Consulate, Overseas Workers Welfare Association (OWWA), Maasin association, and others.

text: “Sa mga kasimanwa ko, indi kamo magkabalaka.
english: “My fellow citizens, do not worry.

text: May trauma pa nga gamay, pero, okay lang, at least, nakaluwas man.
english: There was still a little trauma, but, okay, at least, survived.

text: Ang kaluluoy dira amo ang mga biktima nga wala pa makita… masakit,” suno sa Ilongga OFW samtang nagahilibion.
english: The pity here is the victims who have not been found... painful,” said the Ilongga OFW while crying.

text: Sandig sa Hong Kong authorities, nagsaka na sa 151 ang patay sa amo nga sunog matapos nakit-an ang iban nga mga bangkay sa hagdan kag mga rooftop.
english: According to Hong Kong authorities, the death toll in the fire has risen to 151 after some bodies were found on stairs and rooftops.

text: 13 naman ka tawo ang gindakop bangud sa suspected manslaughter.
english: 13 people were arrested for the suspected manslaughter.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon.#
english: The investigation is still ongoing.

text: Nag-appoint na ang Iran sang bag-o nga intelligence chief sa sulod sang Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) kasunod sang pagkapatay sang anay intel chief bangud sa airstrike.
english: Iran has appointed a new intelligence chief within the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) following the death of the former intel chief in an airstrike.

text: Ginpili ni Iran Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) commander, Major General Mohammad Pakpour si Brigadier General Majid Khadami nga magaserbu bilang bag-o nga head sang intelligence division.
english: Iran Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) commander, Major General Mohammad Pakpour has selected Brigadier General Majid Khadami to serve as the new head of the intelligence division.

text: Pagatal-osan ni BGen Khadami si Mohammed Kazemi ang anay intel chief nga napatay sa nauna nga strike kaupid ang duha pa ka mataas nga opisyal sang IRGC nga sanday Hassan Mohaghegh kag Mohsen Bagheri.
english: BGen Khadami will replace Mohammed Kazemi, the former intel chief who was killed in the earlier strike along with two other senior IRGC officials, Hassan Mohaghegh and Mohsen Bagheri.

text: Samtang, sa ia ka interview kay IRGC commander Pakpour, kampante ini nga magampanan sang bag-o nga gin-appoint nga intel chief ang iya responsibilidad, kadungan sang mga serye sang airstrike nga ginpatigayon sini batok sa Israel.
english: Meanwhile, in an interview with IRGC commander Pakpour, he said he is confident that the newly appointed intel chief will fulfill his responsibilities, along with the series of airstrikes it has conducted against Israel.

text: Liwat nga nagpabalo ang Iranian war chief sa Israel sang mas mabug-at nga pag-atake sa masunod nga adlaw.
english: The Iranian war chief again warned Israel of a heavier attack the next day.

text: Isa ang ginapatihan nga ginbawian sang kabuhi samtang tatlo naman ang pilason matapos nagbungguanay ang duha ka mga motorsiklo sa Brgy.
english: One person was believed to have died while three others were injured after two motorcycles collided in Brgy.

text: Puntahagdan, Tobias Fornier, Antique kaina sang aga.
english: Puntahagdan, Tobias Fornier, Antique this morning.

text: Gindala sa President Diosdado Macapagal Memorial District Hospital ang isa sa mga biktima apang gindeklarar nga dead on arrival.
english: One of the victims was rushed to the President Diosdado Macapagal Memorial District Hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Una man nga gindala sa nasambit nga ospital ang tatlo pa ka mga biktima apang ginsaylo sa Angel Salazar Memorial General Hospital sa San Jose.
english: Three other victims were also brought to the hospital but were transferred to the Angel Salazar Memorial General Hospital in San Jose.

text: Ginpahayag nga ang duha sa mga biktima ang nagbakal pa sang cake para sa kaadlawan sang ila lolo kag pakadto na sa venue sang  selebrasyon sang natabo ang aksidente.
english: Two of the victims were reportedly buying a cake for their grandfather's birthday and were on their way to the venue of the celebration when the accident occurred.

text: Isa sa pinakaagaw-atensyon nga resulta sa hampang sa basketball sa Paris Olympics 2024 amo ang maragtason nga kadalag-an sang world no.
english: One of the most eye-catching results in the Paris Olympics 2024 basketball match was the historic victory of the world no.

text: 33 nga South Sudan batok sa World no.
english: 33 South Sudan against World no.

text: 16 nga Puerto Rico, 90-79.
english: 16 Puerto Rico, 90–79.

text: Ini man ang labing-una nga Olympic win sang amo nga African nation nga amo ang pinakabata nga pungsod sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: It is also the first Olympic win of the African nation, which is the youngest country in the world.

text: Sa bilog nga maragtas sang sini nga quadrennial meet, ini lamang ang ikaduha nga bes nga nagdaog ang isa ka African team batok sa pungsod halin sa America.
english: In the entire history of this quadrennial meet, this is only the second time an African team has won against the country from America.

text: Antes ang hampang sang duha ka teams, sala pa nga national anthem ang gintukar para sa South Sudan apang gin-untat 20 segundos ang makaligad.
english: Before the match between the two teams, the wrong national anthem was played for South Sudan but was stopped 20 seconds later.

text: Gindayaw man sang publiko ang South Sudanese players nga padayon sa pagtindog samtang nagabutang sang kamot sa dughan tubtub nga na-restart ang husto na nga national anthem halos tres minutos ang makaligad.
english: The public also praised the South Sudanese players who continued to stand with their hands on their chests until the national anthem was restarted almost three minutes later.

text: Pagkatapos sang kanta, naghugpon ang mga tawo sa venue kag ginpalakpakan ang South Sudan team.
english: After the song, the crowd at the venue gathered and applauded the South Sudan team.

text: Mangin ang Puerto Rico players kag media members ang nagpakita man sang ila suporta.
english: Even Puerto Rican players and media members showed their support.

text: Ginapahayag nga yara sa 27,000 ka mga tawo sa Pierre Mauroy Stadium sa France ang nakasaksi sang amo nga basketball event.
english: It is reported that around 27,000 people at the Pierre Mauroy Stadium in France witnessed the basketball event.

text: (Photo: FIBA)
english: (Photo: FIBA)

text: Bangud sa paghigugma apisar daw leon pa kun kaisa ang batasan sang imo partner, masarangan mo sa gihapon nga updon ini sa isa ka balay.
english: Because of love, even if your partner sometimes behaves like a lion, you can still accompany him in the same house.

text: Apang sa Penza, Russia, may magkahagugma nga may kaupod nga literal nga Leon nga ila nangin madugay na nga hinuptanan kag kaupod sa sulod sang ila balay.
english: But in Penza, Russia, a couple had a literal Lion as their companion who had long been their pet and companion inside their home.

text: Ang couple amo sanday Aleksandr kag Maria Dmitriev, lunsay trained psychologist kag ang ila hinuptanan nga Leon ang ila ginpangalanan nga Messi.
english: The couple are Aleksandr and Maria Dmitriev, both trained psychologists and their pet Leon they named Messi.

text: Si Messi ang tatlo ka-tuig nga cougar, ang ginakabig second-largest feline sa pamilya sang mga kuring.
english: Messi is a three-year-old cougar, the second-largest feline in the cat family.

text: Ang nasambit nga cougar ang ginakabig nga predator sa mga kagulangan apang si Messi ang nagdako sa isa ka petting zoo bilang house cat kag nagabehave nga daw kaangay sang overgrown nga kuring.
english: The cougar is considered a predator in the wild but Messi grew up in a petting zoo as a house cat and behaves like an overgrown cat.

text: Si Messi sadto ang may seryoso nga pagkinahanglan sang medical attention sa petting zoo kag sang madiskubrehan ini sang couple, nagdesisyon sila nga baklon ang baby nga mountain lion agud sagudon kag bunglon.
english: Messi was in serious need of medical attention at the petting zoo and when the couple discovered this, they decided to buy the baby mountain lion to raise and care for.

text: Gin-ako sang couple nga nangin tuman ka positibo ang nangin epekto ni Messi sa ila nga kabuhi apang madamo man sila sang mga pagpanghangkat nga gin-atubang kaupod ang hinuptanan.
english: The couple admitted that Messi's impact on their lives has been very positive but they have also faced many challenges with the pet.

text: Ang leon ang nagakadapat hatagan sang madamo nga atensyon sa diin halos indi makabakasyon ang couple ukon makabonding kaupod ang ila mga abyan.
english: The lion deserves a lot of attention where the couple can hardly go on vacation or bond with their friends.

text: Ginapahayag nga nagasuprir sang ‘ katsaridaphobia’ ang asawa sang isa ka software engineer sa nasambit nga pungsod sa diin sa tion nga makakita ini sang tanga sa sulod sang ila balay, gilayon sila nga nagahalin na naman sang balay.
english: The wife of a software engineer in the country reportedly suffers from 'katsaridaphobia' where whenever she sees a lizard inside their house, they immediately leave the house.

text: Sa subong, nagaplano ang mag-asawa nga magbulaganay bangud santo sa babaye, wala siya gina-intindi sang iya bana sa diin masami pa siya nga ginadala sa mga psychiatrist agud ipacheck up.
english: Currently, the couple is planning to separate because according to the woman, her husband does not understand her and often takes her to psychiatrists for check ups.

text: Pahayag naman sang bana, luyag gid niya nga mahangpan ang kondisyon sang iya asawa sa diin tuman ang kahangawa sini sa tion nga makakita sang sapat nga tanga.
english: The husband said he wanted to understand the condition of his wife where she was very worried when she saw the animal.

text: Bangod sa ginpahayag pagka ‘fed up’ ukon ‘frustration’ nga nabatyagan sang bana sa wala untat nga pagsaylo nila sang balay bangud man sa kondisyon sang iya asawa, nagaplano na sila nga duha nga magbulagay nalang.
english: Due to the alleged 'fed up' or 'frustration' that the husband felt with the constant movement of houses due to his wife's condition, they are planning to separate.

text: Samtang, santo sa FearOf.net, kaangay sang iban nga phobias, ang ‘katsaridaphobia’ ang isa ka sahi sang phobia nga nagamanifest sa pila ka pamaagi.
english: Meanwhile, according to FearOf.net, like other phobias, 'katsaridaphobia' is a type of phobia that manifests in several ways.

english: There are people who just hear the word 'tanga' and experience a lot of anxiety.

text: Pilason ang pito ka mga tawo sang nagbaliskad ang isa ka truck sa provincial road sa Barangay New Agutaya,San Vicente, Palawan.
english: Seven people were injured when a truck overturned on the provincial road in Barangay New Agutaya, San Vicente, Palawan.

text: Ginpahayag nga nadulaan sang kontrol ang driver sang truck nga may karga nga construction materials, matapos nag-eksperyensiya sang mechanical trouble.
english: The driver of the truck loaded with construction materials reportedly lost control after experiencing mechanical trouble.

text: Nagdalus-os ini kag nagbaliskad sa kilid sang dalan.
english: It skidded and overturned on the side of the road.

text: Nadala naman sa sa ospital ang mga biktima matapos ang madasig nga pagresponde sang rescuers.
english: Nadala naman sa sa ospital ang mga biktima matapos ang madasig nga pagresponde sang rescuers.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Ginpatigayon ang Yellow Corn Model Farm Field Day sa Brgy.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Yellow Corn Model Farm Field Day was held in Brgy.

text: Cabagohan, Batad, Iloilo.
english: Cabagohan, Batad, Iloilo.

text: Ini ang ginpasakupan sang 50 ka mga mangunguma halin sa Batad, San Dionisio,  kag  Estancia, Iloilo.
english: It was attended by 50 farmers from Batad, San Dionisio, and Estancia, Iloilo.

text: Ginpasundayag sa kahiwatan ang biofertilizers sa corn farming kag ang nabulig sang gobyerno sa agrikultura.
english: The event showcased biofertilizers in corn farming and the government's contribution to agriculture.

text: Suno kay Sangguniang Bayan Member Emmanuel Pacardo, padayon nga magasuporta ang gobyerno sa mga mangunguma.
english: According to Sangguniang Bayan Member Emmanuel Pacardo, the government will continue to support the farmers.

text: Gin-enganyo man sini ang mga mangunguma nga padayunon ang pagtanom sang nagkalain-lain nga mga produkto kaangay sang mais agud matapna ang pagkatiphag sang duta kag pagbaha.
english: He also urged farmers to continue planting various products such as maize to prevent landslides and flooding.

text: Wala ginapahanugutan ang pag-gamit sang salakyan sang gobyerno para sa anuman nga election campaign purposes.
english: The use of government vehicles for any election campaign purposes is not allowed.

text: Gin-athag ini sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) kasunod sang pag-umpisa na sang campaign period para sa national candidates nga amo naman ang posible maggamit man sang ila nga local counterparts para sa pagpangampanya.
english: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) clarified this following the start of the campaign period for national candidates who are likely to use their local counterparts for campaigning.

text: Sa idalom sang Section 261(O) sang Omnibus Election Code, ginadumilian nga gamiton ang ano man nga sahi sang equipment ukon salakyan nga ginapanag-iyahan sang gobyerno, government-owned ukon controlled corporations, ukon Armed Forces of the Philippines para sa election campaign ukon anuman nga sahi sang partisan political activity.
english: Under Section 261(O) of the Omnibus Election Code, it is prohibited to use any kind of equipment or vehicle owned by the government, government-owned or controlled corporations, or Armed Forces of the Philippines for election campaign or any kind of partisan political activity.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Wil Arceño, provincial election supervisor sa probinsya sang Antique, ginpaathag sini nga ang indi pwede nga makapartisipar sa partisan political activities amo ang mga mga empleyado sang tanan nga ahensya sang gobyerno, career officers, kag uniformed personnel.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Wil Arceño, provincial election supervisor in Antique province, explained that those who are not allowed to participate in partisan political activities are employees of all government agencies, career officers, and uniformed personnel.

text: Wala nalakip diri ang presidente kag bise presidente, myembro sang Gabinete, kag iban pa nga elected officials magluwas sa barangay officials.
english: This does not include the president and vice president, members of the Cabinet, and other elected officials except barangay officials.

text: Apang apisar elected ang opisyal, indi pwede nga magamit ang salakyan kun para sa purpose nga indi sakop sang opisina ukon wala sang labot sa official function sang elected official.
english: However, even if the official is elected, the vehicle cannot be used for purposes that are not within the scope of the office or have nothing to do with the official function of the elected official.

text: Aminado ang poll body nga may mga grey areas pa nga kinahanglan nga athagon ilabi na sa limitations para sa political officers ukon mga persona nga yara sa elective office.
english: The poll body acknowledged that there are still gray areas that need to be clarified especially on the limitations for political officers or persons in the elective office.

text: Mangin ang national office sang Comelec ang nagpahayag nga may dapat pa i-clarify sa Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) kag sa Civil Service Commission (CSC) may kaangtanan sa sini nga pagsulundan.
english: Even the national office of the Comelec said there is still something to be clarified with the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) and the Civil Service Commission (CSC) regarding this rule.

text: Na-ungkat ang isyu sa paggamit sang red-plated government vehicles sang damlag lang matapos nag-viral ang motorcade ni presidential candidate Bongbong Marcos kaupod ang local officials sang San Jose del Monte, Bulacan sang Lunes.
english: The issue of the use of red-plated government vehicles was raised recently after the motorcade of presidential candidate Bongbong Marcos with local officials of San Jose del Monte, Bulacan went viral on Monday.

text: Sakay si Marcos sa puti nga salakyan nga may nakatatak nga government logos apang sang amo nga tion, wala pa nagaumpisa ang election campaign period gani nga nagpahayag ang iya kampo nga wala sang may nakomiter nga violation.
english: Marcos was riding in a white vehicle with government logos but at that time, the election campaign period had not yet begun so his camp said no violation was committed.

text: Ginahingyo na sa Department of Agriculture (DA) nga i-check ang cold storage facilities sa pungsod sa posible nagakatabo nga hoarding sang luy-a matapos ang padayon nga pagpanglakaak sang presyo bisan pa may importasyon na nga ginapatigayon.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has been urged to check cold storage facilities in the country for possible hoarding of ginger following the continuous rise in prices despite imports.

text: Ginduso ini sang farmers’ group nga Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura (SINAG).
english: This was proposed by the farmers’ group Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura (SINAG).

text: Base sa monitoring sang DA sa mga merkado sa Metro Manila, nagatupa na ang presyo sini sa P220 tubtub sa P350 kada kilo.
english: Based on the DA's monitoring in Metro Manila markets, the price has fallen to P220 to P350 per kilo.

text: Suno naman kay Agriculture Assistant Secretary kag spokesman Arnel, 4,248 metric tons (MT) sang imported nga luy-a halin sa China ang nakaabot na sa Pilipinas kag 30% na ini sang kabug-usan nga volume nga ginapaabot sang gobyerno.
english: According to Agriculture Assistant Secretary and spokesman Arnel, 4,248 metric tons (MT) of imported ginger from China have already arrived in the Philippines and this is 30% of the total volume expected by the government.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga ginpasugtan ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: He said Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: ang importasyon bangud ang ginger-producing areas kaangay sang Calabarzon kag mga parte sang Sierra Madre ang apektado gid sang naglabay nga mga bagyo.
english: imports because ginger-producing areas such as Calabarzon and parts of the Sierra Madre were severely affected by past typhoons.

text: Apang suno kay De Mesa, dapat nga manubo sa P100 ang retail price sini nga produkto.
english: However, according to De Mesa, the retail price of this product should be less than P100.

text: Suno naman sa SINAG, bisan manubo subong ang produksyon sa Nueva Ecija, nagalaum sila nga mangin normal na liwat ang local production sa Nobyembre ukon sa Disyembre.
english: According to SINAG, although production in Nueva Ecija is currently low, they hope that local production will return to normal in November or December.

text: Nahibaluan nga una naman nga ginpahayag sang Department of Agriculture nga ginakonsiderar sini nga mag-import man sang luy-a halin sa Indonesia kag Vietnam bilang alternatibo bangud mahal ang produkto nga halin sa China.
english: The Department of Agriculture earlier said it was considering importing ginger from Indonesia and Vietnam as an alternative because the product from China is expensive.

text: Gin-forecast anay sang Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI) nga 13,725 metric tons sang ginger imports ang kinahanglanon sang Pilipinas subong lamang nga tuig.#
english: The Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI) earlier forecast that the Philippines will need 13,725 metric tons of ginger imports this year alone.

english: According to the investigation, the victim was riding a ferris wheel with friends and when he was on top, he looked down but his body was shaken and he fell.

english: It was discovered that there was no seatbelt on the ferris wheel.

english: The operator of the ferris wheel and his assistant are being investigated in connection with the case of reckless imprudence resulting to serious physical injuries.

english: Pope Leo XIV commemorates today the 43rd anniversary of his ordination as a priest.

text: 43 ka tuig na ang nagligad sang gin-ordinagan si Father Prevost sa Chapel of Saint Monica sa Rome, nga pila ka tikang lang halin sa Vatican kag halin sa Piazza del Sant’Uffizio, kun sa diin siya nagaistar subong.
english: 43 years ago, Father Prevost was ordained in the Chapel of Saint Monica in Rome, just steps from the Vatican and from the Piazza del Sant’Uffizio, where he now lives.

text: Ang iya ordination sadto ang gin-confer ni Archbishop Jean Jadot sang Belgium, nga sang amo nga tion nagaserbe nga Pro-President sang Secretariat for Non-Christians.
english: His ordination was then conferred by Archbishop Jean Jadot of Belgium, who at the time was serving as Pro-President of the Secretariat for Non-Christians.

text: Sang tion sang iya ordinasyon, si Father Robert Francis Prevost ang 27-anyos lamang.
english: At the time of his ordination, Father Robert Francis Prevost was only 27-years-old.

text: Ginarekomendar sang House Committee on Ethics ang 60-ka-adlaw nga suspensyon ni Cavite 4th District Rep.
english: The House Committee on Ethics recommends the 60-day suspension of Cavite 4th District Rep.

text: Kiko Barzaga matapos ginpasakaan sang guilty sa iya disorderly behavior tungod sang iya ginapangbuy-an nga pahayag sa iya social media nga ginakabig wala nagakaigo bilang isa ka public official.
english: Kiko Barzaga after being charged with disorderly behavior for making statements on his social media that are considered inappropriate as a public official.

text: Lakip sa iya 60-ka-adlaw nga suspensyon sa opisina amo nga indi ini makabaton sang benepisyo kaangay sang sweldo kag allowances kag mahimo nga mas mabug-at nga disciplinary action ang igahatag sa iya.
english: Among his 60-day suspension from office is that he will not receive benefits such as salary and allowances and may face more severe disciplinary action.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagpaguwa sang iya sabat si Barzaga sa plenaryo nga ginabaton sini ang bisan ano nga penalidad nga igahatag sa iya.
english: Barzaga immediately issued his response to the plenary that he accepts any penalty that will be given to him.

text: Sa madumduman nga sa una nga pagsinapol sa reklamo batok kay Barzaga, wala ini nagpakita kag ginapahayag sini nga masako siya sa paghampang sang video games sang gab-i antes sang hearing.
english: It can be recalled that during the first meeting on the complaint against Barzaga, he did not appear and claimed that he was busy playing video games the night before the hearing.

text: Apisar retired na sa poll body si anay Commissioner Rowena Guanzon, wala ini naghipos kasunod sang pagpa-guwa na sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) – First Division sang desisyon kaangot sa consolidated disqualification cases nga gin-file batok kay presidential candidate Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.
english: Although former Commissioner Rowena Guanzon has retired from the poll body, she did not remain silent after the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) – First Division issued its decision on the consolidated disqualification cases filed against presidential candidate Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos, Jr.

text: Sa 41 ka pahina nga resolution nga ginsulat sang ponente nga si Commissioner Aimee Ferolino, gin-basura sang division ang mga kaso batok kay Marcos Jr.
english: In a 41-page resolution written by pontent Commissioner Aimee Ferolino, the division dismissed charges against Marcos Jr.

text:
bangud sa “lack of merit.”

Ginhikayan naman ni Guanzon ang amo nga resolution.
english:
due to “lack of merit.”

Guanzon arranged the resolution.

text: “30 ka dias antes mapa-guwa ni Ferolino ang resolution, amo man lang ni gali ang isulat ya?
english: “30 days before Ferolino issues the resolution, this is what he will write?

text: Sa pagka-pigaw nga resolution!
english: With weak resolution!

text: 30 dias gid ang ginhulat ya para maka-retire ako kag indi na maisip ang akon nga boto,” suno kay Guanzon.
english: He waited 30 days for me to retire and my vote was not counted,” Guanzon said.

text: Antes mag-retiro si Guanzon nagikan sa poll body sang Pebrero 2, nangin matunog pa ang drama sa COMELEC bangud sa iya mga ginpangbuyagyag.
english: Before Guanzon retired from the poll body on February 2, the drama in the COMELEC became loud because of his revelations.

text: Ginsapubliko sini nga nagboto siya agud nga i-disqualify si Marcos.
english: He made it public that he voted to disqualify Marcos.

text: Sunod man sini nga gin-alegar nga hungod nga gin-delay ni Ferolino ang pagpa-guwa sang ruling bangud ginahulat nga maka-retiro siya agud nga indi maisip ang iya nga boto.
english: He also alleged that Ferolino deliberately delayed the issuance of the ruling because he was waiting for him to retire so that his vote would not be counted.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni Guanzon nga may isa ka senador nga amo ang nagahilabot sa boto ni Ferolino.
english: Guanzon said there is a senator who is interfering in Ferolino's vote.

text: Tanan nga claims ni Guanzon ang ginpanginwala naman ni Ferolino.
english: Ferolino denied all of Guanzon's claims.

text: Sa sabat ni Ferolino, gin-alegar naman sini nga si Guanzon ang naga-attempt nga impluwensyahan ang iya nga boto.
english: In response, Ferolino alleged that Guanzon was attempting to influence his vote.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Guanzon, ginpahayag sini nga hayag-hayagan na nga graft ang ginhimo ni Ferolino.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Guanzon said that Ferolino's graft was obvious.

text: “Klaro-klaro na gid ni ya nga graft ‘ni ya.
english: “It's clearly a graft.

text: Violation ini sang Anti-graft and Corrupt Practices Act Section 3-C — delaying a decision to favor a litigant,” pahayag ni Guanzon, Pebrero 11.
english: This is a violation of Anti-graft and Corrupt Practices Act Section 3-C — delaying a decision in favor of a litigant,” Guanzon said in a statement, Feb. 11.

text: Gin-criticize man sini ang rason sang first division kag ang pahayag sa resolution nga makadalagan si Marcos apisar nga na-convict ini sa 1990s tax case.
english: He also criticized the reason of the first division and the statement in the resolution that Marcos can run despite his conviction in the 1990s tax case.

text: “Sa pagka-waay-waay!
english: “Into nothingness!

text: Sus kahikay ko!
english: Sus my arrangement!

text: Wala kuno layi nga naga-penalty sang indi pag-file sang income tax returns.
english: There is no law that penalizes failure to file income tax returns.

text: Ano pagkahimo sina kay na-convict na gani si Marcos sa regional trial court kag sa Court of Appeals?
english: What happens when Marcos has already been convicted in the regional trial court and the Court of Appeals?

text: Ginbutangan siya gani multa… nga wala ya man ginbaydan asta subong.
english: He was even fined... which he has not paid yet.

text: Oh te, kundi convict gid siya kag kriminal!
english: Oh well, but he's a convict and a criminal!

text: Kriminal ni ya.
english: This is a criminal.

text: Kriminal gid ni ya.
english: This is criminal.

text: Wala pa siya nagbayad multa.
english: He has not paid a fine.

text: Puerte gid ka pigaw nga resolution.
english: It's a very poor resolution.

text: Saka gid ni sa Supreme Court,” suno kay Guanzon.
english: It's up to the Supreme Court,” Guanzon said.

text: Una na nga ginpaghayag sang petitioners nga i-apelar nila sa Comelec en banc ang nangin ruling sang first division.
english: Earlier, the petitioners said they will appeal the ruling of the first division to the Comelec en banc.

text: Ginaduso sang government pandemic task force sa Commission on Elections (COMELEC) nga panglagson kag pang-dagdagan sang penalidad ang mga kandidato kag political parties nga nagalapas sa health protocols sa tion sang pagpangampanya.
english: The government's pandemic task force has proposed to the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) to impose penalties on candidates and political parties that violate health protocols during the campaign period.

text: Suno kay Secretary Karlo Alexi Nograles, co-chairman sang Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases (IATF-EID) kag amo man ang acting Malacañang spokesman, may mandato ang COMELEC nga pang-disiplinahon ang mga kandidato nga nagapatigayon sang dalagku nga campaign rally nga nahimo na nga superspreader events.
english: According to Secretary Karlo Alexi Nograles, co-chairman of the Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases (IATF-EID) and also the acting Malacañang spokesman, the COMELEC has a mandate to discipline candidates who conduct large-scale campaign rallies that have become superspreader events.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam ang IATF nga ang paghiwat sang daku nga mga political rallies ang posible tunaan sang pagtimbuok liwat sang kaso sang Covid-19 sa pungsod.
english: Earlier, the IATF warned that holding large political rallies could lead to a resurgence of Covid-19 cases in the country.

text: Labi ini nga naistoryahan bangud sa nakit-an nga pagdinaguso sang publiko sang dungan nga ginpatigayon sang mga presidential candidates kag sang ila runningmates kag senatorial slate ang ila nga proclamation rallies sang nagligad nga Martes nga amo ang opisyal nga pag-umpisa sang campaign period para sa nationally-elected nga mga posisyon.
english: This was especially discussed due to the public rush that was seen when the presidential candidates and their runningmates and senatorial slate held their proclamation rallies last Tuesday which was the official start of the campaign period for nationally-elected positions.

text: Suno kay Nograles, tanan nga campaign activities ang natuon sa hurisdiksyon kag pagbantay sang COMELEC.
english: According to Nograles, all campaign activities are under the jurisdiction and supervision of the COMELEC.

text: Ang IATF suno kay Nograles amo ang may katungdanan ukon hurisdiksyon sa non-election-related activities.
english: The IATF, Nograles said, has jurisdiction over non-election-related activities.

text: Matandaan nga lakip sa guidelines sang COMELEC para sa pagpangampanya amo ang mandatory nga pagsuksok sang face mask, wala sang sudlanay sa balay sang botante, wala sang pagkupo-kupo kag pagbeso-beso, kag wala man gina-engganyo ang pagpangamusta ukon handshakes amo man ang pag-selfie sa mga kandidato.
english: It can be recalled that among the guidelines of the COMELEC for the campaign are the mandatory wearing of face masks, no containers in the voter's house, no hugging and kissing, and no greetings or handshakes as well as selfies with candidates are not encouraged.

text: Naglunsar ang mga firms sang mga ilimnon sang kampanya batok sa illicit alcohol sa Pilipinas.
english: Beverage firms have launched a campaign against illicit alcohol in the Philippines.

text: Ini amo ang Alliance Against Counterfeit Spirits (AACS), kaupod ang Asia Pacific International Spirits and Wines Alliance (APISWA) kag Alcoholic Beverages Alliance of the Philippines (ABAPI).
english: These are the Alliance Against Counterfeit Spirits (AACS), alongside the Asia Pacific International Spirits and Wines Alliance (APISWA) and Alcoholic Beverages Alliance of the Philippines (ABAPI).

text: Suno sa international agencies kalakip ang World Health Organization (WHO), ginabanta nga 20 percent tubtob 30 percent sang alcohol nga ginakonsumo sa Pilipinas ang “unrecorded,” nga ginalakipan sang homemade alcohol, smuggled goods, kag counterfeit products.
english: According to international agencies including the World Health Organization (WHO), an estimated 20 percent to 30 percent of alcohol consumed in the Philippines is “unrecorded,” which includes homemade alcohol, smuggled goods, and counterfeit products.

text: Suno sa grupo, ini nga mga unrecorded alcohol ang may dala nga potential health risks kag impact sa economic performance sang legitimate local businesses.
english: According to the group, these unrecorded alcohols carry potential health risks and impact on the economic performance of legitimate local businesses.

text: Gintumod sini nga ang koordinasyon upod sa gobyerno ang tuman ka importante sa pagbaton kontra sa illicit trade kag ang kampanya ang suportado man sang Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines (IPOPHL).
english: He pointed out that coordination with the government is very important in the fight against illicit trade and the campaign is also supported by the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines (IPOPHL).

text: Suno kay Alliance Against Counterfeit Spirits Managing Director David Francis, ini nga kampanya ang importante nga tikang agud masiguro nga ang Filipino consumers ang makahimo sang safe nga pagpili kag makabulig sa pagprotekta sa lehitimo nga lokal nga mga negosyo.
english: According to Alliance Against Counterfeit Spirits Managing Director David Francis, this campaign is an important step to ensure that Filipino consumers can make safe choices and help protect legitimate local businesses.

text: Ginbasura sang Supreme Leader sang Iran ang panawagan sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga mag-surrender na lang ini sa away sini batok sa Israel.
english: Iran's Supreme Leader has rejected calls by the United States to surrender in its fight against Israel.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Ayatollah Ali Khamenei paagi sa isa ka video message matapos ang statement ni US President Donald Trump nga mag-sungka na lang ang Iran nga wala na sang mga kondisyon.
english: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei said this in a video message after US President Donald Trump's statement that Iran should surrender without conditions.

text: Sa nauna nga pahayag ni Trump, ginsiling sini nga nakahibalo sila kun sa diin subong ang Supreme Leader, apang wala sila sang plano nga patyon ini sa subong.
english: In an earlier statement, Trump said they know where the Supreme Leader is, but they have no plans to kill him at the moment.

text: Bisan naga-distansya si Trump sa isyu sang pagbaslanay sang Israel kag Iran sang missile attack, ang iya mga pahayag sini nga mga inadlaw ang nagahatag sang patimaan nga maga-intra ang Estados Unidos, ilabi na bangud nagpadala ang US sang dugang nga military aircraft kag warships sa Middle East.
english: Although Trump is distancing himself from the issue of Israel and Iran exchanging missile attacks, his recent statements hint that the United States will get involved, especially as the US has sent more military aircraft and warships to the Middle East.

text: Sabat naman sang 86-anyos nga si Khamenei, kilala sang mga maalam nga tawo ang Iran nga wala naga-surrender, kag indi sila dapat pagpaagyan sang mga statement nga may unod nga pagpamahog.
english: The 86-year-old Khamenei replied that wise people know that Iran does not surrender, and they should not be subjected to statements containing threats.

text: “Intelligent people who know Iran, the Iranian nation and its history will never speak to this nation in threatening language because the Iranian nation will not surrender,” kabahin sang recorded speech sang Iranian Supreme Leader.
english: “Intelligent people who know Iran, the Iranian nation and its history will never speak to this nation in threatening language because the Iranian nation will not surrender,” was part of the Iranian Supreme Leader’s recorded speech.

text: Nagpaandam ini nga kun mag-intra ang militar sang Amerika, maga-resulta ini sa halit nga indi sarang makaayo.
english: He warned that if the US military gets involved, it will result in irreparable damage.

text: Indi gihapon maathag subong kun sa diin si Khamenei, kag sa iya nga video nga naka-tight shot, makit-an lamang ang kurtina, hayahay sang Iran, kag ang laragway ni Grand Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini nga napatay sang 1989.
english: It is still unclear where Khamenei is, and in his tight shot video, only the curtain, the Iranian flag, and the portrait of Grand Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, who died in 1989, can be seen.

text: Antes sini nga statement, nagpahayag man si Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei nga kun mag-intra ang US sa gamo sang Israel kag Iran, maga-resulta ini sa all-out war.
english: Earlier, Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei said that if the US gets involved in the conflict between Israel and Iran, it will result in an all-out war.

text: Ginpasalig ni Vhong Navarro nga kumpleto ang myembro sang iconic ’90s dance group nga The Streetboys sa ila palaabuton nga reunion concert sa Quezon City sa Nobyembre 8.
english: Vhong Navarro assured that the members of the iconic '90s dance group The Streetboys will be complete for their upcoming reunion concert in Quezon City on November 8.

text: Kumpirmado suno sa iya nga magapauli ang ila nga mga kaupdanan nga yara pa subong sa London, Dubai, kag Canada.
english: He said it is confirmed that their colleagues who are still in London, Dubai, and Canada will return home.

text: Suno naman sa singer-actor nga si Ogie Alcasid nga amo ang maga-produce sang show sa idalom sang company nga A-Team, mahimo paabuton sang fans ang gab-i nga puno sang nostalgia bangud buhion sang iconic performers ang ila glory days.
english: According to singer-actor Ogie Alcasid who will produce the show under the company A-Team, fans can expect a night full of nostalgia as the iconic performers will revive their glory days.

text: Ini nga grupo ang ginabug-usan nanday Vhong, Jhong Hilario, Danilo Barios, Spencer Reyes, Meynard Marcellano, Christopher Cruz, Michael Sesmundo, kag Joseph de Leon.
english: This team consists of Vhong, Jhong Hilario, Danilo Barios, Spencer Reyes, Meynard Marcellano, Christopher Cruz, Michael Sesmundo, and Joseph de Leon.

text: Gintukod ang Streetboys sang 1993 bilang dance troupe apang sang ulihi amat-amat naman nga nagsulod sa acting sa pelikula kag television tubtub nga nangin inactive kag nagkadto na sa luwas sang pungsod ang iban.
english: Streetboys was formed in 1993 as a dance troupe but later gradually entered acting in film and television until it became inactive and some went abroad.

text: Sang Abril, may yara man sila sang benefit concert bilang selebrasyon sang ila ika -31 nga anibersaryo.
english: In April, they also had a benefit concert in celebration of their 31st anniversary.

text: PARIS – Nadepensahan sang World no.
english: PARIS – World no.

text: 4 nga Poland ang isa ka kapaslawan agud malutos ang Japan sa women’s indoor volleyball competition sang Olympic Games Paris 2024, nga naka-iskor sang 20-25, 25-22, 25-23, 28-26 nga kadalag-an sang Domingo (oras sa Pilipinas).
english: 4 Poland was a setback to defeat Japan in the women’s indoor volleyball competition of the Olympic Games Paris 2024, scoring a 20-25, 25-22, 25-23, 28-26 victory on Sunday (Philippine time).

text: Pagkatapos nga napierde sa una nga set, ang Poland naglagas sa likod nanday Agnieszka Korneluk kag Magdalena Stysiak, nga naggamit sang ila superior blocking.
english: After losing the first set, Poland went after Agnieszka Korneluk and Magdalena Stysiak, who used their superior blocking.

text: Ginpangunahan ni Korneluk ang Poland sa pag-iskor, nga nagtapos nga may 20 puntos.
english: Korneluk led Poland in scoring, finishing with 20 points.

text: Mas madamo man siya sang narekord nga mga block sangsa bug-os nga team sang Japan, nga natapos nga may walo para sa hampang.
english: He also recorded more blocks than the entire Japan team, finishing with eight for the match.

text: Ang Poland may 14-5 nga bentaha sa blocking.
english: Poland had a 14-5 blocking advantage.

text: Para sa Japan, nga nagdaug sang pilak sa sining karon lang nga VNL season, isa ini ka masubo nga pagsugod samtang ang team nagkadto sa Olympics kag nagatinguha nga maka-abanse sa ila ika-10 nga pwesto gikan sa Tokyo 2020.
english: For Japan, who won silver in the recent VNL season, it was a bleak start as the team headed into the Olympics and looked to advance on their 10th-place finish from Tokyo 2020.

text: Ang team captain nga si Sarina Nishida, nga nag-anunsyo antes sang Olympics nga magaretiro na ini pagkatapos sang Paris 2024, nagbukas sang iya farewell campaign nga may pinakamataas nga 27 points, 26 gikan sa attacks.
english: Team captain Sarina Nishida, who announced before the Olympics that she would retire after Paris 2024, opened her farewell campaign with a game-high 27 points, 26 from attacks.

text: Ginhingyo ni Aksyon Demokratiko presidential bet Isko Moreno Domagoso sa Commission on Elections (Comelec) nga i-konsiderar liwat ang pagsulundan may kaangtanan sa pagdumili sa mga kandidato nga magpa-picture sa mga tawo sa tion sang pagpangampanya.
english: Aksyon Demokratiko presidential bet Isko Moreno Domagoso has asked the Commission on Elections (Comelec) to reconsider the rule regarding the prohibition of candidates from taking pictures with people during the campaign.

text: Suno kay Moreno, nahangpan sini nga ginalikawan lang sang Comelec nga maglapta ang Covid-19 apang mabudlay nga i-kontrol ang publiko ilabi na kun excited sila nga makit-an ang mga kandidato.
english: Moreno said he understands that the Comelec is only trying to prevent the spread of Covid-19 but it is difficult to control the public especially if they are excited to see the candidates.

text: “Kung kaligayahan ‘yun ng ibang tao, tingin ko, mag-isip pa tayo ng ibang rule na tingin ko mas sensible.
english: “If it's someone else's happiness, I think we should think of another rule that I think is more sensible.

text: Siguro pag-aralan nila yung mga alituntunin… ‘Yung iba, baka hindi na akma sa sitwasyon,” suno kay Domagoso.
english: Maybe they will study the rules... 'The others, maybe they don't fit the situation,” Domagoso said.

text: Ini nga ideya ang ginsuportahan man sang iya nga runningmate nga si Aksyon Demokratiko vice presidential candidate Willie Ong, isa ka cardiologist.
english: This idea was also supported by his runningmate Aksyon Demokratiko vice presidential candidate Willie Ong, a cardiologist.

text: Suno kay Ong, manubo ang posibilidad nga maglapta ang virus kun sa guwa man ginahiwat ang aktibidad kag kun naka-face mask man ang mga tawo.
english: According to Ong, the possibility of spreading the virus is low if the activity is held outdoors and if people wear face masks.

text: “Basta open air yung lugar, mababa.
english: “As long as the place is open air, it will be low.

text: Kahit sa caravan, mababa talaga yung risk.
english: Even in a caravan, the risk is really low.

text: Pero kapag sa closed space, doon talaga… Nagiisip nga kami na bumili nung mask na may plastic para kahit papaano makasunod kami at makilala pa din kami ng tao,” suno kay Ong.
english: But when in a closed space, it's really there... We're thinking of buying a mask with plastic so that we can somehow follow and people will still recognize us,” Ong said.

text: Kuhaon bilang mga resource persons sanday House Majority Leader kag Ilocos Norte 1st District Representative Sandro Marcos kag Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo Duterte nga maga-atubang sa Independent Commission on Infrastructure (ICI) sa nagapadayon nga imbestigasyon sa kontrobersiyal nga flood control infrastructure.
english: House Majority Leader and Ilocos Norte 1st District Representative Sandro Marcos and Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo Duterte will be hired as resource persons to appear before the Independent Commission on Infrastructure (ICI) in the ongoing investigation into the controversial flood control infrastructure.

text: Magluwas kay Marcos kag Duterte paga-imbitaron man ang iban pa nga mga mamalidha nga mangin resource person nga sanday Laguna 4th District Rep.
english: Besides Marcos and Duterte, other lawmakers will also be invited to be resource persons, Laguna 4th District Rep.

text: Benjamin Agarao Jr., Bulacan 1st District Rep.
english: Benjamin Agarao Jr., Bulacan 1st District Rep.

text: Danilo Domingo kag Benguet Lone District Rep.
english: Danilo Domingo and Benguet Lone District Rep.

text:
Eric Yap

Una na ginpahayag sang ICI nga handa na ini mag-livestream sang ila ngahearing parte sa anomaliya sa flood control kag nagahulat na lang sang resource person nga magapasugot nga i-livestream ang ila testimonya.
english:
Eric Yap

Earlier, the ICI said it was ready to livestream its hearing on the flood control anomaly and was waiting for a resource person to agree to livestream their testimony.

text: Ini matapos ang alegasyon nga ginpngbu-an ni anay Ako Bicol Party-list Rep.
english: This follows the allegation made by former Ako Bicol Party-list Rep.

text: Zaldy Co nga ang mga Marcos amo ang nagmando sang mga insertion sa 2025 national budget.
english: Zaldy Co said the Marcoses ordered the insertions in the 2025 national budget.

text: Gilayon man ini gindeny ni Sandro Marcos ang mga akusasyon ni Co bilang “fantastical” ukon sala nga alegasyon.
english: Sandro Marcos immediately denied Co's accusations as “fantastical” or false allegations.

text: Samtang, gindeny man ni Paolo Duterte nga may ara kuno siya sang “non-existent” nga mga flood control project sa ila distrito, kabaliskaran sa alegasyon ni House Deputy Minority Leader kag ACT Teachers Party-list Rep.
english: Meanwhile, Paolo Duterte also denied that he has “non-existent” flood control projects in his district, contrary to the allegations of House Deputy Minority Leader and ACT Teachers Party-list Rep.

text: Antonio Tinio.
english: Antonio Tinio.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagbuya sang pahayag si Duterte nga ang tagsa ka flood control project sa Davao kag Matina Rivers natuman, na-inspeksyon, kag na-validate sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) kag sang Commission on Audit (COA).
english: It is known that Duterte denied the statement that each flood control project in Davao and Matina Rivers has been implemented, inspected, and validated by the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) and the Commission on Audit (COA).

text: Gintugyan sang Association of Barangay Captains sa distrito sang Jaro ang kaso sa bahin sang DSWD kun ano ang mangin resulta may kaangtanan sa pagpasaka sang kaso sa mga brgy.
english: The Association of Barangay Captains in Jaro district has handed over the case to the DSWD on the outcome of the filing of cases in brgy.

text: officials angot sa pagbuhin sang AICS.
english: officials regarding the reduction of AICS.

text: Madumduman nga madamo nga pumuluyo halin sa nagkalain- lain nga barangay sang Jaro ang nagreklamo nga ginabuhinan ang P10,000 nga ayuda nga ila nabatun halin sa Department of Social Welfare and Development.
english: It can be recalled that many residents from different barangays of Jaro complained that the P10,000 assistance they received from the Department of Social Welfare and Development was being reduced.

text: Suno kay Brgy.
english: According to Brgy.

text: Kapitan Rodel Mamon sang Ungka Jaro kag Presidente sang Association of Barangay Captains sa Jaro, dapat pasabton gid ang mga involved nga brgy officials angot sa alegasyon batok sa ila.
english: Kapitan Rodel Mamon of Ungka Jaro and President of the Association of Barangay Captains in Jaro, said the involved brgy officials should be held accountable regarding the allegations against them.

text: Suno naman sa DSWD 6, naglab-ot sa 13 ka mga opisyales ang pasakaan sang kaso may kaangtanan sa maanomaliya nga tagtaganay sang AICS.
english: According to DSWD 6, 13 officials will be charged in connection with the anomalous distribution of AICS.

text: Magabalik sa ibabaw sang ring subong nga adlaw ang Pinoy boxing legend nga si anay Senador Manny Pacquiao!
english: Pinoy boxing legend former Senator Manny Pacquiao will return to the ring today!

text: Balantayan ang exhibition match sang amo nga boxing icon batok sa Japanese kickboxer nga si Rukiya Anpo sa main event sang Super RIZIN 3 sa Saitama Super Arena sa Japan.
english: Watch the boxing icon's exhibition match against Japanese kickboxer Rukiya Anpo in the main event of Super RIZIN 3 at the Saitama Super Arena in Japan.

text: Ini nga match nga may 152-pound catchweight ang magalawig sang tatlo gid lamang ka rounds.
english: This match with a 152-pound catchweight will last only three rounds.

text: Base sa nagaguluwa nga impormasyon, gina-seryoso ni Pacquaio ini nga exhibition fight bangud sa ginapanan-aw nga pagbalik sini sa competitive boxing.
english: Based on the information coming out, Pacquaio is taking this exhibition fight seriously because of his expected return to competitive boxing.

text: Paborito man ang 45-anyos nga anay senador nga magdaog, bangud magluwas sa iya 62-8-2 win-loss-draw card, indi kuntani si Anpo ang maka-atubang sini bangud last-minute replacement lang ini nga Japanese fighter sa mixed martial artist nga si Chihiro Suzuki nga nag-withdraw bangud sa injury sa iya nga butkon.
english: The 45-year-old former senator is also a favorite to win, because apart from his 62-8-2 win-loss-draw card, Anpo would not have been able to face it because he was a last-minute replacement for Japanese fighter Chihiro Suzuki who withdrew due to an arm injury.

text: Ang 28-anyos naman nga si Anpo nga isa ka seasoned kickboxer amo man anay ang K-1 super-lightweight champion kag may 5 inches nga mas mataas ipaanggid sa 5-foot-6 nga si Pacquiao.
english: The 28-year-old Anpo, a seasoned kickboxer, is also a former K-1 super-lightweight champion and is 5 inches taller than the 5-foot-6 Pacquiao.

text: Ginapahayag man nga ini nga Anpo fight ang paagi sang nagaisahanon nga eight-division boxing champ nga matilawan kun handa na siya sa pagbalik sa pro ranks.
english: It is also said that this Anpo fight is the only way for the eight-division boxing champ to test if he is ready to return to the pro ranks.

text: Katapusan nga nakahampang si Pacquiao sang Agusto 2021 kun sa diin ginlutos ini sang Cuban fighter nga si Yordenis Ugas via unanimous decision.
english: Pacquiao last fought in August 2021 when he was defeated by Cuban fighter Yordenis Ugas via unanimous decision.

text: Base sa nagaguluwa nga impormasyon, interesado ang Pinoy champ nga atubangon si reigning World Boxing Council welterweight champion Mario Barrios subong nga tuig.
english: Based on emerging information, the Pinoy champ is interested in facing reigning World Boxing Council welterweight champion Mario Barrios this year.

text: Madamo sang flights padulong sa isla sang Bali, Indonesia ang ginkanselar bangud sa paglupok sang bulkan Lewotobi Laki-Laki.
english: Many flights to the island of Bali, Indonesia have been canceled due to the eruption of the volcano Lewotobi Laki-Laki.

text: Nagbuga sang abo ang bulkan tubtob sa 11 kilometros ang kataason.
english: The volcano spewed ash up to 7 miles [11 km] high.

text: Bangud sini, ginpataas ang alerto kag gin-evacuate ang mga residente nga yara sa 7 kilometros nga radius sang crater sang bulkan.
english: As a result, the alert was raised and residents within a 7-kilometer radius of the volcano's crater were evacuated.

text: Naglab-ot sa 37 ka flights ang kanselado bangud sa nasambit nga paglupok sang bulkan.
english: A total of 37 flights were canceled due to the eruption.

text: Wala naman sang may narekord nga pilason ukon napatay sa nasambit nga insidente.
english: No injuries or deaths were recorded in the incident.

text: Madumduman nga sadtong Nobyembre sang nagligad nga tuig, naglupok ang bulkan sa diin siyam ang napatay kag pila ka libo ka mga residente ang ginbakwit.
english: It can be recalled that in November last year, the volcano erupted killing nine people and evacuating several thousand residents.

text: Siling nila, bisan ano mo pa ka-paborito ang isa ka music, kun himuon mo ini nga alarm, maabot gid ang tion nga manginit ka sa sini nga musika bangud indi mo pa gusto magbugtaw.
english: They say, no matter how much you love a piece of music, if you set it as an alarm, there will come a time when you'll be too hot for it because you don't want to wake up.

text: Ano na lang ayhan kun tawo pa gid ang himuon nga alarm… ano ayhan ang kainit mo kun oras oras ka nalang ginapukaw?
english: What if the alarm was made by a human being... what would be your heat if you were woken up every hour?

text: Sa Xinyang, China, isa ka lalaki ang anum ka tuig na nga ginhimo nga palangabuhian ang pagpukaw sa mga tawo paagi sa pag-text kag pagtawag sa ila.
english: In Xinyang, China, a man has spent six years making a living waking people up by texting and calling them.

text: Online supervisor ang tawag sang mga tawo kay Xiao Zhu kag sa sulod sa sining anum ka tuig, nabuligan niya ang iya mga kliyente nga malikawan ang paglaminday.
english: People call Xiao Zhu an online supervisor and over the past six years, he has helped his clients avoid bullying.

text: 20,000 na ang nangin kliyente ni Xiao halin sang gin-umpisahan niya ang amo nga trabaho.
english: Xiao has had 20,000 clients since he took up the job.

text: 15 ka oras kada adlaw ang iya ginagasto para sa pagtext kag pag-call agud maremind ang mga tawo sa ila ulubrahon.
english: 15 hours a day he spends texting and calling to remind people of their work.

text: Wala man ginsapubliko kun pila ang sweldo ni Xiao Zhu apang ginapahayag nga daku ang iya kita bangud amo lang ini lang ang iya nagaisahanon nga trabaho sa sulod sang anum ka tuig.
english: Xiao Zhu's salary was not disclosed but it is said that he earned a lot because it was his only job for six years.

text: Nag mato-mato nga nagsungka si Sarah Discaya sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) nga isa man sa ay dako nga kaangtanan sa flood control scandals sang Disyembre 9, 2025.
english: Sarah Discaya surrendered to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on December 9, 2025.

text: Ini ang nangin kabahin sang pahayag ni President Ferdinand Marcos sa iya nga uploaded video sa Facebook.
english: This was part of the statement of President Ferdinand Marcos in his uploaded video on Facebook.

text: Suno kay PBMM, yara na sa kustodiya sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) si Discaya kag nagahulat na lang sang pormal nga paguwa sang iya nga warrant of arrest.
english: According to PBMM, Discaya is now in the custody of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) and is awaiting the formal issuance of his warrant of arrest.

text: Ginkapakigbahin pa ni Marcos nga madamo na ang maayo nga nagakalatabo bangud nagakadakpan na ang mga involved sa sindikato.
english: Marcos shared that many good things are happening because those involved in the syndicate are being arrested.

text: Ginpasiguro man sini nga magapadayun ang imbestigasyon agud nga manabat ang mga korap kag mabalik ang kwarta nga ila ginkawat.
english: He also assured that the investigation will continue to hold the corrupt accountable and return the money they stole.

text: Nagabaha ang suporta sang mga Ilonggo para kay Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks inoras antes ang pormal nga pagsugod sang coronation night sang Miss Universe Philippines 2024, Mayo 22.
english: Ilonggos are flooding with support for Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks hours before the formal start of the coronation night of Miss Universe Philippines 2024, May 22.

text: Sa iya hometown sa Leon, Iloilo, nag-preparar ang local government unit (LGU) sang libre nga public viewing sa plaza sang banwa agud malantaw sang iya kasimanwa ang ginabantayan nga performance sang Filipino-American beauty queen sa finals sang national pageant.
english: In her hometown in Leon, Iloilo, the local government unit (LGU) prepared a free public viewing in the plaza of the town so that her fellow citizens can watch the performance of the Filipino-American beauty queen in the finals of the national pageant.

text: Nagpanguna naman si Leon Mayor Ma.
english: Leon Mayor Ma.

text: Lina Cabana-Holipas kag si Second District Rep.
english: Lina Cabana-Holipas and Second District Rep.

text: Michael Gorriceta sa mga opisyal nga nagbyahe gid padulong sa Metro Manila para makalantaw sang live event.
english: Michael Gorriceta to the officials who traveled to Metro Manila to watch the live event.

text:
Ang Buga Central Elementary School naman, iban nga LGU officials, kag iban pa nga pageant enthusiasts ang nag-post sang videos kag pictures para suportahan ang ginabansagan nga “People’s Queen.”

Sa bulig sang boto sang mga fans, sulod si Brooks sa finalists sang tanan nga challenges antes ang coronation night kag nalakip man sa Top 3 ang iya “Ugto-Ugto” performance sa Best in National Costume.
english:
Buga Central Elementary School, other LGU officials, and other pageant enthusiasts posted videos and pictures to support the so-called “People’s Queen.”

With the help of fan votes, Brooks was among the finalists of all challenges before the coronation night and his “Ugto-Ugto” performance in Best in National Costume was also included in the Top 3.

text: 53 ka mga kandidata ang magapaindis-indis subong nga gab-i para makabulos sa korona ni reigning queen Michelle Dee.
english: 53 candidates will compete tonight to succeed reigning queen Michelle Dee's crown.

text: Isa man ini ka interesante nga edisyon sang pageant bangud sa pila ka butang: ang delegates ang ginpili paagi sa Accredited Partners Program, may mga kandidata nga nagatiglawas sa overseas Filipino communities, kag wala na sang age restrictions para sa mga magapasakop.
english: It was also an interesting edition of the pageant for several reasons: the delegates were selected through the Accredited Partners Program, there were candidates representing overseas Filipino communities, and there were no age restrictions for the participants.

text: Tanan kita handom nga makapatindog sang balay.
english: We all dream of building a house.

text: Ang iban nagabakal na lang sang human na nga balay apang may tawo naman nga may yara sang luyag nga istruktura sang balay ukon disenyo rason nga nagapa-construct ini — bungalow man ina, two-storey ukon three-storey house.
english: Others just buy a finished house but there are people who have a desired structure or design of the house so they construct it — whether it is a bungalow, two-storey or three-storey house.

text: Apang kun nagapangita ikaw sang balay nga human na, dako, malapad, may swimming pool kag may ice cream station, indi magkabalaka bangud didto sa Westerville, Ohio sa Estados Unidos, may yara yara sang balay nga mapa-WOW ka gid.
english: But if you are looking for a house that is finished, big, spacious, with a swimming pool and an ice cream station, don't worry because in Westerville, Ohio in the United States, there is a house that will WOW you.

text: Kun imo makit-an sa guwa ang itsura sang balay, daw kaangay lang man ini sa mga balay nga imo makita sa mga subdivisions sa diin may yara sang gamay nga garden kag garahe.
english: If you look at the outside of the house, it looks like the houses you see in the subdivisions where there is a small garden and garage.

text: May yara ini sang apat ka kwarto kag tatlo ka bathrooms gani “swak” gid ini para sa imo nga pamilya.
english: It has four bedrooms and three bathrooms so it is perfect for your family.

text: Ang ini nga balay ang perfect para sa mga ice cream lovers bangud may yara sang ice cream factory sa kusina sa diin imo makit-an ang mga flavors nga lain-lain depende sa imo nga naluyagan.
english: This house is perfect for ice cream lovers as there is an ice cream factory in the kitchen where you can find the flavors different depending on what you like.

text: Kun sa imo pagdumdom, ang garahe sang balay ang para sa salakyan, motorsiklo ukon bike, dira ka gid nagsala bangud kun buksan mo ang garahe, swimming pool gali ang imo nga makit-an.
english: If you think that the garage of the house is for cars, motorcycles or bikes, you are wrong because if you open the garage, you will see a swimming pool.

text: Ti kun dream house mo na ini, ipreparar na dira ang imo inugbakal bangud ginabaligya ini sang tag-iya sa balor nga $338,000 ukon P16.4 million.
english: If this is your dream house, prepare your purchase because the owner is selling it for $338,000 or P16.4 million.

text: Patay ang national boxing coach sang Samoa matapos ini nagsuprer sang cardiac arrest samtang yara mismo sa sulod sang Olympic village sa Paris, France.
