english: Samoa's national boxing coach died after suffering a cardiac arrest while inside the Olympic village in Paris, France.

text: Ginlista man sang otoridad nga resulta sang “natural causes” ang kamatayon sang biktima nga gin-identify nga si Lionel Fatu Elika, 60.
english: Authorities also listed the death of the victim, identified as Lionel Fatu Elika, 60, as a result of “natural causes”.

text: Sunod man nga ginkumpirma sang Samoa Association of Sport and National Olympic Committee (SASNOC) ang amo nga balita kun sa diin ginlaragway man ang biktima nga isa sa sa top boxing coaches sa Samoa kag nagapati gid sa prinsipyo sang Olympics.
english: The Samoa Association of Sport and National Olympic Committee (SASNOC) later confirmed the news, describing the victim as one of the top boxing coaches in Samoa and a firm believer in the principles of the Olympics.

text: Naghatag naman sang mensahe sang simpatiya ang International Boxing Association sa Samoan boxing community kag mga abyan kag pamilya sang coach kasunod sang amo nga hitabo.
english: The International Boxing Association sent a message of sympathy to the Samoan boxing community and the coach's friends and family following the incident.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang heavyweight nga si Ato Plodzicki-Faoagali amo lamang ang isahanon nga Samoan boxer nga naga-compete sa Paris Olympics.
english: It is known that heavyweight Ato Plodzicki-Faoagali is the only Samoan boxer competing in the Paris Olympics.

text: Ini nga two-time Pacific Games champion ang magasambuwa batok kay Victor Schelstraete sang Belgium subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 28.
english: The two-time Pacific Games champion will face Victor Schelstraete of Belgium today, July 28.

text: Naghugyaw ang delegasyon sang Pilipinas bangud nagdaku ang tyansa nga makadala gid sang INDI LANG ISA KUNDI TATLO GID ka medalya ang Golden Boy sang pungsod nga si Carlos Edriel Yulo ukon si Caloy Yulo matapos ini nag-abanse na sa finals sa tatlo ka kategorya sa gymnastics tournament sa Paris Olympics 2024!
english: The Philippine delegation cheered because the country's Golden Boy Carlos Edriel Yulo or Caloy Yulo has a chance to win NOT ONE BUT THREE medals after he advanced to the finals in three categories at the gymnastics tournament at the Paris 2024 Olympics!

text: Base sa Paris Olympics website nga ginpaguwa pasado ‘las tres sa kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas, kumpirmado nga kuwalipikado ang Pinoy gymnast sa medal rounds sang all-around event, vault, kag floor exercise.
english: Based on the Paris Olympics website released around 3:00 am Philippine time, the Filipino gymnast was confirmed qualified for the medal rounds of the all-around event, vault, and floor exercise.

text: Nakaangkon si Yulo sang total score nga 83.631 sa qualification round agud nga makatapak sa finals.
english: Yulo scored a total score of 83.631 in the qualification round to advance to the finals.

text: Nahibaluan nga top 24 gymnasts lamang ang nag-abanse sa amo nga -around finals.
english: Only the top 24 gymnasts advanced to the -around finals.

text: Sa floor exercise, nangin impresibo ang hulag ni Yulo kag nakaangkon sang skor nga 14.766 sa qualification round kag nagpangaduha sa tiglawas sang Great Britain nga si Jake Jarman nga may 14.966.
english: In the floor exercise, Yulo was impressive and scored 14.766 in the qualification round to finish second to Great Britain's Jake Jarman with 14.966.

text: Sa vault apparatus, nakakuha ini sang average nga 14.683 sa qualifiers kag nagpang-anum sa pangkabug-usan.
english: On vault apparatus, she averaged 14.683 in qualifiers and placed sixth overall.

text: Ginpahayag sang Filipino gymnast nga may yara pa siya sang inughatag nga mas impresibo nga performance sa qualification apang wala sini anay ginbubo ang tanan bangud mas ginhatagan sini sang prayoridad ang safety kag nagahalong nga indi makaangkon sang injury samtang yara na sa all-around finals.
english: The Filipino gymnast said she has a more impressive performance to give in the qualification but she did not pour everything because she gave priority to safety and is careful not to get injured while in the all-around finals.

text: Kun balikan ang performance sini sa Tokyo Olympics sang 2021, nag-abanse man anay si Yulo sa vault finals apang wala nakabusa sang medalya.
english: Looking back at her performance at the Tokyo Olympics in 2021, Yulo also advanced to the vault finals but did not win a medal.

text: Siya man ang gold medalist sa amo nga apparatus sa 2021 World Championships.
english: He was also the gold medalist on that apparatus at the 2021 World Championships.

text: Balantayan ang all-around finals sa Hulyo 31; ang floor exercise finals sa Agusto 3; kag ang vault finals sa Agusto 4.
english: Watch the all-around finals on July 31; the floor exercise finals on Aug. 3; and the vault finals on Aug. 4.

text: Subong nga adlaw, sa gymnastics sa gihapon, balantayan ang iban pa nga tiglawas sang Pilipina nga sanday Emma Malabuyo, Aleah Finnegan, kag Levi Ruivivar.
english: Today, in gymnastics, watch out for other Philippine representatives Emma Malabuyo, Aleah Finnegan, and Levi Ruivivar.

text: Kun may yara sang white sand beach sa Boracay, may yara naman sang black sand beach sa Iceland.
english: If there is a white sand beach in Boracay, there is a black sand beach in Iceland.

text: Ini ang masami nga ginakadto-an sang mga dumuluong bangud pinasahi ini ipaanggid sa iban nga mga beach.
english: It is often visited by foreigners because it is unique compared to other beaches.

text: Magluwas sa black sand, nakakuha man sang atensyon ang dalagko nga mga ice nga yara nahamtang sa mga balas.
english: Besides the black sand, the large ice blocks located on the sand also attracted attention.

text: Ang ginkilala bilang Diamond Beach ang makit-an sa Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon sa South Coast sang Iceland.
english: Diamond Beach is located in the Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon on the South Coast of Iceland.

text: Nagapanguna ini nga tourist attraction sa nasambit nga pungsod.
english: It is a leading tourist attraction in the country.

text: Ang size sang sini nga mga ice nga ginakabig “diamonds” ang nagadako sang daw kaangay sa imo nga palad tubtob sa average nga kadakuon sang tawo.
english: The size of these ice, called “diamonds,” ranges from about the size of your palm to the average human size.

text: Magluwas sini, popular man ang Diamond Beach bangud wala nagapalareho ang hitsura sang lugar kada adlaw — may yara kun kaisa nga gamay lang ang mga ice nga yara sa balas apang matabo-an man kun kaisa nga tuman naman ini ka damo, nagatulumpok kag mga dalagko pa.
english: In addition, Diamond Beach is also popular because the appearance of the place is not the same every day — there are sometimes small ice on the sand but sometimes it happens that there are many, clustered and larger.

text: Ang mga ice nga ini ang naghalin sa Breiðamerkurjökull , isa ka outlet glacier sa Vatnajökull — ang pinakadako nga icecap sa Europe.
english: These ices are from Breiðamerkurjökull , an outlet glacier in Vatnajökull — the largest icecap in Europe.

text: Nakabaton ang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) sang 48 ka mga karton sang dokumento nga kabahin sa mga anomalya sa flood control projects.
english: The Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) received 48 cartons of documents as part of anomalies in flood control projects.

text: Suno sa pahayag sang ICI, ang mga dokumento gin-turn over sang Philippine National Police (PNP) nga kabahin sang “collaborative efforts” sang mga ahensya sang gobyerno sa pag-imbestigar sang irregularidad sa flood control projects.
english: According to the ICI statement, the documents were turned over by the Philippine National Police (PNP) as part of the “collaborative efforts” of government agencies to investigate irregularities in flood control projects.

text: Ang dokumento nagalakip sang 11 ka reports sa flood control projects sa Masinloc, Zambales; San Agustin, Romblon; San Jose, Occidental Mindoro; Noveleta, Cavite; kag Rodriguez, Rizal, samtang may tatlo ka project reports para sa Imus kag General Trias sa Cavite.
english: The document includes 11 reports on flood control projects in Masinloc, Zambales; San Agustin, Romblon; San Jose, Western Mindoro; Noveleta, Cavite; and Rodriguez, Rizal, while there are three project reports for Imus and General Trias in Cavite.

text: Nakabaton man ang ICI sang duha ka complaint affidavits gikan sa pribado nga mga tawo natuhoy sa kahimtangan sang flood control kag iban pa nga public works projects sa 2nd District sang Surigao del Norte.
english: The ICI also received two complaint affidavits from private individuals regarding the condition of flood control and other public works projects in the 2nd District of Surigao del Norte.

text: Samtang, sang ginpatigayon na ang virtual meeting sang Technical Working Group (TWG) sang ICI gin-postpone bangud kulang sa quorum, kay pito lang sa 23 ka member-agencies ang available.
english: Meanwhile, when the virtual meeting of the Technical Working Group (TWG) of ICI was held, it was postponed due to lack of quorum, as only seven of the 23 member-agencies were available.

text: Ipakita sang bug-os nga pwersa sang Ilonggo pageant fans ang suporta para sa tiglawas sang Iloilo City nga si Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks para sa koronasyon sang Miss Universe Philippines 2024 subong nga adlaw, Mayo 22.
english: The entire force of Ilonggo pageant fans will show their support for Iloilo City representative Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks for the coronation of Miss Universe Philippines 2024 today, May 22.

text: Sa Leon, Iloilo nga hometown sang Filipino-American beauty queen, preparado na ang plaza para sa public viewing nga magasugod 7:00 karon sa gab-i kag buksan nga libre para sa tanan.
english: In Leon, Iloilo, the hometown of the Filipino-American beauty queen, the plaza is ready for public viewing that will start at 7:00 pm and will be open free of charge to all.

text: Si Mayor Malin Cabana-Holipas nga magapadulong gid sa Metro Manila para makalantaw sang live coronation night ang nagpanawagan man sa tanan nga mga Ilonggo nga mag-isa sa pagpakita sang suporta kay Brooks nga isa sa ginalantaw magapauli sang korona.
english: Mayor Malin Cabana-Holipas who will be traveling to Metro Manila to watch the live coronation night also called on all Ilonggos to unite in showing support to Brooks who is expected to bring home the crown.

text: “Ang bilog nga banwa kang Leon naga paabot gid kang bug-os nga suporta sa amon kasimanwa kag bugal kang Leon, Alexie Caimoso Brooks.
english: “The entire town of Leon is looking forward to the full support of our fellow citizen and pride of Leon, Alexie Caimoso Brooks.

text: Ang iya kadalag-an, kadalagan kang bilog nga banwa kag mga pumuluyo kang Leon,” kabahin sang pahayag sang alcalde.
english: His victory is the victory of the entire town and the people of Leon,” the mayor said.

text: Sa bulig sang boto sang mga fans, sulod si Brooks sa finalists sang tanan nga challenges antes ang coronation night kag nalakip man sa Top 3 ang iya “Ugto-Ugto” performance sa Best in National Costume.
english: With the help of fan votes, Brooks was among the finalists of all challenges before the coronation night and his “Ugto-Ugto” performance in Best in National Costume was also included in the Top 3.

text: 53 ka mga kandidata ang magapaindis-indis subong nga adlaw para makabulos sa korona ni reigning queen Michelle Dee.
english: 53 candidates will compete today to succeed reigning queen Michelle Dee's crown.

text: Isa man ini ka interesante nga edisyon sang pageant bangud sa pila ka butang: ang delegates ang ginpili paagi sa Accredited Partners Program, may mga kandidata nga nagatiglawas sa overseas Filipino communities, kag wala na sang age restrictions para sa mga magapasakop.
english: It was also an interesting edition of the pageant for several reasons: the delegates were selected through the Accredited Partners Program, there were candidates representing overseas Filipino communities, and there were no age restrictions for the participants.

text: Magluwas sa main crown, may apat ka iban pa nga korona para sa sini nga pageant nga magahatag sang oportunidad sa winners nga itiglawas ang Pilipinas sa international pageants.
english: Besides the main crown, there are four other crowns for this pageant that will give the winners the opportunity to represent the Philippines in international pageants.

text: Magadul-ong man ang Bombo Radyo sang updates sa coronation night nga magasugod 8:00 karon sa gab-i sa Mall of Asia Arena sa Pasay.#
english: Bombo Radyo will also bring updates on the coronation night starting at 8:00 pm tonight at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay.

text: Umpisahan naman sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) – Antique ang Oplan Pangbaklas subong nga semana agud nga mapangkakas na ang campaign posters nga iligal nga ginapangpaskil sa palibot sang probinsya.
english: The Commission on Elections (Comelec)-Antique will launch Oplan Pangbaklas this week to remove campaign posters that are illegally posted around the province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Antique Provincial Election Supervisor Atty. Wil Arceño, iya ginpahayag nga pangbaklason man ang mga campaign materials nga wala nagasunod sa husto nga size requirement kag ang mga ginpangtapik sa indi designated nga mga lugar pati na sa mga kahoy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Antique Provincial Election Supervisor Atty. Wil Arceño, he said that campaign materials that do not comply with the correct size requirement and those that are posted in non-designated areas including trees will also be removed.

text: Buwas, Pebrero 8, sa una nga adlaw sang campaign period para sa national candidates, may yara na sang aktibidad si senatorial aspirant Loren Legarda kag may isa man ka partylist group nga may kick-off activity.
english: Tomorrow, February 8, on the first day of the campaign period for national candidates, senatorial aspirant Loren Legarda will have an activity and a partylist group will also have a kick-off activity.

text: Taga-Antique ang first nominee sang amo nga partylist suno kay Arceño.
english: The first nominee of the partylist is from Antique, Arceño said.

text:
PEACE COVENANT SIGNING

Well-attended ang peace covenant signing nga ginpatigayon sang Comelec sa probinsya sang Antique kaina.
english:
PEACE COVENANT SIGNING

The peace covenant signing conducted by the Comelec in Antique province yesterday was well-attended.

text: Suno kay Arceño, nagkomiter man ang mga kandidato nga magkooperar para sa malinong nga eleksyon sa probinsya.
english: Arceño said the candidates also committed to cooperate for a peaceful election in the province.

text: I-maintain suno kay Arceño ang record sang probinsya nga wala sang recorded nga election-related nga violence halin sang 2019.
english: Arceño said the province's record of no recorded election-related violence since 2019 will be maintained.

text:
DUGANG NGA MGA PAHANUMDOM

Sa pag-umpisa sang campaign period, nagpahanumdom ang Comelec nga indi pwede ang pagpanagtag sang donations — in kind man ukon cash.
english:
ADDITIONAL REMINDERS

At the beginning of the campaign period, the Comelec reminded that the distribution of donations — in kind or cash — is not allowed.

text:
Indi pwede ang pagpanghatag sang pagkaon, ukon “anything of value.”

Sa tanan nga mga kandidato nga magakampanya, kinahanglan nga may yara gid sang permit halin sa Comelec Campaign Committee.
english:
The distribution of food, or “anything of value,” is not allowed.

All candidates who will campaign must have a permit from the Comelec Campaign Committee.

text:
Yari ang dugang nga mga pahanumdom para sa national candidates:

Wala na sang physical contact kun magpangampanya — wala sudlanay sa balay, pagkupo-kupo- ukon pagbeso-beso.
english:
Here are more reminders for national candidates:

There will be no physical contact when campaigning — no touching, hugging or kissing.

text: Istrikto nga ginadumilian ang gathering sang tuman ka damo nga tawo.
english: Gathering of too many people is strictly prohibited.

text: Sa in-person campaigns, holding of rallies, caravans kag iban pa nga kaangay nga campaign, kinahanglan gid anay nga may yara sang permit sang Committee paagi sa pag-apply sa regional ukon provincial election offices kun sa diin patigayunon ang aktibidad.
english: In-person campaigns, holding of rallies, caravans and other similar campaigns, it is necessary to have a permit from the Committee by applying to the regional or provincial election offices where the activity will be held.

text: Naka-kolekta na ang gobyerno sang Pilipinas sang P2.77 trillion sa tax revenues subong nga tuig.
english: The Philippine government has already collected P2.77 trillion in tax revenues this year.

text: Base ini sa preliminary data nga ginpaguwa sang Department of Finance (DOF) nga nagapakita sang nasukot nga buwis halin sang Enero tubtub Septyembre.
english: This is based on preliminary data released by the Department of Finance (DOF) showing the tax collected from January to September.

text: Nueve porsyento ini nga mas mataas sa P2.54 trillion revenues sa amo man nga period sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This is nine percent higher than the P2.54 trillion revenues in the same period last year.

text: Katumbas man ini sa 72.5 percent sa P3.82 trillion nga amo ang target nga malab-ot subong nga tuig.
english: This is also equivalent to 72.5 percent of the P3.82 trillion target to be achieved this year.

text: Ang tax revenues amo ang ginalauman nga maga-account sang 89% sang overall revenue collections sa sulod sang isa ka tuig samtang ang nabilin naman ang kuhaon halin sa non-tax revenues kag privatization proceeds.
english: Tax revenues are expected to account for 89% of the overall revenue collections during the year while the rest will come from non-tax revenues and privatization proceeds.

text: Sang damlag lang, matandaan nga ginsapol ni Finance Secretary Ralph Recto ang Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) kag ang Bureau of Customs (BOC) agud i-assess ang collection performances sang mga ahensya kag istoryahan ang mga plano agud malab-ot ang target subong nga tuig kag sa 2025.
english: Recently, Finance Secretary Ralph Recto met with the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) and the Bureau of Customs (BOC) to assess the collection performances of the agencies and discuss plans to achieve the target this year and in 2025.

text: ‘Di bala kanami sa pamatyag nga mabakal mo ang mga gamit nga imo naluyagan gamit ang imo sweldo sa pagpanikasog sa trabaho?
english: 'Doesn't it feel good to buy the things you like with your hard-earned money?

text: Apang indi tanan ang mapalaron ilabi na subong nga kadam-an sa mga Filipino ang wala sang trabaho bangud sa pandemya.
english: But not everyone is lucky especially now that most Filipinos are unemployed due to the pandemic.

text: Kag kun wala ikaw sang trabaho, indi malikawan nga mangayo kita sang bulig sa aton nga ginikanan.
english: And if you don't have a job, we inevitably ask our parents for help.

text: Apang indi man siguro maglab-ot sa punto nga ma-mandu ka mismo sa inyo mga ginikanan nga suportahan kafinancially tubtob sa ulihe ‘di bala?
english: But it probably won't get to the point where you'll be ordered by your parents to support you financially until the end, right?

text: Ini ang natabo sa isa ka 41 anyos nga lalaki sa United Kingdom sa diin gindala pa niya sa korte ang iya mga ginikanan agud lang nga pwersahon ini nga suportahan siya pinansyal bangud wala siya sang trabaho.
english: This happened to a 41-year-old man in the United Kingdom where he even took his parents to court just to force them to support him financially because he was unemployed.

text: Si Faiz Siddiqui ang nagtapos sang iya pag-eskwela sa Oxford University kag gin-ako man niya nga tuman siya ka dependent sa iya nga mga ginikanan.
english: Faiz Siddiqui graduated from Oxford University and admitted that he was very dependent on his parents.

text: Nagapati ang lalaki nga malapas ang iya tawhanon nga kinamatarong kun utdon na sang iya mga manggaranon nga ginikanan ang pagsuporta sa iya.
english: The man believes that his human rights will be violated if his wealthy parents stop supporting him.

text: Humalin sang 2011, wala nakatrabaho si Faiz kag nagatinir lamang ini sang libre sa apartment nga ginabaydan sang iya mga ginikanan sa balor nga $1.4 million kag nagabaton man siya sang $550 kada semana bilang allowance.
english: Since 2011, Faiz has not been able to work and lives for free in an apartment paid for by his parents for $1.4 million and he also receives $550 a week as an allowance.

text: Apang nadesisyonan sang ginikanan nga tapuson na ang paghatag sang kwarta sa ila anak bangud nag-angkon sila sang seryoso nga argumento.
english: However, the parents decided to stop giving money to their son because they had a serious argument.

text: Indi lamang ini ang labing una nga reklamo ni Faiz nga gindala niya sa korte bangud mangin ang Oxford University ang iya man nga ginreklamo bangud sa ginapahayag niya nga wala nagahatag sang insakto nga pagtuon ang nasambit nga eskwelahan.
english: This is not the first complaint that Faiz has brought to court as he has also complained against Oxford University because he claims that the said school does not provide proper education.

text: Nag-share sang dugang nga pictures ang tiglawas sang Iloilo City nga si Alexie Brooks suksok ang gown nga iya gingamit sa preliminary competition sang Miss Universe Philippines 2024.
english: Iloilo City representative Alexie Brooks shared more pictures wearing the gown she used in the preliminary competition of Miss Universe Philippines 2024.

text: Himo ini sang world renowned Filipino artist nga si Rian Fernandez.
english: It was created by world renowned Filipino artist Rian Fernandez.

text:
Yari ang post:

“This intricately crafted masterpiece by world renowned Filipino artist Rian Fernandez, is a homage to the “Butlak sang Adlaw”, a Hiligaynon phrase that translates to sunrise.
english:
Here is the post:

“This intricately crafted masterpiece by world renowned Filipino artist Rian Fernandez, is a homage to the “Butlak sang Adlaw”, a Hiligaynon phrase that translates to sunrise.

text:
“Butlak sang adlaw” symbolizes, new beginnings, opportunities and hope that illuminates the lives of every Filipino.”

“Alexie Brooks is a symbol of hope, a champion and paragon of purpose, diversity and inclusion, showing us that like the sun’s rays, she also trailblazes the way for every single Filipino who dares to dream hugely, bring impact to the lives of others and strongly conquer the feared unknown.”

Balantayan ang coronation night sang Miss Universe Philippines buwas, Mayo 22 sa diin magluwas sa Miss Universe Philippines 2024 crown, may apat ka iban pa nga national crowns nga ihatag sa apat ka iban nga mga kandidata nga amo ang Miss Supranational Philippines, Miss Charm Philippines, Miss Eco International Philippines, kag Miss Cosmo Philippines.
english:
“Butlak sang sun” symbolizes, new beginnings, opportunities and hope that illuminates the lives of every Filipino.”

“Alexie Brooks is a symbol of hope, a champion and paragon of purpose, diversity and inclusion, showing us that like the sun’s rays, she also trailblazes the way for every single Filipino who dares to dream hugely, bring impact to the lives of others and strongly conquer the feared unknown.”

Stay tuned for the coronation night of Miss Universe Philippines tomorrow, May 22 where besides the Miss Universe Philippines 2024 crown, there will be four other national crowns to be awarded to four other contestants namely Miss Supranational Philippines, Miss Charm Philippines, Miss Eco Philippines, Miss Philippines International and Miss Philippines.

text: Lain-lain ang preparasyon sang kada Olympian antes sila magsaka sa ginakabig pinakadaku nga entablado para sa mga atleta sang bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Every Olympian prepares differently before they take to what is considered the biggest stage for athletes from all over the world.

text: Sobra ang ila halong antes ang ila nga kumpetisyon, apang may yara gid sang mga sirkumstansya nga indi gid mapaktan kag sarang gid makaapekto sa ila handum sa pagtapak sa Olympiada.
english: They are very careful before their competition, but there are always circumstances that are very unpredictable and can really affect their dream of entering the Olympics.

text: Kaangay sa isa ka 30-anyos nga field hockey player kag two-time Olympian sang Australia nga si Matt Dawson nga wala sang iban nga ginahandum kundi makuha ang gold medal subong nga Paris Summer Games matapos nakadaog sang silver sang nagligad nga Tokyo Olympics.
english: As in a 30-year-old field hockey player and two-time Olympian of Australia Matt Dawson who wants nothing more than to win the gold medal this Paris Summer Games after winning silver at the last Tokyo Olympics.

text: Duha ka semana antes ang Olympics, samtang yara siya sa practice, natam-an gid ang iya isa ka tudlo bangud naigu ini sang hockey stick.
english: Two weeks before the Olympics, while he was in practice, he severely injured one of his fingers after being hit by a hockey stick.

text: Sang amo nga tion, halos madula na sa iya ang iya nga Olympic dream bangud nakahibalo siya nga maapektuhan gid ang iya performance bangud sa injury sang iya ring finger.
english: At that time, he almost lost his Olympic dream because he knew that his performance would be severely affected by the injury to his ring finger.

text: Mangin ang surgeon ang nagsiling nga “severe impact” gid ang natabo sa iya tudlo kag maayo na lang bangud nagakabit pa ini.
english: Even the surgeon said that there was a “severe impact” on his finger and that it was good because it was still attached.

text: Duha ka options ang ginhatag sa Olympian: una, i-reconstruct ang iya tudlo paagi sa pagbutang sang wire, apang nagakahulugan ini nga dapat apat tubtub anum ka bulan gid ang ipahuway sang iya ring finger agud nga maka-recover — buot silingon, wala na siya sang tyansa nga maka-compete sa Olympics.
english: The Olympian was given two options: first, reconstruct his finger by inserting a wire, but this meant that his ring finger would have to rest for four to six months to recover — meaning he would have no chance of competing in the Olympics.

text: Ang ikaduha sini nga option amo nga dalayon na lang nga utdon ang apektado nga tudlo.
english: The second option is to amputate the affected finger immediately.

text: Daku ini nga desisyon para sa hockey player, apang ginpili sini nga hungod na lang nga ipa-utod ang apektado nga tudlo agud nga makahampang siya sa Paris kag may tyansa nga makuha ang bulawan nga medalya.
english: It was a big decision for the hockey player, but he chose to have the affected finger amputated so that he could play in Paris and have a chance to win the gold medal.

text: Subong nga Hulyo 27, kaupod si Dawson sa Kookaburras nga maga-atubang sa pungsod Argentina eksakto siyam ka adlaw matapos nga naangkon niya ang injury.
english: This July 27, Dawson will be with the Kookaburras who will face Argentina exactly nine days after he suffered the injury.

text: Ginlaragway man sini nga yara siya sa “best position” kag nalangkag gid siya nga makahampang ilabi na bangud may talapuson pa sila nga misyon kasunod sang ila silver medal finish sa Japan sang 2021.
english: He also described himself as being in the “best position” and looking forward to playing especially since they still have a long mission following their silver medal finish in Japan in 2021.

text: “There was a rollercoaster of emotions in the last two weeks of not really knowing.
english: “There was a rollercoaster of emotions in the last two weeks of not really knowing.

text: Going into my third Olympic Games and then initially thinking that that was going to be taken away from me.
english: Going into my third Olympic Games and then initially thinking that that was going to be taken away from me.

text: But then it all came back pretty quickly.
english: But then it all came back pretty quickly.

text: And now, I guess I’m in the best position to be here only 48 hours now out from our first game, which is really exciting,” pahayag sini.
english: And now, I guess I’m in the best position to be here only 48 hours now out from our first game, which is really exciting,” he said.

text: “I’m just looking forward to the opportunity of, I think this group is building to something pretty special.
english: “I’m just looking forward to the opportunity of, I think this group is building to something pretty special.

text: We were pretty close in Tokyo.
english: We were pretty close in Tokyo.

text: And I think there’s that burning desire and the drive within the group to continue to push ourselves and win that elusive title,” dugang sang Olympian.#
english: And I think there’s that burning desire and the drive within the group to continue to push ourselves and win that elusive title,” the Olympian added.#

text: Pagasakaan na sang kaso sang Department of Justice (DOJ) si Charlie “Atong” Ang, kag sa 25 pa ka mga indibidwal may kaangtanan sa serye sang missing sabungeros.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) will file charges against Charlie “Atong” Ang, and 25 other individuals in connection with the series of missing sabungeros.

text: Suno sa press statement kahapon nga adlaw nakita sang panel of prosecutors nga may prima facie evidence ukon may nagaka-igo nga pamatuod ukon may “reasonable certainty of conviction” para sa napulo (10) ka counts sang kaso nga Kidnapping with Homicide.
english: According to a press statement yesterday, the panel of prosecutors found that there is prima facie evidence or sufficient evidence or “reasonable certainty of conviction” for ten (10) counts of the case of Kidnapping with Homicide.

text: Lakip sa kabilogan nga mga akusado ang pila ka opisyal sang pulis, mga empleyado sang bulangan, kag mga anay tinawo ni Atong Ang.
english: The total number of defendants includes several police officers, hospital employees, and former employees of Atong Ang.

text:
Dugang pa, may napulo kag anom (16) ka counts sang Kidnapping with Serious Illegal Detention man nga ginpasaka batuk sa pareho nga grupo kun sa diin naglab-ot sa kabug-usan nga 26 tanan ka kaso ang igahatag sa korte para sa hearing,

Samtang ang iban nga kaso batuk sa iban pa nga respondents temporaryo anay nga ginbasura, apang posible liwat pasakaan kon may bag-o liwat nga ebidensya nga maguwa.
english:
In addition, sixteen (16) counts of Kidnapping with Serious Illegal Detention were also filed against the same group, bringing the total to 26 cases that will be submitted to the court for hearing,

Meanwhile, other cases against other respondents were temporarily dismissed, but may be refiled if new evidence comes to light.

text: Sa karon, ginahulat pa ang sabat sang kampo sang mga akusado para sa ila opisyal nga statement parte sa pagkadalahig sa nasambit nga kaso.
english: The response of the defendants' camp is currently awaited for their official statement on involvement in the case.

text: Naplastar na sang bahin sang kapulisan ang security measures nga ipatuman may kaangtanan sa pag-umpisa buwas, Pebrero 8, sang 90-day campaign period para sa national candidates sa 2022 elections.
english: The police have already laid out the security measures to be implemented in connection with the start tomorrow, February 8, of the 90-day campaign period for national candidates in the 2022 elections.

text: Suno kay Police Regional Office (PRO) VI Spokesperson Pol.
english: According to Police Regional Office (PRO) VI Spokesperson Pol.

text: Lt.
english: Lt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Arnel Solis, may assistance nga i-provide ang mga pulis kun may yara sang campaign activity apang dapat nga may distansya lang halin sa mismo area nga may aktibidad agud nga malikawan nga madagtaan sang kolor ukon maangot ang pulis sa isa ka political party.
english: Arnel Solis, the police will provide assistance when there is a campaign activity but there should be a distance from the area where the activity is held to avoid being tarnished or associated with a political party.

text: Pwede nga mapatigayon sang pulis ang advance party ilabi na kun delikado ang lugar nga kadtuan sang mga kandidato, apang sandig sa pagsulundan sang Commission on Elections (Comelec), wala ginapahanugutan ang convoy agud ‘indi mahatagan sang kolor’ ang mga pulis.
english: The police can conduct the advance party especially if the place where the candidates are going is dangerous, but according to the rules of the Commission on Elections (Comelec), the convoy is not allowed so as not to 'give color' to the police.

text: Apang suno kay Solis, kun may approval lang ukon abiso halin sa Comelec, handa gid ang mga pulis nga mag-provide sang dugang nga security para sa mga kandidato kag sa ila nga mga supporters.
english: However, Solis said that if there is approval or notice from the Comelec, the police are ready to provide additional security for the candidates and their supporters.

text: Wala pa sang gina-uyatan nga schedule ang PRO VI kun ano nga political group ukon sin-o man nga kandidato ang may himuon nga aktibidad sa rehiyon subong nga semana.
english: PRO VI does not yet have a schedule of which political group or candidate will hold activities in the region this week.

text: Sandig sa pagsulundan, kinahanglan anay nga mag-secure sang permit halin sa Comelec antes ang pagpatigayon sang political campaign.
english: According to the rules, a permit from the Comelec must be secured before conducting a political campaign.

text: Masobra dos pesos ang mahimo ipatuman nga price hike sang mga kumpaniya sang langis sa masunod nga semana.
english: Oil companies could implement a price hike of more than two pesos next week.

text:
Suno kay Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Director Rodela Romero, base sa apat ka adlaw nga trading, yari ang posible isaka sa presyo:

Gasoline – P2.00 tubtub sa P2.30 per liter

Diesel – P2.35 tubtub sa 2.65 per liter

Kerosene – P2.45 tubtub sa 2.55 per liter

Ginalantaw nga epekto na ini sang nagalala nga krisis sa Middle East kag paglaslas sang Hurricane Milton sa Estados Unidos.
english:
According to Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Director Rodela Romero, based on four days of trading, here are the possible price increases:

Gasoline – P2.00 to P2.30 per liter

Diesel – P2.35 up to 2.65 per liter

Kerosene – P2.45 to 2.55 per liter

This is seen as an effect of the worsening crisis in the Middle East and the onslaught of Hurricane Milton in the United States.

text: Ang kinagamo sa tunga sang Israel kag militante nga grupo sa Lebanon ang mahimo makatuga sang supply disruption, samtang ang Category 5 hurricane naman sa Estados Unidos ang makaapekto sa delivery sang energy services.
english: The conflict between Israel and militant groups in Lebanon could cause supply disruption, while a Category 5 hurricane in the United States could affect the delivery of energy services.

text: Ang mahina nga demand halin sa China ang nakaapekto man sa presyo.
english: Weak demand from China has also affected prices.

text: Ini na ang pang-apat nga sunod-sunod nga semana nga may hike sa presyo sang diesel kag kerosene, kag pangatlo nga sunod-sunod nga semana naman para sa gasolina.
english: This is the fourth consecutive week of hikes in diesel and kerosene prices, and the third consecutive week for gasoline.

text: Gintudlo ni Senate Blue Ribbon Committee Chairman Senator Richard Gordon si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga liable bangud sa pagpahanugot sa iya appointees nga magpalagyo sa ginaalegar ma-anomaliya nga government deals sa pharmaceutical firm nga Pharmally.
english: Senate Blue Ribbon Committee Chairman Senator Richard Gordon pointed to President Rodrigo Duterte as liable for allowing his appointees to escape from allegedly anomalous government deals with pharmaceutical firm Pharmally.

text: Ginhimo ini ni Gordon samtang gina-engganyo ang iya mga kaupdanan sa Senado nga pirmahan ang ila nga committee report.
english: Gordon did this while encouraging his colleagues in the Senate to sign their committee report.

text: Matandaan nga sa draft report nanday Gordon, gin-criticize si Duterte bangud sa pagpahilabot sa imbestigasyon sang committee kag sa kapaslawan sini nga panglagson ang mga persona nga gin-tag sa amo nga anomaliya.
english: In Gordon's draft report, Duterte was criticized for interfering in the committee's investigation and for failing to pursue the persons tagged in the anomaly.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Gordon nga walo na ka mga senador ang nagpirma sa committee report.
english: Gordon also said eight senators have already signed on to the committee report.

text: Magluwas kay Gordon, ang mga senador nga nagpirma amo sanday Senators Manny Pacquiao, Franklin Drilon, Aquilino “Koko” Pimentel III, Risa Hontiveros, Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan, kag Leila de Lima.
english: In addition to Gordon, the senators who signed were Senators Manny Pacquiao, Franklin Drilon, Aquilino “Koko” Pimentel III, Risa Hontiveros, Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan, and Leila de Lima.

text: Kun diri sa Pilipinas, kadam-an sa makit-an sa kada balay amo ang ila mga salakyan ukon motorsiklo nga naka-park.
english: Here in the Philippines, most of the things you see in every house are their cars or motorcycles parked.

text: Apang nakahibalo ka bala nga may yara sang komunidad nga indi salakyan ukon motorisklo ang nakapark sa ila nga garahe kundi mga eroplano?
english: But did you know that there is a community where not cars or motorcycles are parked in their garage but airplanes?

text: Di bala sosyal?
english: The social bullet?

text: Ang ini nga komunidad ang gindesinyo para sa mga tawo nga may yara sang ila kaugalingon nga ‘light airplanes’ .
english: This community is designed for people who have their own ‘light airplanes’ .

text: Sa pagkamatuod may yara sang kapin 650 airparks sa bilog nga kalibutan apang ngaa gamay lang nga mga tawo ang nakahibalo sini?
english: In fact there are more than 650 airparks around the world but why do so few people know about it?

text: Ang pag-istar sa mga fly-in communities ang indi barato.
english: Living in fly-in communities is not cheap.

text: Bangud kun luyag mo magbakal sang balay sa Cameron Airpark Estates sa California — isa sa may pinakamanami nga airparks sa bilog nga kalibutan, ihanda na lang ang imo $1.5 million ukon P72.7 million.
english: Because if you want to buy a house in Cameron Airpark Estates in California — one of the best airparks in the world, just prepare your $1.5 million or P72.7 million.

text: Ang ini nga komunidad ang may yara sang bastante nga espasyo agud nga maka take-off kag maka-landing sang maayo ang eroplano.
english: This community will have enough space to allow the aircraft to take-off and land smoothly.

text: Wala man nagabunggo-anay ang mga eroplano diri kag wala man sang traffic.
english: There are no planes hitting each other here and there is no traffic.

text:
Maga-updanay liwat sanday Kathryn Bernardo kag Alden Richards para sa sequel sang 2019 hit nga “Hello, Love, Goodbye.”

Ini amo ang pelikula nga “Hello, Love, Again” kun sa diin dal-on gihapon nila ang papel nanday Ethan kag Joy kag sa idalom gihapon sang direksyon ni Cathy Garcia-Sampana.
english:
Kathryn Bernardo and Alden Richards will reunite for the sequel to the 2019 hit “Hello, Love, Goodbye.”

This is the film “Hello, Love, Again” where they will still play the roles of Ethan and Joy and still under the direction of Cathy Garcia-Sampana.

text: Ipaguwa ini sa Nobyembre 13 sa Pilipinas kag pagasundan naman sang international releases.
english: It will be released on November 13 in the Philippines and will be followed by international releases.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang “Hello, Love, Goodbye” amo ang highest-grossing Philippine film tubtub sang Enero 2024 sang nalapawan na ini “Rewind” nanday Marian Rivera kag Dingdong Dantes.
english: It is known that “Hello, Love, Goodbye” is the highest-grossing Philippine film until January 2024 when it was surpassed by “Rewind” by Marian Rivera and Dingdong Dantes.

text: Ang istorya sini ang nagalibot nanday Joy kag Ethan nga pareho nga overseas Filipino workers nga naka-base sa Hong Kong.
english: The story revolves around Joy and Ethan who are both overseas Filipino workers based in Hong Kong.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, naka-set ang sequel lima ka tuig matapos nagpaalam si Joy kay Ethan kag sa Hong Kong agud nga lab-uton ang handum sini sa Canada.
english: According to initial information, the sequel is set five years after Joy said goodbye to Ethan and Hong Kong to pursue her dream in Canada.

text: Muling bumagsak ang halaga ng piso laban sa dolyar matapos umabot sa P59.22 kada $1 ngayong Martes, Disyembre 9, 2025.
english: The peso fell again against the dollar after reaching P59.22 per $1 on Tuesday, December 9, 2025.

text: Ito ang pinakamababang antas sa kasaysayan ng bansa, na lumampas sa dating rekord na P59.17 noong Nobyembre 12, 2025.
english: This is the lowest level in the country's history, surpassing the previous record of P59.17 on November 12, 2025.

text: Nagsimula ang taon sa antas na P55 kada $1 ngunit unti-unting humina ang piso dahil sa mataas na inflation at malakas na dolyar.
english: The year started at P55 per $1 but the peso gradually depreciated due to high inflation and a strong dollar.

text: Malaking salik ang patuloy na mataas na interest rates ng US Federal Reserve na nagpalakas sa dolyar at nagdulot ng pressure sa mga emerging markets.
english: The US Federal Reserve's continued high interest rates have strengthened the dollar and put pressure on emerging markets.

text: Ayon sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, patuloy nilang babantayan ang sitwasyon at handang mag-intervene upang mapanatili ang stability ng piso.
english: According to the Central Bank of the Philippines, they will continue to monitor the situation and are ready to intervene to maintain the stability of the peso.

text: Ang pagbagsak ng piso ay nagdudulot ng mas mataas na presyo ng imported goods gaya ng langis at pagkain, na direktang nakakaapekto sa mga mamamayan.
english: The depreciation of the peso is leading to higher prices of imported goods such as oil and food, which directly affects the people.

text: Gin-obserbaran ni Department of the Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla, ang kilos-protesta ukon Trillion Peso March sa bahin sang Mendiola, Manila.
english: Department of the Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla observed the kilos-protesta or Trillion Peso March in Mendiola, Manila.

text: Nakit-an ini nga yara sa likod sang mga kapulisan kag nagalantaw sa ginhiwat nga protesta.
english: He was seen behind the police and watching the protest.

text: Nagpanawagan man ang mga raliyista kay Remulla nga halinon ang mga barikada agud makapalapit ang mga ini sa Malacañang Palace kun sa diin hugot ang pagbantay sang mga kapulisan kag sarado ang mga kalsada nga nagapalibot diri.
english: The rallyists also called on Remulla to remove the barricades so that they can approach the Malacañang Palace where the police are tightly guarding and the roads around it are closed.

text: Suno kay Remulla isa ini ka tikang agud masiguro ang siguridad sang tanan.
english: Remulla said this is a step to ensure the safety of all.

text: Dugang man niya sa mga nagasiling nga overkill security sa Mendiola, mas maayo na nga mas hugot ang ila siguridad kun ikumparar ini sa kulang nga preparasyon.
english: He added that to those who say overkill security in Mendiola, it is better to have tighter security compared to lack of preparation.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nakabaton sila sang impormasyon nga may nagaplano nga mag-ginamo sa kilos-protesta kun sa diin wala man sang may natabo sang natapos na ang aktibidad.
english: He also said that they received information that someone was planning to cause trouble during the protest where nothing happened after the activity.

text: Nagapanglakakaak na sa halos P300 ang presyo sang kada kilo sang luy-a sa pila ka mga mercado sa Pilipinas subong nga tuig, apang ginalauman nga magahagan-hagan ini subong nga bulan bangud sa pagsugod sa pag-abot sang imports.
english: The price of ginger is already hovering at nearly P300 per kilo in some markets in the Philippines this year, but it is expected to ease this month due to the start of imports.

text: Suno kay Agriculture assistant secretary kag spokesman Arnel de Mesa, 4,200 metric tons sa 13,725 MT sang ginger imports ang nakaabot na sa pungsod.
english: According to Agriculture assistant secretary and spokesman Arnel de Mesa, 4,200 metric tons of the 13,725 MT of ginger imports have already arrived in the country.

text: Kadam-an sini suno kay De Mesa ang naghalin pa sa China.
english: Most of them, De Mesa said, came from China.

text: Matandaan nga sang Septyembre 30 sang gin-aprubahan sang Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI) ang importasyon sang 50 MT sang luy-a halin sa Vietnam kag Indonesia agud nga mas madamo pa nga pungsod ang makuhaan sang Pilipinas sang amo nga produkto.
english: It can be recalled that on September 30, the Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI) approved the import of 50 MT of ginger from Vietnam and Indonesia so that the Philippines can get the product from more countries.

text: Pahayag ni De Mesa, indi man gid madamo nga luy-a ang na-import sang Pilipinas sa nagligad nga duha ka tuig.
english: De Mesa said the Philippines has not imported much ginger in the past two years.

text: Nagsaka ang demand subong nga tuig ilabi na sa industrial users partikular sa nagahimo sang herbal tea kaangay sang turmeric tea.
english: Demand has increased this year especially among industrial users particularly those who make herbal tea such as turmeric tea.

text: Naglala pa ang sitwasyon sa pagkapierde sang produksyon bangud sang mga bagyo kag epekto man sang El Niño phenomenon.
english: The situation has worsened with the loss of production due to typhoons and the effects of the El Niño phenomenon.

text: Sa subong lamang nga bulan, 450 MT sang dugang nga imports ang magasulod sa Pilipinas.
english: This month alone, 450 MT of additional imports will enter the Philippines.

text: Dapat man suno sa agriculture official nga mas manubo lamang sa P100 ang kada kilo sang luy-a bangud kun magsobra, makabig na ini nga mahal.
english: The agriculture official said the price of ginger should be less than P100 per kilo because if it exceeds, it is considered expensive.

text: Sa Metro Manila, nagatupa na ini sa P140 tubtub sa P300 per kilo.
english: In Metro Manila, it has dropped to P140 to P300 per kilo.

text: Una naman nga ginplastar ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Earlier, Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: nga napilitan lamang ang gobyerno nga mag-import sang luy-a bangud sa pagsaka sang presyo sini sa domestic market.
english: that the government was forced to import ginger due to the increase in its price in the domestic market.

text: Balantayan na 7:00 karon sa gab-i ang preliminary competition para sa Miss Universe Philippines 2024.
english: Watch the preliminary competition for Miss Universe Philippines 2024 at 7:00 pm tonight.

text: Sa sini nga prelims, iga-rate ang 53 ka mga kandidata sa swimsuit kag evening gown categories.
english: In these prelims, 53 candidates will be rated in swimsuit and evening gown categories.

text: Ang highest scoring delegates ang magasulod sa semi-final round.
english: The highest scoring delegates will advance to the semi-final round.

text: Lakip man sa semifinalists amo ang top winners sang nagkalain-lain nga challenges antes ang final show kaangay sa swimwear, runway, interview, kag casting reel.
english: Also among the semifinalists are the top winners of various challenges before the final show such as swimwear, runway, interview, and casting reel.

text: Mangin host sa preliminary competition ang outgoing titleholder nga si Michelle Marquez Dee kag aktor nga si Marco Gumabao.
english: Outgoing titleholder Michelle Marquez Dee and actor Marco Gumabao will host the preliminary competition.

text: Ang grand coronation night naman ang magasunod na sa Mayo 22 kun sa diin magluwas sa Miss Universe Philippines 2024 crown, may apat ka iban pa nga national crowns nga ihatag sa apat ka iban nga mga kandidata nga amo ang Miss Supranational Philippines, Miss Charm Philippines, Miss Eco International Philippines, kag Miss Cosmo Philippines.
english: The grand coronation night will follow on May 22 where besides the Miss Universe Philippines 2024 crown, there will be four other national crowns to be awarded to four other candidates namely Miss Supranational Philippines, Miss Charm Philippines, Miss Eco International Philippines, and Miss Cosmo Philippines.

text: PARIS – Samtang ginasaulog sang mga organisador kag mga fans ang pagsugod sang una nga “gender-equal Games” sini nga bulan sa Paris, ang mga atleta sa Paralympic nagaatubang sa gihapon sang madamo nga mga pagbalagbag kag issue sa paglab-ot sang handum sang mga babaye.
english: PARIS – As organizers and fans celebrate the start of the first “gender-equal Games” this month in Paris, Paralympic athletes still face many obstacles and issues in achieving the female dream.

text: Suno sa mga eksperto, ang 2024 Olympics magamarka sang isa ka makasaysayan nga hitabo kon magsugod ini sa Hulyo 26, nga may pareho nga kadamuon sang mga lugar nga gin-alokar sa mga babaye kag lalaki nga mga atleta sa labing-una nga tion, pagkatapos sang tinuig nga pagpanikasog sang International Olympic Committee.
english: Experts say the 2024 Olympics will mark a historic milestone when it begins on July 26, with the same number of spots allocated to female and male athletes for the first time, after years of effort by the International Olympic Committee.

text: Ginpahayag man sang retired nga Paralympian nga si Alana Nichols, three time gold medalist sa basketball kag alpine skiing nga sa headline lamang wala na nagalakip sang Paralympic (Community).
english: Retired Paralympian Alana Nichols, three time gold medalist in basketball and alpine skiing, also said that the headline alone does not include Paralympic (Community).

text: Ang International Paralympic Committee (IPC) nagapaabot sang mga 55% tubtob 45% nga pagbinahinbahin sa tunga sang mga lalaki kag babayi nga mga competitors sa Paris.
english: The International Paralympic Committee (IPC) expects about a 55% to 45% split between male and female competitors in Paris.

text: Si Nichols nagpaindis-indis sa iya katapusan nga Hampang sang 2016 kag gindala ang iya trabaho sa adbokasiya sa Women’s Sports Foundation, nga nagserbisyo sa isa ka termino bilang presidente sang non-profit nga organisasyon nga Scout Bassett Grant, kon sa diin, nagahatag sang pinansyal nga suporta para sa mga atleta nga may kasablagan.
english: Nichols competed in her last Games in 2016 and took her advocacy work to the Women’s Sports Foundation, serving a term as president of the non-profit organization Scout Bassett Grant, where, provides financial support for athletes with disabilities.

text: Nagsiling man ini nga indi bastante ang mga kababayin-an kag mga dalagita nga nagasulod sa para-sport pipeline agud iduso ang Paralympics sa isa ka patas nga lebel sang partisipasyon sang gender.
english: It also said that not enough women and girls are entering the para-sport pipeline to push the Paralympics to an equal level of gender participation.

text: Suno kay Nichols, isa ini ka sahi sang proseso sang pagpabakod sang kaugalingon nga nagakatabo sa diin ang mga kababayin-an nga may mga kasablagan, ang may mas manubo nga media coverage kag access.
english: According to Nichols, this is a kind of self-empowerment process that occurs where women with disabilities, have less media coverage and access.

text: Samtang, si Craig Spence, ang chief brand kag communications officer sang International Paralympic Committee, nagpahayag nga may yara sang 1,860 female slots para sa Paris Paralympics, nga para sa iya, isa ka daku nga pag-uswag gikan sa 990 nga matigayon sa 2000 Sydney Games apang indi gihapon patas sa tunga sang mga lalaki kag mga babayi.
english: Meanwhile, Craig Spence, the chief brand and communications officer of the International Paralympic Committee, revealed that there will be 1,860 female slots for the Paris Paralympics, which for him, is a significant improvement from the 990 available at the 2000 Sydney Games but is still not equal between men and women.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang global governing body ang nagtuytoy sang daku nga kantidad padulong sa pagpauswag sang pangkalibutanon nga Paralympic nga hublag halin sang 2016, nga nagabulig sa pagpatas sang patag sang paghampang sa tunga sang mas magagmay nga mga pungsod kag mas naumwad nga National Paralympic Committees.
english: It is known that the global governing body has directed significant sums towards the development of the global Paralympic movement since 2016, helping to level the playing field between smaller countries and more developed National Paralympic Committees.

text: Kaangay ni Nichols, nakita ni Spence ang grassroots investment bilang yabi sa pagkuha sang madamo nga mga kababayin-an sa adaptive sport.
english: Like Nichols, Spence sees grassroots investment as key to getting more women into adaptive sport.

text: ILOILO – Ginakabig sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) nga importante nga lihok ang pagpatigayon sang peace covenant signing.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) considers the peace covenant signing an important step.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay COMELEC Provincial Director Atty. Ian Lee Ananoria, iya ginpahayag nga ang pagtipon sa mga kandidato agud mag-commit nga mangin malinong kag matawhay ang palaabuton nga eleksyon ang pamaagi agud nga indi maglapas sa layi ang mga nagapadalagan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, COMELEC Provincial Director Atty. Ian Lee Ananoria, he said that the gathering of candidates to commit to a peaceful and orderly upcoming election is the way to ensure that the candidates do not violate the law.

text: Suno kay Atty. Ananoria, ang peace covenant signing ang manami nga inisyatibo sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office.
english: According to Atty. Ananoria, the peace covenant signing is a good initiative of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office.

text: Sa mga kandidato nga wala makatambong sa covenant signing, mahimo nga ipadala na lang sa ila ini agud nga mapirmahan.
english: For those candidates who did not attend the covenant signing, it may be sent to them for signing.

text: Tagsa sa aton ang may yara sang dream job.
english: Each of us has a dream job.

text: Apang makabig bala nga dream job ang pagtulog?
english: But can sleep be considered a dream job?

text: Pat-od nga “huo” ang sabat sang iban ilabi na kun mas madamo pa ang oras sini sa trabaho ipaanggid sa pagtulog.
english: Some would answer “yes” especially if they spend more time at work than sleeping.

text: Gani may yara sang isa ka health advice website nga nagatanyag sang $2,000 ukon kapin P100,000 para matuman ang imo nga dream job.
english: So there is a health advice website that offers $2,000 or more than P100,000 to fulfill your dream job.

text: Bayadan ka kabaylo sang imo mahamuok nga tulog sa sulod sang lima ka gab-i sa nagkalain-lain nga mga lugar lakip na sa isa ka five-star hotel.
english: You will be paid in exchange for your comfortable sleep for five nights in a variety of places including a five-star hotel.

text: Ang ini nga website ang nagapangita sang tawo nga makabulig sa ila nga matun-an pa ang mga impluwensya sang palibot sa kalidad sang tulog sang tawo.
english: This website is looking for someone to help them learn more about environmental influences on human sleep quality.

text: Sa kada lugar nga tulugan sang mapili-an nga tawo ang maga-rate sang kada sleeping enviroment halin sa 1 to 10 kag magsulat man kun ano ang iya nangin eksperyensya sa pagtulog sa amo nga lugar.
english: For each sleeping place, the selected person will rate each sleeping environment from 1 to 10 and write about his or her experience sleeping in that place.

text: ‘Di bala indi kana piyerde sina?
english: 'Don't you lose that?

text: Matulog ka lang, may sweldo kapa.
english: You just sleep, you get paid.

text: Nagpangaluyag si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: sa mga negosyante sa Lao PDR agud nga mag-invest man sila sa Pilipinas.
english: to businessmen in Lao PDR so that they can also invest in the Philippines.

text:
Sa ginpatigayon nga ASEAN Business and Investment Summit, gintawag ni Marcos ang Pilipinas nga “ideal hub for smart and sustainable manufacturing.”

Ginpadayaw man sini nga ginaduso sang Pilipinas ang agresibo nga development sa nagkalain-lain nga mga sektor lakip na sa imprastraktura, manufacturing, agrikultura, kag digital connectivity.
english:
At the ASEAN Business and Investment Summit, Marcos called the Philippines an “ideal hub for smart and sustainable manufacturing.”

He also praised the Philippines for pushing aggressive development in various sectors including infrastructure, manufacturing, agriculture, and digital connectivity.

text: Partikular sini nga gintumod nga target sang Pilipinas ang industriya sang green metals, battery manufacturing, energy equipment, data centers, kag agribusiness.
english: He specifically identified the Philippines as targeting the green metals industry, battery manufacturing, energy equipment, data centers, and agribusiness.

text: “So, let me put on my salesman’s hat and invite you to explore the investment opportunities we offer.
english: “So, let me put on my salesman’s hat and invite you to explore the investment opportunities we offer.

text: We are targeting industries like green metals, battery manufacturing, energy equipment, data centers, and agribusiness,” pahayag ni Marcos sa iya keynote speech.
english: We are targeting industries like green metals, battery manufacturing, energy equipment, data centers, and agribusiness,” Marcos said in his keynote speech.

text: Dugang sini, “So, let us be the architects of an interconnected, integrated, and progressive ASEAN.
english: It added, “So, let us be the architects of an interconnected, integrated, and progressive ASEAN.

text:
Let us build bridges that transcend borders, shaping a future where every member of the ASEAN family has a path to success.”

Bisan madamo ang nagasiling nga palpak ang distribusyon sang National ID cards, ginpadayaw man ini ni Marcos sa amo nga ASEAN summit.
english:
Let us build bridges that transcend borders, shaping a future where every member of the ASEAN family has a path to success.”

Although many say the distribution of National ID cards was a failure, Marcos also praised it at the ASEAN summit.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga ang digital ID amo ang nagatugot sa rehistrado nga mga Pilipinas nga mas mahapusan sa access sa financial, social protection, health, education, kag iban pa nga government services.
english: He said the digital ID allows registered Filipinos to more easily access financial, social protection, health, education, and other government services.

text: Ginplastar ini ni Marcos sang gina-istorya sini ang pagkinahanglan sa pag-empower sa 1.5-million workers nga makasulod sa global gig economy kag dapat nga hatagan sila sang nagakaigu nga ikasarang para nga maka-adoptar man sa digital age.
english: Marcos raised this when talking about the need to empower the 1.5-million workers to enter the global gig economy and they should be given the right skills to adopt the digital age.

text: “We are also implementing and distributing now our digital National ID, which allows registered citizens easier access to financial, social protection, health, education,  and other government services,” kabahin pa sang iya nga speech.
english: “We are also implementing and distributing now our digital National ID, which allows registered citizens easier access to financial, social protection, health, education, and other government services,” he said.

text: Ang mga kabataan masami madamo gid sang pamangkot kag kun kaisa, ila pa ini nga gina-testingan agud mahibaluan kun ano ang mangin resulta ukon sabat sa ila palamangkutanon.
english: Children often have many questions and sometimes, they even test them to see what the result or answer to their question will be.

text: Apang kun kaisa, ang resulta ang indi masami nga positibo.
english: But sometimes, the results are not always positive.

text: Kaangay na lang sa isa ka 12 anyos nga bata nga lalaki nga gintulon ang magnet — indi lang isa, duha ukon tatlo kundi 54 gid kabilog agud kuntani iya mahibaluan kun bala magtapik ini sa iya tiyan.
english: It's like a 12-year-old boy who swallowed a magnet — not just one, two or three but 54 pieces to see if it would stick to his stomach.

text: Ginpaidalom sa surgery si Rhiley Morrison sang Manchester matapos nga gintulon sini ang 54 ka mga magnet nga iya ginapahayag bangud sa eksperimento.
english: Manchester's Rhiley Morrison underwent surgery after swallowing 54 magnets which she claims were due to the experiment.

text: Ang bata ang ginapahayag may yara sang ADHD.
english: The child is said to have ADHD.

text: Sa pagdumdom ni Rhiley, madala man lang ang mga magnet kun siya ang mag CR rason nga tayuyon ang iya pagtulon sini apang bangud madugay na kag wala sa gihapon nagguwa ang magnet, gilayon niya ginhambalan ang iya iloy.
english: Rhiley thought that the magnets would be carried away if he went to the bathroom so he kept swallowing them but since it had been a long time and the magnet had not come out, he immediately told his mother.

text: Nangin tuman ka mabudlay para sa iloy nga makita ang iya anak nga nagakasakitan bangud lang sa iya pag-eksperimento.
english: It became extremely difficult for the mother to see her son in pain just because of his experimentation.

text: Nagtinir si Rhiley sa ospital sang 10 ka adlaw, indi makahulag, nagasululuka, kag sa tube na lang ginpaagi ang iya pagkaon.
english: Rhiley spent 10 days in the hospital, unable to move, vomiting, and being fed through a tube.

text: Bangud sa COVID-19 mas nangin mabudlay pa ang sitwasyon sang bata bangud ginadumilian ang bisita sa ospital.
english: Because of COVID-19, the child's situation became even more difficult because visitors to the hospital are prohibited.

text: Gani sa mga ginikanan dira, bantayan gid sang maayo ang mga kabataan kag kun may yara man sila sang pamangkot, indi gid matak-an sa pagsabat sa ila sang insakto.
english: So to the parents there, watch your children carefully and if they have any questions, don't hesitate to answer them correctly.

text: Magluwas nga na-diagnose nga may lima ka autoimmune diseases, ginsapubliko man sang “Queen of All Media” nga si Kris Aquino nga may problema man ini sa iya nga korason.
english: Besides being diagnosed with five autoimmune diseases, “Queen of All Media” Kris Aquino also revealed that she also has heart problems.

text: Gin-share ini sang 53-anyos nga aktres sa iya conversation sa iya suod nga abyan nga si Dindo Balares nga isa man ka entertainment journalist.
english: The 53-year-old actress shared this in her conversation with her close friend Dindo Balares who is also an entertainment journalist.

text: “There’s a problem with my heart, Kuya Dindo — genetics.
english: “There’s a problem with my heart, Kuya Dindo — genetics.

text: Very high cholesterol and triglycerides that at this point can’t be treated because I am underweight (91 lbs),” pahayag ni Kris kay Dindo.
english: Very high cholesterol and triglycerides that at this point can’t be treated because I am underweight (91 lbs),” Kris told Dindo.

text: “My BP (blood pressure) is misbehaving.
english: “My BP (blood pressure) is misbehaving.

text: I am normally 145/122 with a heart rate of 110-130.
english: I am normally 145/122 with a heart rate of 110-130.

text: It’s the diastolic and heart rate that’s scary,” dugang sini.
english: It’s the diastolic and heart rate that’s scary,” it added.

text: Sa positibo nga bahin, gin-share sini nga naga-respond na ang iya nga autoimmune disease sa methotrexate nga amo ang iya chemotherapy.
english: On the positive side, she shared that her autoimmune disease is responding to methotrexate which is her chemotherapy.

text: Nagbalik man pati ang iya nga cravings sa pagkaon.
english: His food cravings also returned.

text: Gindayaw man sini ang air quality sa Newport Coast sa Orange County, California, US kun sa diin siya subong nagatinir.
english: He also praised the air quality in Newport Coast in Orange County, California, US where he now lives.

text: “Can you please thank everyone praying for me?
english: “Can you please thank everyone praying for me?

text: The combination of medicine I’m being given is really effective.
english: The combination of medicine I’m being given is really effective.

text: It’s just that after the Methotrexate and Dupixent, I am super down for four days.
english: It’s just that after the Methotrexate and Dupixent, I am super down for four days.

text: UCLA (University of California, Los Angeles) is very impressive.
english: UCLA (University of California, Los Angeles) is very impressive.

text: We don’t have Dupixent at home,” pahayag pa sang aktres.
english: We don’t have Dupixent at home,” the actress said.

text: “I miss my sisters so much.
english: “I miss my sisters so much.

text: Time for my meds.
english: Time for my meds.

text:
Yes, Kuya Dindo, please thank everyone praying.”

Matandaan nga sang Pebrero, ginbuyagyag ni Kris sa atubang ni Boy Abunda nga may ginabatuan siya nga Churg Strauss, isa ka rare autoimmune disease, kag ginpakigbahin man sini ang iya kahadlok sa heart failure kag cardiac arrest.
english:
Yes, Kuya Dindo, please thank everyone praying.”

In February, Kris revealed to Boy Abunda that she was battling Churg Strauss, a rare autoimmune disease, and he also shared her fear of heart failure and cardiac arrest.

text: “Because of Churg Strauss I now have cardiomyopathy.
english: “Because of Churg Strauss I now have cardiomyopathy.

text:
This means my heart muscles are having trouble pumping blood due to inflammation, and because of that inflammation, it’s exhausting my heart and causing it to begin to fail and ultimately, please pray with me – sana hindi tuluyang sumuko or mag cardiac arrest.”

Ginmensyonar man sini anay nga mangin crucial ang masunod nga binulan para sa iya.
english:
This means my heart muscles are having trouble pumping blood due to inflammation, and because of that inflammation, it’s exhausting my heart and causing it to begin to fail and ultimately, please pray with me – hopefully not completely give up or go into cardiac arrest.”

He also previously mentioned that the next month will be crucial for him.

text: Una na ini naghingyo sang pangamuyo para makaupod pa sini ang iya anak nga si Bimby, 16, kag si Josh, 28, nga nagakinahanglan pa sang pagtatap bangud sa autism.#
english: Earlier, she asked for prayers to be with her sons Bimby, 16, and Josh, 28, who still need care due to autism.

text:
Ginbaton na ni Senator Panfilo ‘Ping’ Lacson ang paathag ni former president Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo nga ginlagas siya kag ginkabig kriminal sa tion sang Arroyo Administration bangud sang impormasyon nga “ulihi lang nahibaluan nga sala.”

Suno kay Lacson, napatawad na niya si Arroyo.
english:
Senator Panfilo 'Ping' Lacson has accepted former president Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo's explanation that she was persecuted and considered a criminal during the Arroyo Administration because of information that was “later discovered to be wrong.”

Lacson said he has forgiven Arroyo.

text: “Late is always better than never.
english: “Late is always better than never.

text: To ex-PGMA’s credit, she has the decency and courage to admit that she publicly and unjustly accused me of various crimes based on false information.
english: To ex-PGMA’s credit, she has the decency and courage to admit that she publicly and unjustly accused me of various crimes based on false information.

text: Whatever, I have already forgiven her a long time ago,” suno kay Lacson.
english: Whatever, I have already forgiven her a long time ago,” according to Lacson.

text: “For nine long years, under her regime, all that I had been hoping and praying for was to get back my dignity and honor,” pahayag pa sang presidential aspirant.
english: “For nine long years, under her regime, all that I had been hoping and praying for was to get back my dignity and honor,” the presidential aspirant said.

text: Una diri, sa iya recently launched memoir nga may titulo “Deus Ex Machina,” gin-ako sang anay presidente nga may nag-feed sa iya sang ‘false information’.
english: Earlier, in his recently launched memoir titled “Deus Ex Machina,” the former president admitted that someone fed him ‘false information’.

text: Ginapahayag nga kahimuan ini ni Antonio Luis Marquez aka Ador Mawanay.
english: It is allegedly the work of Antonio Luis Marquez aka Ador Mawanay.

text: Gin-link si Lacson sang 2001 sa nagkalain-lain nga criminal activities.
english: Lacson was linked in 2001 to various criminal activities.

text: Lakip sa mga akusasyon amo ang pagtago sang ginatos ka milyon nga dolyar sa foreign bank accounts nga gin-alegar ginkuha ni Lacson paagi sa iya involvement sa criminal activities sang siya pa ang nagpamuno sa Philippine National Police (PNP).
english: Among the accusations is the hiding of hundreds of millions of dollars in foreign bank accounts that Lacson allegedly obtained through his involvement in criminal activities when he was the head of the Philippine National Police (PNP).

text: Suno kay Arroyo, ginkabig niya si Lacson nga kaaway sa baylo nga kaalyado bangud sa mga claims nga indi man “substantiated.” ##
english: Arroyo said she considered Lacson an enemy rather than an ally because of claims that were not “substantiated.” ##

text: Nagalaum ang Pilipinas nga magapakita ini sang mabaskog nga performance sa 2025 Southeast Asian Games sa Thailand bangud ipadala sini ang mga dalagkuan nga delegasyon sang atleta sa kasaysayan sang kompetisyon sa Disyembre.
english: The Philippines hopes to show a strong performance at the 2025 Southeast Asian Games in Thailand as it will send the largest athletic delegation in the history of the competition in December.

text: Ginpunto man ni Philippine Sports Commission chairman Patrick “Pato” Gregorio nga halos nag-doble ang mga delegado subong nga edisyon kag ini magahatag sa Pilipinas sang mas maayo nga tsansa para sa mas daku nga exposure sa international stage.
english: Philippine Sports Commission chairman Patrick “Pato” Gregorio also pointed out that the number of delegates has almost doubled this edition and this will give the Philippines a better chance for greater exposure on the international stage.

text: Nagahatag man ini sang oportunidad sa mga Filipino athletes nga maka-atubang sa mas mabaskog nga kompetisyon sa gwa sang pungsod ilabi na sa mga atleta nga nagapaninguha nga makalab-ot sa Asian Games kag Olympics.
english: It also gives Filipino athletes the opportunity to face stronger competition outside the country especially athletes who are trying to reach the Asian Games and Olympics.

text: Ginhatagan man sang Philippine Sports Commission sang slots sa national team ang mga nagdaog sa Palarong Pambansa kag Batang Pinoy para sa masobra 50 ka events sa 2025 SEA Games.
english: The Philippine Sports Commission also gave slots in the national team to the winners of the Palarong Pambansa and Batang Pinoy for more than 50 events in the 2025 SEA Games.

text: Nahibaluan nga natapos sa ikalima nga puwesto sang tuig 2023 edition ang Pilipinas nga ginhiwat sa Cambodia.
english: The Philippines finished fifth in the 2023 edition held in Cambodia.

text: Nagsigabong ang Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting (IRIB) building samtang naga-live broadcast ang isa ka babaye nga presenter.
english: The Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting (IRIB) building caught fire while a female presenter was broadcasting live.

text:
Antes ang pag-atake, ginapakamalaot sang anchor nga si Sahar Emami ang ginahimo sang Israel kag gintawag ini nga “aggression against the homeland.”

Nabatian ang pagsiyagit sa background, naghalin ang presenter sa live broadcast, kag nagdulom ang palibot.
english:
Before the attack, anchor Sahar Emami condemned Israel’s actions and called them “aggression against the homeland.”

Screaming was heard in the background, the presenter left the live broadcast, and the atmosphere went dark.

text: Indi pa klaro kun ano ka daku ang nabilin nga halit sini, apang nag-resume man ang live coverage pagkatapos sang insidente.
english: It is not clear how much damage was left, but live coverage resumed after the incident.

text: Natabo ang atake matapos nag-isyu sang paandam ang Israeli military sa District Three sang Tehran kun sa diin nahamtang ang headquarters sang state broadcaster.
english: The attack came after the Israeli military issued a warning in District Three of Tehran where the headquarters of the state broadcaster is located.

text:
Nagpahayag pa si Defense Minister Israel Katz: “The Iranian propaganda and incitement mouthpiece is on its way to disappear.”

Nagpaguwa naman sang statement si Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei kun sa diin gintawag sini nga “wicked act” kag “war crime” ang ginhino sang Israel.
english:
Defense Minister Israel Katz said: “The Iranian propaganda and incitement mouthpiece is on its way to disappear.”

Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei issued a statement calling Israel's attack a "wicked act" and a "war crime.

text: Nagpanawagan ini sa United Nations Security Council (UNSC) agud nga tapnaon na ang ila gintawag nga “genocidal aggressor” sa paghimo sang dugang nga kalakasan sa mga tawo sa Iran.
english: It called on the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) to stop what it called a “genocidal aggressor” from committing further violence against the people of Iran.

text: Sa statement naman sang Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, ginkondenar sini ang ginhimo sang Israel kag gintawag nga indi makatawo, kriminal, kag isa ka akto sang terorismo.
english: In a statement, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps condemned Israel's actions and called them inhuman, criminal, and an act of terrorism.

text: Ini na ang pang-apat nga adlaw sang masingki nga bayluhanay sang atake sa tunga sang Israel kag Iran.
english: This is the fourth day of a violent exchange of attacks between Israel and Iran.

text: Nagnubo sa 4% ang unemployment rate sang Agosto.
english: The unemployment rate fell to 4% in August.

text: Suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority, mas manubo ini sa 4.7% nga narekord sang Hulyo kag sa 4.4% nga narekord sang Agosto sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority, this is lower than the 4.7% recorded in July and the 4.4% recorded in August last year.

text: Sa resulta nga ini, nagwa nga  2.07 million nga Pilipino ang wala sang trabaho sang Agosto nga mas manubo sa 2.22 million sang 2023.
english: This result shows that 2.07 million Filipinos were unemployed in August, down from 2.22 million in 2023.

text: Nagwa man nga ang mga subsector nga may pinakataas nga narekord nga numero sang trabaho amo ang wholesale and retail trade, public administration and defense, kag education.
english: It also emerged that the subsectors with the highest recorded employment numbers were wholesale and retail trade, public administration and defence, and education.

text: Ang mga subsector sang agriculture and forestry, fishing and aquaculture kag financial and insurance activities naman ang nakarekord sang pinakadako nga pagnubo.
english: The subsectors of agriculture and forestry, fishing and aquaculture and financial and insurance activities recorded the largest declines.

text: Magapartisipar sa hublag Protesta ang 86 ka mga diocese kag archdiocese sa Pilipinas agud mas ipabati sa gobyerno ang tingog sang mga pumuluyo nga kontra sa korapsyon.
english: Eighty-six dioceses and archdioceses in the Philippines will participate in the protest movement to make the voice of the people against corruption heard in the government.

text: Lakip diri ang Archdiocese of Jaro.
english: This includes the Archdiocese of Jaro.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Msgr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Center, iya gin-imbitar ang mga Ilonggo para sa pagahiwatun nga rally bwas nga adlaw nga ginapangunahan sang grupo nga Kahublagan Kontra Korapsyon.
english: Meliton Oso, director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Center, he invited Ilonggos for the rally to be held tomorrow led by the group Kahublagan Kontra Korapsyon.

text: Suno man sa iya, importante ang amo nga aktibidad agud mabuksan ang pinsar sang mga Pilipino sa korapsyon kag sa maanomaliya nga proyekto sang gobyerno.
english: He said the activity is important to open the minds of Filipinos to corruption and anomalous government projects.

text: Isa man ini ka panibag-o nga klase sang protesta bangud bangud magahiwat sang hublag-protesta halin sa prelature sang Batanes tubtub sa Jolo.
english: This is also a new kind of protest because there will be a protest rally from the prelature of Batanes to Jolo.

text: Maragtason man ini nga hitabo, bangud kun ikumparar ini sa EDSA People Power Revolution, ginpahayag ni Oso nga nakasentro lang ang anay nga protesta sa bahin sang Manila, apang sa subong, mas masangkad ang sakop sini kag bilog nga pungsod ang nagapakig-away batok sa korapsyon.
english: This is also a historic event, because compared to the EDSA People Power Revolution, Oso said that the protest was centered in Manila, but now, its scope is wider and the whole country is fighting against corruption.

text: Matingob-pwersa ang mga personnel halin sa Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Region 6 kag City Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) agud mangkakas sang campaign posters sang mga pulitiko nga ginpangtapik sa mga kahoy.
english: Personnel from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Region 6 and City Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) will join forces to remove campaign posters of politicians affixed to trees.

text: Suno kay CENRO head Engineer Noel Hechanova, umpisahan ini sa masunod nga semana.
english: According to CENRO head Engineer Noel Hechanova, it will start next week.

text: May ipadala nga mga tinawo halin sa DENR kay may mga tinawo man halin sa CENRO.
english: There will be personnel from the DENR because there are also personnel from CENRO.

text: Gin-athag ni Hechanova nga limitado lang ang ila himuon sa mga tarpaulins kag posters nga yara sa kahoy.
english: Hechanova explained that they will only do limited work on the tarpaulins and posters on the trees.

text: Ang iban nga posters nga nagalapta sa palibot sang syudad ang yara na sa hurisdiksyon sang Anti-Squatting and Illegal Structures Unit (ASIS-U).
english: Some of the posters scattered around the city are now under the jurisdiction of the Anti-Squatting and Illegal Structures Unit (ASIS-U).

text: Indi makabig nga common poster area ang mga kahoy.
