english: Trees are not considered a common poster area.

text: Lakip ini sa nakasaad sa Section 3 sang Presidential Decree (PD) 953, kun sa diin nakasaad man nga ang magalapas sa pagsulundan ang pagamultahan sang pagkapreso sa sulod sang anum ka bulan tubtub sa duha ka tuig, kag may multa nga P500 tubtub P5,000 ukon pagka-preso gid kag multa — depende sa discretion sang korte.
english: This is in accordance with Section 3 of Presidential Decree (PD) 953, which also states that violators will be fined imprisonment for six months to two years, and a fine of P500 to P5,000 or imprisonment and fine — depending on the discretion of the court.

text: Ang campaign period ang magaumpisa sa Pebrero 8 para sa mga national candidates.
english: The campaign period will begin on February 8 for national candidates.

text: Marso 25 naman maga-umpisa ang kampanya para sa local candidates.
english: The campaign for local candidates will begin on March 25.

text: Sa bahin sang Commission on Elections (Comelec), bangud wala pa naga-umpisa ang official campaign period, wala pa ini sang poder nga maka-impose sang mga pagsulundan para sa campaign posters, streamers kag tarpaulins.
english: On the part of the Commission on Elections (Comelec), since the official campaign period has not yet begun, it does not have the power to impose rules for campaign posters, streamers and tarpaulins.

text: Kun makaumpisa na ang campaign period, pangkakason na sang Comelec ang posters, streamers kag tarpaulins nga ginapangplastar sa guwa sang designated campaign poster areas.
english: Once the campaign period begins, the Comelec will remove the posters, streamers and tarpaulins placed outside the designated campaign poster areas.

text: Sa paglibot sang Bombo News Team, kalabanan nga mga posters nga ginpangtapik sa mga kahoy ang yara sa distrito sang Mandurriao.
english: During the Bombo News Team's tour, most of the posters affixed to the trees were in the Mandurriao district.

text:
COMMON POSTER AREAS

Sa notice nga gin-isyu sang Office of the Election Officer – Iloilo City, yari ang common poster areas sa syudad:

* SA CITY PROPER – Plaza Libertad facing JM Basa Street

* SA AREVALO – Plaza Villa facing Iloilo Supermart, Arevalo District Health Center kag Arevalo Police Station sa Rizal Street

* SA JARO – Plaza Jaro facing Ledi Supermarket padulong sa Land Bank Jaro

* SA LAPAZ – Plaza Lapaz facing Huervana Street kag Lapaz Police Station

* SA LAPUZ – Facing Barrio Obrero Catholic Church

* SA MANDURRIAO – Plaza Mandurriao facing Mandurriao Police Station sa R. Mapa Street

* SA MOLO – Plaza Molo facing Molo Caltex Station kag Molo Mansion sa Locsin Street
english:
COMMON POSTER AREAS

In a notice issued by the Office of the Election Officer – Iloilo City, here are the common poster areas in the city:

* IN CITY PROPER – Plaza Libertad facing JM Basa Street

* IN AREVALO – Plaza Villa facing Iloilo Supermart, Arevalo District Health Center and Arevalo Police Station on Rizal Street

* IN JARO – Plaza Jaro facing Ledi Supermarket towards Land Bank Jaro

* IN LAPAZ – Plaza Lapaz facing Huervana Street and Lapaz Police Station

* SA LAPUZ – Facing Barrio Obrero Catholic Church

* IN MANDURRIAO – Plaza Mandurriao facing Mandurriao Police Station on R. Mapa Street

* IN MOLO – Plaza Molo facing Molo Caltex Station and Molo Mansion on Locsin Street

text: Nagresulta sa tiniruhay sang duha ka pamilya ang ginhimo nga pagtabanay sang duha ka magkahagugma sa Mamasapano, Maguindanao del Sur.
english: The fight between two lovers in Mamasapano, Maguindanao del Sur resulted in a fight between two families.

text: Suno kay Philippine Army 6th Infantry Division spokesperson LtCol Roden Orbon, may natabo nga bayluhanay sang lupok sa tunga sang grupo ni Sukor Guiamalon, opisyal sang 106th Base Command sang MILF-Bangsamoro Islamic Armed Forces, kag sang grupo ni Barangay Sapakan Chairman Mohamad Tatak.
english: According to Philippine Army 6th Infantry Division spokesperson LtCol Roden Orbon, there was an exchange of fire between the group of Sukor Guiamalon, officer of the 106th Base Command of the MILF-Bangsamoro Islamic Armed Forces, and the group of Barangay Sapakan Chairman Mohamad Tatak.

text: Ginpahayag nga madugay na nga may hiligut-anon ang duha ka pamilya kag naglala pa matapos ang pagtabanay sang anak ni Guiamalon kag utsd ni Chairman Tatak.
english: It was reported that the two families had a long-standing quarrel and it got worse after Guiamalon's son and Chairman Tatak's utsd fought.

text: Naglawig naman ang tiruhay sang halos duha ka oras ka nauntat lang sang nag-abot ang militar.
english: The fighting lasted for nearly two hours and was interrupted when the military arrived.

text: Wala pa sang report kun may napilasan ukon napatay sa amo nga inaway.
english: There were no reports of casualties or casualties in the fighting.

text: Kun ano kainit sa Pilipinas, amo man kainit ang pagbaton sang Filipino fans sa pagbalik sang Irish singer-songwriter nga si Niall Horan.
english: As hot as it was in the Philippines, Filipino fans welcomed the return of Irish singer-songwriter Niall Horan.

text: Kadungan ini sang Philippine leg sang iya “The Show: Live on Tour at the Mall of Asia Arena, Pasay City” nga para sa iya ikatatlo na nga studio album nga “The Show” nga may lead singles nga “Heaven” kag “Meltdown” nga live sini nga gin-perform.
english: This coincides with the Philippine leg of his “The Show: Live on Tour at the Mall of Asia Arena, Pasay City” which is for his third studio album “The Show” with lead singles “Heaven” and “Meltdown” which he performed live.

text:
Lakip sa gin-perform sini amo ang “Nice to Meet Ya” kag “Small Talk” nga ginsundan ang “On the Loose” kag “On a Night Like Tonight” kag gintapos ang show paagi sa ‘Save my Life” lag “Slow Hands.”

Nangin mas matunog pa ang gahod sang fans sang ginkanta na sini ang “Night Changes” sang One Direction.
english:
Among its performances were “Nice to Meet Ya” and “Small Talk” followed by “On the Loose” and “On a Night Like Tonight” and ending the show with ‘Save my Life” lag “Slow Hands.”

The fans became even louder when he sang One Direction's “Night Changes”.

text: Ini man ang ikatatlo nga tion nga nakabalik siya sa Pilipinas — una sang kabahin pa siya sang One Direction sang 2015 kag ang ikaduha amo ang iya uno nga solo concert nga Flicker Tour sang 2018.
english: This is also the third time he has returned to the Philippines — first when he was part of One Direction in 2015 and the second was his first solo concert Flicker Tour in 2018.

text: Napilian ang four-time NBA champion kag all-time NBA leading scorer nga si LeBron James bilang male flag bearer sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa opening ceremony sa Paris Olympics subong nga semana.
english: Four-time NBA champion and all-time NBA leading scorer LeBron James has been chosen as the male flag bearer of the United States of America at the opening ceremony at the Paris Olympics this week.

text: Ang iya partisipasyon sa Summer Games subong nga tuig amo ang naga-marka sang iya ikaapat na nga pagtapak sa Olympiada kun sa diin nakadaog na siya sang duha ka gold medals.
english: His participation in this year's Summer Games marks his fourth appearance in the Olympics where he has won two gold medals.

text: Sa statement naman sang 39-anyos nga basketball superstar, ginsiling sini nga isa ka daku nga dungog nga itiglawas ang Estados Unidos sa global stage ilabi na sa entablado kun sa diin naga-isa ang bilog nga kalibutan.
english: In a statement, the 39-year-old basketball superstar said it is a great honor to represent the United States on the global stage especially on a stage where the whole world is united.

text:
“For a kid from Akron, this responsibility means everything to not only myself, but to my family, all the kids in my hometown, my teammates, fellow Olympians, and so many people across the country with big aspirations.”

“Sports have the power to bring us all together and I’m proud to be a part of this important moment,” pahayag sini.
english:
“For a kid from Akron, this responsibility means everything to not only myself, but to my family, all the kids in my hometown, my teammates, fellow Olympians, and so many people across the country with big aspirations.”

“Sports has the power to bring us all together and I’m proud to be a part of this important moment,” he said.

text: Ginabantayan pa kun sin-o ang mangin female counterpart ni James.
english: James' female counterpart is still being determined.

text: Mangin maragtason man ang opening ceremony sang Summer Games subong nga tuig bangud sa baylo nga stadium, matabo ang parada sa bantog nga River Seine sa atubang sang ginabanta 300,000 ka spectators.
english: The opening ceremony of this year's Summer Games will also be historic because instead of a stadium, the parade will take place on the famous River Seine in front of an estimated 300,000 spectators.

text: Ginalauman nga halos 600 ka mga atleta ang ipadala sang US sa Paris Games kun sa diin 53% diri ang mga babaye.
english: The US is expected to send nearly 600 athletes to the Paris Games, 53% of whom are women.

text: Gin-insister ni Presidential aspirant kag former Senator Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Presidential aspirant and former Senator Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. insisted that

text: nga nakakuha siya sang degree halin sa University of Oxford.
english: that he had obtained a degree from the University of Oxford.

text: Baliskad ini sa mga alegasyon nga ginahaboy sang iya nga mga kritiko nga special diploma lang ang iya nga nakuha halin sa amo nga unibersidad.
english: This is contrary to the allegations thrown by his critics that he only received a special diploma from the university.

text: Sa isa ka radio interview subong nga Sabado, ginpahayag ni Marcos, “Well, naipakita ko na ang diploma ko.
english: In a radio interview this Saturday, Marcos said, “Well, I have already shown my diploma.

text: It is a degree course.
english: It is a degree course.

text:
So yeah, naggraduate ako sa Oxford.”

Kun balik-balikan ang statement sang kampo ni Marcos sang Oktubre 2021, ginpahayag ni chief of staff kag spokesperson Atty. Victor Rodriguez nga ginatindugan sang ila nga kampo nga may Degree confirmation nga nakuha si Marcos halin sa University of Oxford.
english:
So yeah, I graduated from Oxford.”

Going back to the statement of the Marcos camp in October 2021, chief of staff and spokesperson Atty. Victor Rodriguez that their camp stands with a degree confirmation that Marcos obtained from the University of Oxford.

text: Sang amo man nga bulan, nagpa-guwa sang statement ang Oxford Philippines Society, grupo sang Filipino students kag alumni sang Oxford, nga wala sang degree si Marcos halin sa amo nga university.
english: That same month, the Oxford Philippines Society, a group of Filipino students and alumni of Oxford, issued a statement saying Marcos did not have a degree from the university.

text: Ginapahayag nahatagan lang si Marcos sang Special Diploma in Social Studies sang 1978.
english: Marcos was reportedly awarded a Special Diploma in Social Studies in 1978.

text: Ang Special Diploma indi degree suno sa grupo kag indi man “comparable, superior, ukon equivalent” sa degree.
english: The Special Diploma is not a degree according to the group nor is it “comparable, superior, or equivalent” to the degree.

text: Ginbasura sang regional prosecutor ang reklamo nga ginpasaka batok sa isa ka police major nga naangot sa hinali nga pagkadula sang teacher kag beauty queen nga si Catherine Camilon.
english: The regional prosecutor has dismissed a complaint filed against a police major in connection with the sudden disappearance of teacher and beauty queen Catherine Camilon.

text: Ginpahayag nga gin-dismiss sang piskalya ang panumbungon bangud kulang ang ebidensya.
english: The prosecution reportedly dismissed the charges due to insufficient evidence.

text: Matandaan nga complaints nga kidnapping kag serious illegal detention ang ginpasaka batok kanday Police Major Allan de Castro kag iya driver-bodyguard nga si Jeffrey Magpantay.
english: It can be recalled that complaints of kidnapping and serious illegal detention were filed against Police Major Allan de Castro and his driver-bodyguard Jeffrey Magpantay.

text: Nahibaluan nga base sa imbestigasyon, nagaguwa nga si De Castro ang ulihi nga kaupod ni Camilon antes siya na-report nga missing sang Oktubre 2023 sa Batangas.
english: Based on the investigation, it appears that De Castro was the last companion of Camilon before he was reported missing in October 2023 in Batangas.

text: Nagaguwa man nga may relasyon sila nga duha, kag nagapakigbulag na si Camilon.
english: It also turns out that the two of them are having an affair, and Camilon is breaking up.

text: Ginpanginwala naman ni De Castro nga nobya sini ang beauty queen samtang todo-panginwala man si Magpantay nga may kaangtanan siya sa pagka-missing sang biktima.
english: De Castro denied that the beauty queen was his girlfriend while Magpantay denied any involvement in the victim's disappearance.

text: Matandaan nga naimbitar anay si De Castro sa hearing sang Senate committee on public order and dangerous drugs kag na-cite in contempt pa bangud sa ginapahayag pagbinutig sa atubang sang mga senador kaangot sa iya relasyon sa beauty queen.
english: De Castro was previously invited to a hearing of the Senate committee on public order and dangerous drugs and was cited in contempt for allegedly lying in front of senators about his relationship with the beauty queen.

text: Duha ka adlaw ang nagligad, ginhilway man ini ni Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa bangud bakasyon sang Senado sa sulod sang isa ka bulan.
english: Two days later, Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa also released him because the Senate is on vacation for a month.

text: Makatawo man ini nga rason suno kay dela Rosa kag nagahibi na ang pulis suno sa iya sa pagpaathag nga wala sila sang relasyon sang biktima.
english: Dela Rosa said this is a humane reason and the policeman is crying when he explains that they have no relationship with the victim.

text: Matandaan nga base sa CCTV footage nga na-capture sang Oktubre 12, nakit-an ang salakyan ni Camilon nga naglabay sa pila ka banwa sa Batangas kag ginadudahan nga wala ini nagaisahanon.
english: It can be recalled that based on CCTV footage captured on October 12, Camilon's vehicle was seen passing through several towns in Batangas and it is suspected that he was not alone.

text: May mga testigo nga nagpalapit sa otoridad kag nagpanugid nga nakit-an nila ang lawas ni Camilon nga duguon kag ginasaylo halin sa iya salakyan pakadto sa lain nga salakyan sang Oktubre 12.
english: Witnesses approached authorities and said they saw Camilon's body bleeding and being moved from his vehicle to another vehicle on October 12.

text: Ginsiling man sang mga testigo nga nakit-an nila si Jeffrey Magpantay sa area.
english: Witnesses also said they saw Jeffrey Magpantay in the area.

text: Ini nga salakyan ang na-recover sang pulis kag may nakit-an nga mga buhok kag dugo nga nag-santo naman sa DNA profile sang mga ginikanan sang beauty queen.
english: The vehicle was recovered by the police and found hair and blood that matched the DNA profile of the beauty queen's parents.

text: Wala sang kumpirmasyon halin sa otoridad kun buhi ukon patay na ang biktima bangud wala pa nakit-an ang lawas sini.
english: There is no confirmation from the authorities whether the victim is alive or dead because his body has not been found.

text: Matandaan man nga ang involved nga police major ang napahalin na sa serbisyo sang Enero 2024 suno sa Philippine National Police-Calabarzon office bangud sa conduct unbecoming of a police officer.#
english: It can also be recalled that the involved police major was dismissed from service in January 2024 according to the Philippine National Police-Calabarzon office due to conduct unbecoming of a police officer.

text: Padayon ang hugot nga kampanya sang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office ukon ( ICTTMO) batok sa mga E-bike, E-trike kag Colorum nga mga transport vehicle sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office (ICTTMO) continues its strong campaign against E-bikes, E-trikes and Colorum transport vehicles in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: PCol.
english: PCol.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO) kag amo man sang ICTTMO, iya ginpahayag nga hugot na nila nga ginapatuman ang traffic regulation plan sa siyudad, amo man ang pagpadayon sang pagpanakop sa mga E-bike, E-trike ilabi na sa mga dalanun nga gina dumilian ang pagbyahe sang sahi nga mga transport vehicle.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO) and ICTTMO, said they are strictly implementing the traffic regulation plan in the city, as well as continuing to seize E-bikes, E-trikes especially on roads where vehicles are prohibited from traveling.

text: Dugang pa sini nga nagatuga sang uhol sa mga dalanun sa siyudad ang sahi nga mga transport vehicle kag kun ila madakpan ang mga ini nga nagabyahe sa mga mayor nga dalanun, pagadakpon ini gilayun sang ila mga traffic personnel.
english: He added that these types of transport vehicles are causing traffic jams on the city's roads and if they catch them traveling on the main roads, they will be arrested immediately by their traffic personnel.

text: Ini kasunod sa mandu sang Land Transportation Office ( LTO) nga sugod Desyembre 1, pagadakpon na kag iga-impound ang sahi nga transport vehicle nga makit-an nga nagabyahe sa mga national road sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: This is in line with the Land Transportation Office (LTO)'s directive that starting December 1, any transport vehicle found traveling on national roads nationwide will be arrested and impounded.

text: Ini nga kasuguan ang sa idalum sang R.A 4136 ukon Land Transportation and Traffic Code, nga nagatugda sang vehicle registration, traffic rules, kag road safety sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: This law is under R.A 4136 or the Land Transportation and Traffic Code, which establishes vehicle registration, traffic rules, and road safety nationwide.

text: Kun sadto lunsay mga gamit lang ang gina-arkilahan apang sa subong mangin ang tawo ang gina-arkilahan naman.
english: In the past, only equipment was rented, but now even people are rented.

text: Wala ka bala sang nobya ukon nobyo?
english: Don’t you have a girlfriend or boyfriend?

text: Luyag mo bala ma-eksperyensyahan nga mag-date?
english: Do you want to experience dating?

text: Indi magkabalaka bangud may yara sang isa ka kompaniya sa Taiwan nga mahimo ka makaarkila sang imo mangin girlfriend ukon boyfriend sa sulod sang tatlo ka oras.
english: Don’t worry because there is a company in Taiwan where you can rent your future girlfriend or boyfriend for three hours.

text: Bangud sini, isa ka lalaki nga amo si Chen ang nagbayad sang 7,200 Taiwanese dollars ukon P12,345 agud lang nga makaangkon ini sang nobya apisar sa malip-ot lang nga tion.
english: As a result, a man named Chen paid 7,200 Taiwanese dollars or P12,345 just to get a girlfriend even for a short time.

text: Ang serbisyo ang limitado lamang sa diin mahimo sang kliyente nga ma-uyatan ang kamot sang iya gin-arkilahan nga nobya, mahimo man sini mahikap ang buhok kag makup-an apang indi sini mahimo nga halukan ang babaye ukon uyatan ang iya pribado nga lawas.
english: The service is limited to the fact that the client can hold the hand of his rented girlfriend, he can also touch her hair and hug her but he cannot kiss the woman or touch her private body.

text: Nagkitaay si Chen kag ang iya nobya sa Taipei Main Station para saila tatlo ka oras nga date.
english: Chen and his girlfriend met at Taipei Main Station for their three-hour date.

text: Nangin matawhay man ang unanga oras sang ila pag-updanaytubtob nga nagdesisyon si Chen nga maglakat-lakat sa park.
english: The first hour of their time together was also peaceful until Chen decided to go for a walk in the park.

text: Ginkakibot na lang sang babaye ang mga ginabuy-an nga tinaga ni Chen sa iya tubtob nga gin-uyatan na sang lalaki ang iya nga paa.
english: The woman was surprised by Chen's words until the man grabbed her leg.

text: Bangud sa kakulba kag wala man ini sang madalagan nga tawo agud magpangayo sang bulig, wala sang choice ang babaye kag ginpabay-an lang sini ang mga ginahimo sa iya ni Chen.
english: Because of her panic and no one to run to for help, the woman had no choice but to let Chen do it to her.

text: Apang pagkatapos sang tatlo ka oras, ginrespeto man ni Chen ang kontrata kag ginpalakat na ang babaye.
english: But after three hours, Chen respected the contract and sent the woman away.

text: Sa pagdumdom ni Chen, wala sang nangin problema sa babaye apang nagpadulong sa police station ang amo nga babaye kag gin-report ang ginhimo ni Chen sa iya.
english: According to Chen, there was no problem with the woman but she went to the police station and reported what Chen had done to her.

text: Gilayon nga gindakop si Chen kag nagpangayo man ini sang pasaylo sa gin-arkilahan niya nga nobya.
english: Chen was immediately arrested and also apologized to his rented girlfriend.

text: Magluwas sa pagka-preso, ginapabaydan man ini sang multa nga nagabalor 180,000 Taiwanese dollars ukon P308,488.
english: In addition to imprisonment, he was also fined 180,000 Taiwanese dollars or P308,488.

text: Nagpaguwa na ang Court of Appeals (CA) sang freeze order sa bank accounts, properties, kag air assets sang mga kontraktor kag duha ka mga kongresista nga naangot sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: The Court of Appeals (CA) has issued a freeze order on the bank accounts, properties, and air assets of contractors and two congressmen linked to anomalous flood control projects.

text: Suno kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., sakop sang order ang accounts kag assets sang Silverwolves Construction Corporation kag Sky Yard Aviation Corporation.
english: According to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., the order covers the accounts and assets of Silverwolves Construction Corporation and Sky Yard Aviation Corporation.

text: Sakop man sini suno sa iya ang personal nga mga account kag asset sang mga indibidwal nga gina-imbestigaran subong lakip sanday Benguet Representative Eric Yap kag iya utod nga si ACT-CIS party-list Rep.
english: He said it also covers the personal accounts and assets of individuals currently under investigation including Benguet Representative Eric Yap and his brother ACT-CIS party-list Rep.

text: Edvic Yap.
english: Edwig Yap.

text: “Kailangan natin ang mga freeze order na ito para hindi maibenta ang mga ari arian at para maibalik natin sa ating mga kababayan ang bawat pisong pinaghihinalaang ninakaw,” suno kay Marcos sa iya video report nga ginpaguwa kaina sang aga.
english: “We need these freeze orders to prevent the sale of assets and to return to our fellow citizens every penny suspected of being stolen,” Marcos said in his video report released yesterday morning.

text: Pahayag sang punong ehekutibo, masobra sa P16-billion ang balor sang mga transaksyon nga nagsulod sa account sang Silverwolves halin sang 2022 tubtub 2025.
english: The chief executive said more than P16-billion worth of transactions entered the Silverwolves' account from 2022 to 2025.

text: Kalabanan sini suno sa iya ang naangot sa flood control projects sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: Most of these, he said, are related to flood control projects of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: Kabug-usan nga 280 bank accounts ang na-freeze suno kay Marcos amo man ang 22 insurance policies, tatlo ka securities accounts, kag walo ka air assets sang kumpaniya lakip na ang eroplano kag helicopter nga na-link sa Sky Yard Aviation.
english: A total of 280 bank accounts were frozen, Marcos said, as were 22 insurance policies, three securities accounts, and eight air assets of the company including an aircraft and helicopter linked to Sky Yard Aviation.

text: “Para sa mga Pilipinong paulit-ulit binabaha, nawawalan ng bahay at kabuhayan, hindi na maaaring nakawin ang pondong para sa inyo at basta na lamang tumakas sa hustisya,” pahayag pa sang presidente.
english: “For the Filipinos who are repeatedly flooded, losing their homes and livelihoods, it is impossible to win the funds for you and just run away from justice,” the president said.

text: Matandaan nga una na gintawag ni Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla si Eric Yap nga “person of interest” kaangot sa nabayaran na apang wala pa natapos nga flood control projects sa La Union paagi sa firm nga ginapanag-iyahan sini sadto.
english: It can be recalled that Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla earlier called Eric Yap a “person of interest” in connection with the paid but unfinished flood control projects in La Union through the firm he used to own.

text: Ginsiling man ni Remulla nga nagbaton sanday Edvic Yap kag Bulacan Rep.
english: Remulla also said that Edvic Yap and Bulacan Rep.

text: Salvador Pleyto sang kuwarta paagi sa bank transfers halin sa bilyonaryo nga mga kontraktor nga sanday Curlee kag Sarah Discaya.
english: Salvador Pleyto of money through bank transfers from billionaire contractors Curlee and Sarah Discaya.

text: Si Eric Yap amo ang House appropriations panel chairperson sang administrasyon ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Eric Yap is the House appropriations panel chairperson of the administration of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Nemensyonar ang pangalan sini sa Senate hearing sang Septyembre, apang una na ini nagpanginwala nga may kahilabtanan siya sa eskandalo sa kurapsyon.
english: He was named in a Senate hearing in September, but had previously denied any involvement in the corruption scandal.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam si President Marcos nga padayon ang pagpasaka sang kaso kag madamo ang mahimo nga mapreso antes ang Paskuwa.#
english: Earlier, President Marcos warned that cases will continue to be filed and many could be jailed before Easter.

text: Nakasulod na si Carlos Yulo kag ang iban pa nga Filipino gymnasts sa Olympic Village sa France antes ang opisyal nga pagbukas sang Paris Summer Games sa Sabado, Hulyo 27 (oras sa Pilipinas).
english: Carlos Yulo and other Filipino gymnasts have entered the Olympic Village in France ahead of the official opening of the Paris Summer Games on Saturday, July 27 (Philippine time).

text: Kaupod sang 24-anyos nga Pinoy gymnast kag two-time Olympian amo sanday Aleah Finnegan kag Emma Malabuyo.
english: Along with the 24-year-old Filipino gymnast and two-time Olympian are Aleah Finnegan and Emma Malabuyo.

text: Ini nga 54-hectare Olympic Village ang nahamtang malapit sa Seine River, naga-feature sang 3,200-seat dining hall, may 24-hour gym,may 3,500-square-meter polyclinic, kag may gamay nga supermarket.
english: This 54-hectare Olympic Village is located near the Seine River, features a 3,200-seat dining hall, has a 24-hour gym,has a 3,500-square-meter polyclinic, and has a small supermarket.

text: Nahibaluan nga 10,500 ka mga atleta ang magapasakop sa Summer Games kag magluwas sa sini nga village, may yara man sang tiniran nga satellite villages sa Chateauroux (shooting), Lille (basketball preliminaries and handball), Marseille (sailing) kag Tahiti (surfing).
english: It is known that 10,500 athletes will participate in the Summer Games and besides this village, there are also satellite villages in Chateauroux (shooting), Lille (basketball preliminaries and handball), Marseille (sailing) and Tahiti (surfing).

text: Si Yulo, kaupod ang boksidor nga si Eumir Felix Marcial kag rower nga si Joanie Delgaco amo ang una sa delegado sang Pilipinas nga una nga magasabak sa kumpetisyon sa Olympiada subong nga tuig.
english: Yulo, along with boxer Eumir Felix Marcial and rower Joanie Delgaco, are the first of the Philippine delegates to compete in this year's Olympiad.

text: 22 tanan ang tiglawas sang Pilipinas sa sini nga edition sang Olympics kun sa diin tuyo nga malapawan ang nalab-ot sang nagligad nga 2020 Olympics sa Tokyo — isa ka gold medal, duha ka silver, kag isa ka bronze.
english: 22 total representatives of the Philippines in this edition of the Olympics where the aim is to surpass the achievement of the last 2020 Olympics in Tokyo — one gold medal, two silver, and one bronze.

text: Posible nga magguwa na subong nga semana ang arrest warrant batok sa kontrobersyal nga bilyonaryo nga kontraktor nga si Sarah Discaya.
english: An arrest warrant against controversial billionaire contractor Sarah Discaya is likely to be issued this week.

text: “Inaasahan din natin na lalabas ang warrant of arrest ni Sarah Discaya nitong linggong ito, at hindi na rin magtatagal ang pag-aresto sa kaniya,” suno kay President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: “We also expect the warrant of arrest of Sarah Discaya to be issued this week, and her arrest will not take long,” said President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: sa iya nga video report subong nga aga, Disyembre 9.
english: in his video report this morning, December 9.

text:
Dugang sini, “magpapatuloy ang imbestigasyon, magpapatuloy ang pagpapanagot, at titiyakin ng pamahalaan na ang pera ng bayan ay maibabalik sa taumbayan.”

Matandaan nga sang Byernes, nagpasaka na ang Ombudsman sang kaso nga graft kag malversation batok kay Discaya kag walo ka mga opisyal sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) bangud sang P96.5-million flood control project sa Davao Occidental nga nabayaran na apang wala man gintukod.
english:
He added that “the investigation will continue, accountability will continue, and the government will ensure that the people's money will be returned to the people.”

On Friday, the Ombudsman filed a case of graft and malversation against Discaya and eight officials of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) over the P96.5-million flood control project in Davao Occidental that was paid for but not built.

text: Suno kay Assistant Ombudsman Mico Clavano, gin-file ang kaso sa Regional Trial Court sang Digos City, nga isa sa special courts nga gin-designar sang Supreme Court nga magpatigayon sang trial kaangot sa infrastructure corruption-related cases.
english: Assistant Ombudsman Mico Clavano said the case was filed in the Regional Trial Court of Digos City, which is one of the special courts designated by the Supreme Court to conduct trials related to infrastructure corruption-related cases.

text: Pareho sang kaso nga ginpasaka batok sa resigned lawmaker nga si Zaldy Co, nagrekomendar man ang Ombudsman nga wala sang pyansa para sa malversation case ni Discaya.
english: Like the case filed against resigned lawmaker Zaldy Co, the Ombudsman also recommended no bail for Discaya's malversation case.

text: Ang bana naman ni Sarah nga si Pacifico “Curlee” Discaya II ang nagapabilin sa Senate detention matapos ini gin-cite in contempt bangud sang pagbinutig kag paghatag sang indi consistent nga mga pahayag sa mga hearing kaagot sa flood control scandal.
english: Sarah's husband, Pacifico “Curlee” Discaya II, remains in Senate detention after he was cited in contempt for lying and making inconsistent statements in hearings related to the flood control scandal.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag si Marcos nga nagmandu na ini sa Department of the Interior and Local Government kag sa Philippine National Police (PNP) nga i-monitor si Discaya agud nga madakpan gilayon pananglitan magguwa na ang arrest warrant.
english: Earlier, Marcos said he has ordered the Department of the Interior and Local Government and the Philippine National Police (PNP) to monitor Discaya so that he can be arrested immediately in case of an arrest warrant.

text: Ginlapta naman sang PNP ang ila nga intelligence units kag tracker teams agud nga mahibaluan kun sa diin ang babaye nga Discaya kag ang iban pa nga na-implicate sa alleged ghost flood control project.#
english: The PNP has deployed its intelligence units and tracker teams to find out where the woman Discaya and others implicated in the alleged ghost flood control project are.

text: Nagapaayo na sa ila balay ang aktres nga si Julia Barreto matapos nagtinir sang pila ka adlaw sa ospital.
english: Actress Julia Barreto is recovering at home after spending several days in the hospital.

text: Wala sini gindetalye kun ano ang rason sang pagka-confine sini apang ginlaragway niya ini nga “mabudlay” kag nagpahanumdom pa sa publiko nga dapat unahon gid sa prayoridad ang ikaayong lawas.
english: He did not elaborate on the reason for his confinement but described it as “difficult” and reminded the public that health should be a priority.

text: “A tough time but taking this one as a reminder that our health should always be top priority.
english: “It’s a tough time but taking this one as a reminder that our health should always be top priority.

text: Sending good energy!,” kabahin sang caption sa Instagram.
english: Sending good energy!,” was part of the caption on Instagram.

text: Sa black-and-white picture sini nga gin-share, may yara pa sang oxygen tube sa iya nga ilong.
english: In the black-and-white picture he shared, he still has an oxygen tube in his nose.

text: Sa isa ka picture, nagahigda na ini apang wala na sang nasal tube.
english: In one picture, he is lying down but no longer has a nasal tube.

text: “Discharged and finally home.
english: “Discharged and finally home.

text: Thanks so much to my doctors, nurses and the entire medical staff for taking such good care of me the past couple of days.
english: Thanks so much to my doctors, nurses and the entire medical staff for taking such good care of me the past couple of days.

text: Thank you for the long hours of hard work,” pahayag ni Julia.
english: Thank you for the long hours of hard work,” Julia said.

text: Sang nagligad nga sinemana, matandaan nga nakit-an pa si Julia sa interviews samtang nga gina-promote sini ang bag-o nga pelikula kaupod ang iya ex-boyfriend nga si Joshua Garcia.#
english: Last week, Julia was seen in interviews while promoting her new film with her ex-boyfriend Joshua Garcia.

text: Kasunod sang mga aktibidad sang Leni-Kiko tandem sa Iloilo, ang grupo naman nga nagasuporta nanday presidential aspirant Ferdinand ‘Bong-bong’ Marcos, Jr.
english: Following the activities of the Leni-Kiko tandem in Iloilo, the group that supports presidential aspirant Ferdinand 'Bong-bong' Marcos, Jr.

text: kag vice-presidential aspirant Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio ang magapadulong sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: and vice-presidential aspirant Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio will visit the city and province of Iloilo.

text: Naka-schedule ang sympathy caravan sa Disyembre 11.
english: The sympathy caravan is scheduled for December 11.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Passi City Vice Mayor Jesry Palmares, Iloilo provincial chairman sang Lakas-CMD, iya ginpahayag nga magahalin ang caravan sa Iloilo kag makapadulong pa pati sa syudad sang Passi.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Passi City Vice Mayor Jesry Palmares, Iloilo provincial chairman of Lakas-CMD, said the caravan will leave Iloilo and can also reach Passi City.

text: Suno kay Palmares, ginahulat pa subong nga ipahibalo sa local leaders ang mangin plano sang partido sa national nga lebel.
english: Palmares said they are still waiting to inform local leaders of the party's plan at the national level.

text: Ang Lakas-CMD amo ang isa sa mga partido nga nalakip sa UniTeam Alliance, alyansa sang apat ka mga partido nga nagasuporta sa tandem nanday Marcos kag Inday Sara sa 2022 elections.
english: Lakas-CMD is among the parties included in the UniTeam Alliance, alliance of four parties supporting the tandem of Marcos and Inday Sara in the 2022 elections.

text: Indi pa sigurado suno kay Palmares kun makasunod sanday Marcos kag Duterte-Carpio sa amo nga adlaw, apang ang maathag, magaabot ang duha antes patigayunon ang Dinagyang Festival sa Enero 2022.
english: Palmares said it is not yet clear whether Marcos and Duterte-Carpio will be able to attend on that day, but what is clear is that the two will arrive before the Dinagyang Festival in January 2022.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Iloilo City Mayor Mayor Jerry Treñas nga welcome sa syudad sang Iloilo ang tanan nga political parties kag ang ila nga mga aktibidad may kaangtanan sa eleksyon sa Mayo 2022.
english: Earlier, Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas said that all political parties and their activities related to the May 2022 elections are welcome in Iloilo City.

text: Doble ang selebrasyon sang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala bangud indi lamang isa kundi duha gid ang korona nga iya nakuha sa pagpasakop sini sa International Tennis Federation (ITF) W100 Vitoria-Gasteiz sa Espanya.
english: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala is celebrating twice as she won not only one but two crowns in her participation in the International Tennis Federation (ITF) W100 Vitoria-Gasteiz in Spain.

text: Nabulsa sang 19-anyos nga tennis sensation ang women’s singles title sa amo nga tournament wala gani 24 oras matapos man ini nagpangibabaw sa women’s doubles championship.
english: The 19-year-old tennis sensation won the women's singles title in the tournament less than 24 hours after she also dominated the women's doubles championship.

text: Nakuha sini ang titulo sa singles — ikalima na sa iya karera — matapos ginlutos ang Andorran standout nga si Victoria Jimenez Kasintseva sa women’s finals, 6-4, 6-4.
english: She won the singles title — the fifth of her career — after defeating Andorran standout Victoria Jimenez Kasintseva in the women’s finals, 6-4, 6-4.

text: Antes nakaabot sa final match, ginpierde man sang Pinay si Yulia Starodubtsewa sang Ukraine sa quarterfinals, 7-6, 6-4, kag si Maria Jose Portillo Ramirez sang Mexico sa semifinals, 6-2, 6-1.
english: Before reaching the final match, the Filipina also defeated Yulia Starodubtsewa of Ukraine in the quarterfinals, 7-6, 6-4, and Maria Jose Portillo Ramirez of Mexico in the semifinals, 6-2, 6-1.

text: Ang doubles title naman — ikatatlo sa iya karera — ang nakuha ni Eala kaupod ang French partner sini nga si Estelle Cascino matapos gin-domina sanday Diana Marcinkevica sang Latvia kag Lia Karatantcheva sang Bulgaria sa Women’s Finals sang ila division, 6-3, 2-6, 10-4.
english: The doubles title — the third of her career — was won by Eala with her French partner Estelle Cascino after dominating Diana Marcinkevica of Latvia and Lia Karatantcheva of Bulgaria in the Women's Finals of their division, 6-3, 2-6, 10-4.

text: Antes ini nga doubles crown, nakadaog man si Eala sang doubles title sa Pune, India kaupod si Darja Semenistaja kag sa Croissy-Beaubourg, France kaupod man si Cascino.
english: Before this doubles crown, Eala also won the doubles title in Pune, India with Darja Semenistaja and in Croissy-Beaubourg, France with Cascino.

text: Samtang malipayon nga ginselebrar sang iban nga mga iloy ang Mother’s Day, ginkumpirma naman sang actress kag fashion icon nga si Heart Evangelista nga nahulugan ini sa ikaapat na nga tion.
english: While other mothers celebrated Mother's Day happily, actress and fashion icon Heart Evangelista confirmed that she fell for the fourth time.

text:
Ginpaagi ini ni Heart sa iya ka sulat para sa iya kuntani anak nga lalaki nga si “FrancisKo.”

Base sa sulat, preparado na kuntani ang aktres nga makit-an ang iya bata apang nag-untat sa pagpitik ang korason sini samtang nga yara pa lamang ini sa taguangkan ni Heart.
english:
Heart sent this in a letter to her would-be son, “FrancisKo.”

According to the letter, the actress was ready to see her child but her heart stopped beating while she was still in Heart's womb.

text: “I was sure to meet you soon.
english: “I was sure to meet you soon.

text: I had prepared a few things that you may like but for some reason your beating heart lost its way to us,” kabahin sang handwritten letter.
english: I had prepared a few things that you may like but for some reason your beating heart lost its way to us,” the handwritten letter said.

text: Apisar nasubuan gid sa sini nga sitwasyon, ginpasalamatan man ni Heart ang ila kuntani “fourth angel” bangud sa pagpalangga kag paglaun sini nga nahatag apisar nga wala pa ini nakaguwa sa kalibutan.
english: Although very sad about this situation, Heart also thanked their would-be “fourth angel” for the love and care he gave her even though he has not yet left the world.

text: “I will keep my heart intact while you find your way back to us.
english: “I will keep my heart intact while you find your way back to us.

text: Your beating heart has healed me in so many ways…Thank you for still trying to be with me and for making me feel so much love already,” pahayag pa sini.
english: Your beating heart has healed me in so many ways…Thank you for still trying to be with me and for making me feel so much love already,” he said.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga tion subong lamang nga 2024 nga nagsapubliko ang fashion personality nga nahulugan ini.
english: This is the second time since 2024 that the fashion personality has publicly fallen.

text: Sang Marso, matandaan nga ginkumpirma man sini nga may baby girl kuntani sila ni Senator Chiz Escudero nga ginpangalanan sini nga si Sophia Heart apang nadula man sa ila antes ang ila pag-renew sang ila wedding vows sa Balesin.
english: In March, he also confirmed that he and Senator Chiz Escudero were supposed to have a baby girl named Sophia Heart but she disappeared before they renewed their wedding vows in Balesin.

text: 2015 sang nagpakasal ang senador kag ang aktres.
english: 2015 when the senator and the actress got married.

text: 2018 sang gin-anunsyo ang iya pagbusong sa ila una kuntani nga anak kag sang ulihi ginkumpirma nga kapid gali apang magkasunod man nga nadula sa ila.
english: 2018 when she announced her pregnancy with their first child and later confirmed that they were actually twins but they disappeared one after another.

text: Nalakip ang Archdiocese of Jaro sa masobra 80 ka mga archdiocese kag diocese sa bilog nga Pilipinas nga magasuporta kag maga-upod buwas, Nobyembre 30, sa Trillion Peso March bilang panawagan sa pagtapna sa kurapsyon.
english: The Archdiocese of Jaro is among more than 80 archdioceses and dioceses across the Philippines that will support and join tomorrow, November 30, in the Trillion Peso March as a call to fight corruption.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Msgr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, ang director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC), iya ginpahayag nga tuman ini ka maragtason nga hitabo bangud ini ang una nga tion nga maga-isa ang 86 ka mga simbahan agud mag-upod sa isa lang ka panawagan nga manabat ang tanan nga involved sa pagpangawat sa kaban sang gobyerno.
english: Meliton Oso, director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC), said this is a historic event because it is the first time that 86 churches will unite to join in a single call to hold accountable all those involved in stealing from the government coffers.

text: Ini nga numero ang nakumpirma man sa latest social media post sang Caritas Philippines, isa ka non-profit organization kag social arm sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP).
english: This figure was also confirmed in the latest social media post by Caritas Philippines, a non-profit organization and social arm of the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP).

text: Tumalagsahon ini nga sahi sang hublag-protesta suno kay Oso bangud may rally halin sa prelature sang Batanes pakadto sa Jolo.
english: Oso said this is a unique protest because there is a rally from the prelature of Batanes to Jolo.

text: Mangin sa EDSA People Power Revolution suno sa iya, nakasentro lang anay ang daku nga hublag sa Manila, samtang naka-monitor lang ang iban.
english: Even in the EDSA People Power Revolution, he said, the big movement was centered in Manila, while others were monitoring.

text: “Ini sila maga-isa kag maga-unite sa isa lang ka panawagan: ‘lahat ng sangkot, dapat managot’,” suno kay Oso.
english: “They will unite and unite in one call: 'all involved, must be held accountable',” Oso said.

text: “Ang last report nga nabaton ko, tanan nga diocese halin sa prelatura sang Batanes pakadto sa prelatura sang Jolo, may paghublag.
english: “The last report I received, all the dioceses from the prelature of Batanes to the prelature of Jolo, there is a movement.

text:
Isa lang ang panawagan: ‘Lahat ng sangkot, dapat managot.’ Kag dapat nga ibalik ang kwarta nga kinawatan.”

Sa Archdiocese of Jaro, nagpaguwa sang circular letter si Jaro Archbishop Most Reverend Midyphil B. Billones, D.D. nga nagapanawagan sa mga tumuluo nga mag-upod sa patigayunon nga “Kahublagan Kontra Korapsyon” ukon KKK.
english:
There is only one call: 'All involved, must be held accountable.' And the money stolen must be returned.”

In the Archdiocese of Jaro, Jaro Archbishop Most Reverend Midyphil B. Billones, D.D. calling on believers to join the upcoming “Struggle Against Corruption” or KKK.

text: Sa iya sulat, gin-engganyo ni Archbishop Billiones ang mga parokya, religious communities, mga propesyunal, business groups, kabataan, kag civic organizations nga mag-isa para sa pagpanawagan sa pagtapna sa kurapsyon.
english: In his letter, Archbishop Billiones encouraged parishes, religious communities, professionals, business groups, children, and civic organizations to unite for the call to fight corruption.

text: Ginpanawagan sini ang pagpasakop sa mga aktibidad kaangay sang candle-lighting events kag pagtipon para sa pagpangamuyo.
english: He called for participation in activities such as candle-lighting events and gatherings for prayer.

text: Mahimo man mag-upod sa streaming kag photo campaigns nga may mga mensahe kontra sa kurapsyon kag magbutang sang puti nga ribbon sa guwa sang mga eskwelahan kag pampubliko nga lugar.
english: You can also join streaming and photo campaigns with anti-corruption messages and put up white ribbons outside schools and public places.

text: Ginbutang man ang pagbagting sang lingganay sang simbahan; pagpatigayon sang mga diskusyon sa mga buluthuan, parokya, kag mga komunidad; kag pagpatigayon sang sectoral mobilization para sa kamatuoran kag hustisya.
english: The church bell was also installed; facilitating discussions in schools, parishes, and communities; and facilitating sectoral mobilization for truth and justice.

text: Madumduman nga sang una nga hugnat sang anti-corruption protest sang Septyembre 21, lakip sanday Oso kag Billones sa nagmartsa kag nag-upod sa protesta.
english: It can be recalled that during the first phase of the anti-corruption protest on September 21, Oso and Billones were among those who marched and joined the protest.

text: Buwas, maga-umpisa ang martsa sang mga protesters sa University of the Philippines-Iloilo City kag sa atubang sang Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral, kag magatipon sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol Grounds umpisa alas tres sang hapon.
english: Tomorrow, the protesters will start their march at the University of the Philippines-Iloilo City and in front of the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral, and will gather at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol Grounds starting at 3 pm.

text: Magalawig ang programa tubtub alas sais sa gab-i.#
english: The program will last until 6 pm.

text: Nagbalik na sa Pilipinas ang korona sa William Jones Cup matapos ang lima ka tuig!
english: The William Jones Cup crown is back in the Philippines after five years!

text: Natabo ini sang ginlutos sang Strong Group-Pilipinas ang host team nga Chinese Taipei-Blue sa overtime, 83-79, sa championship match subong nga gab-i sa Xinzhuang Gymnasium sa New Taipei City, Taiwan.
english: This happened when Strong Group-Philippines defeated host team Chinese Taipei-Blue in overtime, 83-79, in the championship match tonight at Xinzhuang Gymnasium in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

text: Nagpanguna sa team ang American import nga si Tajuan Agee samtang daku man ang kontribusyon sang locals nga sanday Kiefer Ravena kag RJ Abarrientos para makuha sang pungsod ang ika-pito na sini nga Jones Cup title kag nagpabilin nga undefeated sa walo ka hampang sa 2024 edition sang sini nga tournament.
english: American import Tajuan Agee led the team while locals Kiefer Ravena and RJ Abarrientos also contributed to the country's seventh Jones Cup title and remained undefeated in eight games in the 2024 edition of the tournament.

text: Sa final game, nagtapos si Agee nga may 21 puntos, may 14 si Abarrientos samtang 9 naman ang kay Ravena.
english: In the final game, Agee finished with 21 points, Abarrientos had 14 while Ravena had nine.

text: Ang pag-kampyon sang Pilipinas amo man ang naghatag sa Chinese Taipei-Blue sang una sini nga kalutusan subong nga tournament (7-1).
english: The Philippines' championship also handed Chinese Taipei-Blue its first defeat of the tournament (7-1).

text: Antes ini nga kampyonato, nadag-an man sang Pilipinas ini nga mid-year tournament sang 1982 (Northern Cement), 1985 (San Miguel), 1998 (Centennial Team), 2012 (Gilas), kag 2016 kag 2019 (Mighty Sports).
english: Prior to this championship, the Philippines also won this mid-year tournament in 1982 (Northern Cement), 1985 (San Miguel), 1998 (Centennial Team), 2012 (Gilas), and 2016 and 2019 (Mighty Sports).

text: Nagpaguwa sang hugot nga paandam si US President Donald Trump sa Iran, nga nagadeklarar nga kun atakehon ang Estados Unidos, ma-eksperyensyahan sini ang “bug-os nga pwersa” sang Amerikano nga militar sang pungsod.
english: US President Donald Trump has issued a strong warning to Iran, declaring that if the United States is attacked, it will experience the "full force" of the country's American military.

text: Sa isa ka post sa Truth Social, ginpanginwala ni Trump nga nadalahig ang U.S. sang mga airstrikes sang Israel sa Iran.
english: In a post on Truth Social, Trump denied that the U.S. was involved in Israeli airstrikes on Iran.

text: Gin-ako ni Trump nga ang U.S. nagbulig sa Israel batok sa mga missile, apang wala nagpasilabot sa direkta nga pag-atake sa Iran.
english: Trump acknowledged that the U.S. helped Israel against the missiles, but did not intervene in a direct attack on Iran.

text: Ginpabugal pa ni Trump nga sila, upod sa Israel, mahimo gilayon nga tapuson ang inaway kon luyag nila.
english: Trump even boasted that they, along with Israel, could immediately end the war if they wanted to.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi nagpahayag nga may yara sila sang ebidensya nga nagapakita sang ginaalegar nga suporta gikan sa Estados Unidos para sa mga pag-atake nga ginhimo sang Israel.
english: On the other hand, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that they have evidence showing alleged support from the United States for the attacks carried out by Israel.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag man ni Trump sa isa ka pag-istoryahanay kay Russian President Vladimir Putin nga dapat magbinuligay ang mga pungsod agud tapuson ang inaway sa tunga sang Israel kag Iran.
english: Meanwhile, Trump also said in a conversation with Russian President Vladimir Putin that countries should work together to end the war between Israel and Iran.

text: Apang madumduman nga ang mga opisyales sang Russia nagpabutyag sang ila padayon nga suporta para sa negosasyon sa programa nukleyar sang Iran.
english: But it can be recalled that Russian officials have expressed their continued support for negotiations on Iran’s nuclear program.

text: Ang Alemanya, upod ang Pransia kag Britanya, nagpabutyag man sang ila kahanda sa paghambal sa Iran nahanungod sa ila nukleyar nga programa agud malikawan ang paglala sang sitwasyon sa Natung-an nga Sidlangan.
english: Germany, along with France and Britain, has also expressed its willingness to talk to Iran about its nuclear program to avoid an escalation of the situation in the Middle East.

text: Mangatubang si presidential aspirant former senator Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Presidential aspirant former senator Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: sang isa pa gid ka disqualification case sa 2022 national elections.
english: of yet another disqualification case in the 2022 national elections.

text: Subong nga adlaw, Disyembre 2, natalana nga mag-file ang Akbayan Party-list sang isa ka petition batok kay Marcos.
english: Today, December 2, the Akbayan Party-list is scheduled to file a petition against Marcos.

text: Sandig sa advisory sang grupo, ang disqualification case nga i-file sa Commission on Elections (Comelec) ang maga-assert nga indi pwede makapadalagan si Marcos para sa public office bilang resulta sang iya 1995 tax evasion conviction.
english: According to the group's advisory, the disqualification case to be filed with the Commission on Elections (Comelec) will assert that Marcos cannot run for public office as a result of his 1995 tax evasion conviction.

text: Lakip sa signatories sa petition amo sanday Akbayan First Nominee Perci Cendaña, former Commission on Human Rights Chairperson Etta Rosales, lawyer Byron Bocar sang Institute for Political and Electoral Reforms, Akbayan Youth Chairperson Dr. RJ Naguit, Tition Lao-Manalo kag Doris Nuval sang Claimants 1081, Jean Enriquez sang Coalition Against Trafficking in Women (CATW-Asia Pacific) kag Nice Coronacion sang Sentro ng mga Nagkakaisa at Progresibong Manggagawa (SENTRO).
english: Among the signatories to the petition are Akbayan First Nominee Perci Cendaña, former Commission on Human Rights Chairperson Etta Rosales, lawyer Byron Bocar of the Institute for Political and Electoral Reforms, Akbayan Youth Chairperson Dr. RJ Naguit, Tition Lao-Manalo and Doris Nuval of Claimants 1081, Jean Enriquez of the Coalition Against Trafficking in Women (CATW-Asia Pacific) and Nice Coronacion of the Center for Progressive Workers (CENTER).

text: May patigayunon man nga protest action kadungan sang iga-file nga petition suno sa Akbayan.
english: There will also be a protest action along with the petition to be filed, according to Akbayan.

text: Antes sini, may apat na nga daan ka disqualification cases nga gin-file sa Comelec agud balabagan ang presidential ambition ni Marcos.
english: Earlier, there were already four disqualification cases filed with the Comelec to block Marcos' presidential ambition.

text: Rodriguez, Rizal – Trahedya ang sinapit ng isang 34-anyos na guro matapos umano siyang saksakin hanggang sa mapatay ng kanyang sariling asawa dahil sa pinaniniwalaang post sa Facebook.
english: Rodriguez, Rizal – Tragedy struck a 34-year-old teacher after he was allegedly stabbed to death by his own wife because of a believed post on Facebook.

text: Kinilala ang biktima sa alyas na “Ann”, habang ang suspek ay ang kanyang mister na si alyas “Herson”, 37 taong gulang at isang barbero.
english: The victim was identified as “Ann”, while the suspect was her husband, alias “Herson”, 37 years old and a barber.

text: Ayon sa paunang imbestigasyon, naganap ang insidente sa Brgy.
english: According to preliminary investigation, the incident occurred in Brgy.

text: Mascap sa bayan ng Rodriguez, Rizal.
english: Mascap in the town of Rodriguez, Rizal.

text: Nagsimula umano ang pagtatalo ng mag-asawa habang sila’y nagkakape, nang magkaroon sila ng mainit na diskusyon ukol sa isang hindi pinangalanang post sa Facebook.
english: The couple allegedly started fighting while they were having coffee, when they had a heated argument over an unnamed post on Facebook.

text: Sa tindi ng galit ni Herson, ibinuhos nito ang kape sa kanyang asawa at agad na sinaksak nang ilang ulit.
english: In a fit of rage, Herson poured coffee on his wife and immediately stabbed her several times.

text: Nagtamo ng malubhang sugat ang biktima at agad na binawian ng buhay sa mismong loob ng kanilang tahanan.
english: The victim sustained serious injuries and died immediately inside their home.

text: Matapos ang krimen, tumakas si Herson ngunit kalaunan ay sumuko sa mga awtoridad sa tulong ng isa niyang kamag-anak.
english: After the crime, Herson fled the scene but later surrendered to authorities with the help of a relative.

text: Patuloy ang imbestigasyon ng pulisya upang malaman ang buong motibo ng krimen, habang inihahanda na rin ang kaukulang kaso laban sa suspek.
english: Police are conducting an investigation to determine the motive of the crime, while preparing a case against the suspect.

text: Nakuha sang isa ka Special Needs Education graduate kag tiglawas sang Matanao, Davao del Sur ang korona bilang Miss Philippines Earth 2024!
english: A Special Needs Education graduate and representative of Matanao, Davao del Sur has won the crown as Miss Philippines Earth 2024!

text: Sa coronation night sa Talakag, Bukidnon, nagpangibabaw si Irha Mel Alfeche sa 28 ka iban pa nga mga kandidata kag amo ang nagbulos sa titulo ni Yllana Marie Aduana nga amo naman ang nagauyat sang titulo nga Miss Earth Air 2023 sa latest international edition sang pageant.
english: At the coronation night in Talakag, Bukidnon, Irha Mel Alfeche topped 28 other contestants and replaced Yllana Marie Aduana who holds the title of Miss Earth Air 2023 in the latest international edition of the pageant.

text: Ginhingadlan naman sanday Feliz Clareianne Thea Solomon Recentes sang Sindangan, Zamboanga del Norte bilang Miss Philippines Air 2024, Samantha Dana Bug-os sang Baco, Oriental Mindoro bilang Miss Philippines Water 2024, kag Kia Labiano sang Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay bilang Miss Philippines Fire 2024.
english: Feliz Clareianne Thea Solomon Recentes of Sindangan, Zamboanga del Norte was named Miss Philippines Air 2024, Samantha Dana Bug-os of Baco, Oriental Mindoro as Miss Philippines Water 2024, and Kia Labiano of Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay as Miss Fire Philippines 2024.

text: Nagkadto naman kay Ira Patricia Malaluan sang Batangas City ang titulo nga Miss Philippines Eco Tourism 2024.
english: Ira Patricia Malaluan of Batangas City went to the title of Miss Philippines Eco Tourism 2024.

text: Ang Philippines Earth isa ka tuigan nga beauty pageant nga nagatib-ong sang environmental awareness kag protection sa pungsod.
english: Philippines Earth is an annual beauty pageant that raises environmental awareness and protection in the country.

text: Ang winner diri amo ang magatiglawas sa Pilipinas sa global edition sang Miss Earth nga isa sa ginakabig nga big four beauty pageants.#
english: The winner will represent the Philippines in the global edition of Miss Earth, one of the big four beauty pageants.

text: May kakilala ka bala nga nanamian gid nga magtinir sa ospital adlaw man ukon gab-i?
english: Do you know someone who loves to stay in the hospital day or night?

text: Wala gid, indi bala?
english: Nothing, right?

text: Kadam-an sang aton kakilala ang indi gid makahulat nga ma-discharge sa ospital.
english: Most of our acquaintances simply cannot wait to be discharged from the hospital.

text: Apang indi amo sina pirme ang sitwasyon.
english: But that is not always the case.

text: Didto sa Beijing, China, isa ka lalaki kag pamilya niya ang nakabiya gid man sa ospital sang damlag lang matapos ang 6 ka tuig nga pagtinir sa sulod sang amo nga medical institution.
english: In Beijing, China, a man and his family were recently discharged from the hospital after six years inside the medical institution.

text: Natingala kamo kun paano ina natabo?
english: You wonder how that happened?

text: Sang 2014, gin-admit ang isa ka lalaki sa amo nga ospital bangud sa duha ka bulan na niya nga pagsuka kag pagkudog sang iya nga tiil sa masobra na sa isa ka semana.
english: In 2014, a man was admitted to the hospital after two months of vomiting and shaking of his leg for more than a week.

text: Samtang nagapaidalom sa treatment, gin-updan sang iya mga ginikanan ang amo nga lalaki.
english: While undergoing treatment, the man was accompanied by his parents.

text: Sang nag-ayo na ang pasyente, nahibaluan nila nga daku ang ila nga medical bill ukon balayran bangud sang ila nga pagtinir sa ospital gani ang iya nga ginhimo….
english: When the patient recovered, they learned that they had a large medical bill because of their stay in the hospital.

text: gin-akusaran niya ang ospital sang indi husto ukon inappropriate treatment sa iya.
english: he accused the hospital of improper or inappropriate treatment of him.

text: Nagpabilin sila sa amo nga kwarto sa ospital kag ginpangdala didto ang ila mga kalaha, bayo, kag iban pa nga kagamitan.
english: They stayed in that hospital room and brought their pans, clothes, and other belongings there.

text: Pila ka beses sila nga gintuyo pahalinon, ginpasakaan sang kaso, kag ginpabayad sang ila nga medical costs apang nagabato man ang lalaki kag naga-countersue sa hospital kag nagaalegar sang medical negligence.
english: They were tried several times to be evicted, filed a case, and paid for their medical costs but the man resisted and countersued the hospital and alleged medical negligence.

text: Sang damlag lang, nagdagdag na sang desisyon ang Beijing Xicheng District People’s Court nga dapat na maghalin sa hospital ward ang magpamilya apang entitled sila sa kompensasyon nga halin sa hospital management.
english: Recently, the Beijing Xicheng District People's Court added a ruling that the family must leave the hospital ward but they are entitled to compensation from the hospital management.

text: Ang natabo?
english: What happened?

text: Syempre, ginbaton sang pamilya ang 480,000 yuan nga compensation halin sa ospital kag gindul-ong pa sila sang ambulansya papauli sa ila matuod nga balay.
english: Of course, the family accepted the 480,000 yuan compensation from the hospital and was even taken by ambulance back to their real home.

text: Sin-o na lang ang mangin presidential bet sang administrasyon para sa 2022 elections?
english: Who will be the administration’s presidential bet for the 2022 elections?

text: Wala pa nasabat ini nga pamangkot kasunod sang pag-withdraw ni Sen.
english: This question remains unanswered following the withdrawal of Sen.

text: Bong Go sang iya kandidatura sa pagka-presidente.
english: Bong Go of his candidacy for president.

text: Si Go, close-aide sang presidente, amo gid ang una nga gin-endorso sang administrasyon.
english: Go, close-aide to the president, was actually the first to be endorsed by the administration.

text: Sa subong, ginahulat kun ano nga pangalan ang imitlang ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga iya suportahan sa eleksyon.
english: Currently, it is waiting to see what name President Rodrigo Duterte will mention that he will support in the election.

text: Indi basta-basta ang mangin endorsement sang presidente bangud sang iya “enduring popularity” sa iya mga die-hard fans ukon supporters.
english: The president's endorsement is not easy because of his “enduring popularity” among his die-hard fans or supporters.

text: Si Manila Mayor Isko Moreno ayhan?
english: Is it Manila Mayor Isko Moreno?

text: “Kung ako ang mapupusuan nila, uy salamat, thank you in advance.
english: “If they like me, thank you, thank you in advance.

text: Pero ayaw ko pa rin pangunahan sila until they say so.
english: But I still don't want to lead them until they say so.

text: For the meantime, I’m always hopeful,” suno sa 47-anyos nga presidential aspirant.
english: For the meantime, I’m always hopeful,” the 47-year-old presidential aspirant said.

text: Magapalapit bala siya sa kampo ni Go ukon kampo ni Duterte?
english: Will he approach Go's camp or Duterte's camp?

text: “Antayin ko na kursonadahin nila ako,” sabat sang alkalde.
english: “I'll wait for them to court me,” the mayor replied.

text: Si Senator Panfilo ‘Ping’ Lacson ayhan?
english: Senator Panfilo ‘Ping’ Lacson perhaps?

text: Mabudlay sabton suno kay Lacson kun handa siya nga mangin kandidato sang administrasyon.
english: Lacson said it is difficult to answer if he is ready to be the administration's candidate.

text:
“But definitely, we will not seek endorsement because it’s too presumptuous on our part.”

Si Senator Manny Pacquiao ayhan, anay kaalyado ni Duterte nga sang tinalikdan nga mga bulan, nangin kasumpong na niya sa word war?
english:
“But definitely, we will not seek endorsement because it’s too presumptuous on our part.”

Senator Manny Pacquiao, a former ally of Duterte who in recent months, has become his opponent in the word war?

text: “Kung ie-endorso ako, walang problema.
english: “If I am endorsed, no problem.

text: Pagkakaisa naman ang isinusulong natin kasi biblical naman yan eh.
english: We are promoting unity because it is biblical.

text: ‘[If] a kingdom is divided against themselves, that kingdom cannot stand.
english: ‘[If] a kingdom is divided against themselves, that kingdom cannot stand.

text: If a house is divided, that house cannot stand,'” suno sa boxer-turned-senator.
english: If a house is divided, that house cannot stand,'” according to the boxer-turned-senator.

text: Ginahulat pa kun ano ang mangin reaksyon sang kampo ni presidential aspirant Bongbong Marcos.
english: The reaction of the camp of presidential aspirant Bongbong Marcos is still awaited.

text: Si Marcos, standard bearer sang PFP, amo ang running-mate sang presidential daughter nga si Sara Duterte-Carpio.
english: Marcos, standard bearer of the PFP, is the running-mate of presidential daughter Sara Duterte-Carpio.

text: Ginakuha man ang iban nga statement sang iban pa nga presidential aspirants.
english: Other statements of other presidential aspirants are also being taken.

text: Nagkampyon ang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala kag iya partner nga si Estelle Cascino sang France sa women’s doubles sa International Tennis Federation (ITF) Women’s 100 Tennis Tournament sa Vitoria-Gasteiz, Spain.
english: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala and her partner Estelle Cascino of France won the women’s doubles at the International Tennis Federation (ITF) Women’s 100 Tennis Tournament in Vitoria-Gasteiz, Spain.

text: Ginlutos sang Pinay kag French players ang pares nga sanday Lia Karatancheva sang Bulgaria kag Diana Marcinkevica sang Latvia sa tatlo ka sets sa finals, 6-3, 2-6, 10-4.
english: The Filipina and French players defeated the pair of Lia Karatancheva of Bulgaria and Diana Marcinkevica of Latvia in three sets in the finals, 6-3, 2-6, 10-4.

text: Na-domina nanday Eala ang first set, naglagbong ang performance sa ikaduha nga set, apang naka-recover kag gintapos ang hampang sa extra frame.
english: Eala dominated the first set, performed in the second set, but recovered and finished the match in the extra frame.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga tion nga ang Filipino-French tennis pair ang nagdaog sang doubles title matapos nakuha man ang korona sa ITF Open 3C Seine-et-Marne women’s doubles tournament sa France sang nagligad nga Marso.
english: This is the second time that the Filipino-French tennis pair has won the doubles title after also winning the crown in the ITF Open 3C Seine-et-Marne women’s doubles tournament in France last March.

text: Ini man ang ikatatlo nga doubles title ni Eala subong nga tuig matapos nadag-an man ang Nuc-Deccan Women’s Doubles Tournament sa Pune, India kaupod sa iya Latvian partner nga si Darja Semenistaja.
english: This is also Eala's third doubles title this year after she also won the Nuc-Deccan Women's Doubles Tournament in Pune, India with her Latvian partner Darja Semenistaja.

text: Gintaban sang mga kawatan ang masobra sa 30 laptops sa sulod sang isa ka faculty room sa Manila.
english: Thieves stole more than 30 laptops from a faculty room in Manila.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, sa kasagsagan sang suspensyon sang klase, ginsulod sang tatlo ka mga lalaki kag duha ka solterito ang amo nga eskwelahan.
english: According to the investigation, during the suspension of classes, three men and two boys entered the school.

text: Ang nasambit nga laptops ang halin sa Department of Education (DepEd) kag ang duha ang personal nga laptop sang mga manunudlo.
english: The laptops are from the Department of Education (DepEd) and the two are personal laptops of the teachers.

text: Sa pag-imbestigar sang otoridad, nakit-an ang guba nga door knob sang faculty room kag buho sa pader sa likod sang buluthuan.
english: During the investigation, the authorities found a broken door knob of the faculty room and a hole in the wall behind the school.

text: Maswerte naman nga may barangay tanod nga nakakita sa mga suspek nga may dala nga mga sako kag sang iya ginsita, nagpalagyo ang mga ini.
english: Fortunately, a barangay tanod saw the suspects carrying sacks and when he arrested them, they fled.

text: Sa follow-up operations, nadakpan ang mga suspek nga nagaedad 19 tubtob 35 samtang sa separado nga operasyon, nadakpan ang mga menor de edad nga 15 kag 17-anyos.
english: In follow-up operations, the suspects aged 19 to 35 were arrested while in a separate operation, minors aged 15 and 17 were arrested.

text: Sa ginkawat nga laptops, pito pa lang ang narekober.
english: Of the stolen laptops, only seven have been recovered.

text: Ginpunto ni Bicol Saro Rep.
english: Bicol One Rep.

text: Terry Ridon nga nakabase sa facts, ebidensya kag prinsipyo ang impeachment kag pagadumalahan sang House ang mandato sini sa oras gna may verified complaints batok sa bisan sin-o man nga impeachable officer.
english: Terry Ridon said impeachment is based on facts, evidence and principles and the House will carry out its mandate when there are verified complaints against any impeachable officer.

text: Sa isa ka pahayag, ginsiling niya nga ginahulat na lang sang Kamara ang desisyon sang Supreme Court sa ila Motion for Reconsideration angot sa nauna nga impeachment proceedings batok kay Vice Pres.
english: In a statement, he said the House is awaiting the Supreme Court's decision on its Motion for Reconsideration regarding the previous impeachment proceedings against Vice Pres.

text: Sara Duterte.
english: Sara Duterte.

text: Kasunod ini sang akusasyon sang Bise Presidente na ginagamit kuno ang bag-o nga impeachment complaint nga plano nga i-file batok sa iya bilang “bargaining chip” antes masumiter ang 2026 national budget.
english: This follows the Vice President's accusation that the new impeachment complaint planned to be filed against him is being used as a bargaining chip before the 2026 national budget is submitted.

text: “If the [Motion for Reconsideration] is resolved in favor of the House, the impeachment will proceed to trial in the Senate.
english: “If the [Motion for Reconsideration] is resolved in favor of the House, the impeachment will proceed to trial in the Senate.

text: If resolved against the House, a new complaint may be filed against the Vice President in February, under the new Supreme Court impeachment guidelines,” pahayag ni Ridon.
english: If resolved against the House, a new complaint may be filed against the Vice President in February, under the new Supreme Court impeachment guidelines,” Ridon said.

text: Anum ka bulan na nga nagabusong ang model nga si Hailey Bieber sang ila mangin subang nga anak sang iya bana nga si Justin Bieber!
english: Model Hailey Bieber is six months pregnant with her husband Justin Bieber's youngest child!

text: Pareho man nga ginkumpirma sang mag-asawa ini nga maayo nga balita paagi sa ila nga Instagram pages.
english: Both couples also confirmed the good news through their Instagram pages.

text: Lakip diri ang short kag romantic video clip kun sa diin nakit-an sila nga naga-kiss samtang kit-anon ang baby bump ni Hailey.
english: This includes a short and romantic video clip where they are seen kissing while looking at Hailey's baby bump.

text: Ginsundan ini sang photo shoot kun sa diin si Justin ang naga-picture sa iya asawa.
english: This was followed by a photo shoot where Justin took pictures with his wife.

text: Ginpahayag nga ini nga video kag photoshoot ang kuha sa vow renewal ceremony sang celebrity couple sa Hawaii.
english: The video and photoshoot were reportedly taken at the celebrity couple's vow renewal ceremony in Hawaii.

text: 2018 sang ginkumpirma sang Biebers ang ila pagpakasal.
english: 2018 when the Biebers confirmed their engagement.

text: Si Hailey —anak sang aktor nga si Stephen Baldwin—ang isa man ka founder sang skincare line nga Rhode.
english: Hailey —daughter of actor Stephen Baldwin—is also a founder of skincare line Rhode.

text: Isa naman ka Canadian si Justin nga na-diskubre bilang singer sa edad nga 13 kag labi pa nga nagsikat, nangin pop sensation, kag nangin Grammy winner nga may eight No.
english: Justin is a Canadian who was discovered as a singer at the age of 13 and became even more famous, became a pop sensation, and became a Grammy winner with eight No.

text: 1 songs sa iya belt lakip ang “Sorry,” “Love Yourself,” “What Do You Mean?” kag “Despacito.” Ang iya katapusan nga album nga “Justice” ang napaguwa sang 2021.
english: 1 songs on his belt including “Sorry,” “Love Yourself,” “What Do You Mean?” and “Despacito.” His last album “Justice” was released in 2021.

text: Gina-respeto sang partido nga Pederalismo ng Dugong Dakilang Samahan (PDDS) ang desisyon sang standard-bearer sini nga si Senator Christopher “Bong” Go nga mag-isol sa presidential race sa 2022 national and local elections.
english: The Federalist Party (PDDS) respects the decision of its standard-bearer Senator Christopher “Bong” Go to withdraw from the presidential race in the 2022 national and local elections.

text: “Yan po ang naging desisyon niya.
english: “That's what he decided.

text: And we have to respect it,” suno kay former Presidential Anti-Crime Commissioner (PACC) Greco Belgica, isa ka senatorial aspirant sa idalom sang PDDS.
english: And we have to respect it,” said former Presidential Anti-Crime Commissioner (PACC) Greco Belgica, a senatorial aspirant under the PDDS.

text: Si Grepor “Butch” Belgica, amay ni Belgica kag isa ka ex-convict turned Christian preacher, ang founder sang PDDS.
english: Grepor “Butch” Belgica, Belgica’s father and an ex-convict turned Christian preacher, is the founder of PDDS.

text: Accredited ini sang Comelec bilang national political party.
english: It is accredited by the Comelec as a national political party.

text: Suno sa senatorial aspirant, magasapol pa ang PDDS agud nga istoryahan kun ano ang mangin masunod nga tikang sang partido.
english: According to the senatorial aspirant, the PDDS will meet to discuss the next steps of the party.

text: Magatambong sa discussion sanday President Rodrigo Duterte kag si Go.
english: President Rodrigo Duterte and Go.

text: “Mag-uusap pa kami sa parido para tahakin ang susunod naming hakbang kasama ang Pangulo at si Sen.
english: “We will continue to discuss our next steps with the President and Sen.

text: Bong Go,” suno kay Belgica.
english: Bong Go,” according to Belgica.

text: Kun kaisa imo mapaminsaran nga daw kaangay nga weird na ang iban nga mga pagkaon bangud sa mga kombinasyon sini.
english: Sometimes you think that some foods are weird because of their combinations.

text: Sin-o bala ang magdumdom nga halin sa pizza nga ang toppings amo lamang ang ham kag pineapple, apang sa subong may yara na sang nagkalain-lain nga sahi sang pizza.
english: Who would have thought that from pizza where the only toppings were ham and pineapple, but nowadays there are different types of pizza.

text: May yara sang cookies ‘n creme pizza, talaba pizza kag shrimp pizza.
english: Cookies ‘n creme pizza, oyster pizza and shrimp pizza are available.

text: Kun pie naman ang aton istoryahan, indi na kita maglayo pa bangud paborito sang kadam-an ang buko pie kag egg pie.
english: When it comes to pie, let's not go too far because buko pie and egg pie are favorites.

text: Apang mangin paborito mo man ayhan ang ini nga pie kun imo na matilawan?
english: But will this pie be your favorite once you taste it?

text: Ini ang ginatawag nga “Stargazy Pie”.
english: This is called “Stargazy Pie”.

text: Pinasahi na naman nga pagkaon nga makapataas sang imo nga kilay.
english: Another unique dish that will raise your eyebrows.

text: Ang ini nga pie ang may yara man lang sang ulo kag ikog sang isda nga nakatungtong mismo sa ibabaw sang pie.
english: This pie also only has the head and tail of the fish perched right on top of the pie.

text: Ang England ang kilala sa mga nagkalain-lain nga pies humalin sa apple pie tubtob sa pork pie.
english: England is known for its variety of pies from apple pie to pork pie.

text: Madamo ang nagpa “wow” sa sini nga Stargazy Pie — sin-o bala ang magdumdom nga ang ulo kag ikog gali sang isda ang mahimo nga kombinasyon sa pie?
english: This Stargazy Pie made many go “wow” — who would have thought that it was actually the head and tail of the fish that could be the combination in the pie?

text: Nagkalain-lain man nga isda ang mahimo nga ibutang sa pie sa diin may yara ini sang lemon , herb kag mashed potato .
english: A variety of fish can also be stuffed into the pie where it contains lemon , herb and mashed potato .

text: Gani ikaw kun prito kag pinaksiwan lang ang imo nahibaluan nga lutuon, try mo naman ang ini nga stargazy pie.
english: So if you only know how to cook fried and pinaksiwan, try this stargazy pie.

text: Nagsaka pa sa 7-0 ang malimpyo nga record sang Strong Group- Pilipinas sa 2024 William Jones Cup matapos sini gintambakan sang puntos ang Chinese Taipei-White, 96-70.
english: Strong Group-Philippines' clean record in the 2024 William Jones Cup rose to 7-0 after it beat Chinese Taipei-White, 96-70.

text: Nagpanguna sa team ang import nga si Chris McCullough nga may 25 points sa 10-of-13 free throw shooting, samtang ang veteran guard naman nga si Kiefer Ravena ang may yara sang 14 points.
english: Import Chris McCullough led the team with 25 points on 10-of-13 free throw shooting, while veteran guard Kiefer Ravena had 14 points.

text: Sa imbukada pa lang sang sambuwa, natilawan na sang kasumpong kun ano ka-seryoso ang Pilipinas nga mapadayon ang 20-5 nga lead apisar wala ang pila sa key players kaangay kanday Filipino center Ange Kouame, import Tajuan Agee, kag Gilas Pilipinas high-flyer nga si Rhenz Abando.
english: Early in the match, the opponent tasted how serious the Philippines was to maintain a 20-5 lead despite the absence of some key players such as Filipino center Ange Kouame, import Tajuan Agee, and Gilas Pilipinas high-flyer Rhenz Abando.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga hampang, wala man ang bisan sin-o nga naghampang sa tatlo ka players bangud sa injury kag pagmasakit apang ginlutos gihapon sang Strong Group-Pilipinas ang Japan U22.
english: It can be recalled that in the previous match, none of the three players played due to injury and illness but Strong Group-Philippines still defeated Japan U22.

text: Karon sa gab-i atubangon sang Pilipinas ang isa man ka undefeated team nga Chinese Taipei-A kag amo na lamang ang nabilin nga nagabalabag sa Strong Group nga mabulsa ang kampyonato sa Jones Cup subong nga tuig.
english: Tonight, the Philippines will face another undefeated team, Chinese Taipei-A, and that is the only thing left that prevents the Strong Group from pocketing the Jones Cup championship this year.
