text: Makasarang ka bala nga magtinir sang madugay nga oras sa isa ka lugar nga tuman ka-tugnaw?
english: Can you afford to spend long hours in a very cold place?

text: Sa matugnaw nga panahon sa Hubei Province sa China, ginlagas sang mga kapulisan ang isa ka lalaki nga kawatan sa syudad sang Ezhou.
english: In the cold weather in China's Hubei Province, police chased a male thief in the city of Ezhou.

text: Plano kuntani magpalagyo sang kawatan sa diin nag-agi ini sa bintana sang isa ka building apang bangud nga wala ini sang bayo nga nasuksok kag sa tuman nga katugnaw nga iya nabatyagan, wala na niya matinguhaan pa nga malagyo kag halos indi na ini makahulag pa samtang nagakabit sa salsalon.
english: The thief was planning to escape through the window of a building but because he was naked and very cold, he could not try to escape and could hardly move while clinging to the iron.

text: Nagtawag ang mga pulis sang bombero agud nga ma-rescue ang kawatan.
english: The police called the fire department to rescue the thief.

text: Samtang nagakabit ini sa salsalon, nangin emosyonal ang kawatan kag nagpahayag nga masungka na lang ini sa kapulisan bangud indi na niya maagwantahan ang katugnaw ilabi na nga wala ini sang bayo nga suksok.
english: While hanging from the iron, the thief became emotional and said he would surrender to the police because he could not stand the cold especially since he was not wearing clothes.

text: Gilayon nga nag-abot ang mga bombero kag ginhaboyan ang lalaki sang higot agud nga ini siya ang mabutong pasaka balik kag didto nga nasalbar ang kawatan.
english: Firefighters immediately arrived and threw a rope at the man so that he could be pulled back up and the thief was saved.

text: Nagbyahe na padulong sa Paris, France ang delegasyon nga amo ang magatiglawas sang North Korea sa 2024 Olympic Games.
english: The delegation that will represent North Korea at the 2024 Olympic Games has left for Paris, France.

text: Masinadyahon ang North Korean athletes sang nagpa-picture ang mga ini sa airport sa Pyongyang samtang suksok ang puti nga blazers kun sa diin nakabutang ang ila nga national flag kag badge nga naga-feature sang ila anay mga lider.
english: The North Korean athletes were cheerful when they posed for pictures at the airport in Pyongyang wearing white blazers with their national flag and badges featuring their former leaders.

text: 16 ka atleta halin sa amo nga pungsod ang maga-compete sa pito ka Olympic events lakip na ang boxing kag table tennis.
english: 16 athletes from that country will compete in seven Olympic events including boxing and table tennis.

text: Kaupod sang mga atleta ang North Korean culture and sports minister nga si Kim Il Guk.
english: The athletes were accompanied by North Korean culture and sports minister Kim Il Guk.

text: Matandaan nga sang 2020 Olympics sa Japan, wala nagpadala sang delegasyon ang North Korea bangud sa kahangawa sa pandemya samtang sa 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics naman, gin-ban sila sa pagtambong.
english: It can be recalled that during the 2020 Olympics in Japan, North Korea did not send a delegation due to concerns about the pandemic while in the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics, they were banned from attending.

text: Matandaan nga nakakuha ang North sang duha ka gold medals sa Rio Olympics sang 2016 nga amo ang katapusan nga tion nga nakapasakop ini sa Summer Games.
english: It can be recalled that the North won two gold medals at the Rio Olympics in 2016 which was the last time it participated in the Summer Games.

text: Nagsugata sa mga motorista ang oil price hike sa una nga adlaw sang Oktubre.
english: Motorists were greeted by the oil price hike on the first day of October.

text:
Santo sa oil industry sources, yari ang ginalauman nga pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong:

Gasoline -P0.45/LiterDiesel – P0.90/LiterKerosene – P0.30/Liter

Suno sa Department of Energy, ang nagalala nga gyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Hezbollah sa Lebanon ang nakita nga rason sa pagtaas sang presyo sang mga produktong petrolyo.
english:
According to oil industry sources, here are the expected increases in fuel prices:

Gasoline -P0.45/LiterDiesel – P0.90/Liter Kerosene – P0.30/Liter

According to the Department of Energy, the escalating war between Israel and Hezbollah in Lebanon was seen as the reason for the increase in the price of petroleum products.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini na ang ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga semana nga ginpatuman ang oil price hike.
english: This is the second consecutive week that the oil price hike has been implemented.

text: Nagpasaka sang cyber libel complaint ang mag-asawa nga sanday Sharon Cuneta kag former senator Kiko Pangilinan batok sa showbiz talk show host nga si Cristy Fermin.
english: Sharon Cuneta and former senator Kiko Pangilinan have filed a cyber libel complaint against showbiz talk show host Cristy Fermin.

text: Sa reklamo sang duha sa Makati City Prosecutor’s Office, nakasaad nga nangin subject sila sang “humiliation and ridicule” matapos nagpalapta si Fermin sang malisyoso nga mga pahayag batok sa ila.
english: In the complaint of the two to the Makati City Prosecutor's Office, it is stated that they were subjected to “humiliation and ridicule” after Fermin spread malicious statements against them.

text:
Suno pa sa mga abogado nanday Sharon kag Kiko, madugay nga naghipos ang mag-asawa apang bangud sa padayon nga pagpang-atake online sa ila nga pamilya, indi na nila ini mabaton kag kinahanglan na nga pasabton ang showbiz host sa sini nga “criminal behavior.”

Nahibaluan naman ni Fermin ini nga cyber libel complaint batok sa iya kag ginsiling man nga nahangpan sini kun ano ang balatyagon nanday Sharon kag Kiko.
english:
According to Sharon and Kiko's lawyers, the couple remained silent for a long time but due to the continuous online attacks on their family, they can no longer accept it and the showbiz host must be held accountable for this “criminal behavior.”

Fermin said he was aware of the cyber libel complaint against him and said he understood how Sharon and Kiko felt.

text: Ginpaathag man sini nga kabahin na ini sang iya trabaho.
english: He also explained that it was part of his job.

text: “Talagang tumataas ang mga libel, ng mga demandahan.
english: “The libels, the lawsuits are really going up.

text: From Sarah Lahbati, to Bea Alonzo, Sharon Cuneta na ang kasunod.
english: From Sarah Lahbati, to Bea Alonzo, Sharon Cuneta is the next.

text: Sino po kaya ang susunod, si Julia Roberts na?
english: Who's next, Julia Roberts?

text: Basta, naiintindihan natin kung saan sila nagmumula.
english: It's just, we understand where they're blushing.

text: Wala pa po ako masasabi.
english: I don't have anything to say yet.

text: Wala pa kaming impormasyon na tinatanggap, basta naiintindihan natin ito.
english: We have not yet received information, as long as we understand it.

text: Kasama po ‘yan sa trabaho natin bilang mamamahayag,” suno sa host.
english: That's part of our job as journalists,” the host said.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga semana, nagpasaka man si Bea Alonzo sang cyber libel complaints batok kay Fermin, Ogie Diaz, kag sa ila program co-hosts.
english: Last week, Bea Alonzo also filed cyber libel complaints against Fermin, Ogie Diaz, and their program co-hosts.

text: Gin-cite ni Alonzo sa iya nga complaint affidavit nga gindala nanday Diaz kag Fermin sa ila talk show ang “baseless, false and damaging information” kaangot sa aktres.#
english: Alonzo cited in his complaint affidavit that Diaz and Fermin brought “baseless, false and damaging information” about the actress to their talk show.

text: Lain ang senaryo nga lauman kun madesisyunan sang Korte Suprema nga i-disqualify si presidential aspirant Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr antes ang eleksyon kag lain man ang senaryo kun hinali nga mag-guwa ang desisyon pagkatapos sang eleksyon.
english: The scenario is different if the Supreme Court decides to disqualify presidential aspirant Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos, Jr. before the election and the scenario is different if the decision suddenly comes out after the election.

text: Lakip ini sa mga ginkonsiderar matapos nga lima ka disqualification cases ang gin-file sa Comission on Elections (Comelec) agud balabagan ang kandidatura ni Marcos sa pagka-presidente sa 2022 elections.
english: This is among the considerations after five disqualification cases were filed with the Commission on Elections (Comelec) to block Marcos' candidacy for president in the 2022 elections.

text: May yara sang naga-claim nga ang COC ni Marcos ang naga-unod sang multiple false material representations — butang nga gintawag sang kampo ni Marcos nga predictable nuisance petition.
english: There are those who claim that Marcos' COC contains multiple false material representations — something the Marcos camp has called a predictable nuisance petition.

text: May yara man sang petition nga gin-file agud kabigon si BBM bilang nuisance candidate — butang kun sa diin nag-file man ang kampo ni Marcos sang counter case.
english: A petition was also filed to consider BBM as a nuisance candidate — something to which the Marcos camp also filed a counter case.

text: May naga-claim man nga napatay na ang matuod nga BBM kag ginaalegar nga impostor lang ang BBM nga nag-file sang COC sa pagka-presidente.
english: There are also claims that the real BBM is dead and it is alleged that the BBM who filed his COC for the presidency is an imposter.

text:
Kun basehan ang dalagan sang mga kaso sa Pilipinas, ginapanan-aw nga basi kun mapatigayon na ang eleksyon kag wala pa ang desisyon sang Comelec bangud may yara pa sang “pending issues nga kinahanglan i-resolve.”

Suno kay Atty. Nelson Borja, isa ka criminal law expert, pat-od nga ipasaka ini nga petitions sa Korte Suprema kag hulaton ang ‘decision with finality’.
english:
Based on the course of cases in the Philippines, it is expected that the election may be held and the Comelec has not yet made a decision because there are still “pending issues that need to be resolved.”

According to Atty. Nelson Borja, a criminal law expert, will definitely file these petitions in the Supreme Court and wait for the 'decision with finality'.

text:
Kun ma-disqualify si Marcos antes ang eleksyon, yari ang matabo suno kay Borja:

– Kinahanglan ang replacement sa iya kandidatura sa pagka-presidente apang dapat nga ka-apelyido niya ang mabulos; kag

– Sa idalom sang Comelec rules, pwede nga maka-replace ang isa ka kandidato tubtub sa mid-day sang election, buot silingon, tubtub sa udto sang Mayo 9, 2022

Samtang, kun halimbawa, magdaog si Marcos, na-eleher bilang presidente, apang na-guwa ang desisyon sang Korte nga disqualified siya sa posisyon, yari ang matabo:

– Kinahanglan nga mag-step down si Marcos sa pagka-presidente; – Ma-take over sa pagka-presidente ang magadaug nga bise-presidente; kag,

– Sa idalom sang Konstitusyon, ang magabulos sa pagka-bise presidente amo ang Senate President
english:
If Marcos is disqualified before the election, here's what will happen, Borja said:

– A replacement is required for his presidential candidacy but the replacement must be of his surname; and

– Under Comelec rules, a candidate can replace until mid-day of the election, that is, until noon on May 9, 2022

Meanwhile, if, for example, Marcos wins, is elected president, but the Court rules that he is disqualified from office, here is what happens:

– Marcos needs to step down from the presidency; – The winning vice-president will take over as president; and,

– Under the Constitution, the successor to the vice presidency is the Senate President

text: Sa tunga sang mas nagasako nga pagpanghanda para sa Miss Universe Philippines competition, isa pa ka daku nga kadalag-an ang ginselebrar sang Ilongga beauty queen nga si Alexie Brooks — ang paggradwar sa kolehiyo!
english: In the midst of busier preparations for the Miss Universe Philippines competition, Ilongga beauty queen Alexie Brooks celebrated another big achievement — graduating from college!

text: Ginpakigbahin sini ang pictures kun sa diin nakasuksok siya sang toga kag bitbit na ang diploma matapos nakuha ang degree nga Business Administration halin sa National University Philippines – Manila.
english: He shared pictures where he was wearing a toga and carrying a diploma after getting a degree in Business Administration from the National University Philippines - Manila.

text: Isa man ka makatalandog-balatyagon nga mensahe ang gin-share sini sa isa ka Facebook post kun sa diin ginplastar sini ang mga pagpanghangkat nga naagyan agud nga matapos ang iya edukasyon.
english: He also shared a touching message in a Facebook post where he laid out the challenges he faced to complete his education.

text: “With aspirations as seemingly endless as the horizon, I carried the hopes of my small town on my shoulders since I was young.
english: “With aspirations as seemingly endless as the horizon, I carried the hopes of my small town on my shoulders since I was young.

text: I emerged from the shadows of a broken home and found a path to a collegiate education, thanks to the gift and talent of sports,” pahayag ni Brooks.
english: I emerged from the shadows of a broken home and found a path to a collegiate education, thanks to the gift and talent of sports,” stated Brooks.

text: Ginpasalamatan sini ang iya Lola kag Tiya nga nagbulig sa iya amo man ang nangin kabahin sang iya banas: iya pamilya, mga abyan, mentors, teammates, kag ang Ginuo.
english: He thanked his Grandmother and Aunt who helped him as well as being a part of his path: his family, friends, mentors, teammates, and the Lord.

text:
“This is merely the prologue, a testament to the indomitable spirit fueled by determination, dedication, discipline, and dreams that span the infinite expanse of the universe,” kabahin pa sang iya post nga “What You Think, You Become.”

Isa si Brooks sa pinakamatunog nga pangalan sa Miss Universe Philippines 2024 competition.
english:
“This is merely the prologue, a testament to the indomitable spirit fueled by determination, dedication, discipline, and dreams that span the infinite expanse of the universe,” he said in part in his post “What You Think, You Become.”

Brooks is one of the loudest names in the Miss Universe Philippines 2024 competition.

text: Sulod ini sa Top 5 finalists sa Swimsuit Challenge, Top 5 sang Up Close and Personal Interview Challenge, kag nalakip sa Top 3 sang Best in National Costume.
english: She was among the Top 5 finalists in the Swimsuit Challenge, Top 5 of the Up Close and Personal Interview Challenge, and was included in the Top 3 of Best in National Costume.

text: Patigayunon ang coronation night sang Miss Universe Philippines sa Mayo 22 sa Mall of Asia Arena kun sa diin igapasa ni reigning queen Michelle Dee ang korona sa iya successor nga amo ang magatiglawas sang Pilipinas sa international pageant sa Mexico.#
english: The coronation night of Miss Universe Philippines will be held on May 22 at the Mall of Asia Arena where reigning queen Michelle Dee will hand over the crown to her successor who will represent the Philippines in the international pageant in Mexico.

text: Pareho na nga naghatag sang kumpirmasyon sanday presidential aspirant Bongbong Marcos kag vice-presidential aspirant Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte Carpio sang ila tandem sa 2022 elections.
english: Presidential aspirant Bongbong Marcos and vice-presidential aspirant Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte Carpio have both confirmed their tandem for the 2022 elections.

text:
Suno kay Marcos, “Naitawid na namin ni Mayor Inday Sara Duterte ang proseso para sa tambalang inaasam-asam ng aming mga taga-suporta—ang BBM-SARA sa 2022.”

Si Marcos ang standard bearer sang Partido Federal ng Pilipinas (PFP) samtang si Sara naman ang vice presidential nominee sang Lakas-CMD.
english:
According to Marcos, “Mayor Inday Sara Duterte and I have crossed the process for the medicine that our supporters are waiting for—the BBM-SARA in 2022.”

Marcos is the standard bearer of Partido Federal ng Pilipinas (PFP) while Sara is the vice presidential nominee of Lakas-CMD.

text: Antes ang pahayag halin kay Marcos, una na nga nakapagwa sang video statement si Sara: “Ang aking partido ay nakipag-alyansa at humingi ng suporta para kay Bongbong Marcos at para sa akin matapos kong tanggapin ang inyong hamon at panawagan.”##
english: Before the statement from Marcos, Sara had already released a video statement: “My party has formed an alliance and expressed its support for Bongbong Marcos and for me after I accepted your challenge and call.”##

text: Gina-kwestyon sang Association of Taxi Operators of Panay (ATOP) kag United Taxi Operators of Panay (UTOP) ang pag-operate sang mga Blue Taxi sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: The Association of Taxi Operators of Panay (ATOP) and United Taxi Operators of Panay (UTOP) are questioning the operation of Blue Taxis in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rodrigo Baculado, operation supervisor sang ATOP, iya ginpahayag nga nagalain gid ang ila buot bangud wala pa sang clearance nga nagapahanugot para sa Blue taxi agud mag operate, kag wala sang ebidensiya nga may nagapakita nga may ginproseso ang mga ini nga mga papeles.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rodrigo Baculado, operation supervisor of ATOP, said they are very upset because there is no clearance that allows the Blue taxi to operate, and there is no evidence that these documents have been processed.

text: Dugang pa sini nga ang mga Blue Taxi ang bag-o pa lamang sa siyudad, apang daw kaangay nga sila pa ang mayor, gani nagapangayo ang mga ini sang patas nga pagtratar sa pareho nila nga mga Taxi Operators.
english: He added that the Blue Taxis are new to the city, but it seems that they are still the main ones, so they are asking for fair treatment from their fellow Taxi Operators.

text: Sa separado naman nga interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Marie Joy Celis, C-GOP Taxi Inc., iya ginapanawagan sa mga otoridad ang pagpatuman sang patas nga layi sa tanan nga mga taxi company ilabi na sa kumpanya sang Blue Tax, kun sa diin apektado ang mga ini sang regulasyon sang LTFRB, apang ila nabatyagan ang indi patas nga pagtratar sa ila.
english: In a separate interview with Bombo Radyo, Marie Joy Celis, C-GOP Taxi Inc., called on the authorities to implement fair laws for all taxi companies especially the Blue Tax company, where they are affected by the regulations of the LTFRB, but they feel unfair treatment.

text: Ginklaro man niya nga wala nila ginabalagan ang pagsulod sang blue taxi, apang kun tani magsunod lang sa insakto nga proseso kag layi bangud nga sila man mismo ang nag-agi sa legal nga proseso.
english: He also clarified that they are not blocking the entry of blue taxis, but should follow the proper process and law because they themselves went through the legal process.

text: Gin-abisohan ni anay Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque si Sen.
english: Former Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque warned Sen.

text: Ronald Dela Rosa nga magpangayo sang sanctuary sa Supreme Court.
english: Ronald Dela Rosa to seek sanctuary in the Supreme Court.

text: Subong nga adlaw ginsiling ni Roque nga may yara sang warrant of arrest batok kay Dela Rosa.
english: Today, Roque said there is a warrant of arrest against Dela Rosa.

text: Apisar nga wala niya ginbuyagyag nga halin ini sa International Criminal Court (ICC), ginhambalan niya ang anay Philippine National Police (PNP) chief nga indi magpa-kidnap.
english: Although he did not disclose that it was from the International Criminal Court (ICC), he told the former Philippine National Police (PNP) chief not to get kidnapped.

text: Sa masunod nga post ni Roque, gin-abisohan niya si Dela Rosa nga ‘mag-posas na lang siya sa sulod sang prisohan, ilabi na sa Supreme Court’.
english: In Roque's next post, he advised Dela Rosa to 'stay handcuffed inside the jail, especially in the Supreme Court'

text: Sa subong, wala pa masiguro ang impormasyon kun sa diin si Sen.
english: At present, the information on the whereabouts of Sen.
